10.name: Denny
10.desc: The legal currency in New Eridu. Can be used to purchase various items.
10.desc2: While there are Denny notes available in larger denominations, many still prefer coins. After all, who doesn't love a hefty purse?

100.name: Polychrome
100.desc: While each film captures only one single color, when layered together, they produce vibrant, multicolored images.
100.desc2: Colored images bring your memories back to life. Some buyers are willing to trade anything for such a rare find.

101.name: Monochrome
101.desc: Commonly used in antique cameras, this photographic film will reveal an image after being developed.
101.desc2: Given its potential to have captured a picture of the old civilization before the Hollow disasters, it holds significant value for some collectors.

110.name: Master Tape
110.desc: Required item for Signal Searches on Stable Channel.
110.desc2: This medium can be used to convert audio band signals into visual information. Video store operators may find master tapes to be the most suitable option for maintaining confidentiality.

111.name: Encrypted Master Tape
111.desc: Required item for Signal Searches on Exclusive and W-Engine Channels.
111.desc2: This medium can be used to convert band signals of specific frequency into visual information, providing an increased level of encrypted security.

112.name: Boopon
112.desc: Required item for Signal Searches on Bangboo Channel.
112.desc2: A coupon for the Bangboo repair and cleaning service issued by the Marcel Group. You can order Bangboo to provide various services for you with this coupon.

115.name: Residual Signal
115.desc: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Signal Shop.
115.desc2: During the signal search process, it is possible to capture Residual Signals that are too fragmented to be analyzed on their own. However, by recording and combining these Residual Signals, you may extract valuable information from them.

116.name: Bangbuck
116.desc: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Signal Shop.
116.desc2: Token issued by the Marcel Group. Can be used to purchase Bangboo-related accessories.

117.name: Fading Signal
117.desc: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Signal Shop.
117.desc2: When converting Signals, fragments of residual echoes are collected, resembling murmurs, making it difficult to distinguish their meanings. Even though recording and assembling them can be very difficult, if achievable, some additional information can still be extracted from them.

118.name: Z-Merits
118.desc: Used for purchasing valuable items in Outpost Logistics
118.desc2: Among investigators, there's a lot of insider lingo, and "you can earn Z-Merits" is the most unique one. It could be a joke on rookies, a threat to juniors, admiration for seniors, or a curse on troublemakers... Because there's only one way to earn Z-Merits — participating in the investigation of Hollow Zero...

119.name: Investigation Merits
119.desc: Used for purchasing valuable items in Association Supplies.
119.desc2: Hollows are practical disasters, and won't become any less dangerous due to your rank, social status, or wealth. Survival depends on skill (and luck). That's why the Hollow Investigative Association's investigator assessments are also practical. So long as you can complete a dangerous Investigation mission, you can obtain merits and with merits, you'll naturally be able to obtain rewards.

120.name: "Inspiration" Small Pack
120.desc: Can be exchanged for decorations at the Sān-Z STUDIO.
120.desc2: Yi's Studio doesn't charge Dennies. If you want to take his creations, you'll need to offer something interesting in return... like a small pinch of "inspiration" picked up from life?

121.name: Red Bean Bun Token
121.desc:
Obtain from the limited-time event "Moonlight Traces."
Used to redeem special rewards in the event.
121.desc2: Red bean bags are the best daily commute companions!

122.name: Duel Arena Token
122.desc:
Obtain from the limited-time event "The Champion."
Used to redeem special rewards in the event.
122.desc2: Under the victor's crown lie endless scars.

123.name: Memory Shard
123.desc:
Obtain from the limited-time event "Windchaser Harumasa."
Used to redeem special rewards in the event.
123.desc2: That is the scar after the wound healed, it is the badge of all his past experiences.

124.name: Popularity Carrot
124.desc2: Someone once asked Joyous why he called the Hollow route data "Carrot." He replied, "Why not ask that woman why she made those machines look like rabbits?"

125.name: Video Game Festival Coupon
125.desc: A limited-time voucher obtained in the "Godfinger Ultimate Showdown" event. Can be used to exchange for rewards during the event.
125.desc2: Stacking up a ton of coupons doesn't always mean you're a gaming pro, but it sure shows how little sleep you got during the "Urban Video Game Festival."

126.name: Used Battery
126.desc: Obtained after consuming any amount of Battery Charge for the first time each day during the 141 Eco-Art Exhibition event. Used to exchange for rewards at Sjal's booth in Failume Heights.
126.desc2: To implement the environmental protection campaign, Buy, Ask, and Give Change's average daily step count has exceeded thirty thousand — please take out your used batteries and help save these Bangboo!

127.name: Astra Yao's Event Token
127.desc: Earned by participating in the limited-time event [OVA Event]. Can be used to redeem special rewards during the event.
127.desc2: Astra Yao's Event Token Story Description

128.name: Ellen's Event Token
128.desc: Earned by participating in the limited-time event [Character Storyline Event]. Can be used to redeem special rewards during the event.

129.name: Popularity Carrot
129.desc2: Someone once asked Joyous why he called the Hollow route data "Carrot." He replied, "Why not ask that woman why she made those machines look like rabbits?"

130.name: Cloud Crest
130.desc: General Commemorative Coins, can be used for Suibian Temple repairs and upgrades.
130.desc2: Let's revive Suibian Temple in style! Minting coins with the temple's emblem is one of our strategies to boost its presence during the restoration.

131.name: Omnicoin
131.desc: Tokens exclusively circulated at Devon Pawnshop. Can be used to redeem rewards.
131.desc2: "Master of the land and skies, expert in daily necessities" is merely a sweet fantasy of those who deal in currency.

132.name: Wishletter
132.desc: Souvenir from praying at Suibian Temple.
132.desc2: The delicate crepe paper cradles patterns painted with vermilion, each crease holding unspoken wishes. The moment they are released from one's fingertips, those unvoiced prayers transform into threads of light as they ascend, casting gentle shadows through the clouds — like silken cords descending from the heavens, waiting to bind earthly warmth to the highest skies.

133.name: Seashell
133.desc: Obtained after consuming any amount of Battery Charge for the first time each day. It can be exchanged at A-Qiang's stall for random fishing catches and corresponding rewards.
133.desc2: The Investigation Association's uniquely shaped commemorative badges, known for their elegant form and realistic design, have become a hit among seaside tourists. In response, fish stall owner A-Qiang remarks: "Nobody can resist shiny shells... Plus, these ones smell way better than the real deal!"

134.name: Wish Bottle
134.desc: Obtain upon first daily login or after consuming any Battery Charge: Can be used in the "Wish Bottle Adrift" event. Write down your wishes and throw the wish bottles into the sea to receive corresponding rewards.
134.desc2:
A glass bottle with a cork stopper - ordinary in every way, no matter how you look at it. But the Bangboo, who calls itself the "Scion of the Great Sea God," loudly declares:
"This bottle holds divine power! Throw it, and the gods will bless you!"

135.name: Contribution Points
135.desc: Used to buy various items in "Points Exchange"
135.desc2:
Just like carrots come in all sizes, Proxies come in all types. Whether posting or accepting commissions, any contribution to Inter-Knot's reputation will earn you respect from your peers.
And then... take a trip to "Points Exchange" to see how your fellow Proxies' respect translates into real rewards.

136.name: Commemorative Ticket Stub
136.desc: "Filmgoer Thank-You Gift" event item. During the event, obtain through purchasing Monochrome, New Eridu City Fund, select Bundles, Inter-Knot Membership, etc.
136.desc2: A gleaming, golden ticket stub — and a token of time itself. With our eager excitement, we traded for a dream worth cherishing; and as the lights flickered and flowed, we walked into a life that never belonged to us.

137.name: Wish Bottle
137.desc: Obtained upon first daily login or after consuming any Battery Charge. Can be used in the "Wish Filing Station" event.
137.desc2: The Cunning Hares, known for their cost-cutting efficiency, somehow got their hands on these surprisingly sturdy bottles from who knows where. Wishes sealed inside could wander the seas for a very, very long time without being worn away by time.

138.name: Little Golden Carp
138.desc: Once you've collected enough, you can redeem them for exclusive holiday gifts.
138.desc2: If carp fish are the embodiment of good fortune in Waifei Peninsula, then golden carp represent an extra dose of luck. Bring some winter sunshine and good vibes to welcome this dazzling messenger of fortune!

139.name: Stamp Seal
139.desc: A special item custom-made by the HIA Club for this event. Can be exchanged for a card flip opportunity.
139.desc2: Collect enough stamps and you can claim a prize — though your drawer's already packed with "souvenirs" from way too many of these expired events. But this time... maybe you'll actually be able to cash in for something?

140.name: Golden Soda Bottle Cap
140.desc: Obtained after consuming any amount of Battery Charge for the first time each day. Visit the Bangboo Merch stall and open a surprise box to receive the corresponding rewards.
140.desc2: A limited-edition soda cap from some boutique beverage brand. Bangboo go crazy over its golden look, but it's really just another ordinary product for the industry.

141.name: Wish Letter
141.desc: Obtained upon your first daily login or after consuming any Battery Charge. Can be used in the "Ding-Dong! Delivery Training in Progress" event. Drop it into a mailbox to receive the corresponding rewards.
141.desc2:
Write down every unfinished dream and every wish yet to be made in this letter...
Then let it follow the wind to the place where your hopes await.

142.name: Investigation Certificate
142.desc: Used for purchasing exclusive actions and other valuable items in Association Supplies - Exclusive Showcase.
142.desc2: — A commemorative token exclusively for the brave.

201.name: Inter-Knot Credit
201.desc: Virtual credit used on Inter-Knot. Your Inter-Knot Level will increase with enough Credit.
201.desc2: "In the world of Proxies, reputation is more precious than Dennies. Because without it, the means of earning Dennies are vastly limited..."

211.name: Daily Performance
211.desc: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Potential Archive store, primarily obtained through Ridu Weekly.
211.desc2: The everyday isn't a dull routine — it''s a sea of ideas quietly gathering change. In those tiny miracles we repeat day after day, maybe there's a spark of power waiting to unlock our "potential."

215.name: Special Invitation Letter
215.desc: When an S-Rank Agent's Mindscape reaches the max level, you will receive 1 "Special Invitation Letter" when obtaining that Agent again, which can be exchanged for valuable items in the "Collectible Exchange" Store under "Agent Exchange".
215.desc2: A high-tech invitation card. What kind of magic does this tiny screen possess to make so many exceptional Agents eagerly accept? —More often than not, the name "Phaethon" inspires far more trust than Dennies.

216.name: W-Engine Microcontroller Unit
216.desc: An item that can be exchanged for valuable items in the "Collectible Exchange" Store under "W-Engine Exchange."
216.desc2: A pristine W-Engine Microcontroller Unit with virtually no signs of use — perfect for crafting higher precision, more effective W-Engines. These units are rare, expensive, and highly specialized. Keep it out of sight to avoid getting reported.

217.name: Season EXP
217.desc: Season EXP to boost your Season Lv. Resets each cycle.

221.name: Outpost Trust
221.desc: Used to increase Permission Level, obtainable by completing commissions from other Proxies.
221.desc2: Leveling up your Permission Level unlocks new titles and adds more items to the Points Exchange shop.

301.name: W-Engine Chip
301.desc: Used to craft W-Engines at the gadget store.
301.desc2: When you dismantle W-Engines, it's possible to preserve their core rotors if you handle them properly. These chips can then be used to craft new W-Engines or... simply kept as collectibles.

401.name: Doggy Voucher
401.desc: A voucher obtained in the Soul Hounds III special event. Can exchange for rewards at the Godfinger Arcade.
401.desc2: When you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss gazes also into you.

402.name: Snaky Voucher
402.desc: A voucher obtained in the Snake Duel special event. Can exchange for rewards at the Godfinger Arcade.
402.desc2: Anything in my way will become my food!

403.name: HIA Commemorative Marble
403.desc: Exchange rewards in the Exchange Store of the Mr. Hello's Savior event.
403.desc2: Issued by Mr. Hello, these commemorative marbles bear witness to investigators' efforts in driving forth the Association's mission, and can be exchanged for rewards. You can almost hear Mr. Hello saying "My favorite investigator!" if you stare long enough at the design.

404.name: Lost Supply Box
404.desc: A very sturdy storage chest. It looks quite valuable.
404.desc2: There seems to be an unfamiliar company logo on the corner of the chest. From the make and quality, this appears to be for military use. Though it's covered in dust, there are no signs of Ether corruption.

406.name: Engagement Record Points
406.desc: Points earned from completing the "Back in Business" activity accumulate, and upon reaching a certain amount or activity milestones, you can claim the corresponding rewards.
406.desc2: A small note documenting every work accomplishment after the reopening of the video store and Proxy's business. It encapsulates the excitement of witnessing everything unfold alongside your closest kin.

407.name: Revenue
407.desc: The revenue from the diner can be used to invest
407.desc2: You can obtain a certain amount of revenue upon clearing a management challenge. The higher the ratings of customers, the greater the revenue obtained

408.name: Management Insights
408.desc: Insight that is required in order to invest in new decor
408.desc2: Obtained via <color=#FFAF2C>event Side Commissions</color>. Head to Tasks to check related Commissions.

409.name: Engagement Record Points
409.desc: Points earned from completing the "Back in Business" activity. Upon accumulating a certain amount and reaching milestones, you can claim the corresponding rewards.
409.desc2: A small note documenting every work accomplishment after the reopening of the video store and Proxy business. It encapsulates the excitement of witnessing everything unfold alongside your closest kin.

410.name: Orchidea's Letter
410.desc: A token from the florist. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
410.desc2: Caring for fresh flowers is time-consuming and labor-intensive, which might be too much for the Convenience Store Bangboo to handle... The meticulous Miss Orchidea has prepared some potted plants for the customers at "141" to choose from.

411.name: Coco's Letter
411.desc: A token from the teamilk store. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
411.desc2: "141" Convenience Store x Richard Teamilk Collaboration — Enjoy the Rich Flavor Anytime, Anywhere!

412.name: Beaverson's Letter
412.desc: A token from the salon. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
412.desc2: Exclusive Care Set, brought to you by the salon with the longest wait times at Lumina Square — nourish your hair with precision. Now, no appointment is needed. Enjoy the luxury at home!

413.name: Chop Junior's Letter
413.desc: A token from the noodle shop. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
413.desc2: The young noodle shop owner made a decision that went against his father's wishes... But did General Chop really know nothing, or did he silently approve of his child's attempt?

414.name: Duyi's Letter
414.desc: A token from the massage parlor. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
414.desc2: The portable massager developed by Old Duyi offers a total of 10 massage angles and 5 levels of air pressure, providing an ideal relaxation experience for all residents of the city.

415.name: Stellar Trek's Letter
415.desc: A token from the clothing store. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.

416.name: Simmer's Letter
416.desc: A token from the hot pot restaurant. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
416.desc2: The new spicy dishes from Simmer are made from the same ingredients as the soup base in the store! However, whether it is suitable for "141" to introduce... I'm afraid someone needs to be brave enough to try it.

417.name: Field Experience
417.desc: Used to increase Investigation Level which in turn gives Combat Permits.
417.desc2: A document used to keep a written record of Field Experience. Words may seem powerless, but they can stand as proof of strength.

418.name: Supply Voucher
418.desc: For redeeming rewards in Combat Supply.
418.desc2: Even if the Void Hunter herself shows up, as long as New Eridu isn't on the verge of destruction, no extra supplies can be taken from Logistics without a Supply Voucher.

419.name: Assessment Score
419.desc: Congratulations on leading the Bangboo to victory over the Ethereals! Although this happened in the VR exam field, the test score already shows — you're an outstanding combat assistant!

420.name: Combat Permit
420.desc: Enhances Agents' combat capabilities in Gear Deployment.
420.desc2: Unchecked force will surely invite disaster, particularly with powers that have the potential to bring great harm. Only with this permit may one train freely in lands beset by calamity.

421.name: Angler Points
421.desc: You can earn rewards by participating in the Elpis Ultimate Angler Championship, completing Port Anecdotes, or updating the Fishing Encyclopedia.
421.desc2: Ridu Fishing Association has set up Fishing Permit Points. Accumulating points can increase your permit level and unlock various rewards.

422.name: Fantasy Capsule
422.desc: A capsule filled with crystals formed from condensed dream energy and carefully stored in a protective shell. It serves as a potent medicine to cross into fantasy.
422.desc2: Fantasy: The floating fantasy, the overflowing fantasy, the fantasy that refracts itself like a crystal. When fantasy gradually expands, will you get lost in its jungle, or will you instead gain the courage to transcend reality?

423.name: Flower Shop Revenue
423.desc: Revenue earned during the flower shop's operation. It turns out that the temporary manager of Dew Gardening Shop has quite the talent for both "floristry" and "business"!

424.name: Movie Points
424.desc: Watch movies at Gravity Cinema to earn points that can be used to upgrade your Gravity VIP membership card.
424.desc2: "If heaven really exists, it probably looks like a movie theater."

425.name: Angler Commemorative Coin
425.desc: Penguinboo Empy from Fantasy Resort is a master Bangboo fisher at Port Elpis, and he's well acquainted with the old-timers at the Port Elpis Fishing Association.
425.desc2: With Empy acting as go-between, the Fishing Association has agreed that the Bangboo would be able to buy more advanced fishing gear, aquarium decorations, and various other items at discounted prices as long as they sell their catches to the association. To facilitate the transactions further, the association has even specially created a unique currency for the Bangboo — the Angler Commemorative Coin.

426.name: Visitor Traffic
426.desc: A ticket with Fantasy Resort guest information on it.
426.desc2: On one hand, the staff can offer personalized service to each guest using the information above. On the other hand, the growing number of tickets is also a sign of the resort's rising popularity.

427.name: Dream Data
427.desc: Data shards that can increase the stability value of simulated dreams.
427.desc2: The HIA research team discovered the key to brain wave decoding and image synchronization lies in collecting complete high-frequency data. On this basis, psychological intervention can then be used to enhance a patient's mental stability.

428.name: Dusty Old Coin
428.desc: Dust-covered Porcelume coins that can be taken to the shopkeeper at Buyan for a reward.
428.desc2: Wealth once forged from radiance now lies buried under the dust of time.

429.name: Mystery Points
429.desc: Used to raise your Mystery Level and trade for rewards at the Buyan store.
429.desc2: Records the stories and achievements you've gathered along your journey of discovery.

430.name: Sword Mastery
430.desc: Enhancement item obtained through combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving in the Qingming Realm.
430.desc2: A note recording experience gained in real combat. While it may seem like trivial details, accumulating these over time can lead to mastering powerful sword techniques.

431.name: Sword Will Essence
431.desc: Advanced enhancement item obtained by challenging powerful foes, completing explorations, and solving puzzles in the Qingming Realm.
431.desc2: A fragment of an ancient tome containing the accumulated insights of countless swordmasters — a treasure found only within the hidden realm, and capable of greatly advancing the Sword Keeper's abilities.

432.name: Sword Mastery
432.desc: Enhancement item obtained through combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving in the Qingming Realm.
432.desc2: A note recording experience gained in real combat. While it may seem like trivial details, accumulating these over time can lead to mastering powerful sword techniques.

433.name: Sword Will Essence
433.desc: Advanced enhancement item obtained by challenging powerful foes, completing explorations, and solving puzzles in the Qingming Realm.
433.desc2: A fragment of an ancient tome containing the accumulated insights of countless swordmasters — a treasure found only within the hidden realm, and capable of greatly advancing the Sword Keeper's abilities.

435.name: Victory Points
435.desc:
Used to measure each contestant's performance in the "En-Nah" Chess Legend event.
Accumulate Victory Points to reach specified milestones and unlock fantastics surprise rewards!

436.name: Survey Data
436.desc: Exploration route data gathered in the Papago Hollow. Accumulate a certain amount to increase Proxy's Exploration Level.
436.desc2: If guiding people within the Hollow is the most important part of a Proxy's job, then the path data would be the most important information in the Hollow. Just as cooking requires ingredients, path data is the crux of Hollow navigation.

437.name: Mini Cargo Truck
437.desc: After opening a Mini Cargo Truck, you have a chance to obtain Gear, Resonium or emotes.
437.desc2:
The Mini Cargo Truck: Your sturdiest safety net. A general logistics vehicle used by the HIA to deliver all kinds of supplies to aid investigators in harvesting Ether resources. Some lost Mini Cargo Trucks will end up as a sweet bonus for Hollow Raiders looking around for loot.
If you see a lost Mini Cargo Truck, please use whatever is inside as you see fit... It's not like they'll fight back.

438.name: Star Point
438.desc: Accumulate Star Points to boost Star Progress and increase the popularity of the Angels of Delusion Official Account.
438.desc2:
Shimmering, sparkling, dazzling...
Starting now, rack up those Star Points and kick off your wish-granting journey with the Angels of Delusion!

446.name: Lucky: Wish Come True Boo
446.desc: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Lucky" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 1.
446.desc2:
"Every Denny should bring its friends to me, so I can have lots of Dennies to buy batteries!"
—The mumbled sleep-talk of a certain little Bangboo.

447.name: Lucky: Dragon & Pheonix Dance Boo
447.desc: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Lucky" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 1.
447.desc2:
"Every day! Happy! Everything! Goes great! I'm a happy little lion!"
—The excited ehn-ne sounds from a Bangboo bobbing its head during the lion dance.

448.name: Lucky: Skyward Soar Boo
448.desc: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Lucky" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 1.
448.desc2:
"Light up the sky with pretty fireworks, and luck will fall down like snow, right?"
—The careful ehn-ne sounds from a Bangboo cautiously lighting fireworks.

449.name: Gilded: Back-to-Back Luck Boo
449.desc: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
449.desc2:
"Surprise~! I hope you get little surprises like this every day!"
—The sudden ehn-ne sounds from a Bangboo suddenly popping out of a gift box.

450.name: Gilded: Riches and Good Fortune Boo
450.desc: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
450.desc2:
「One for you, and one for you... don't worry, everyone gets their share of good fortune on Gilded Carrot Day~」
——The diligent ehn-ne sounds of a Bangboo helping its owner hand out lucky money.

451.name: Gilded: Rolling in Riches Boo
451.desc: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
451.desc2:
"You want my gold ingots? Come and get 'em then. I'll be waiting for you deep in the Hollow!"
—The triumphant en-nah sounds of a Bangboo proudly clutching gold ingots.

452.name: Gilded: Blessings Come Knocking Boo
452.desc: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
452.desc2:
"The light from this lantern is so warm and cozy... feels like it could light up the whole New Year!"
—The lively ehn-ne sounds of a Bangboo hopping around while holding a lantern.

453.name: "Gilded Fortune" Series Bangboo Badge
453.desc: Event-exclusive Bangboo badges for "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns," featuring both the "Lucky" and "Gilded" series. These badges were a total hit thanks to their festive vibes.
453.desc2: No one knows what surprise awaits until the box is opened. Heart pounding with anticipation and festive dreams, step forward and embrace the golden glow of good fortune!

454.name: ActivityBangkov_Coin_Name
454.desc: Internal currency used within the Marcel Group.
454.desc2: Only valid at the Employee Exclusive Store.

455.name: Interboo Coins
455.desc: The digital currency of Interboo. Can be used to level up your Interboo account.
455.desc2: Whether in the real world or the virtual one, bottle caps are always the hard currency of Roscaelifer's Bangboo.

456.name: Marcel Storage Coupon
456.desc: Upon obtaining, increases exclusive Storage capacity in "Operation: Save Bootopia" by +1
456.desc2: A storage redemption coupon provided by Marcel Group, printed with different months and the corresponding Bangboo ambassador. Distributed as a monthly employee benefit, it grants free storage space for internal circulation only (valid for the current month only).

457.name: Gear Coin
457.desc: Currency used exclusively within the Hollow. Use it to purchase various supplies. Obtained by selling supplies at the <color=#FFAF2C>Depot Hub</color>.

458.name: Lucky Bottle Cap
458.desc: Collect all the rare bottle caps redeemable with data cards from Roarin' Brekkies and toss them into the Fountain of the Bottle Cap Fairy to make a wish.
458.desc2: A bottle cap recognized by the Bangboo of Roscaelifer as the "most precious" of all. Rumor has it this cap possesses the conceptual power to make wishes come true... though that's only a rumor.

459.name: Souvenir Shop Revenue
459.desc: Obtained in the "Summer Waves Roll In" event through "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading". Earn enough revenue to claim rewards.
459.desc2: A key source of funds for the bonfire party. Earned through "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading".

460.name: Season Coins
460.desc: Season-exclusive currency earned by completing Season Commissions in Enigma of the Labyrinth. Exchange it for valuable supplies in the Season Limited section of Boojee's Store.

461.name: Gear Bottle Cap
461.desc: A bottle cap currency used to trade with Bangboo.
461.desc2: Bangboo say they can't live without gears, so Roscaelifer has Gear Street. Then they say they can't live without bottle caps either, so naturally there's Gear Bottle Caps.

462.name: Food
462.desc: Nutritious food that can be used to feed your Orbie.

463.name: Snacks
463.desc: A flavor-packed snack that can be used to feed your Orbie.
463.desc2: "Smells so good! I wanna eat, I wanna eat!"

501.name: Battery Charge
501.desc: You can have up to 1,000 Battery Charge. When Battery Charge is lower than 240, recover 1 Battery Charge every 6 minutes.
501.desc2: The power source for Bangboo. Before going exploring in a Hollow, make sure that your Bangboo is sufficiently charged.

502.name: Ether Battery
502.desc: Gain 60 Battery Charge when used. Can also be used for auto-combat in Combat Simulation or Area Patrol missions to instantly receive one mission reward.
502.desc2: A special battery designed for multiple Ether technology electronic gadgets, capable of supplying power for a small ether-powered vehicle to travel 20 meters or a Bangboo running frantically for 2 hours.

503.name: Backup Battery Charge
503.desc:
Once Battery Charge reaches 240, recover 1 Backup Battery Charge every 18 minutes. You can have up to 2,400 Backup Battery Charge.
Consume Backup Battery Charge to gain an equal amount of Battery Charge.
503.desc2:
Battery Charge stored in a backup battery, ready for use whenever needed.
If Ether technology can be applied to produce batteries, their efficiency might be further improved. Luckily, this backup battery has a large capacity, turning Battery Charge into a valuable long-term asset.

510.name: Victoria Housekeeping Coupon
510.desc: After use, you can directly receive the reward for a Area Patrol task.
510.desc2: Victoria Housekeeping Co. presents a special service voucher for our esteemed clients. Even the most difficult tasks — including "troublesome matters" within the Hollows — are no match for our skilled professionals.

511.name: Prepaid Power Card
511.desc: Complete HDD commissions without meeting the usual first-clear requirements and earn the corresponding rewards. Can also be used for crafting Ether Batteries.
511.desc2: A prepaid power card commonly used in New Eridu. While commissioning Fairy for Hollow exploration will cause high HDD load, this card won't solve the skyrocketing power bills, but it'll save you from a heart attack when it arrives.

701.name: Investigation Point
701.desc: Completing explorations of Hollow Zero earns you Investigation Points, which can be used to upgrade your Investigation License Level and get extra supplies.

12015.name: [Cinder] Cobalt
12015.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
12015.desc2: A W-Engine with a built-in heating component. When operating at high speeds, it resembles a blazing blue flame.

12016.name: [Lunar] Semiluna
12016.desc: Equipping this boosts the combat capabilities of Armorer Agents

13001.name: Street Superstar
13001.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
13001.desc2: A custom-made W-Engine designed for urban music lovers. It sacrifices heat dissipation components for improved sound quality.

13002.name: Slice of Time
13002.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
13002.desc2: A special W-Engine equipped with a high-speed camera module. The best choice for in-Hollow photography enthusiasts.

13003.name: Rainforest Gourmet
13003.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
13003.desc2: A consumer-class W-Engine launched by an exotic pet fan club to promote pet culture. Due to its cute appearance, it was once a very popular model.

13004.name: Starlight Engine
13004.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
13004.desc2: A damage-type W-Engine made of special Etheric matter. When its user is attacked, it builds up energy.

13005.name: Steam Oven
13005.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
13005.desc2: A high-power W-Engine that boasts a cutting-edge energy conversion system. It collects excess heat and supplies it to the steamer.

13006.name: Precious Fossilized Core
13006.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
13006.desc2: A special W-Engine whose outer shell is made of composite Etheric matter that effectively absorbs impact, and turns it against the enemy.

13007.name: Original Transmorpher
13007.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
13007.desc2: An epic W-Engine favored by Starlight Knight fans. Its high popularity and scarcity marketing strategy have caused an influx of knock-offs.

13008.name: Weeping Gemini
13008.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
13008.desc2: A W-Engine produced by recycling abandoned Bangboo shells. Its electrode cores made of recycled metals can release high-voltage charges.

13009.name: Electro-Lip Gloss
13009.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
13009.desc2: This damage-type W-Engine boasts a built-in current transformer, and automatically attracts electrically sensitive objects around the operator and deals additional damage to them.

13010.name: Bunny Band
13010.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
13010.desc2: A special W-Engine decorated with a fluffy bunny. However, it is just an imitation of the real animal.

13011.name: Spring Embrace
13011.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
13011.desc2: A special W-Engine equipped with a temperature regulator where residual heat generated by the W-Engine's high frequency is funneled into the hot springs on its surface.

13012.name: Puzzle Sphere
13012.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
13012.desc2: The W-Engine, with its bright colors and great performance, saw poor sales at first because it resembled a toy. But with its reasonable price, it slowly gained a positive reputation.

13013.name: Gilded Blossom
13013.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
13013.desc2: A W-Engine with a grandiose and luxurious appearance equipped with a premium Ether-powered anti-theft device. It's actually used to provide the equipper with energy.

13014.name: Radiowave Journey
13014.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
13014.desc2: Designed for those Hollow-dwelling bards who refuse to listen to the same albums repeatedly, this W-Engine comes equipped with a radio module that can transform Etheric frequencies into melodies.

13015.name: Marcato Desire
13015.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
13015.desc2: Gather 'round, mortals! Turn up the music!

13016.name: Reel Projector
13016.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
13016.desc2: Clearly a W-Engine is for sound, and not images. What kind of lunatic genius would insist on stuffing a 16mm film camera into a W-Engine?

13017.name: Catty Luck
13017.desc: Equipping this boosts the combat capabilities of Armorer Agents

13018.name: Boisterous Echoes
13018.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
13018.desc2: Pick it up and play another thunk-thud concerto!

13019.name: Cauldron of Clarity
13019.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
13019.desc2: Countless threads of Sword Will echo through this tiny stretch of sky.

13020.name: The Simmering Pot
13020.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
13020.desc2: Whoa, that's hot! Seriously hot! But it's so good!

13021.name: Bloodmarrow Coffer
13021.desc: Equipping this boosts the combat capabilities of Armorer Agents

13101.name: Demara Battery Mark II
13101.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
13101.desc2: A customized W-Engine that focuses on energy storage, modified to improve its energy capacity. This model is often used by Anby.

13103.name: The Vault
13103.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
13103.desc2: A cost-effective W-Engine that can store energy, with improvements made to its internal space. This model is often used by Nicole.

13106.name: Housekeeper
13106.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
13106.desc2: An enhanced W-Engine with a high rotation speed. A chainsaw has been integrated into its shaft. This model is often used by Corin.

13108.name: Starlight Engine Replica
13108.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
13108.desc2: A customized supercomputing W-Engine, specialized in aim support and ballistic calculations. Modified by Billy, it now looks like some sort of knock-off Starlight Knight figurine.

13111.name: Drill Rig - Red Axis
13111.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
13111.desc2: Originally a rev-enhanced W-Engine, it has been modified by Anton with the most expensive rotary drill parts that allow it to exceed its output limits.

13112.name: Big Cylinder
13112.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
13112.desc2: A powerful protection-type W-Engine, characterized by thick oil cylinders that ceaselessly roar inside it. It can provide sufficient power for heavy machinery.

13113.name: Bashful Demon
13113.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
13113.desc2: An intricate W-Engine developed by Section 6 and later modified with extra features. It can control Ether particles to form an energy field. This model is favored by Soukaku.

13115.name: Kaboom the Cannon
13115.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
13115.desc2: A support W-Engine propelled by jets that is both mobile and impactful, it can traverse the entire battlefield providing combat buffs.

13127.name: Peacekeeper - Specialized
13127.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
13127.desc2: A defensive W-Engine independently researched and created by Public Security which simplifies the offensive components to enhance the energy conversion ability in its shield.

13128.name: Roaring Ride
13128.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
13128.desc2: An energy W-Engine modded from spare parts of a truck's engine. It converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous.

13135.name: Box Cutter
13135.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
13135.desc2: An energy W-Engine modded from spare parts of a truck's engine. It converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous.

13142.name: Tremor Trigram Vessel
13142.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
13142.desc2: Pressing acupoints is like cooking. Striking the fatal acupoint is like setting the stove on fire, bringing disaster.

13144.name: Grill O'Wisp
13144.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
13144.desc2: A flame both fierce and faithful, burning without end.

14001.name: Cannon Rotor
14001.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14001.desc2: A high-performance supercomputing W-Engine, capable of collecting real-time battlefield data and equipped with mini cannons.

14002.name: Unfettered Game Ball
14002.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
14002.desc2: A new supercomputing W-Engine, featuring cutting-edge integrated chips that dynamically monitor the battlefield and provide tactical analysis for the user.

14003.name: Six Shooter
14003.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14003.desc2: A special W-Engine modeled after a revolver. It can load bullet-shaped condensed Ether batteries, which release a great amount of power when fired.

14102.name: Steel Cushion
14102.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14102.desc2: A supercomputing W-Engine equipped with a motion monitoring feature. Thanks to Nekomata's modifications, it perfectly matches the fast reflexes and combat maneuvers of feline Thirens.

14104.name: The Brimstone
14104.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14104.desc2: A W-Engine made for Soldier 11 by Obsidian Division. Its intense heat can be used to clear the entire battlefield.

14105.name: Kraken's Cradle
14105.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
14105.desc2: In chasing illusions, she was entranced by the light that pierced through the mist.

14107.name: Tusks of Fury
14107.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
14107.desc2: A versatile W-Engine based on a motorcycle tire that Big Daddy made for Caesar.

14109.name: Hailstorm Shrine
14109.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14109.desc2: Hail falls before the shrine, waking her. The blizzard is coming.

14110.name: Hellfire Gears
14110.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14110.desc2: A functional W-Engine with ultra-high power capacity. Modified by Koleda, its energy level has almost exceeded the safety limit.

14114.name: The Restrained
14114.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14114.desc2: A special W-Engine with a powerful temperature control system. Modified by Lycaon, it has the capability to quickly create extremely cold environments.

14116.name: Blazing Laurel
14116.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14116.desc2: A violent W-Engine that can ignite flames with a siphon. It deals simple and crude burn damage, encouraging relentless, bone-crushing follow-up attacks.

14117.name: Flamemaker Shaker
14117.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14117.desc2: Modified by Burnice, this W-Engine uses a special fuel as its power source to boost combustion performance to the max.

14118.name: Fusion Compiler
14118.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14118.desc2: The latest W-Engine that possesses a hypercalculation core. It can compile operational codes for machines at top speed. This model is favored by Grace.

14119.name: Deep Sea Visitor
14119.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14119.desc2: A high-power W-Engine that possesses efficient freezing capabilities and high damage output. This model is often used by Ellen.

14120.name: Zanshin Herb Case
14120.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14120.desc2: Bitterness and pain beget hope, and he devours them all.

14121.name: Weeping Cradle
14121.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
14121.desc2: A special W-Engine with multiple layers embedded inside. It can quickly recharge 	special-model Bangboo and custom-made combat equipment. This model is favored by Rina.

14122.name: Timeweaver
14122.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14122.desc2: A new model of supercomputing W-Engine custom-made by HSO Section 6, equipped with the most elite calculation and analysis functions.

14124.name: Riot Suppressor Mark VI
14124.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14124.desc2: The latest tactical W-Engine used by Public Security's elite Hollow squads, possessing a powerful Ether energy source. It's Zhu Yuan's favored model.

14125.name: Ice-Jade Teapot
14125.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14125.desc2: A custom stun W-Engine made for an Automaton referencing the combat style and abilities of one. Energy is stored within, then lashes outwards upon conversion.

14126.name: Sharpened Stinger
14126.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14126.desc2: A deadly W-Engine from unknown sources, modified personally by Jane Doe with the intent to deal severe physical damage and Anomaly.

14129.name: Myriad Eclipse
14129.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14129.desc2: Shadowed by darkness at every step, he laid bare his heart to kindle a single, flickering flame.

14130.name: Bellicose Blaze
14130.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14130.desc2: She lingers by the banks of the Styx, waiting for the tide to extinguish the fury burning in her chamber.

14131.name: Elegant Vanity
14131.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
14131.desc2: Underneath the radiant splendor, her genuine self has never been hidden.

14132.name: Heartstring Nocturne
14132.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14132.desc2: The sound of the strings, sharp as blades, cut through the night, protecting the one.

14133.name: Flight of Fancy
14133.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14133.desc2: A bird landed on the windowsill, scattering starlight from its tail feathers.

14134.name: Half-Sugar Bunny
14134.desc: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
14134.desc2: Not too sweet, and not too cold.

14136.name: Spectral Gaze
14136.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14136.desc2: Broken eyes hold both resilience and vulnerability.

14137.name: Qingming Birdcage
14137.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
14137.desc2: The world is vast and full of change, and fate is unpredictable. But regardless of hardship or lack thereof, one must stay true to one's heart.

14138.name: Severed Innocence
14138.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14138.desc2: The sheen of silver is not innocence. Can the blades of the past cut through fate's connections?

14139.name: Roaring Fur-nace
14139.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14139.desc2: The warm fire blazes through the long night, casting light on the tiger's roar in my heart.

14140.name: Practiced Perfection
14140.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14140.desc2: Starlight became her blade, and she held courage and love firmly in her hands.

14141.name: Metanukimorphosis
14141.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
14141.desc2: A masterfully crafted design, infused with the creator's pursuit of beauty.

14143.name: Cloudcleave Radiance
14143.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14143.desc2: The world may change, but my heart remains constant, like clouds standing eternal.

14145.name: Dreamlit Hearth
14145.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
14145.desc2: After countless years, it remains a silent puzzle.

14146.name: Cordis Germina
14146.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14146.desc2: Her journey continues along the long, endless circle.

14147.name: Wrathful Vajra
14147.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
14147.desc2: The purging flames burned a hundred times, yet never cleansed me.

14148.name: Yesterday Calls
14148.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14148.desc2: That call you never picked up... she's the one who answered it.

14149.name: Thoughtbop
14149.desc: Equip to increase Support Agents' combat capabilities
14149.desc2: Thoughts follow the veins of fantasy, weaving themselves into song.

14150.name: Angel in the Shell
14150.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14150.desc2: There is a soul, even within a shell of steel.

14151.name: Neon Fantasies
14151.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14151.desc2: A risky and unpredictable delusion that's impossible to refuse.

14152.name: Serpentine Seeker
14152.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14152.desc2: Digital venom flows beneath those alloy scales.

14153.name: Starlight Rider Faceplate
14153.desc: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
14153.desc2: The proof of being a knight is within your grasp.

14154.name: Frostfall Sickle
14154.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14154.desc2: Carry out judgment until the end comes.

14155.name: Sol Exuvia
14155.desc: Equip to increase Pyrois' combat capabilities. Can also be used to increase other Attack Agents' combat capabilities.
14155.desc2: The blazing sun falls, leaving the trapped beast with nowhere left to run.

14156.name: Joyau Dore
14156.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14156.desc2: Sit quietly, and listen to the wind's song.

14157.name: Chief Sidekick
14157.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
14157.desc2: Nhe-nha ehn ne! (Through fire and flames for Lady Norma!)

14158.name: Ode of Resurrected Wings
14158.desc: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
14158.desc2: Drifting through the cracks of time in search of the light.

14159.name: Knight's Extolment
14159.desc: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
14159.desc2: Across the vast skies and seas of clouds, the extolment for the knights echoes in quiet reverence.

14161.name: Crimson Thirst
14161.desc: Equipping this boosts the combat capabilities of Armorer Agents

14162.desc: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities

20102.name: Potential Silhouette: Nekomata
20102.desc: Used to awaken Nekomata's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive shop.
20102.desc2:
A sharp, striking silhouette that embodies the Agent's potential "ideal self."

The stray cat once wandered through life without a care, but now she's found a home, and she'll bare her claws to protect it.

20104.name: Potential Silhouette: Soldier 11
20104.desc: Used to awaken Soldier 11's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20104.desc2:
A sharp, clean silhouette capturing an Agent's potential "ideal self."

She still keeps up her old training routine, like a stubborn flame burning through the night. Still, having crossed paths with you so many times without realizing it, She finally has a reason to search for her own "identity."

20110.name: Potential Silhouette: Koleda
20110.desc: Used to awaken Koleda's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20110.desc2:
A sharp, clean-cut silhouette marking the Agent's latent "ideal self" image.

She may not have hit her growth spurt yet, but that won't stop her from bringing the attitude! After all, she IS the president of the whole dang company!

20114.name: Potential Silhouette: Lycaon
20114.desc: Used to awaken Lycaon's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20114.desc2:
A sharp, clean silhouette capturing an Agent's potential "ideal self."

To execute housekeeping services with precision and grace, to uphold the justice they believe in, and to protect everything they hold dear — the "Elegant Attendant" never slacks off.

20117.name: Potential Silhouette: Burnice
20117.desc: Used to awaken Burnice's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20117.desc2:
A sharp, clean silhouette capturing an Agent's potential "ideal self."

Nitro-Fuel, a cocktail shaker, and igniter — when fuel and passion collide, what shines brighter: the flames, or the smile on her face?

20118.name: Potential Silhouette: Grace
20118.desc: Used to awaken Grace's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20118.desc2:
A sharp, clean silhouette capturing an Agent's potential "ideal self."

Wearing gloves smudged with engine oil and holding her ever-present wrench, the "Iron Witch" stays devoted to creating her mechanical potions, unwavering as ever.

20119.name: Potential Silhouette: Ellen
20119.desc: Used to awaken Ellen's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20119.desc2:
A sharp, clean silhouette capturing an Agent's potential "ideal self."

For Ellen, getting stronger isn't about chasing power... she just wants to finish her work fast and curl up for a midday nap in her soft nest of blankets.

20120.name: Potential Silhouette: Asaba Harumasa
20120.desc: Used to awaken Asaba Harumasa's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20120.desc2:
A sharp, clean silhouette capturing an Agent's potential "ideal self."

With a vivid yellow headscarf tied in place, the mirror shows someone clearly lost in thought. Because he prefers to stand at the edge of the spotlight, people forget: this laid-back kid is also a genius with exceptional talent.

20121.name: Potential Silhouette: Rina
20121.desc: Used to awaken Rina's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive shop.
20121.desc2:
A sharp, striking silhouette that embodies the Agent's potential "ideal self."

Defeat the villains, remove every obstacle. No matter what hardships lie ahead, the perfect head maid always begins a new day's work right on schedule.

20126.name: Potential Silhouette: Jane
20126.desc: Used to awaken Jane's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive shop.
20126.desc2:
A sharp, striking silhouette that embodies the Agent's potential "ideal self."

No matter what mask she wears, every move she makes is as graceful as a dance. All you need to ensure... is that, throughout this deadly tango, she remains your most loyal partner.

20138.name: Potential Silhouette: Soldier 0 - Anby
20138.desc: Used to awaken Soldier 0 - Anby's potential. Can be exchanged in the Potential Archive store.
20138.desc2:
A sharp, clean silhouette capturing an Agent's potential "ideal self."

She made peace with her past and promised herself a future — now she's strong enough to down ten steaming-hot burgers in one go.

32721.name: Branch & Blade Song [1]
32721.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32721.desc2: "East he went, in his youth, encountering evil monkeys on the barren roads. A spring branch from a tree to serve as his blade, driving away the beasts that plagued the people."

32722.name: Branch & Blade Song [2]
32722.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32722.desc2: "West he went, now mature, where the croaks of frogs occupy the walls. A single strike sends astonishment through the crowds, for what they once knew was merely the stars they could see from the bottom of a well."

32723.name: Branch & Blade Song [3]
32723.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32723.desc2: "North he went, aging now, facing a dire wolf devouring the lands. With orange leaves grasping bloodied fangs, a perfect new blade he now has."

32724.name: Branch & Blade Song [4]
32724.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32724.desc2: "South he went, elderly now, where swarms of locusts invade the fields. A guardian, he cleaves through with a single slash, giving hope of survival until the thaw."

32725.name: Branch & Blade Song [5]
32725.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32725.desc2: "Home he goes, hair now white, with his feats told in every corner. Hoping for peace and quiet, he hides his blade, and meanders to the feast with the wandering crowd."

32726.name: Branch & Blade Song [6]
32726.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32726.desc2: "Suddenly, he sees the guests of honor, the villainous monkeys he bested in the past, dressed in regal facades. Their cunning fangs and deceiving lips spin empty tales of miracles and false promises. He throws back his cloak with a wrinkled hand, and righteous anger flows. Stepping through the mud and into the courtyard, he breaks off a branch, becoming the youth he once was."

32821.desc2: "A symptom of staying in Hollows for too long, it's damaged your hearing." The doctor has given a strict warning that if I don't want to go deaf, I had better never go into a Hollow again. Welp... no can do. While my Proxy career is important, but having enough hearing to listen to Astra Yao's new song is more important.

32822.name: Astral Voice [2]
32822.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32822.desc2: I couldn't help it, I ended up accepting a job where I had to go into a Hollow. Like expected, the doctor was mad when I came for another check-up. This time the doctor told me that my hearing wasn't normal for someone my age and if I didn't take care of myself, I'd end up completely deaf within two months... Alright, alright, looks like I'd really be better off switching jobs...

32823.name: Astral Voice [3]
32823.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32823.desc2: Well, that's that, I've wrapped things up, told all my friends, and they all understand. Now to just get a normal job and live a normal life. Though, I do have ample time to go to Astra's concerts now. You lose some you gain some, I suppose.

32824.name: Astral Voice [4]
32824.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32824.desc2: I met a group of super outgoing girls at Astra's album signing. Though we're pretty far apart in age, we have endless things to say when it comes to Astra. With them, I had the pleasure of experiencing the journey of a true fan chasing their idol and going all around the city. It was honestly kinda like back when I worked in Hollows... I even agreed to go check out their place sometime.

32825.name: Astral Voice [5]
32825.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32825.desc2: Their apartment's pretty simple, but they have a lot of meaningful and even discontinued and limited posters and albums of Astra's. This certainly opened my eyes, even though I'd count myself an old fan. But... I do worry. To save money, the place they rented is way too close to a high sub-Hollow risk area.

32826.name: Astral Voice [6]
32826.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32826.desc2: They've invited me to one of Astra's concerts as a thank-you for rescuing them from the Hollow. I happily agreed. We waved our hands, singing and dancing together in the packed concert hall... Even though... Even though my ears were filled with nothing but silence, I could hear that familiar voice every time Astra's lips moved as she sang.

32921.name: Shadow Harmony [1]
32921.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32921.desc2:
Birdsong dances with the shade of trees,
The flowers sway in the afternoon breeze.
Sunlight sneaks, unnoticed by all,
Leaning down to admire your gentle call.
You can't open your eyes, so I'll describe,
The moment when our worlds first collide.

32922.name: Shadow Harmony [2]
32922.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32922.desc2:
A sturdy hand, a gentle touch,
A smiling face, loving so much.
Something's stirring, a dream yet so young,
Your name is murmured, softly sung.
You can't understand it, so I'll tell you the way,
Each whisper's a part of my life today.

32923.name: Shadow Harmony [3]
32923.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32923.desc2:
Even with laughter mocking in my ear,
I follow your steps, year after year.
The pain of falling belongs to yesterday.
No matter where we go, what dangers may lay,
You haven't spoken, so I'll describe.
I'll run ahead of you, all my life.

32924.name: Shadow Harmony [4]
32924.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32924.desc2:
I seek you out when there's no one near,
In those times, your loneliness is clear.
We both sigh, gazing at the streetlamp's light,
But you never lift your head to face your own fight.
You never see it, so let me describe,
No matter who you wish to be, your shadow's your guide.

32925.name: Shadow Harmony [5]
32925.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32925.desc2:
When you pick up your helmet and sword,
I wrap myself in shadows, my heart ignored.
When you wave goodbye to your love so true,
I stand beneath the lamp, weeping too.
You're driven by ideals, so here's what I'll say,
The person you dream of may not be that way.

32926.name: Shadow Harmony [6]
32926.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
32926.desc2:
Your reason fades, it falls away,
Like madness creeping, here to stay.
Your twisted arms grow fierce and tight,
Like danger lurking out of sight.
You've locked yourself in endless night,
Where even I can't reach your light.
You shut me out, you look away,
So let me speak before I stray...
When light returns and breaks the gloom,
Your shadow slips back into view.
No matter what, love, hate, or fear,
I'll stay right here—I'm always near.

33021.name: Phaethon's Melody [1]
33021.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33021.desc2:
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Descends upon the Hollow.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Guidance of the Hollow Raiders.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
The legend of the Proxy! The legend of the Inter-Knot! The legend of New Eridu!

33022.name: Phaethon's Melody [2]
33022.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33022.desc2:
Green eyes shooting out a laser beam,
With a whoosh, the whole building starts to steam.
Black and white ears wiggle and sway,
Hearing mice move in the Hollows, making their way.

33023.name: Phaethon's Melody [3]
33023.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33023.desc2:
Notorious Ethereal that won't obey,
Lifts up a leg and kicks the melon-head away.
The girl in tears wants to go home,
She waves her hand, and the Hollow door's shown.

33024.name: Phaethon's Melody [4]
33024.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33024.desc2:
Swings a thousand-pound hammer with might,
Smashes villains' armor flat as a pancake, what a sight.
Hoists a missile launcher with ease,
Sends rogues flying from the Hollow — no farewells, please!

33025.name: Phaethon's Melody [5]
33025.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33025.desc2:
Lord Phaethon, Lord Phaethon!
A red scarf flutters in the wind, a legend reborn!
Who dares defy? Who dares defy?
Which Ethereal still refuses to comply?

33026.name: Phaethon's Melody [6]
33026.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33026.desc2:
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Ruler of New Eridu.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Savior of the Hollow Raiders.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Loyal Proxy, we listen to your command!

33122.name: Yunkui Tales [2]
33122.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33122.desc2:

33123.desc2:

33124.name: Yunkui Tales [4]

33124.desc2:

33221.name: King of the Summit [1]
33221.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33221.desc2:
Roar roar roar
The Tiger King climbs the mountain
All animals bow
And cry
"Oh king, oh king, so mighty!"

33222.name: King of the Summit [2]
33222.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33222.desc2:
Howl howl howl
The Tiger King descends the mountain
Scaring all the bad guys
They beg
"Great hero, great hero, please have mercy!"

33223.name: King of the Summit [3]
33223.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33223.desc2:
Awoo awoo awoo
The Tiger King feels down
Born a tiger, but so cute
Pet her head like she's a cat
That's so humiliating for a king!

33224.name: King of the Summit [4]
33224.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33224.desc2:
Growl growl growl
Mystic seals and powers flow
Wielding hammers, claws aglow
Boundless qi, demons fall
Beat up the bad guys and all!

33225.name: King of the Summit [5]
33225.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33225.desc2:
Huff huff huff
With Hu Wei's might by the king's side
Even moving mountains and the tide
Brilliant plans string together like pearls tied
As helpers, serving the king is your pride!

33226.name: King of the Summit [6]
33226.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33226.desc2:
Roar roar roar
King of the Summit, King of the Summit
The almighty King of the Summit
The legendary King of the Summit
The invincible King of the Summit!

Howl howl howl
The Tiger King descends the mountain
Scaring all the bad guys
They beg
"Great hero, great hero, please have mercy!"

33243.name: King of the Summit [3]
33243.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33243.desc2:
Awoo awoo awoo
The Tiger King feels down
Born a tiger, but so cute
Pet her head like she's a cat
That's so humiliating for a king!

33244.name: King of the Summit [4]
33244.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33244.desc2:
Growl growl growl
Mystic seals and powers flow
Wielding hammers, claws aglow
Boundless qi, demons fall
Beat up the bad guys and all!

33245.name: King of the Summit [5]
33245.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33245.desc2:
Huff huff huff
With Hu Wei's might by the king's side
Even moving mountains and the tide
Brilliant plans string together like pearls tied
As helpers, serving the king is your pride!

33246.name: King of the Summit [6]
33246.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33246.desc2:
Roar roar roar
King of the Summit, King of the Summit
The almighty King of the Summit
The legendary King of the Summit
The invincible King of the Summit!

33321.name: Dawn's Bloom [1]
33321.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33321.desc2:
"A little sprout peeks out from the stone,
Humming quietly beneath the fallen beams.
It keeps singing under the rubble
Its song is sweeter than any nectar."

33322.name: Dawn's Bloom [2]
33322.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33322.desc2:
"Stone walls crumble in the distance.
Dust rises, veiling the day.
The horizon swallows the land—
And yet, we've still got the blue sky"

33323.name: Dawn's Bloom [3]
33323.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33323.desc2:
"Little birds chirp across the sky,
They have something to say to you:
'We've brought the seeds of spring—
No matter how long the night, dawn will break through'"

33324.name: Dawn's Bloom [4]
33324.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33324.desc2:
"Courage is a silent wind,
Carrying me to distant lands.
O fearless souls,
Who can  smell the morning light"

33325.name: Dawn's Bloom [5]
33325.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33325.desc2:
"White flowers in the ruins bloom,
Drifting out from glass-walled rooms.
Petals float past street corners—
Welcome to this brave new world"

33326.name: Dawn's Bloom [6]
33326.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33326.desc2:
"I imagine what the world could be—
With flowers, spring, and sunlight free.
A child's voice still lingers on the breeze...
The flowers in the wind... an eternal melody..."

33521.name: White Water Ballad [1]
33521.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33521.desc2: "A youth unsheathes his sword by the rain-washed tower's shadow, and rides on singing freely, with no urge to take it slow."

33522.name: White Water Ballad [2]
33522.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33522.desc2: "His sword cast starlight, like startled swan in flight. Through the wide Qingming realm he wandered in light."

33523.name: White Water Ballad [3]
33523.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33523.desc2: "By midlife his spirit drifted off like the cloud. He carried his sword where the deep pines allowed."

33524.name: White Water Ballad [4]
33524.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33524.desc2: "His body, like river water, fading and thin. Old friends lost in the mountains, no path leads him in."

33525.name: White Water Ballad [5]
33525.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33525.desc2: "Life and death — both verses he sang without shame. Why would a broken form cling to a name?"

33526.name: White Water Ballad [6]
33526.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33526.desc2: "He prays that his sword will ring morning and night. And cut through the darkness for miles in its light."

33621.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33621.desc2:
"On tiptoes I feel the weight rise, lifting me above the skies
Against the wind's shifting tides, brushing where the sunlight lies
(Dreams, take flight!)"

33622.name: Shining Aria [2]
33622.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33622.desc2:
"Imperfect dreams in my hand, warming softly where I stand
I believe someday they'll land right beside you, just as planned
(By your side!)"

33623.name: Shining Aria [3]
33623.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33623.desc2:
"In the practice room's bright glow, mirrors show how much I've grown
Sweat becomes the seed I sow; one day hope will fully bloom
(It will bloom!)"

33624.name: Shining Aria [4]
33624.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33624.desc2:
"Though my voice is small today, not enough to loud convey
Still this feeling on its way forms an angel's wings to stay."

33625.name: Shining Aria [5]
33625.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33625.desc2:
"When the city's neon glow drowns out every single sound
Will you hear me then? Will you see me now?
An idol born from daydreams, rising from the clouds."

33626.name: Shining Aria [6]
33626.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33626.desc2:
"This is not the final call, this is where our dreams stand tall
Now our music starts for all, hear our anthem rise and fall
(Angels of Delusion — We're Number One!)"
✧⁺⸜(●′▾‵●)⸝⁺✧

33721.name: Bunny in Wonderland [1]
33721.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33721.desc2:
March sunlight lowers its gaze
A snow-white rabbit tumbles into a fluffy abyss
Tell me, who is the riddle behind the dream?

33722.name: Bunny in Wonderland [2]
33722.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33722.desc2:
Shifting forms in a spinning dance
Lighter than dewdrops, clearer than tree shadows
Dandelions carry the whispers of feathers

33723.name: Bunny in Wonderland [3]
33723.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33723.desc2:
A black cat at the treetop hides a smiling face
A crescent moon in the pond cups up tears
Hurry now, a mad tea party awaits

33724.name: Bunny in Wonderland [4]
33724.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33724.desc2:
To the left lies the scarecrow's garden
To the right, the rabbit earl's courtyard
Shards of candy wrappers shimmer with a faint glow, paving the way to a harbor of sweet dreams

33725.name: Bunny in Wonderland [5]
33725.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33725.desc2:
A rainbow bridge rises from the teacup
A pocket watch sleeps in the jam
Ding-a-ling, all the frozen clocks begin to dance

33726.name: Bunny in Wonderland [6]
33726.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33726.desc2:
When waking, the world tilts slightly
Spring melts the lingering snow upon the lashes
Laughter rides the wind, setting tree shadows swaying
Life, is it only a folding of dreams?

33821.name: Notes From the Chained [1]
33821.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33821.desc2:
Rust gnaws at time upon the wrists
Cold walls stand as the only thing to lean on
Long accustomed to this crushing weight
Stifled breaths repeat in endless cycles
Until worn down into a single grain of decayed dust

33822.name: Notes From the Chained [2]
33822.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33822.desc2:
Thoughts melt like wax, dripping into a bottomless lake
The world peels like lacquer, shadows dancing on the ceiling
Distant birds sweep past, leaving behind fractured cries
Weightless descent blurs the line between dreams and wandering delusion

33823.name: Notes From the Chained [3]
33823.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33823.desc2:
In shattered mirrors of bygone days, that irreversible loss is reflected
One misstep buries countless stars by one's own hand
Thus retreat into shadow, a sentence of eternal confinement pronounced
Amid the ruins of repentance, that heavy door is sealed shut by one's own hand

33824.name: Notes From the Chained [4]
33824.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33824.desc2:
Silence crashes like thunder, cold sweat extinguishing the remnants of dreams
Deep within the chest, a withered heart begins to beat with unrest—
A sudden weariness of this immortal stillness
A longing to see once more that sky, both cursed and long forgotten

33825.name: Notes From the Chained [5]
33825.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33825.desc2:
Trembling fingertips search every inch of every seam
No echo of iron, no chill of any lock
The gate was never truly closed
And so no key or incantation is needed

33826.name: Notes From the Chained [6]
33826.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33826.desc2:
A golden tide surges forth, swallowing the imagined prison garb
Beyond the cage, wet snow drifts as warm sunlight hangs low
Shackles at the wrists grow light as nothing
The self-bound prisoner walks the road home

33843.desc2:
In shattered mirrors of bygone days, that irreversible loss is reflected
One misstep buries countless stars by one's own hand
Thus retreat into shadow, a sentence of eternal confinement pronounced
Amid the ruins of repentance, that heavy door is sealed shut by one's own hand

33844.name: Notes From the Chained [4]
33844.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33844.desc2:
Silence crashes like thunder, cold sweat extinguishing the remnants of dreams
Deep within the chest, a withered heart begins to beat with unrest—
A sudden weariness of this immortal stillness
A longing to see once more that sky, both cursed and long forgotten

33845.name: Notes From the Chained [5]
33845.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33845.desc2:
Trembling fingertips search every inch of every seam
No echo of iron, no chill of any lock
The gate was never truly closed
And so no key or incantation is needed

33846.name: Notes From the Chained [6]
33846.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33846.desc2:
A golden tide surges forth, swallowing the imagined prison garb
Beyond the cage, wet snow drifts as warm sunlight hangs low
Shackles at the wrists grow light as nothing
The self-bound prisoner walks the road home

33921.name: Wuthering Salon [1]
33921.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33921.desc2:
Act I
Silver hair cascades before the desk, steam from tea drifts up the stairs
The clock shifts time forward tick by tick — the salon waits for curtain call, but the guests have yet to arrive

33922.name: Wuthering Salon [2]
33922.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33922.desc2:
Act II
The Chief seat remains empty as ever, the ruler lurks behind the veil
Change is coming but hasn't landed yet, the world keeps moving in its natural order, but that order's stretched thin and taut

33923.name: Wuthering Salon [3]
33923.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33923.desc2:
Act III
A small figure settles into the seat, the computational order flows on without cease, never forgetting
But the child had long since abandoned all that wore away: the vast stretch of years, the long goodbyes

33924.name: Wuthering Salon [4]
33924.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33924.desc2:
Act IV
The watch is not yet over, a guest arrives, preceded by laughter
Silence sweeps in like a bitter frost, but collapses into ruin at her side alone

33925.name: Wuthering Salon [5]
33925.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33925.desc2:
Act V
The last guest arrives... her robes trailing with ash
The islands fall silent, the hearth dims, and the storm draws near
Flint's oath, forged in blood and fire, tempered to this day

33926.name: Wuthering Salon [6]
33926.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
33926.desc2:
Act VI
Silver hair cascades before the desk, the long night wuthering past
As always, a golden utopia stands unshaken in the sky, defiant against the dark stars and moon

34021.name: The Sky Ablaze [1]
34021.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34021.desc2:
Immeasurable shadows and light,
Flowing along scorching trails.
A shroud of darkness buries the earth,
Yet the golden arrow seeks to pierce the throat of the abyss.

34022.name: The Sky Ablaze [2]
34022.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34022.desc2:
The vast sea's experiences converge in one's view like a tidal wave,
Longing for the chariot's blaze to ride across the deep,
Scattering golden wheat seeds upon the mortal world.
Such mercy, such arrogance.

34023.name: The Sky Ablaze [3]
34023.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34023.desc2:
A throne blazing in glory and splendor,
Violence that scorched the earth to ash,
The yoke of fate forged around the neck,
The blood of kin smeared upon the altar.

34024.name: The Sky Ablaze [4]
34024.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34024.desc2:
The blazing sun falls, a god's life comes to an end.
A helpless cub's fate with no one to rely on,
The last survivor scattered, the road comes to an end.

34025.name: The Sky Ablaze [5]
34025.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34025.desc2:
Forge the reins of yesterday into a compass,
That ever-burning child leads and guides us,
Through digital cages and the night's hollow lies,
Turning rigid time into a crown of soft flowers.

34026.name: The Sky Ablaze [6]
34026.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34026.desc2:
Dusk bleeds crimson, dawn soft as ever.
The long night is but a prelude to sunrise,
The beasts of darkness howl in vain,
The knight's chains shall melt away.
