34121.name: Feathered Fate [1]
34121.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34121.desc2:
Little bird, little bird, where are you flying to?
The little bird just shakes its head with a smile.
I don't know.
I just want to go somewhere far away.

34122.name: Feathered Fate [2]
34122.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34122.desc2:
The little bird flies over mountains and rivers,
finding a quiet garden in full bloom.
Countless daisies smile up at her,
and the little bird falls in love with the sunshine, the morning dew, and the gentle fragrance.

34123.name: Feathered Fate [3]
34123.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34123.desc2:
But the garden is never truly at peace.
A sleeping bear lies within, and gray wolves prowl its edges.
The daisies sway gently,
begging the little bird to take flight once more.

34124.name: Feathered Fate [4]
34124.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34124.desc2:
The little bird gladly agrees, though she still doesn't know where to fly.
To the ends of the world, to the homeland of the bears and wolves!
The daisies sing in unison:
It's a land of peace, an ocean free of all sorrow.

34125.name: Feathered Fate [5]
34125.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34125.desc2:
The little bird flies through countless springs and countless winters.
She befriends migrating birds, and together they soar through the skies.
But over the course of the long journey, these companions drift away one by one, losing their way.
The little bird keeps flying, alone, toward places even farther away.

34126.name: Feathered Fate [6]
34126.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34126.desc2:
But there is no ocean at the world's end, only a blazing sun.
Fierce winds snap the little bird's wings, and the scorching sun burns away every feather.
The little bird falls from the heavens. As her consciousness begins to fade, she seems to catch the scent once more...
Of those daisies she once saw, at the very beginning of her journey.

34221.name: Thorned Rose [1]
34221.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34221.desc2:
The ancient rings of time stand silent as iron.
A silver coffin lies across the spine of the deep forest.
A nameless cry echoes from within.
What slumbers inside knocks upon the gates of the world.

34222.name: Thorned Rose [2]
34222.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34222.desc2:
A thorned rose rests beside the coffin,
its roots sunk deep in rotting earth, drinking in the mist and morning frost.
It knows the seal is about to break,
and a thousand petals bloom with ravenous hunger.

34223.name: Thorned Rose [3]
34223.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34223.desc2:
The refugees of the endless night come, guided by the crimson moon.
A crimson tide erupts through pale veins.
The blood-hungry bloom sips at the lingering warmth,
and the silent roots at last learn how to grow.

34224.name: Thorned Rose [4]
34224.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34224.desc2:
The rose rejoices in wild delight.
Awakened in an instant, the thorns engulf the silver coffin.
Every thorn's mark is a crimson vow,
and every tightening embrace buries another wail.

34225.name: Thorned Rose [5]
34225.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34225.desc2:
The refugees of the eternal night smile as they drift into sleep.
Their pale flesh and bones return to the soil.
The barren spring dreams again of a heartbeat,
and crimson streams rise from the depths of the earth.

34226.name: Thorned Rose [6]
34226.desc: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
34226.desc2:
When every last drop of blood has run dry,
the rose withers alongside the silver coffin.
At last, the blood-soaked vows bear fruit,
and the first silver stamen greets the dawn.

104001.name: Prototype Seal
104001.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>[Universal Agent Breakthrough Item]</color>Can be used in place of Certification Seals when you don't have enough. A different number of Prototype Seals must be used to substitute different rarities of Certification Seals.
104001.desc2: A fairly simple seal made through basic forging techniques. It's popular amongst Agents for its low-key style and matte finish.

104002.name: Master Component
104002.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>[Universal W-Engine Breakthrough Item]</color>Can be used in place of W-Engine Components when you don't have enough. A different number of Master Components must be used to substitute different rarities of W-Engine Components.
104002.desc2: A mysterious legend known among W-Engine enthusiasts. This item may look like nothing special, but it'll add the finishing touch to your sound quality.

104003.name: Original Chip
104003.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>[Universal Skill Level-Up Item]</color>Can be used in place of Tactical Chips when you don't have enough. A different number of Original Chips must be used to substitute different rarities of Tactical Chips.
104003.desc2: An original chip, unmarred by time or sedimentation. Its immense memory bank awaits training data to be uploaded so Agents can use it to hone their skills.

110001.name: Ferocious Grip
110001.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110001.desc2: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Dead End Butcher. Despite being completely shredded, it still retains the shape of something trying to grab.

110002.name: Living Drive
110002.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110002.desc2: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Unknown Corruption Complex. It looks just like a normal joint, but keeps writhing around as though alive — like it's trying to power some colossus in a wild dance.

110003.name: Finale Dance Shoes
110003.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110003.desc2: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Twin Marionettes. Just one look is enough to feel the hostile loneliness it exudes. Everything must come to an end, except in the Hollows.

110004.name: Scarlet Engine
110004.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110004.desc2: Etheric coagulum preserved in a rare form, extracted from the Corrupted Overlord - Pompey. Although it appears to be merely a broken component, the immense Etheric energy contained within seems to rumble incessantly.

110005.name: Sycophant's Refinement
110005.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110005.desc2: A rare form of Etheric coagulum obtained from "Sacrifice" Bringer. There is no explanation, and further investigation is prohibited. This is Ether in a bizarre form, whispering to those who desire it of the consequences of greed.

110006.name: Exuvia of Refinement
110006.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110006.desc2: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Miasma Priest. The cast-off remains of one who commanded and wielded miasma. A nauseating filth still surges and grows upon it, like some twisted, undying faith.

110007.name: Crimson Miasma Spike
110007.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110007.desc2: A rare form of etheric coagulum preserved from the "Corrupted Wandering Hunter". A spiky crystalline formation with an ominous red hue reminiscent of Miasma. Yet it emits no intense waves - only a crystal-like, unwavering persistence.

110008.name: Clouded Crystalline Substance
110008.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110008.desc2: An etheric coagulum preserved in a rare form, taken from the giant beast "Sobek" controlled by The Thrall. An indescribable crystalline substance, with tainted patterns clinging to its surface that seem to whisper tales of the abyss to whoever possesses it.

110009.name: Marrow-Draining Thorn
110009.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110009.desc2: An etheric coagulum preserved in a rare form, extracted from the Sanguine Sweeper. A lethal blade that decides life and death with ease, its edge still exuding the rusty-sweet scent of countless blood-soaked kills. The sadistic hunger is never sated, and blood only deepens the thirst, a void that cannot be filled.

110010.name: Timeworn Husk
110010.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110010.desc2: A rare form of etheric coagulum retrieved from Girtablullu. Even as its shell crumbled into ruin, its burning desire to become Metamorphosed never faded.

110011.name: Forged Away Core
110011.desc: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
110011.desc2: A rare form of etheric coagulum preserved from the Kusarikku. An Enchainer larvae yet to be Metamorphosed—even a Hollow immortal creation was once reduced to a tool for those who would usurp.

110501.name: Higher Dimensional Data: Murderous Obituary
110501.desc: An item required to increase your Agent's Core Skill level.
110501.desc2: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Notorious Dullahan, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

110504.desc: An item required to increase your Agent's Core Skill level.
110504.desc2: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Hans - Energized, including investigators' most insightful impressions and assessments. It's enough data to see it "born and survive" inside a VR system.

110505.desc: An item required to increase your Agent's Core Skill level.
110505.desc2: A data model built on the combat records of numerous investigators versus Typhon Slugger, including the most penetrating impressions of it by the investigators. It's enough data to see it "born and alive" inside a VR system.

300001.name: Trainee Investigator Log
300001.desc2: A newbie Hollow investigator's operation video logs, recorded by their companion Bangboo.

300002.name: Official Investigator Log
300002.desc2: This provides far more combat-related details compared to the newbie investigator's records.

300003.name: Senior Investigator Log
300003.desc2: Detailed and meticulous operation logs. Watching this makes you feel as if you have explored Hollows yourself.

301001.name: W-Engine Battery
301001.desc2: A special storage battery containing electrolytes with trace amounts of Ether crystals, providing a reliable power supply for the W-Engine.

301002.name: W-Engine Power Supply
301002.desc2: A high-performance power supply capable of converting power. It can adapt to various W-Engine models and provide an accurate power supply based on real-time power consumption.

301003.name: W-Engine Energy Module
301003.desc2: A high-efficiency energy module made of various Etheric matter, providing stable and long-lasting energy for all models of W-Engines.

302001.name: Molded Plating Agent
302001.desc: Provides 100 EXP for your Drive Disc.
302001.desc2: A plating agent used to enhance Drive Discs, providing a certain level of resistance to corruption.

302002.name: Crystallized Plating Agent
302002.desc: Provides 500 EXP for your Drive Disc.
302002.desc2: A plating agent used to enhance Drive Discs. It forms a coating on the surface that provides superior protection against corruption and exhibits a crystalline polish. As a result, it has also been utilized on decorations to enhance their appearance.

302003.name: Ether Plating Agent
302003.desc: Provides 2000 EXP for your Drive Disc.
302003.desc2: A plating agent used to enhance Drive Discs and another example of how Ether technology can benefit daily life. The Ether resources extracted from Hollows are ultimately used to explore even deeper into these Hollows.

303001.name: Bangboo Software Patch
303001.desc2: A software patch storing a large amount of behavioral data. It can initially train a Bangboo's logic core and improve its computational capability.

303002.name: Bangboo Algorithm Module
303002.desc2: A large data module specifically designed for Bangboo logic algorithms, enabling rapid improvement of a Bangboo's computing power.

303003.name: Bangboo System Widget
303003.desc2: A comprehensive data package that can upgrade a Bangboo's logic core, resulting in a significant improvement in its overall capabilities.

304009.desc2: A must-have spray paint for graffiti lovers. Its core ingredients contain the Ether component that allows the paint's color to never fade.

304043.desc: Open to obtain 3-5 Enemy Cards, including at least 1 Advanced Enemy Card.
304043.desc2: An Enemy Card that is not too difficult to acquire and moderately difficult in training. Nevertheless, they stand one level higher than the basic cards, becoming an "It may not be formidable, but I can't go without it" item for collectors.

304046.name: Lost W-Engine
304046.desc: One of the lost W-Engines from the gadget store. Get it back to Susie.
304046.desc2: Susie says the gadget store lost a batch of limited-edition collectibles to a Hollow disaster. This must be one of them.

304047.name: Wild Duck Out of Its Cage
304047.desc: A duck that escaped from a Pegasos truck. Catch it and take it back.
304047.desc2: A new breed of domestic duck bred by a famous farm in Eridu Valley. The driver Gael from Pegasos was responsible for transporting them but for unknown reasons, the vehicle's cargo compartment was opened, and these priceless ducks scattered and escaped.

304048.name: Lost W-Engine
304048.desc: One of the lost W-Engines from the gadget store. Get it back to Susie.
304048.desc2: Susie says the gadget store lost a batch of limited-edition collectibles to a Hollow disaster. This must be one of them.

304049.name: Damaged Small Safe
304049.desc: This is a standard small safe found in Hollows, but its lock is jammed and can't be opened normally. Consult a professional modifier if you need to open it.
304049.desc2: The memories of your journey together are cherished here.

304050.name: "Starlight Knight" Film Case
304050.desc: A film case containing the "Starlight Knight" videotape

304051.name: The Port Peak Videotape
304051.desc: A movie lent out from Random Play to bribe the Mountain Lion Gang.
304051.desc2: A thriller based on a true story. The film tells the tale of a group of adventurers who encounter the ruthless villain known as "The Lumberjack" in The Port Peak. Many viewers say they're left with a fear of the woods after watching it.

304052.name: Keycard for the Equipment Room
304052.desc: A keycard in the shape of a work card. It can be used to swipe open the door to Public Security's equipment room.
304052.desc2: Technically, every Public Security Officer can swipe their work card to get into the equipment room, but sometimes they forget to bring it. This master keycard is just for when this happens.

304053.name: Master E-Keycard
304053.desc: A master keycard that can be used on most mid-to-large electronic machines. It can be used to open the final mechanism leading to the Lion's Den.
304053.desc2: The master keycard stored in the NEPS equipment room is a low-level asset. This renders most — or rather, all criminal syndicate hideout defenses based on an outdated IT system obsolete.

304054.name: Lost Supply Box
304054.desc: A very sturdy storage chest. It looks quite valuable.
304054.desc2: There seems to be an unfamiliar company logo on the corner of the chest. From the make and quality, this appears to be for military use. Though it's covered in dust, there are no signs of Ether corruption.

304055.name: Focus
304055.desc: Unlocking course nodes requires consuming specific Focus points. When your focus points decrease to a level where you cannot unlock or participate in the next course, please take time to rest and recover. Focus points are restored by 150 points daily at 4:00 AM, with a maximum capacity of 500 Focus points.
304055.desc2: Over time, your mind will gradually become clearer.

304056.name: Nitro-Fuel
304056.desc2: Nitro-Fuel borrowed from the residents of Blazewood for a showdown with Lighter.

304057.name: Nitro-Fuel Raffle Ticket
304057.desc2: A voucher from the Settlement Days celebration used to support your chosen contestant. You can exchange this voucher for double the Nitro-Fuel if they win!

304058.name: Raffle Ticket
304058.desc: The raffle ticket given to us by Hugo.
304058.desc2: I wonder what kind of prize we'll get...

304059.name: Auction Invitation
304059.desc: An invitation required for entry to the auction.
304059.desc2: An exquisitely crafted invitation card, giving off a subtle fragrance of perfume.

304060.name: A Rather Abstract Piece of Art
304060.desc: An art piece acquired at an auction.

304061.name: Old Skyletter
304061.desc: Prayers That Failed to Take Flight
304061.desc2: The skyletter preserved by Mr. Mo has straight and clean creases, as if freshly folded. Yet upon closer inspection of the paper's color, one can still see traces left by the passage of time. The skyletter's owner must have taken great care in preserving it.

304062.name: Skyletter
304062.desc2: A skyletter crafted by Yixuan and distributed to the mystics of Suibian Temple. On the night of the Tidefaire, these paper birds will flutter their delicate wings, carrying the blessings and hopes of the Waifei Peninsula's people to the Hollow. After a perilous night, through storms and surging waves, where will these birds finally come to rest?

304063.name: Skyletter
304063.desc2: A skyletter crafted by Yixuan and distributed to the mystics of Suibian Temple. On the night of the Tidefaire, these paper birds will flutter their delicate wings, carrying the blessings and hopes of the Waifei Peninsula's people to the Hollow. After a perilous night, through storms and surging waves, where will these birds finally come to rest?

304064.name: Skyletter
304064.desc2: A skyletter crafted by Yixuan and distributed to the mystics of Suibian Temple. On the night of the Tidefaire, these paper birds will flutter their delicate wings, carrying the blessings and hopes of the Waifei Peninsula's people to the Hollow. After a perilous night, through storms and surging waves, where will these birds finally come to rest?

304065.name: Strange Copper Coin
304065.desc: Looks pretty weird, but weird in a good way
304065.desc2: A strange copper coin Sweety received from a customer, engraved with patterns she's never seen before. Maybe Master Vince at Devon Pawnshop would know what it is.

304066.name: Fortune's Tea Pet
304066.desc: Obtained from Mini Cargo Truck in Failume Heights. Used to submit a Yum Cha Sin order commission.
304066.desc2:
"Hold onto your 'Fortune's Tea Pet' and sip some tea - it'll bring you luck in everything you do!"
Once a best-selling tea pet set in the Waifei Peninsula, it gained widespread popularity for its adorable design and meaningful symbolism. After the manufacturing company's unfortunate closure following the fall of the old capital, these sets became increasingly rare. Today, a small number of enthusiasts still collect them.

304067.name: The Quizmaster's Card
304067.desc: The Quizmaster's card. It's also a clue to finding them.
304067.desc2: A card left by a mysterious trickster who repeatedly posed riddles to others in the Lemnian Hollow. Made of expensive Porcelume material, it reads "Congratulations on solving all the puzzles - your reward is the journey itself! Looking forward to another mind-bending adventure with you~". This could be a clue to finding this person. What kind of individual could they be?

304068.name: "To Delulus" Performance Ticket
304068.desc: Tickets prepared by the Angels of Delusion for "Delulus" coming to watch the Gilded Carrot Day performance. Make sure you're there on time and dive into the world of delusion with them together!
304068.desc2: Help the Angels of Delusion hand out the tickets to their friends.

304069.name: Yixuan's Lucky Money
304069.desc:
An opened Lucky Money envelope from Yixuan, with a blessing written on it:
"Wishing you safety, peace, and happiness."
304069.desc2: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year... and a few dozen Dennies.

304070.name: Uncle Baorong's Lucky Money
304070.desc:
An opened Lucky Money envelope from Uncle Baorong, with a blessing written on it:
"May you keep discovering and creating. Endless wonders are still waiting for you in the new year, young one."
304070.desc2: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year... and a few dozen Dennies.

304071.name: Wise's Lucky Money
304071.desc:
An opened Lucky Money envelope from Wise, with a blessing written on it:
"I'll be right by your side in the new year, Belle."
304071.desc2: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year...

304072.name: Belle's Lucky Money
304072.desc:
An already opened Lucky Money envelope from Belle, with a blessing written on it:
"Let's stick together in the new year too, Wise!"
304072.desc2: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year...

305001.name: Universal Audio Memory Card
305001.desc: A memory card used for storing audio data.
305001.desc2: This universal model can read and transfer content from various devices, including but not limited to surveillance bugs, Bangboo, security rooms, mobile phones, VCRs, voice recorders, and internal storage for Hollow communication devices...

305002.name: Universal Audio Memory Card
305002.desc: A memory card used for storing audio data.
305002.desc2: This universal model can read and transfer content from various devices, including but not limited to surveillance bugs, Bangboo, security rooms, mobile phones, VCRs, voice recorders, and internal storage for Hollow communication devices...

305003.name: Bag of Cash
305003.desc2:
A travel bag with dark red and black scuff marks on the side.
Unzipping it reveals it to be stuffed full of banknotes.

305004.name: Retro Flip Phone
305004.desc2:
A phone with a long list of failed outgoing calls to a contact named "Sis."
A pre-composed message remains unsent in the outbox:
"If anyone reads this and also finds a bag full of cash nearby, can you please send some of the money to a girl named Carol in Ward A2-1402, Eridu Hospital? Just tell her this is the aid she requested before."

305007.desc: An ID card for a Hollow Zero investigator.
305007.desc2:
Cardholder: Parker.
The card has been crudely made, with obvious ghosting on both the name and serial number. It also feels rough around the edges.
The outer laminate has scratches and tears in it, and it looks like it was discarded long ago.

305010.name: Zenless Limit Gauge
305010.desc2:
Its meter is one tick away from the red line.
Fortunately, Ether activity did not reach the Zenless limit — Otherwise, New Eridu would have yet another Hollow.

305011.name: Bullet
305011.desc: The casing of a bullet from a revolver.
305011.desc2:
Engravings on the base identify it as military issue.
It seems like a discarded bullet with no trace of having been used.

305012.name: Universal Audio Memory Card
305012.desc: A memory card used for storing audio data.
305012.desc2: This universal model can read and transfer content from various devices, including but not limited to surveillance bugs, Bangboo, security rooms, mobile phones, VCRs, voice recorders, and internal storage for Hollow communication devices...

305013.name: Polaroid Picture
305013.desc: A polaroid picture of a large dog that looks rather long in the tooth.
305013.desc2:
A handwritten message on the back is blotched at the edges:
"Will you still be my dog in my next life? I'll stay with you right until the very end."

305014.name: Button
305014.desc: Looks like just a normal button.
305014.desc2:
It's in the style of those buttons on the overcoats popular among boys' uniforms throughout New Eridu high schools.
The button has the initials "D.R." scrawled lightly into it in acrylic ink.

305015.name: Official Dossier from the Hollow Investigative Association
305015.desc2:
From what content remains, it seems to read:
"Hollow Investigative Association Decision on Citizens Trespassing Through Hollow Zero" 
"Please take the two girls back to school, and re-educate them on Hollow safety procedures.
Hollow Zero is the highest-risk area in New Eridu. Please do not enter of your own accord."

305018.desc2: Opening it reveals several pages headed "Notice of Construction Termination."

305019.name: Pillow from the Staff Breakroom
305019.desc2: A pillow from the staff breakroom in the abandoned observation center of Hollow Zero that's completely different in style to any other device surrounding it. Filthy dark brown stains adorn the pillow.

305020.desc: A letter of recommendation addressed to an academic at the White Star Institute.
305020.desc2: It's recommending a person called Dylan, and signed by Joyce.

305026.desc2: There are visible marks of use around the lock.

305028.name: Attendees' Pen Gift Box
305028.desc2:
It contains one pen and one bottle of ink.
The packaging reveals it to be a gift from the Symbiosis Seminar.
A message is printed inside the box:
"With Regards: Thank you for attending our seminar on symbiosis under the influence of Hollows."

305029.name: Book Called "Symbiosis"
305029.desc2: Judging by its cover, it looks quite old. The section explaining symbiosis has its page folded over.

305030.name: "Withering" Corruption Sample
305030.desc2: It was discovered that someone cut this oddly shaped "Withering" Corruption sample from an Ethereal, which explains its distinct form. A salute to the brave fighter who once faced the Ethereal.

305031.name: "Withering" Corruption Sample
305031.desc: "Withering" Corruption Sample from the Abandoned Safe Spot
305031.desc2: A "withering" corruption sample buried under an abandoned safe spot. Did the scholars and investigators who rested here back then manage to escape the attack...

305032.name: "Withering" Corruption Sample
305032.desc2: An abnormally heavy "withering" corruption sample. Upon analysis, a piece of metal is found at the core of the sample with traces of human use... Looks like an unfortunate person was swallowed by an Ethereal... Rest in peace.

305033.name: "Withering" Corruption Sample
305033.desc2: A very small "Withering" Corruption sample. It looks like a small fragment chipped off from a larger piece... Seems like the person who encountered the Ethereal did pretty much no damage to it. Let's just hope ran fast enough...

305034.name: Gorgeous Fabric
305034.desc: An old item found by chance in Hollow Zero. Find all the related items to unlock a story lost in the Hollow.
305034.desc2: "Things can be lost, but stories live on forever. As long as our neurotransmitters can still transmit information, stories will come to life once again."

306001.name: Tooth Necklace
306001.desc2: It's a red fang and seems like the insignia from a certain street gang. And judging by the exposed metal part, it's not just for decoration.

306002.name: Institute Strongbox
306002.desc: A strongbox stolen from an institute by the Red Fang Gang.
306002.desc2: It ended up making its way into the Cunning Hares' hands. The box has lost all value since the contents have been used for survival, and it's currently stashed at the video store.

306003.name: Photo of Six People
306003.desc2:
It was taken at a buffet restaurant after the Vision demolition crisis was taken care of. Just as Nekomata claims, it's a very good picture.
Looking at it brings back memories of a delicious meal, relaxed spirits, and slight whiplash at the sight of the bill.

306004.name: Site Diagram
306004.desc: A low-res image sent by Fairy to Grace's tablet.
306004.desc2: It shows the area near the prototype before it was swallowed up by the Hollow. You can make out a strange tower in the picture.

306005.name: External Memory Unit
306005.desc: A microchip-like object that Koleda gave us for safekeeping.
306005.desc2: It looks like an external memory unit that's been taken from the prototype. There could still be some clues contained within from before everything with Khors went down...

306006.name: Photo of a Young Girl
306006.desc2:
This should be the hacker Rain.
But the girl looks really familiar... You're pretty sure you've seen her before.

306007.name: Item_ClueItem_Story_07_name
306007.desc2:
This should be the hacker Rain.
But the girl looks really familiar... You're pretty sure you've seen her before.

306008.name: Item_ClueItem_Story_08_name
306008.desc2:
This should be the hacker Rain.
But the girl looks really familiar... You're pretty sure you've seen her before.

306010.name: Detective Sketch
306010.desc: An investigative sketch Qingyi drew according to Holly's descriptions. So Holly's friend Teddy is actually a Bangboo...

306011.name: Ballet Twins Blueprint
306011.desc: A hand-drawn blueprint provided by Victoria Housekeeping Co. that clearly outlines the structure of the Ballet Twins and the route to the rooftop of Tower B.

306013.name: Public Security Safety Awareness Campaign Questionnaire
306013.desc: A flyer from Officer Zhu Yuan. It appears to be a survey for an upcoming public event hosted by Public Security. Hmm... doesn't the person on the front look familiar?

306014.name: New Modified W-Engine
306014.desc: The gadget store owner gives you the latest W-Engine as a reward for the commission. It was customized based on Anby's weapon characteristics to enhance the power of its electrical output.

306015.name: Evidence: Autographed Poster
306015.desc: An old autographed poster that almost didn't make it as evidence. It says "To Holly & Teddy." It was apparently something Teddy had on the day it went missing. There doesn't seem to be anything special about it at first glance. What clues does it hold?

306016.name: Jane's Consultant ID Card
306016.desc: A hard plastic ID card authorized by Public Security. It has a photo of Jane that was taken while she was an external staff consultant on criminal psychology.

306017.name: Joran's Legacy
306017.desc2:
An unofficially recorded album.
It was secretly recorded by a fan known as "SofaCushions&PotatoChips" during Joran's fan meeting. By a twist of fate, this became the last semi-public recording of Joran. Never officially released or leaked, it has since become a legendary album among music enthusiasts, hailed as "Joran's legacy."

306019.name: ClueName_306019
306019.desc2: A pillow from the staff breakroom in the abandoned observation center of Hollow Zero that's completely different in style to any other device surrounding it. Filthy dark brown stains adorn the pillow.

306020.name: ClueName_306020
306020.desc: A letter of recommendation addressed to an academic at the White Star Institute.
306020.desc2: It's recommending a person called Dylan, and signed by Joyce.

306023.name: Old Photo of Woman with Covered Eyes
306023.desc: A somewhat aged photograph, though the image remains fairly clear. A blond young woman with her eyes covered leans against a wall. For some reason, her silhouette seems so fragile - as if she might shatter into pieces at any moment, filled with such profound sadness.

306024.name: Lyre Squad's Tape
306024.desc:
A tape from Lyre Squad, discovered by Nathan, Lethe's younger brother. This long-sealed recording sparked the series of events that would follow.
Years have passed, and while the tape's surface shows some wear, the audio within remains pristine - as crystal clear as if it was recorded just yesterday.

306025.name: Anby Doll
306025.desc:
A doll meticulously crafted by Nekomata, looking somewhat similar to Anby.
"Why is it top-heavy?"
"To simulate how someone often dives headfirst into the Hollow, meow."

306026.name: Sacrifice Core
306026.desc:
A weird Core extracted from a Sacrifice, radiating an ominous aura.
It seems to be hiding a mysterious power.

306027.name: Bringer's Notebook
306027.desc:
Bringer's notebook — old and worn-looking.
It seems to have a lot of locations of interest marked down.

306028.name: Paranormal Exploration Journal
306028.desc: A letter of recommendation addressed to an academic at the White Star Institute.
306028.desc2:
A time-worn document.
On the first page, the words "Paranormal Expedition" are scrawled. The journal details a paranormal exploration of Ballet Twins. Some pages are missing, and the handwriting is blurred, providing only a faint glimpse into the bizarre experiences of the explorers.

306029.name: External Memory Unit
306029.desc2:
Bangboo's external memory unit.
It stores key records of the paranormal exploration team's past operations. When accessed, it reveals logs of the team's activities and analysis data. However, the records abruptly cut off at a critical moment, hinting at a grim and unfortunate outcome. This sudden interruption stirs a deep sense of curiosity and unease about the truth of what happened.

306030.name: Astra-nomical Lightstick
306030.desc2:
A custom-made lightstick designed for Astra's New Year concert.
This unique stick combines a microphone with a Harmonic Core. When activated, the Harmonic Core causes the red section of the stick to rotate slowly, making it feel more like a magical wand than an ordinary lightstick.

306031.name: Fancy Collectible
306031.desc:
A collectible gifted by Vivian.
It looks like an expensive and exquisite piece of art, but it seems hollow inside... Might that mess with its value?

306032.name: Fancy Collectible
306032.desc:
A collectible gifted by Vivian.
It looks like an expensive and exquisite piece of art, and no one could have guessed it could be opened.
Inside, it conceals the mysterious Sacrifice Core.

306056.name: Sparkstone
306056.desc: The flint that Appon threw into the mine when he was hiding from Ethereals.
306056.desc2: The product of lost technology, and an object of interest for Engineer Bangboo's research. The Flame Spark, capable of igniting the Cinder Lake, might also... help it ignite a certain cage.

307001.name: Blooming Wind
307001.desc: Used to upgrade the Gilded Blossom W-Engine
307001.desc2: A special W-Engine component obtained in Hollow C41. It can be used to upgrade the W-Engine, Gilded Blossom, increasing its Ether resonance. A seed that can cause the gilded golden flowers to bloom, etched with the radiance of a season that slips by like sand through your fingers.

307002.name: Roaring Tides
307002.desc: Used to upgrade the Marcato Desire W-Engine.
307002.desc2: A specialized W-Engine Component obtained from the unique Melinoe Hollow, capable of enhancing the Ether Resonance performance of the Marcato Desire W-Engine. Even in the pale abyss, let the song of mortals resound.

307003.name: 16mm Film
307003.desc: Can be used to upgrade W-Engine Reel Projector.
307003.desc2: A commemorative W-Engine Component distributed by Gravity Cinema that can be used to enhance the Ether resonance performance of the W-Engine Reel Projector. A trace of inspirational light for engraving images, captured in a fleeting moment within 16mm film.

307004.name: Cerulean Echoes
307004.desc: Used to upgrade the Cauldron of Clarity W-Engine.
307004.desc2: A special engine component obtained from the Qingming Realm, capable of enhancing the Ether Resonance performance of the Cauldron of Clarity W-Engine. Countless waves of Sword Will, like echoes of the heart, resonating within this small stretch of sky.

307005.name: Blazing Chili
307005.desc: Used to upgrade The Simmering Pot W-Engine.
307005.desc2: A special W-Engine Component infused with searing Fire Energy, used to enhance the Resonance performance of The Simmering Pot W-Engine. Not spicy enough? Then crank up the heat!

307006.name: Child at Heart
307006.desc: Used to upgrade the Boisterous Echoes W-Engine.
307006.desc2: A special W-Engine Component that produces a pleasant sound when struck. It can be used to improve the Resonance performance of the W-Engine "Boisterous Echoes" and is highly favored by both faculty and students at Aurelia Academy.

307007.name: Twilight Afterimage
307007.desc: Can be used to upgrade the Sol Exuvia W-Engine.
307007.desc2: A special W-Engine Component obtained during the journey through Roscaelifer. It embodies the power of the fading light of ages past, carrying the hope of kindling tomorrow's dawn.

310104.name: New Modified W-Engine
310104.desc: The gadget store owner gives you the latest W-Engine as a reward for the commission. It was customized based on Anby's weapon characteristics to enhance the power of its electrical output.

310105.name: Evidence: Autographed Poster
310105.desc: An old autographed poster that almost didn't make it as evidence. It says "To Holly & Teddy." It was apparently something Teddy had on the day it went missing. There doesn't seem to be anything special about it at first glance. What clues does it hold?

310106.name: Jane's Consultant ID Card
310106.desc: A hard plastic ID card authorized by Public Security. It has a photo of Jane that was taken while she was an external staff consultant on criminal psychology.

400001.name: Cross Blast
400001.desc: Places a time bomb that explodes in a cross after 3 turns, <color=#2BAD00>clearing away most event tiles in its blast area.</color>
400001.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

400002.name: Cross Blast II
400002.desc: Places a time bomb that explodes in a cross after 3 turns, <color=#2BAD00>clearing away most event tiles in its blast area.</color>
400002.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

400003.name: Mysterious Carrot
400003.desc: Instantly teleports you to a random location.
400003.desc2: A Carrot Plug-In of unknown origin. Who knows where it will take you. Are you sure you want to use it...

400004.name: Mysterious Carrot II
400004.desc2: A Carrot map plug-in from an unidentified source. It can take you to the safest of places by the most efficient of means.

400005.name: Concentrated Medicine
400005.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Restores 10% of all squad members' Max HP.</color>
400005.desc2: A plug-in used to adjust Med Kit's potency. Enhances its healing effects.

400006.name: Concentrated Medicine II
400006.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Restores 20% of all squad members' Max HP.</color>
400006.desc2: A plug-in used to adjust Med Kit's potency. Largely enhances its healing effects.

400007.name: Short Distance Collection
400007.desc: Spin the wheel once. You may get: Gear Coins, a deadly trap, restorative medicine, or a Resonium.
400007.desc2: Release an auto-collection device to explore in a random direction, with a chance to bring back anything found on the way, which may include trouble.

400008.name: Short Distance Collection II
400008.desc: Spin the wheel once <color=#2BAD00>with a good chance of winning something nice</color>. You may get: Gear Coins, a deadly trap, restorative medicine, or Resonia.
400008.desc2: Release an auto-collection device to explore in a random direction, with a chance to bring back anything found on the way, which may include trouble.

400009.name: Powerful Excavation
400009.desc: Enter an unknown area that cannot be scanned.
400009.desc2: Excavate in directions with no path and discover new areas.

400010.name: Powerful Excavation II
400010.desc: Enter a mysterious unknown area that cannot be scanned.
400010.desc2: Excavate in directions with no path and discover new areas.

400011.name: Gold Calling
400011.desc: Turns 8 adjacent empty tiles into <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coin event tiles</color>.
400011.desc2: Come to me, Gear Coins! Enough hiding, it's time to come home!

400012.name: Gold Calling II
400012.desc: Turns all empty tiles into <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coin event tiles</color>.
400012.desc2: Come to me, Gear Coins! Enough hiding, it's time to come home!

400013.name: Concentrated Sedative
400013.desc2: A plug-in used to adjust Sedative's potency. Enhances its pressure-reducing effect.

400014.name: Concentrated Sedative II
400014.desc2: A plug-in that adjusts Sedative's potency and largely enhances its Pressure reducing effects.

400015.name: Raid Type Ethereal Decoy
400015.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Clears most event tiles along the way</color>, instantly claiming any positive outcomes while destroying any negative outcomes. Lasts 3 turns.
400015.desc2: A plug-in that sends out strong signals to irritate and attract specific Ethereals. Used in a destructive strategy to lure Ethereals and sweep the road ahead.

400016.name: Capture Type Ethereal Decoy
400016.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Clears most event tiles along the way</color>, doubling any positive outcomes while destroying any negative outcomes. Lasts 3 turns.
400016.desc2: A plug-in that sends out strong signals to irritate and attract specific Ethereals. While sweeping the road ahead, it will attempt to collect usable resources. Apparently, a certain degree of damage has enabled it to gather resources more efficiently.

400017.name: Integrated Supply
400017.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Fully restores all members' HP</color> and <color=#2BAD00>removes all traps</color>.
400017.desc2: A multi-functional supply plug-in that provides a large amount of Recovery Medicine and Detection Devices.

400018.name: Integrated Supply II
400018.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Fully restores all members' HP</color>, <color=#2BAD00>removes all traps</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>obtain 1 random Resonium</color>.
400018.desc2: This multi-functional supply plug-in provides a large amount of Recovery Medicine and Detection Devices... and even a Resonium!

400019.name: Stereoscopic Photocopy
400019.desc2: A plug-in that instantly copies Gear Coins. Bangboo merchants are strongly against this plug-in, but they can't tell the difference between the genuine coins and their replicas, so they can only repeatedly declare their opposition.

400020.name: Stereoscopic Photocopy II
400020.desc2: A plug-in that instantly copies Gear Coins. Bangboo merchants are strongly against this plug-in, but they can't tell the difference between the genuine coins and their replicas, so they can only repeatedly declare their opposition.

400021.name: Resonia Housekeeper
400021.desc: Randomly generates Resonia options. Collect, replace, discard, and perform other options.
400021.desc2: Plug-in that integrates Resonium collection and management. Place it on the road to auto-search for Resonia. Looks like a floor sweeping robot in every way.

400022.name: Navigation Beacon
400022.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Retains</color> the current event tile and carries it over <color=#2BAD00>to the next Hollow level</color>.
400022.desc2: Able to maintain a signal position synchronized with a Bangboo within a certain range, allowing for easy pathing to said position.

400025.name: Standard Sedative
400025.desc2: This improved sedative can effectively reduce Pressure.

400027.name: Handheld Xenon Flashlight
400027.desc: Produces a bright light that can be used to <color=#2BAD00>remove unidentified organisms within the 4 tiles around you</color>.
400027.desc2: A highly luminous light source filled with an inert gas mixture that emits intense light with a color temperature similar to that of the sun.

400028.name: Infrared Camera
400028.desc: Cameras are commonly found within the Ballet Twins, enabling clear vision even in darkness when utilized.

400029.name: Infrared Camera
400029.desc: Cameras are commonly found within the Ballet Twins, enabling clear vision even in darkness when utilized.

400032.name: Psyche-Resonance Plug-In
400032.desc: Enter Qingyi's Mindspace, sharing your senses and gathered intelligence.

400035.name: Bangboo Temporary Access
400035.desc: Rina gave you temporary access permissions to her Bangboo. You can switch between Drusilla and Anastella's control permissions.

400040.name: Heat Haze Amplifier
400040.desc: A Plug-In patented by Midsummer Inc. It's capable of quickly absorbing high concentrations of Ether in the air and converting it into an amplifying heat wave, as well as allowing one to check their current boosts.
400040.desc2: This device is designed to enhance Ether adept people's efficiency in cold and foggy environments in the Hollows. Therefore, when operational, it generates "a little bit" of heat in the surrounding area...

400041.name: Heat Haze Amplifier
400041.desc: No energy, unable to absorb Ether particles, can only be used to check buffs.
400041.desc2: This device is designed to enhance Ether adept people's efficiency in cold and foggy environments in the Hollows. Therefore, when operational, it generates "a little bit" of heat in the surrounding area...

400043.name: Rechargeable Jackhammer
400043.desc: Used to destroy rock obstacles. If sufficient Ether resources are provided for a charge, the destructive effect will be further enhanced.

400044.name: Powered Jackhammer
400044.desc: Further increases the destruction speed and can destroy harder rocks.

400045.name: Captain Charge
400045.desc: It increases the destructive efficiency and power to the maximum, and can consume Ether energy to perform "charge skills".

400046.name: Deus Ex Machina
400046.desc: Reverse death on the current tile
400046.desc2: "It's got unlimited uses! No need to go easy, use it as you please!"

400047.name: Gold Calling
400047.desc: Spend <color=#CF4029>500 Gear Coins</color>. Place the pile of <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coins</color> in the<color=#2BAD00>current location</color> to attract the Golden Bangboo.

400048.name: Ether Dewdrops
400048.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Revives and restores a certain amount of HP</color> of an incapacitated Agent after use.
400048.desc2: Mildly concentrated Ether energy... It looks inviting and exquisite, at least before it causes corruption.

400050.name: Captain Charge
400050.desc: Consumes energy to break through rocky obstacles. Offers further increased destruction speed and destroys extremely hard obstacles.

400051.name: Tactical Knife
400051.desc: Instantly eliminate all enemies on this floor (no EXP or drop)

400053.name: Climbing Gear
400053.desc: You can pass through walls on this floor.

400055.name: Crystal Catalyst
400055.desc: Turn all empty tiles within 7 tiles into <color=#2BAD00>Ether Crystals</color>

400056.name: Code Copy: Key
400056.desc: Double the current number of <color=#FFAF2C>keys</color> held

400057.name: Code Copy: Bomb
400057.desc: Double the current number of <color=#FFAF2C>bombs</color> held

400058.name: Code Copy: Gear Coin
400058.desc: Double the current number of <color=#FFAF2C>Gear Coins</color> held

400060.name: Pay for Peace
400060.desc: Turn all Gear Coin tiles on this floor into health recovery tiles

400061.name: Turning Waste into Treasure
400061.desc: Turn all walls on this floor into random other events

400063.name: Experience Converter
400063.desc: Turn all life recovery tiles on this floor into EXP tiles

400064.name: Code Copy: Disposable Plug-In
400064.desc: Reduces the protagonist's HP to 1, deal DMG equal to the lost HP to all enemies on this floor

400065.name: Causality Remote
400065.desc: Summon a <color=#2BAD00>machine</color> to a nearby empty tile

400066.name: Autonomous Robot Remote
400066.desc: Summon an <color=#2BAD00>"Autonomous Robot"</color> to a nearby empty tile

400067.name: Random Plug-In
400067.desc: Randomly trigger the effect of an activated item

400068.name: Detachable Backpack
400068.desc: Discard all held Gear Coins and keys, regenerate them within 10 tiles

400069.name: Super Bomb
400069.desc: Create a cross-shaped explosion at the current location. The explosion extends infinitely

400070.name: Bomb Pre-Plant Command
400070.desc: Turns walls, doors, and spikes in the surrounding 7 tiles into <color=#CF4029>enemies</color>

400071.name: Credit Card
400071.desc: Purchase all items within the surrounding 7 tiles

400073.name: Resonium Magic Box
400073.desc: Generate 1 <color=#2BAD00>Resonium Tile</color>, with 1 additional tile generated for each floor descended

400074.name: Gear Coin Machine Gun
400074.desc: No usage limit, consumes 100 Gear Coins when used, reduces all monsters' HP in the room by 1

400075.name: Quick Nav
400075.desc: Teleport to the entrance to the next floor

400076.name: Demolition Device
400076.desc: Destroy all walls, doors, and spikes on this floor

400077.name: Powerful Flashlight
400077.desc: Reveal all hidden tiles on this floor

400078.name: Fragile Boxing Gloves
400078.desc: Protagonist gains <color=#2BAD00>+100</color> ATK, effect wears off after one attack

400079.name: Family Photo
400079.desc: Immediately increases the Protagonist's HP by <color=#2BAD00>10</color> after use. This Plug-In will be automatically used when at death's doors, reviving you with 100% effectiveness

400081.name: Risk and Reward
400081.desc: Generate <color=#2BAD00>5 – 10</color> HP recovery tiles and <color=#CF4029>5 – 10</color> spikes within in 7-tile range

400084.name: Gilded Spray
400084.desc: Change all Resonium tiles in the surrounding 7 tiles into <color=#FFAF2C>S-Rank</color>

400085.name: Flag
400085.desc: ATK <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> for the Protagonist and all squad members

400089.name: "King of Revival"
400089.desc: Generate a lot of good things. Protagonist immediately takes <color=#CF4029>1,000</color> DMG (that's right, this will cause your immediate <color=#CF4029>demise</color> under most circumstances)

411011.desc: Has Anby's contact info. You can call <color=#2BAD00>Anby</color> for support.
411011.desc2: "Wait here for my signal. When I smash the cup, that's your cue!"

833820.name: Notes From the Chained
833820.desc2:
A mysterious track posted on Inter-Knot by an anonymous creator, inspired by the hallucinations of a lost Hollow wanderer. The melody cuts off abruptly halfway through, yet its hauntingly precise evocation of the despair and disorientation of deep Hollow exploration made it a brief sensation.
It is said that an investigator, once lost, abandoned rescue efforts and instead followed the melody as his guide, wandering within the Hollow. The agony brought on by Corruption nearly blinded him, yet the tune continued to echo in his ears. In the end, he miraculously found a way out.
Later, this investigator who returned from the abyss became a well-known composer and finished writing the second half of the melody.

1000105.desc: Agent <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1000105.desc2: Someone was trying to do the right thing and threw it into the Hollow. Where exactly it fell and what it might have burned is a mystery.

1000106.name: [Ignite] Top-Notch Charcoal
1000106.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Motivation to all squad members.
1000106.desc2: High-end charcoal that emits a fruity fragrance when lit. If used to roast fruit, perhaps it could double the fruity flavor.

1000107.name: [Ignite] Camping Stove
1000107.desc: Inflicting <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> grants <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Motivation to all squad members.
1000107.desc2: With this handy tool, you can enjoy hot food wherever you go.

1000108.name: [Ignite] Deluxe Lighter
1000108.desc2: An elaborately decorated lighter. It looks like the favorite item of the head of a certain gang.

1000109.name: [Ignite] Electric Torch
1000109.desc2: It is known as the Eternally Inextinguishable, but it has gone out more than a few times.

1000110.name: [Ignite] Pulse Igniter
1000110.desc: <color=#FF5521>Burning</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1000110.desc2: A tool that housewives use to light the stove. It can light up places that need to be lit.

1000111.name: [Ignite] Solid Alcohol
1000111.desc2: A convenient and portable item for various occasions. For example, it can be particularly useful when you want to confess your love but can't find enough candles to make a heart pattern.

1000112.name: [Ignite] Collective Emblem
1000112.desc: Increases the chance for [Ignite] Resonia to appear.
1000112.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Come, turn the scattered sparks into a blazing inferno.

1000201.name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble Special
1000201.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 30s, stacking up to 5 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
1000201.desc2: Scarlet Noble of a random flavor. You never know what flavor you have bought until after you drink it. There's supposedly a 0.01% chance of getting the secret flavor: blood.

1000202.name: [Energy] Neon Cola
1000202.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, generates <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> Energy for 1 random Agent.
1000202.desc2: The champion beverage consumer for five years in a row. Sugar-free and healthy drinks only. Even the color of the drinks is white.

1000203.name: [Energy] Raging Taurine
1000203.desc: Ultimate DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
1000203.desc2: "Be brave! Be wild!" The commercial is memorable, particularly the part where the actor pours the half-finished drink over his head and then crushes the can into dust.

1000204.name: [Energy] TANKA: BBQ Flavor
1000204.desc: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent.
1000204.desc2: A brand of soda that is constantly putting out new flavors. This barbecue flavor is supposed to give you that lovely nostalgic taste of barbecue and cola.

1000205.name: [Energy] Power Up
1000205.desc: Launching an Ultimate generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for all squad members.
1000205.desc2: Re-hydrate and restore electrolytes in a flash as fast as lightning!

1000206.name: [Energy] Orange God
1000206.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge generates 6 Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10s</color>.
1000206.desc2: This orange juice is popular among girls. Each can packs the nutritional punch of thirty oranges. "We carefully choose only the finest oranges. One of ours is as good as ten of another kind. That means with just three oranges, you're getting the nutrients of thirty!"

1000207.name: [Energy] Captain Cow
1000207.desc: Agents Decibel Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
1000207.desc2: "Help me grow taller, Captain Cow!" This pure milk drink is loved by both children and adults alike. After all, who wouldn't want to add a few inches to their height?

1000208.name: [Energy] Sharp Smile
1000208.desc: Basic Attack Energy Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1000208.desc2: No additives and sugar free. Who wouldn't love a combo like this?

1000209.name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble: Lemon
1000209.desc: EX Special Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>.
1000209.desc2: An energy drink that is all the rage with young people. Green lemon concentrate covers the taurine flavor.

1000210.name: [Energy] Leman
1000210.desc: Defeating an enemy generates 8 Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s.
1000210.desc2: "Hey, you. Yeah, you. Drink me and we'll be besties for life. Come on. Drink me."

1000211.name: [Energy] Mr. Bright's Probiotics
1000211.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 15s.
1000211.desc2: "Healthy inside and out with a bottle of Mr. Bright."

1000212.name: [Energy] Collective Emblem
1000212.desc: Increases the chance for [Energy] Resonia to appear.
1000212.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Energy! Activity! Huge Excitement!

1000301.name: [Critical] Sniper Scope
1000301.desc: Landing a critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
1000301.desc2: Take it easy. Aim and then shoot. If you miss, it's because you are in too much of a hurry.

1000302.name: [Critical] Sawn-Off Shotgun
1000302.desc: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Insight upon entering the battlefield. Agents <color=#2BAD00>no longer lose</color> Insight stacks when attacked.
1000302.desc2: It packs a punch but is small and convenient to carry. You can even keep it in your waistband. (There are over 200 accidental discharge incidents each year for this very reason)

1000303.name: [Critical] Weapon Crate
1000303.desc: Each Standard [Critical] Resonium owned increases Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
1000303.desc2: Don't be fooled by this unassuming box — it's not just a crate for weapons, but rather a portal to an entire arsenal of them. You will never know how many weapons you can pull out of it.

1000304.name: [Critical] RPG Shell
1000304.desc: Triggering a critical hit increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 3s.
1000304.desc2: Regular soldiers should get out of the way!

1000305.name: [Critical] Gatling Gun
1000305.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants all squad members 1 stack of Insight. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>8</color>s.
1000305.desc2: Once you pull the trigger, you'll never want to let go. Offense is the best defense, so a constant attack is the ultimate defense!

1000306.name: [Critical] Doombringer
1000306.desc2: Smart ignition and precision blasts. How far it explodes all depends on how far you throw it.

1000307.name: [Critical] Tactical Goggles
1000307.desc: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Insight upon entering the battlefield.
1000307.desc2: Sometimes, good cover is all you need to get a clear view of your target.

1000308.name: [Critical] Duelist
1000308.desc: Defeating an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Insight.
1000308.desc2: Add a little high-tech flare to your duel. Who cares if it is fair?

1000309.name: [Critical] Spare Magazine
1000309.desc: Landing a critical hit on an enemy reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 10s.
1000309.desc2: Better prepare for the next enemy early.

1000310.name: [Critical] Muzzle Compensator
1000310.desc: When hitting an enemy from behind, Agent CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1000310.desc2: An essential accessory for firearms, it enhances your prowess in combat.

1000311.name: [Critical] Laser Scope
1000311.desc: Each non-critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>. This effect is reset after the Agent triggers a critical hit.

1000312.name: [Critical] Collective Emblem
1000312.desc: Increases the chance for [Critical] Resonia to appear.
1000312.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
More guns, bigger guns, stronger guns...

1000401.name: [Shield] Fingerless Gloves
1000401.desc: Shielded Agents' <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt level</color> increases, and they receive <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> less DMG.
1000401.desc2: People into punk love wearing this style of gloves.

1000402.name: [Shield] Elastic Kneepads
1000402.desc: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of the Agent's Max HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1000402.desc2: It offers the flexibility needed for all those weird and wonderful leg positions.

1000403.name: [Shield] Battery-Charged Baton
1000403.desc: Increases CRIT DMG of Shielded Agents by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> and Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>15</color>.
1000403.desc2: Don't touch it while it's charging — it's super hot.

1000404.name: [Shield] Riot Helmet
1000404.desc: Generates Shield for all squad members equal to <color=#2BAD00>150%</color> of their initial DEF upon entering the battlefield.
1000404.desc2: Rabbit ears were added to display closeness and power.

1000405.name: [Shield] Punk Belt
1000405.desc: Shielded Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to enemies within 6m.
1000405.desc2: With this spiky belt, no one is going to bother you when you're out and about.

1000406.name: [Shield] War Boots
1000406.desc: Defeating an enemy generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> of Max HP for all squad members, lasting 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
1000406.desc2: It may look handsome, but it has a strong smell.

1000407.name: [Shield] Exoskeleton Armor
1000407.desc: Each Standard [Shield] Resonium owned increases Agent DEF by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>.
1000407.desc2: Provides excellent protection while allowing you to launch powerful elbow strikes.

1000408.name: [Shield] Blast Shield
1000408.desc2: Justice must win! Or at least it can't lose.

1000409.name: [Shield] Warm Bracers
1000409.desc: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 25%, immediately generate Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of Max HP for 10s. (This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.)
1000409.desc2: It's not practical to hope it will stop damage. But graffiti lovers like wearing it to protect their wrists.

1000410.name: [Shield] Flak Jacket
1000410.desc2: Heavy attacks bounce right off. The only problem is you bounce forward.

1000411.name: [Shield] Tactical Mask
1000411.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> of Max HP for 5s. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
1000411.desc2: Strong filtration and fresh circulation. You can even wear it while using the bathroom.

1000412.name: [Shield] Collective Emblem
1000412.desc: Increases the chance for [Shield] Resonia to appear.
1000412.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Pile on the thickest armor... what was next again?

1000501.name: [Shock] Current Gloves
1000501.desc2: Gloves that release a shocking voltage. Remember what these gloves look like, and be careful when shaking hands.

1000502.name: [Shock] Stun Gun
1000502.desc: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy generates <color=#2BAD00>10</color> Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
1000502.desc2: It won't do direct damage, but it is still recommended that you take a shot before a fight.

1000503.name: [Shock] Amplification Bracelet
1000503.desc: Agents with Zap deal <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> more <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
1000503.desc2: According to those who have used this device, running with it feels like an invisible muscle-man is gripping your wrist and yanking you forward as hard as he can.

1000504.name: [Shock] Tesla Sphere
1000504.desc: Agents generate <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> Decibels upon hitting a <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemy. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1000504.desc2: Look cool when the power is on or use it for divination when the power is off (and still look cool).

1000505.name: [Shock] Lightning Trident
1000505.desc: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>6</color> stacks of Zap.
1000505.desc2: You can't take this with you to ponds to harpoon fish!

1000506.name: [Shock] Electric Baton
1000506.desc: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>10</color> stacks of Zap.
1000506.desc2: This weapon is a must for any lady's purse. Once you've shocked the perv, follow it up with a slap to the face.

1000507.name: [Shock] Mosquito Swatter
1000507.desc: Each stack of Zap increases the Agent's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color>.
1000507.desc2: With this powerful and convenient tool, you won't need to tap with your hands anymore. The only downside is that it may emit the smell of burnt meat if you use it for too long...

1000508.name: [Shock] Conductive Coil
1000508.desc: Dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stacks of Zap. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s.
1000508.desc2: A crude method: wrapping the weapon to increase its conductivity.

1000509.name: [Shock] Thunder Whip
1000509.desc2: Sure, it's not practical, but you can look like a villain.

1000510.name: [Shock] EMP Grenade
1000510.desc2: Stay clear of electrical devices when throwing this; otherwise, you'll get carried off too.

1000511.name: [Shock] Hand Crank Generator
1000511.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG to <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemies.
1000511.desc2: The strongest person will find themselves as the poor soul cranking the generator alone on a camping trip.

1000512.name: [Shock] Collective Emblem
1000512.desc: Increases the chance for [Shock] Resonia to appear.
1000512.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
If we gather enough, can we unleash 100,000 volts?

1000601.name: [General] Stimulant
1000601.desc: When below 50% HP, the buff effects of B-Rank and A-Rank Adversity Resonia increase by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
1000601.desc2: Quickly break past human limitations. Boost every body function. Side effects include becoming talkative and fidgety.

1000603.name: [General] Band-Aid
1000603.desc: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>1.2%</color> less DMG.
1000603.desc2: A band-aid with ointment that can stop bleeding and cause a wound to close quickly.

1000604.name: [General] Concentration Pills
1000604.desc: For every 10% of HP lost, the Agent generates <color=#2BAD00>7%</color> Energy.
1000604.desc2: Totally safe and has no side effects. You can eat it like candy.

1000701.name: [Duel] Chain Mace
1000701.desc: For each stack of Rush, Agents' Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> when hitting a Stunned enemy.
1000701.desc2: If you get hit, then you only have yourself to blame for not throwing it far enough.

1000702.name: [Duel] Shock Gloves
1000702.desc: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> Decibels.
1000702.desc2: A direct hit to the jaw is all you need to bring the opponent to their knees.

1000703.name: [Duel] Homemade Spiked Mace
1000703.desc: When triggering a Chain Attack, all squad members receive 1 stack of Rush, and the Stun DMG Multiplier of enemies hit is increased by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, up to a max of <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1000703.desc2: Who even cares if it's sturdy or practical? As long as it looks terrifying and painful, it's good enough!

1000704.name: [Duel] Tonfa
1000704.desc2: Attack and defense are one. The more you hit, the faster you'll become.

1000705.name: [Duel] Joiner's Hammer
1000705.desc: When an enemy is inflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, all squad members gain a stack of Rush. If the target is not Stunned, its Daze increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
1000705.desc2: A decisive blow. Go forth, little nail!

1000706.name: [Duel] Bench
1000706.desc: When an enemy is Stunned, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> Decibels and <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Rush. Can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s.
1000706.desc2:
"I can't bear to watch. I want in, too!"
And then they strike with the power of a substitution that catches enemies off guard.

1000707.name: [Duel] Ergonomic Brick
1000707.desc2: Convenient to have on your person, everyone gets one.

1000708.name: [Duel] Baseball Bat
1000708.desc2: If you accidentally let go, one extra combatant will be stunned.

1000709.name: [Duel] Nunchucks
1000709.desc: EX Special Attacks inflict <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more Daze.
1000709.desc2: Once you start playing, you can't put it down. Even if you hit yourself, it doesn't hurt.

1000710.name: [Duel] Brass Knuckles
1000710.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 5s.
1000710.desc2: Frighten the enemy with your imposing manner and then rain down the punches.

1000711.name: [Duel] Gong of Jubilation
1000711.desc: Upon Stun recovery, the enemy's ATK is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s.
1000711.desc2: Hit it hard by your ear... and you'll see double all day.

1000712.name: [Duel] Rolling Pin
1000712.desc: Chain Attacks and the Ultimate deal <color=#2BAD00>significantly more DMG</color>. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
1000712.desc2: Who beats you depends on who cooks tonight.

1000713.name: [Duel] Collective Emblem
1000713.desc: Increases the chance for [Duel] Resonia to appear.
1000713.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Since a duel is inevitable, let's make sure we have every advantage on our side.

1000801.name: [Dodge] Sports Shades
1000801.desc: Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1000801.desc2:
Pro goggles designed to keep the eyes safe during high-speed sports.
"See! I can see everything!"

1000802.name: [Dodge] Skateboard
1000802.desc: When in the Counter state, Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.

1000803.name: [Dodge] Shuttlecock
1000803.desc: On triggering Perfect Dodge, Agents gain <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Agility and enter Vital View for 4s This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1000803.desc2: One must remain calm and ensure precision during a spike; otherwise, you'll only end up snapping fragile feathers with a roar.

1000804.name: [Dodge] Tennis Racket
1000804.desc: When entering Vital View by triggering Perfect Dodge, the post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter that can be used repeatedly up to <color=#2BAD00>4</color> times.
1000804.desc2: If you can't hit back, at least try to dodge. Getting smacked by that ball hurts.

1000805.name: [Dodge] Fencing Sword
1000805.desc: Extends the duration of the Counter state by <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s.

1000806.name: [Dodge] Yoga Ball
1000806.desc: The post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s. Triggering this effect grants the Agent 1 stack of Agility.
1000806.desc2: If you can maintain one pose without moving, then you can slow down the flow of time.

1000807.name: [Dodge] Killer Paddle
1000807.desc: Upon being attacked, quickly press Dodge to <color=#2BAD00>immediately break free</color> and recover 50% of the DMG taken as HP. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>6</color>s.
1000807.desc2: It's all about the final, show-stopping spike.

1000808.name: [Dodge] Skate Shoes
1000808.desc2: Made for those who seek the ultimate sprinting speed. If you can't stop, you'll probably crash.

1000810.name: [Dodge] Skis
1000810.desc: Triggering Dodge Counter generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent.
1000810.desc2: Gracefully dodge obstacles or eat snow like no one else.

1000811.name: [Dodge] Hard Hat
1000811.desc: Using Dodge increases the Agent's DEF by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 5s.
1000811.desc2: All defensive measures are a means to better offense.

1000812.name: [Dodge] Diving Goggles
1000812.desc: Every 3 times Perfect Dodge is triggered, Vital View activates for 4s. During this period, Agents inflict <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> more Daze.
1000812.desc2: Wearing it makes you feel like you've transformed into someone from another world.

1000813.name: [Dodge] Collective Emblem
1000813.desc: Increases the chance for [Dodge] Resonia to appear.
1000813.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Reduces the dodge rate of dodge Resonia when pulled...

1000814.name: [Dodge] Exercise Stopwatch
1000814.desc: Enter Vital View for 4s after a Perfect Dodge. Hidden Gear Coins are revealed for this duration. (Appears only in Rally Commissions)
1000814.desc2: If you keep staring at it, you'll feel as if everything is gradually getting larger.

1000901.name: [General] Hero's Cape
1000901.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> more DMG but also take <color=#CF4029>15%</color> more DMG.
1000901.desc2: A cape made in the style of a hero from another game. It might look super impressive during a fight, but it's a whole other story if your enemy gets a hold of it.

1000902.name: [General] Cat Comb
1000902.desc: When hitting an enemy from behind, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
1000902.desc2: The only time it won't violently resist is when its back is being brushed.

1000903.name: [General] Bag of Salt
1000903.desc: Attacks against enemies with less than 50% HP deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG.

1000904.name: [General] Duel Invitation
1000904.desc: When there are no more than 3 enemies on the battlefield, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1000904.desc2: A brush that appears to have come from some kendo school.

1000905.name: [General] Moisturizing Mask
1000905.desc: Limits each instance of DMG taken to <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of the Agent's Max HP.
1000905.desc2: Retains moisture (a little bit) and blocks UV rays (for a little while).

1000906.name: [General] Mosquito Swatter
1000906.desc: Defeating an enemy increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
1000906.desc2: If you are trying to swat at a fly buzzing through the air, it won't help. You have to wait for it to be still and then strike.

1000907.name: [General] Cleavers
1000907.desc: When your squad is full, all squad members deal <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> more DMG. Each missing member reduces this effect by 4%.
1000907.desc2: Only a powerful and accurate slash can bring out the true power of a cleaver.

1000908.name: [General] Best Man's Bowtie
1000908.desc: When your squad is full, all squad members take <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> less DMG. Each missing member reduces this effect by 4%.
1000908.desc2: The more grooms, the merrier. Gather all the friends you can. You can't afford to not look impressive.

1000909.name: [General] Basketball Tactical Board
1000909.desc: When your squad is full, all squad members take <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> less DMG and deal <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> more DMG. Each missing member reduces this effect by 4%.
1000909.desc2: Three basketball players work in unison, perfectly in sync with each other's movements. This is the basis for the triangular combat technique.

1000910.name: [General] Rusted Shackles
1000910.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>35%</color> more DMG but <color=#CF4029>will no longer trigger critical hits</color>.
1000910.desc2: Sturdy shackles designed to restrain violent prisoners. Sometimes it can have the opposite effect.

1000911.name: [General] Kettle
1000911.desc: After being in combat for 30s, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color>. This effect expires upon leaving combat.
1000911.desc2: You'll have to wait a bit before you can hear the sound of boiling water.

1000912.name: [General] Disposable Gloves
1000912.desc: Each Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>70% less DMG</color> from the first melee attack received in each combat.
1000912.desc2: "Oh, I'll just wash it off." You're just lying to yourself.

1000913.name: [General] Guide's Flag
1000913.desc: Upon entering combat, the active Agent's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>. This effect expires upon leaving combat.
1000913.desc2: With great power comes great... well you know.

1000914.name: [General] Insecticide
1000914.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to normal enemies.
1000914.desc2: Doesn't matter what kind of bug it is or where it is. The person who catches it first is the strongest.

1000915.name: [General] Fruit Peeler
1000915.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to elites.
1000915.desc2: Seeing coils of apple peels totally unbroken produces a meaningless pride.

1000916.name: [General] Wooden Slingshot
1000916.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> more DMG. Additionally deal <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more DMG to bosses.
1000916.desc2: A slingshot made from a weak branch. It breaks easily. Nevertheless, any child that has it will become a king.

1000917.name: [General] Scarlet Goblet
1000917.desc: Off-field Agents with 25% or lower HP <color=#2BAD00>slowly recover HP</color>.
1000917.desc2: This goblet looks a bit strange. Is it a prop or an actual goblet?

1000918.name: [General] Antique Pocket Watch
1000918.desc: When an Agent is the sole remaining member in the squad, they deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG.
1000918.desc2: A pocket watch with a blurry picture. It brings up memories of the good old days.

1000919.name: [General] Dog Tags
1000919.desc: When an Agent is the sole remaining member in the squad, they take <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> less DMG.
1000919.desc2: Who cares if I'm by myself? I'll pick up my allies' work and keep going.

1000920.name: [General] Aromatic Candle
1000920.desc: When the on-field Agent is defeated, all other Agents recover<color=#2BAD00>50%</color> of their HP.
1000920.desc2: Light a candle and pray for your fallen comrades... Ah... a peach-scented candle is the best.

1000921.name: [General] Multi-Functional Tactical Knife
1000921.desc: Attacks deal additional DMG equivalent to <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> of the target's Max HP. This effect can trigger once every 0.1s.
1000921.desc2: Sure, spring-assisted blades look cooler than regular ones, but whether it will actually be useful is a whole different matter.

1000922.name: [General] Zoom Lens
1000922.desc: Non-critical hits deal additional DMG equivalent to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of ATK. This effect can trigger once every 0.4s.
1000922.desc2: It will keep taking photos and changing focus until it gets the clearest photo.

1000928.name: [General] Cleavers
1000928.desc: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Slash-type</color> skills.
1000928.desc2: Only a powerful and accurate slash can bring out the true power of a cleaver.

1000929.name: [General] Sashimi Knives
1000929.desc: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Pierce-type</color> skills.
1000929.desc2: Its needle-sharp edge can skin and descale with ease, making it an indispensable part of any quality kitchen.

1000930.name: [General] Heavy Knives
1000930.desc: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Strike-type</color> skills.
1000930.desc2: A chef's understanding of the role and use of ingredients is crucial, as just wielding a brutal mallet will only leave a mess.

1000931.name: [General] Cleavers
1000931.desc: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Slash-type</color> skills.
1000931.desc2: Only a powerful and accurate slash can bring out the true power of a cleaver.

1000932.name: [General] Sashimi Knives
1000932.desc: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Pierce-type</color> skills.
1000932.desc2: Its needle-sharp edge can skin and descale with ease, making it an indispensable part of any quality kitchen.

1000933.name: [General] Heavy Knives
1000933.desc: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Strike-type</color> skills.
1000933.desc2: A chef's understanding of the role and use of ingredients is crucial, as just wielding a brutal mallet will only leave a mess.

1000934.name: [General] Miracle Starlight
