1000934.desc2: A transformation badge featured in "Starlight Knight." It symbolizes the miraculous power brought upon by shooting stars. "Breaking the limits of what's possible, I arrive in the chariot of stars. Lower the hand that blocks out their brilliance and face your undoing!"

1000937.name: [General] Aromatic Candle
1000937.desc: Defeating an enemy recovers <color=#2BAD00>2%</color> HP for the Agent.
1000937.desc2: Light a candle and pray for your fallen comrades... Ah... a peach-scented candle is the best.

1000938.name: [General] Antique Pocket Watch
1000938.desc2: A pocket watch with a blurry picture. It brings up memories of the good old days.

1000939.name: [General] Multi-Functional Army Knife
1000939.desc: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>3.5%</color> more DMG.
1000939.desc2: Sure, spring-assisted blades look cooler than regular ones, but whether it will actually be useful is a whole different matter.

1000940.name: [General] Zoom Lens
1000940.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to enemies with a higher percentage HP.
1000940.desc2: It will keep taking photos and changing focus until it gets the clearest photo.

1000941.name: [General] Disposable Gloves
1000941.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Blocks the first instance</color> of fatal DMG taken. (This effect can only be triggered once in each combat.)
1000941.desc2: "Oh, I'll just wash it off." You're just lying to yourself.

1000943.name: [Affinity] Fully Charged
1000943.desc:
Anby has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Charging Field]</color> After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Charging Field: When Anby uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
1000943.desc2: Anby has had enough rest, and she's now ready for a big fight. Wherever she goes, she can hear the crackling of electricity around her.

1000944.name: [Affinity] Apex Predator
1000944.desc:
Nekomata has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Bird Hunter]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Bird Hunter: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
1000944.desc2: Nekomata is coiled and ready to pounce, just like an apex predator ready to leap out and disappear at any second.

1000945.name: [Affinity] Full Firepower
1000945.desc:
Nicole has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Field Expansion]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Field Expansion: When Nicole uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.
1000945.desc2: If fear towards the enemy often stems from a lack of firepower, then Nicole flexing full firepower is what instills fear in them.

1000946.name: [Affinity] Absolutely Flawless
1000946.desc:
Soldier 11 has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Indulgent Blaze]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Indulgent Blaze: If <color=#FFFFFF>Fire Suppression</color> is triggered during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Soldier 11's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG received is reduced by 18% during skill activation.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Fire Suppression</color> is triggered during the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.
1000946.desc2: Soldier 11 is fully prepared, and in better shape than she's ever been.

1000947.name: [Affinity] My BGM is On
1000947.desc:
Billy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Roaming Gunslinger]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Roaming Gunslinger: Billy's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodges</color>. When a Rolling Shot triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it will automatically follow up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>.
1000947.desc2: Billy hums the theme song to Starlight Knights while confidently declaring "Nobody can beat me while my BGM is on!" Clearly... he's in high spirits.

1000948.name: [Affinity] Muscle Mayhem
1000948.desc:
Anton has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Warm-Up Exercises]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Warm-Up Exercises: When <color=#FFFFFF>Drill Attack</color> hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.
1000948.desc2: Anton is in excellent shape, effortlessly moving through chest exercises as if he's powered by endless energy and he's looking for a punching bag to hammer.

1000949.name: [Affinity] Un-Bear-Able Rage
1000949.desc:
Ben has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Agile Adaptation]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Agile Adaptation: When successfully blocking enemy DMG with Ben's invulnerable effect during his <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the following counter deals 30% more DMG.
1000949.desc2: Ben quotes an "angry price," an amount most ordinary people couldn't even dream of affording. Luckily, some unsavory characters down in the Hollows are going to cover the bill.

1000950.name: [Affinity] Exercise Before Dinner
1000950.desc:
Soukaku has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Northern Wind]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Northern Wind: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Frosted Banner</color> state, the number of usable enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.
1000950.desc2: Soukaku radiates with an unprecedented level of energy, clearly driven to complete all her tasks before the restaurant closes.

1000951.name: [Affinity] Frosty Eviction
1000951.desc:
Lycaon has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Full Moon Momentum]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Full Moon Momentum: When Lycaon's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> hits an enemy, the attack's Daze increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s. When he charges his <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.
1000951.desc2: Lycaon is as elegant as always, but he has a particularly relentless look in his eye. Any uninvited guest would be met with a cold kick out the front door before they got the chance to say a thing.

1000952.name: [Affinity] Bangboo Give Me Strength
1000952.desc:
Grace has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lightning Piercer]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Lightning Piercer: When Grace's thrown grenade hits an enemy during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color> is reduced by 8.5%, and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup RES</color> is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.
1000952.desc2: Grace is in fine form. A Bangboo's hug doesn't just relieve exhaustion, it also bring a steady stream of strength.

1000953.name: [Affinity] Hostile Wake-Over
1000953.desc:
Ellen has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Arctic Ocean Predator]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Arctic Ocean Predator: The 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming</color> can be directly followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>. For each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> when using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the current attack's CRIT DMG is increased by 20%, up to a max of 60%.
1000953.desc2: The bad news is that Ellen did not get a good night's sleep. The good news is that she's now refreshed and eager to clear any obstacles for the next night's quality sleep.

1000954.name: [Affinity] Up to the Task
1000954.desc:
Rina has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Dance Duet]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Dance Duet: After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The effect gained from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner</color> by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.
1000954.desc2: Rina and her little Bangboo are in excellent condition. Navigating through the dangerous Hollows is as easy as playing a game of tag.

1000955.name: [Affinity] Passionate Cleanup
1000955.desc:
Corin has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Accumulated Release]</color>.
Accumulated Release: When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks).
During a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the attack to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.
1000955.desc2: With the uplifting effects of genuine compliments and rejuvenating sleep, Corin is now brimming with enthusiasm, even in her spirited "Sorry!"

1000956.name: [Affinity] Hammer Sparks
1000956.desc:
Koleda has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Kinetic Recovery]</color>.
Kinetic Recovery: When Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.
1000956.desc2: Koleda and her formidable hammer have been finely tuned to their best shapes. Now, even her casual strikes now ignite more sparks than ever before.

1000957.name: [Affinity] Solid Companionship
1000957.desc:
Zhu Yuan has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Quick Reload]</color>.
Quick Reload: When Zhu Yuan activates <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimates</color>, gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Reload</color> effect. When Zhu Yuan has the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Reload</color> effect and uses up all <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Reload</color> effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>.
1000957.desc2: When Zhu Yuan confronts dangers and perils, she is never alone — Somewhere beyond her sight, numerous fellow officers stride alongside her. This camaraderie is the source of her confidence and pride as a Public Security officer.

1000958.name: [Affinity] Lady-Like Charge
1000958.desc:
Lucy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Fierce Fangs of Fire]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Fierce Fangs of Fire: When another squad member in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state hits an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!</color>.
1000958.desc2: Lucy and her boars have had a good rest, and were all bursting with energy.

1000959.name: [Affinity] Fighting Style: Mixed Fruit Flavor
1000959.desc:
Lighter has evoked the Mindscape <color=#FFAF2C>The Champion</color>.
The Champion：Among the debuffs imposed by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Accelerant</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.
1000959.desc2: Lighter's fighting style is more elusive than ever: rapid hooks, fierce jabs, brutal straight punches, and... is that a subtle mixed fruit aroma?

1000960.name: [Affinity] Power of Hope
1000960.desc:
Piper has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Mild Excitement]</color>.
Mild Excitement: Increases the duration limit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> by 2s and extends the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color> by 4s.
1000960.desc2: Piper is full of energy, full of hope, obsessed with the lottery, and can't wait to go back and check her ticket.

1000961.name: [Affinity] Like a Fish in Water
1000961.desc:
Qingyi has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Insulation Breakdown]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
[Insulation Breakdown]：When Qingyi enters combat, <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, if <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
1000961.desc2: Qingyi has achieved her daily water intake goal, and she is in her optimal state for the day.

1000962.name: [Affinity] Partners in "Crime"
1000962.desc:
Jane has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Crime Counsel]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Crime Counsel: The maximum uses of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> are increased by one. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by an extra 15% and each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency increases her DMG by 0.1%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.
1000962.desc2: Being recruited by Jane as an "accomplice" is no small feat, and it means she will unleash her full strength.

1000963.name: [Affinity] Path of Honor
1000963.desc:
Seth has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Idealist]</color>.
Idealist: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color>, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
1000963.desc2: The pain didn't affect Seth's condition. Instead, it raised his spirit. These wounds are his medal of honor as a Public Security officer.

1000964.name: [Affinity] Overlord's Accompaniment
1000964.desc:
Caesar has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Spearhead Advance]</color>.
Spearhead Advance: When Caesar becomes the active character in combat, she instantly buffs all squad members with a <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s. While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.
1000964.desc2: For Caesar, obstacles on the path are irrelevant. As long as she can roll over them, they're not obstacles anymore.

1000965.name: [Affinity] Nitro-Fuel Feast
1000965.desc:
Burnice has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Extra at No Additional Charge]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Extra at No Additional Charge: When triggering the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, <color=#FFFFFF>Thermal Penetration</color> is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thermal Penetration</color>, up to a max of 20%.
1000965.desc2: In Burnice's world, solving problems is simple... Gather some good friends from the squad and have a lively Nitro-Fuel Feast together!

1000966.name: [Affinity] 17-Item Check-Up
1000966.desc:
Yanagi has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Outstanding Adaptability]</color>.
[Outstanding Adaptability]：During her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the rapid thrust's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color> increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.
1000966.desc2: After completing a series of thorough check-ups, Yanagi is very satisfied with the results and confident in her teammates' conditions going forward.

1000967.name: [Affinity] Haiku Swordplay
1000967.desc:
Hoshimi Miyabi has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Breath Technique]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
[Breath Technique]: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Kazahana</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by 30%. Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> when the final move of the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Kazahana</color> hits an enemy. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> and her CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
1000967.desc2: Hoshimi Miyabi has begun a new round of training. The focus of her training this time is "reciting haikus while slashing away at enemies." Gotta admit it's quite the sight and her swordsmanship is impeccable. Could the haikus really be making her stronger...?

1000968.name: [Affinity] Efficient Surge
1000968.desc:
Asaba Harumasa has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>["High Spirit"]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
["High Spirit"]: The maximum stack limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya</color> increases to 14 stacks. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quiver</color> is triggered, 2 consecutive <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will be fired at the target.
1000968.desc2: Asaba Harumasa is rested and recharged. Time to get things done!

1000969.name: [Affinity] Encore Time
1000969.desc:
Astra Yao has evoked the Mindscape <color=#FFAF2C>[Art of Greed]</color>.
[Art of Greed]: The ATK buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: "Graceful Andante"</color> is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
1000969.desc2: Astra Yao has had enough rest and is feeling great. It's time for her to hit the stage again!

1000970.name: [Affinity] Back to Prime
1000970.desc:
Evelyn has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Dance of Fire]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
[Dance of Fire]: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.
1000970.desc2: Evelyn's in perfect condition — or rather, her skills are on point. She said, "It feels like I'm back in my prime when I used to go on missions." As for the details, let's just say it's best not to ask...

1000971.name: Affinity: Silver Heart's Resonance
1000971.desc:
Soldier 0 - Anby has awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[Static Charge]</color>.
[Static Charge]: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> 3 times. This effect does not consume any <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> stacks.
1000971.desc2: Silver Heart Tin Soldiers are born for combat, but here beside you is Anby. Her blade speaks of things that cannot be forgotten.

1000972.name: Affinity with Your Rhythm
1000972.desc:
Trigger has awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[Sharpened Senses]</color>.
[Sharpened Senses]: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze</color> is increased by an additional 20%. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> increases by 25%. Maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> increases to 125.
1000972.desc2: Remembering lost loved ones and those beside me, "Trigger" blew an original harmonica tune. The powerful will to protect now transforms into soaring fervor.

1000973.name: [Affinity] Nail It Big Time
1000973.desc:
Pulchra has evoked the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[Behind the Mask]</color>.
[Behind the Mask]: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's</color> DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Business Partner</color>'s <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color> effect now also applies to all damage types, not just <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.
1000973.desc2: Pulchra, brimming with fighting spirit, pulled out various eyeshadows, lipsticks, and compacts... "Are these disguise bombs?" "They're hot-selling resale items. Hold onto them carefully - if they break, they'll lose their value."

1000974.name: [Affinity] The Girl's Parasol
1000974.desc:
Vivian has evoked the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>["Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"]</color>.
["Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"]: When a total of 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> are consumed, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG received by targets under <color=#FFFFFF>Vivian's Prophecy</color> increases by 16%.
1000974.desc2: The hem of her dress and the parasol are more than just a girl's way of attracting attention. When Vivian opens her parasol, her fierce protective instinct sweeps any obstacles, shielding her from all hostility.

1000975.name: [Affinity] The Phantom Thief's Magic
1000975.desc:
Hugo has evoked the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[The Child Within]</color>.
[The Child Within]: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color>, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.
1000975.desc2:
In New Eridu, there's only Ether, no magic — unless you trust the mischievous glint in the eyes of the phantom thief.
Here, you see the unyielding flames and the quiet frost intertwining, revealing a harsh truth mingled with gentle lies.

1000976.name: [Affinity] Guarding Tranquility
1000976.desc:
Yixuan has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Spiritual Path]</color>.
[Spiritual Path]: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Points</color>. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.
1000976.desc2:
"True training is like drawing spring water beneath the moon — you touch the surface gently, leaving the moon's reflection undisturbed, not stirring the stars into chaos."
She's always behind you, quietly shielding you from it all, steady and serene, as if it were nothing.

1000977.name: [Affinity] "Such Might"
1000977.desc:
Ju Fufu has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Super Scary Little Tiger]</color>.
[Super Scary Little Tiger]: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>. When Ju Fufu's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.
1000977.desc2:
According to your dear senior Fufu herself, tiger Thirens naturally possess a protective aura called Might during battle.
Although it can't be explained by either science or sorcery, Fufu's fighting spirit is definitely all fired up.

1000978.name: [Affinity] A Soup to Bring Everyone Together
1000978.desc:
Pan Yinhu has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Meridian Theory]</color>.
[Meridian Theory]: The <color=#FFFFFF>Meridian Flow</color> effect provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment</color> increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
1000978.desc2: Senior Yinhu is doing his best to figure out how to score the finest ingredients from the market at the lowest prices. This bowl of ten-treasure nutrition soup is proof of his trust and gratitude.

1000979.name: [Affinity] Perfect Symmetry
1000979.desc:
Alice has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Sage at the Sword's Tip]</color>.
[Sage at the Sword's Tip]: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starfall Finale</color>'s Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>. All squad members' <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG increases by 15%. <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG against enemies suffering from <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color> increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
1000979.desc2: After all sorts of tweaking and adjusting, Eous is finally perfectly symmetrical, and Alice finally feels a deep sense of relief she's never felt before! As for the tweaking process... Well, some details are better left unsaid.

1000980.name: [Affinity] Lucky Plum Cookie
1000980.desc:
Yuzuha has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Full of Colorful Company]</color>.
[Full of Colorful Company]: When Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief</color> hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> can only occur once every 20s. Whenever another character enters through a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, Yuzuha gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>. Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> cooldown is reduced by 25%.
1000980.desc2: The street snacks of Failume Heights are infamous for their mouth-puckering sourness. While this makes them perfect for Yuzuha's pranks, they also work wonders for folks who wish to stay alert and awake!

1000981.name: [Affinity] Three Musketeers
1000981.desc:
Orphie & "Magus" have awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>Luxurious Cat House</color>.
Luxurious Cat House: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
1000981.desc2:
One gunner, one gun. Two gunners, one gun. Three gunners... still just one gun!
But at least with Orphie and Magus around, you won't have to worry about running out of ammo.

1000982.name: [Affinity] Flowers on the Ruins
1000982.desc:
Seed has awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>"Hibernation Period"</color>.
"Hibernation Period": When Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 100, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color> can be triggered, and the total <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> required to gain one chance to quickly release <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> when entering the battlefield/using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>. Increases <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color> CRIT DMG by 30%.
1000982.desc2:
Once, in ruins like these, humanity had nothing left. But now, she truly saw it... flowers blooming upon the ruins.
At this moment, she offers you flowers filled with love. Please don't ask why - just accept them and don't be shy.

1000983.name: [Affinity] Changing Tides
1000983.desc:
Yidhari has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss</color>.
The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced by 10. After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frost Coil</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>. The HP restored by this <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color> is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> ignore 20% of targets' <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color>.
1000983.desc2:
Around you, her emotions have always ebbed and flowed like gentle tides, whispering softly only when washing over the shore.
But in this moment, you truly sense her feelings surge into silent waves, condensing into a force of immense weight within those rolling swells.

1000984.name: [Affinity] Moonlit Adventure
1000984.desc:
Lucia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Secret Friend</color>.
Secret Friend: When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color>, stacking up to 4 times. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> ends, if Lucia has any <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color> stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> to all squad members.
1000984.desc2:
Keen Ether perception, vast Ethereal knowledge, exceptional combat skills, and an ever-growing curiosity — without a doubt, Lucia is one of the finest Hollow companions.
...And after agreeing to seek the "Doppelganger" together, that boundless energy has reached even greater heights.

1000985.name: [Affinity] Tempered Blade
1000985.desc:
Komano has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Beyond Dreams of the Past</color>.
Beyond Dreams of the Past: When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> hits an enemy, Manato's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
1000985.desc2:
Manato's body and soul are hardened by years of labor and countless brushes with death.
So rest assured, as long as he can still swing that heavy greatsword, he won't let danger come near you.

1000986.name: [Affinity] The Dead Dials
1000986.desc:
Dialyn has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[24/7 Hotline]</color>.
24/7 Hotline: Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> gain an additional 20% Stun DMG Multiplier when Stunned, and all units deal 15% increased DMG to targets affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color>.
1000986.desc2: Only spirits can dial Dialyn's phone. When it rings, it signals the start of a judgment where yesterday's truth condemns today's sins.

1000987.name: [Affinity] Greater Heights
1000987.desc:
Banyue has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Greed Burns Like Fire]</color>.
Greed Burns Like Fire: When Banyue hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: One's Path</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, he inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state. In this state, enemies' <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
1000987.desc2:
Beyond every peak lies an even higher summit. Whether in martial arts or character, Banyue always strives to reach greater heights.
Looking back now, his achievements stand tall and proud.

1000988.name: Sword of the Solitary Heart
1000988.desc:
Ye Shunguang has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Light & Shadow</color>.
[Light & Shadow]: The max stack count of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> increases to 6, and <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> can stack up to 9 times. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> consumed grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color>'s DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.
1000988.desc2:
The Hollow is filled with treacherous places and requires vigilance and caution to remain safe.
But right now, you can rest easy — your senior walks by your side, her sword's light guarding the path ahead.

1000989.name: Double Lucky Bunny Ears
1000989.desc:
Zhao has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Righteous Verdict</color>.
[Righteous Verdict]: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.
1000989.desc2: Xiao'Zhao says clean bunny ears bring luck to everyone, so with me and Xiao'Zhao together, we've got two pairs: that's double the luck!

1000990.name: Wings of Steel
1000990.desc:
Aria has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Energetic Sound Waves</color>.
Energetic Sound Waves：When Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup RES</color>. Additionally, when Aria triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.
1000990.desc2: I'll protect every single one of your delusions — whether on stage or on the battlefield, same as always.

1000991.name: Strawberry Paradise
1000991.desc:
Sunna has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>"Feline Go-With-the-Flow"</color>.
"Feline Go-With-the-Flow"：While Sunna is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color> every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.
1000991.desc2:
She picked up that sheet music, and with it, an entire summer that had withered away in the strawberry garden.
In this awakened paradise, as long as it's her wish, every delusion can come true!

1000992.name: Flawless Plumage
1000992.desc:
Nangong Yu has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lazy Spotlight]</color>.
[Lazy Spotlight]: When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeat</color> is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
1000992.desc2:
There's no such thing as a flawless genius idol, or wings of pure white.
But at least for this one moment, I'll deliver the perfect delusions.

1000993.name: Guidepost Home
1000993.desc:
Cissia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Hunger and Hard Truths]</color>.
[Hunger and Hard Truths]: After a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Gang Operation</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Ophidiophobia</color> hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color> deals 35% increased DMG.
1000993.desc2: Her innate sharp senses always lead Cissia to her destination — be it prey, truth, or just a warm corner where she can curl up. Yet what she craves most is a beacon to take her home.

1000994.name: Beyond the Shackles
1000994.desc:
Promeia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Faltering Conviction]</color>.
Faltering Conviction: Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggered by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> increases by 120%.
1000994.desc2: Promeia never uncuffs herself if it's not necessary, but... it seems a certain special client's presence has turned it into a necessity.

1000995.name: Starlight Beacon
1000995.desc:
Starlight - Billy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Wasteland Automaton]</color>.
Wasteland Automaton：Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> by 50%. Activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color>, or hitting a Stunned enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> grants the <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> effect: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> consumes this effect to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> can be held.
1000995.desc2: The starlight that guides hope may not exist, but there will always be someone who becomes the beacon leading people toward hope.

1000996.name: Like the Spring Breeze
1000996.desc:
Velina has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Saturation Project]</color>.
[Saturation Project]：When Velina triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, she can also gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s. After <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomaly Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this attack is excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations. The DMG increase effects of Velina's <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette</color> are further increased by 15%.
1000996.desc2: Even a gentle breeze sometimes hides its sting, yet Velina has already read the shifting winds. Wherever the path ahead may lead, all lies within her grasp with a single fold of her fan.

1000997.name: En-Nah Laureate
1000997.desc:
Norma has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Visionary Extremism]</color>.
[Visionary Extremism]: The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment</color> increases to 12s. When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
1000997.desc2: Miss Norma has earned the crown in Bangboo technology — and she wears it, quite literally. I mean, she literally has a Bangboo hat that fires large-caliber rounds and flies at high speed.

1000998.name: Dawn's Elegy
1000998.desc:
Norma has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Visionary Extremism]</color>.
[Visionary Extremism]: The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment</color> increases to 12s. When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
1000998.desc2: Sighs gather into a roar, sobs forge a battle hymn. The herald of death, having ushered in the long, silent night, will finally sing the first act of daybreak.

1000999.name: Hannibull
1000999.desc:
Remielle has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Fall Into the Noise</color>.
Fall Into the Noise: Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color> increases by 20%. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color>, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> ends. While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies increases.
1000999.desc2: While the winged Thiren girl favors a light and nimble combat style, treating the enemy to a little Void Hunter shock and awe now and then isn't half bad.

1001000.name: Legendary Ascent
1001000.desc:
Sigrid has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Long, Long Ago</color>.
Long, Long Ago: Upon activating the 3rd stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, enters the <Term:1000030></Term> and gains 1 additional activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. When activations exceed the stored <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>'s activation limit, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>'s final hit deals an additional <color=#FFFFFF>100%</color> of ATK as <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Sigrid's <color=#FFFFFF>ATK</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>25%</color>.
1001000.desc2: Sigrid has left behind many legends in Roscaelifer, though most were spun by a certain "lady." Even so, Sigrid draws closer to those legends with each passing day. This narrow path winding toward legends will one day become a truly legendary road of its own.

1001001.name: [Hollow] Piggy bank
1001001.desc: The more Gear Coins you owe, <color=#2BAD00>the higher the rebate</color> you receive when purchasing items at the Bangboo merchant. (Current Debt: {CReplaceCardParam:debt_1001001,1,2}. Current Rebate: {CReplaceCardParam:InterestRate_Card1001001,1,2}%.)
1001001.desc2: A lovely looking piggy bank. It can bring the owner good luck. The catch is, if you want to get money out, you are going to have to break it.

1001002.name: [Hollow] Lucky Cat
1001002.desc2: Once you have this, all your money troubles will go smoothly.

1001003.name: [Hollow] Casino Banknote
1001003.desc: Whenever you obtain Gear Coins, all squad members restore <color=#2BAD00>1%</color> HP.
1001003.desc2: So long as you have someone to spend time with you, you will be wealthy forever.

1001004.name: [Hollow] Coin Collection
1001004.desc: For every 100 Gear Coins you have, all squad members deal <color=#2BAD00>1%</color> more DMG.
1001004.desc2: A collection with all manner of rare and strange coins. With all these coins, the collection is pretty heavy.

1001005.name: [Hollow] Paper Airplane
1001005.desc: When you have fewer than 250 Gear Coins, your Pressure <color=#2BAD00>does not increase</color>.
1001005.desc2: A simple and cheap toy that carries a dream of success.

1001006.name: [Hollow] Lucky Stars
1001006.desc: You can get an item from the Bangboo merchant <color=#2BAD00>for free</color>.
1001006.desc2: Awarded as "The Most Popular Resonium Among Hollow Investigators" for three years in a row.

1001007.name: [Hollow] Expired VIP Card
1001007.desc: When you have fewer than 888 Gear Coins, you get <color=#2BAD00>20% off on everything </color> from Bangboo merchants.
1001007.desc2: If you don't say anything, the careless store clerk won't figure out it expired a long time ago.

1001008.name: [Hollow] Glass Marbles
1001008.desc: When you have fewer than 250 Gear Coins, all squad members deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG.
1001008.desc2: It might be busted up, but it can still use great force to shoot out marbles.

1001009.name: [Hollow] Mini Punch Bag
1001009.desc: Each Pressure increase is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>2</color>.
1001009.desc2: Using violence to release stress may not be an elegant solution, but it is effective.

1001010.name: [Hollow] Cat Ears Headset
1001010.desc: There is a 15% chance to <color=#2BAD00>negate a Pressure increase</color> each time it happens.

1001011.name: [Hollow] Water Gun
1001011.desc: Entering combat events <color=#2BAD00>does not</color> increase your Pressure.
1001011.desc2: I may not be hurt, but my feelings are.

1001012.name: [Hollow] Bubble Gun
1001012.desc: Whenever you recover HP outside of combat, Pressure is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>5</color>.
1001012.desc2: These bubbles are safe, edible, and child-friendly.

1001013.name: [Hollow] Toy Trumpet
1001013.desc: Entering the next floor lowers Pressure by <color=#2BAD00>30</color>.
1001013.desc2: Face the ocean and shout out whatever is troubling you.

1001014.name: [Hollow] Spray Paint
1001014.desc: Each transaction with the Bangboo merchant reduces Pressure by <color=#2BAD00>10</color>.
1001014.desc2: Give the jar a big shake and then leave a mark of your adventure.

1001015.name: [Hollow] Bangboo Pillow
1001015.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Negates</color> the next Corruption triggered by Pressure overload.
1001015.desc2: A soft and squishy body pillow. It's larger than an actual Bangboo. With this you'll have nothing else to worry about!

1001016.name: [Hollow] Toy Castle
1001016.desc: When your Pressure is overloaded, you get <color=#2BAD00>a random</color> A-Rank Resonium.
1001016.desc2: Yes, it's made of building blocks, but you can recognize how impressive it is. It would be so nice to live there...

1001017.name: [Hollow] Sword Catalog
1001017.desc: Every 10 Pressure increases all squad members' attack DMG by <color=#2BAD00>2.5%</color>. (Current boost: {CReplaceCardParam:DamageShow_1001017,0.01,2}%)
1001017.desc2: A photo album filled with famous swords. The name of each sword's owner is written thoughtfully on the back of each photo.

1001018.name: [Hollow] Herbarium
1001018.desc: Every 10 Pressure reduces all squad members' DMG taken from attacks by <color=#2BAD00>1.5%</color>. (Current mitigation: {CReplaceCardParam:DamageShow_1001018,-0.01,2}%)
1001018.desc2: A collection of leaf specimens. The back of every leaf has a note about what plant it came from.

1001019.name: [Hollow] Toy Laser Blade
1001019.desc: All squad members' attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, but every time Pressure increases, it increases by an additional <color=#CF4029>3</color> Pressure.
1001019.desc2: A toy laser blade that is all the rage with kids. If it's charged, the sword will extend and light up by pressing a button on the hilt (there are also some lackluster sound effects).

1001020.name: [Hollow] Battle Spinner
1001020.desc: Each Corruption increases all squad member's attack DMG by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>. (Current boost: {CReplaceCardParam:DamageShow_1001020,0.01,2}%)
1001020.desc2: The winner earns a prize: the loser's Battle Spinner. Remove a component from the upper side of the top to add it to your own!

1001021.name: [Hollow] Insect Catalog
1001021.desc: For every 10 Pressure, all squad members regenerate <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> Energy upon entering the battlefield. (Current Regen: {CReplaceCardParam:SPShow_1001021,0.01,2}%)
1001021.desc2: A photo album filled with bugs. Looking at it for too long can get you feeling a little anxious.

1001022.name: [Hollow] Funny Alarm
1001022.desc: When your Pressure is overloaded, <color=#2BAD00>resurrect</color> a fallen squad member.
1001022.desc2: "It's 3 a.m. Get up and get to work!"

1001023.name: [Hollow] Ordinary Card Pack
1001023.desc: When obtaining Resonia from Gacha machines, there's a <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> chance to get a B-Rank Resonium.
1001023.desc2: A card pack from the hit board game, Starlight: Lost Tower. Every pack will have at least 2 Starlight Knight cards.

1001024.name: [Hollow] Exclusive Card Pack
1001024.desc: When obtaining Resonia from Gacha machines, there's a <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> chance to get an A-Rank Resonium.
1001024.desc2: A card pack from the hit board game, Starlight: Lost Tower. Every pack will have at least 2 holographic cards.

1001025.name: [Hollow] Giveaway CD
1001025.desc: Identifying a Resonium grants you <color=#2BAD00>an additional</color> B-Rank Resonium. The chance is reduced by 20% each time it successfully activates.
1001025.desc2: A disk that comes with a book. Its contents may be exactly the same as the book. But there could also be some other surprises. Who knows?

1001026.name: [Hollow] Deluxe Surprise Box
1001026.desc: When obtaining Resonia from Gacha machines, there's a <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> chance to get an S-Rank Resonium.
1001026.desc2: Where are the blind boxes? All I want is a blind box!

1001027.name: [Hollow] Toy Stethoscope
1001027.desc: All squad members recover <color=#2BAD00>7%</color> HP upon entering the battlefield.
1001027.desc2: This item is a must for playing doctor at home, but for some reason, kids prefer being the patient.

1001028.name: [Hollow] Kaleido Flashlight
1001028.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Adjacent areas are automatically displayed</color> when exploring a Hollow.
1001028.desc2: A kid's flashlight with seven different colors. It has average light intensity, but switching between the colors frequently can mess you up.

1001029.name: [Hollow] Toy Ambulance
1001029.desc: Entering the next floor restores all squad members' HP by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1001029.desc2: Open the rear door of the car. There are 3 doctor dolls sitting in the back.

1001030.name: [Hollow] Paper Crane
1001030.desc: Entering a Boss stage restores all squad members' HP by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1001030.desc2: Paper cranes that a patient folded on their hospital bed. They carry the patient's hopes for recovery.

1001031.name: [Hollow] Lucky Cat
1001031.desc: Obtain <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> more Gear Coins from working and looting.
1001031.desc2: Once you have this, all your money troubles will go smoothly.

1001032.name: [Hollow] Lucky Cat
1001032.desc: Obtain <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> more Gear Coins from working and looting.
1001032.desc2: Once you have this, all your money troubles will go smoothly.

1001033.name: [Hollow] Lucky Cat
1001033.desc: Obtain <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> more Gear Coins from working and looting.
1001033.desc2: Once you have this, all your money troubles will go smoothly.

1001034.name: [Hollow] Lucky Cat
1001034.desc: Obtain <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> more Gear Coins from working and looting.
1001034.desc2: Once you have this, all your money troubles will go smoothly.

1001035.name: [Hollow] Lucky Cat
1001035.desc: Obtain <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> more Gear Coins from working and looting.
1001035.desc2: Once you have this, all your money troubles will go smoothly.

1001036.name: [Hollow] Lucky Cat
1001036.desc: Obtain <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> more Gear Coins from working and looting.
1001036.desc2: Once you have this, all your money troubles will go smoothly.

1001037.name: [Hollow] Koleda's Demolition Hammer
1001037.desc: Allows you to demolish fragile walls. As for tough ones... we're here for investigation, not demolition.
1001037.desc2: An ability Resonium. "Show me the way, Proxy, and I'll smash through all obstacles!" — Koleda

1001038.name: [Hollow] Grace's Bomb Defuser
1001038.desc: Allows you to <color=#2BAD00>safely defuse</color> planted bombs.
1001038.desc2: An ability Resonium. "I've known how to defuse this kind of bomb since I was in elementary school." — Grace

1001039.name: [Hollow] Ben's Assistance
1001039.desc2: An ability Resonium. "P—President... I didn't mean to break it..." — Ben

1001040.name: [Bundle Code] Ultra Sacred Sword of Radiance
1001040.desc2: A gift code given to all new players, one per person. It looks impressive just from the name and icon...

1001041.name: [Bundle Code] Falling Starsea Armor
1001041.desc2: A gift code given to all new players, one per person. It looks impressive just from the name and icon...

1001042.name: [Bundle Code] Like & Subscribe Gun
1001042.desc: Gives the selected Bangboo <color=#2BAD00>Number of Attacks +1</color>.
1001042.desc2:
To celebrate the game publisher's Inter-Knot account reaching 10,000 followers, here's a commemorative gift code.
"Thank you all for your support and clicks, I plan to include you all in the game!" the publisher stated.

1001043.name: [Bundle Code] Mask No.10
1001043.desc2: During certain special holidays, the game creator occasionally enters battles using a super-powerful Bangboo with "Mask No.10." Despite everyone teaming up and still losing, all participating players receive a rare commemorative gift code. It's the taking part that counts.

1001044.name: [Bundle Code] Super Fusion Metal Dentures
1001044.desc: Gives Sharkboo a new skill: <color=#2BAD00>Attack DMG is doubled</color>.
1001044.desc2: A commemorative reward given to all servers after Sharkboo has been selected as the "MVP of Season 1."

1001045.name: [Bundle Code] VIP Ejection Seat
1001045.desc: Gives the selected Bangboo a new skill: <color=#2BAD00>After being defeated, gives other allied Bangboo HP +10</color>.
1001045.desc2: A consolation prize given to players who have lost five times in a row, it's a rough way to balance the win rate...

1001046.name: [Bundle Code] Bug Shield
1001046.desc: Gives the selected Bangboo a new skill: <color=#2BAD00>Negate the first DMG received in each round</color>.
1001046.desc2: Gift code given to players who took part in the initial test, as a token of appreciation for their enthusiastic ratings and honest feedback.

1001047.name: [Bundle Code] Lone Woof Bandana
1001047.desc: Gives the selected Bangboo a new skill: <color=#2BAD00>When this Bangboo is the only surviving Bangboo, its HP and ATK are increased fivefold</color>.
1001047.desc2: A gift pack for returning players, which not only grants a new skill upon use but also adds a title that looks like a typo in front of the username: Lone Lee Hero.

1001048.name: [Bundle Code] Like & Subscribe Gun
1001048.desc: Gives the selected Bangboo <color=#2BAD00>Number of Attacks +1</color>.
1001048.desc2:
To celebrate the game publisher's Inter-Knot account reaching 10,000 followers, here's a commemorative gift code.
"Thank you all for your support and clicks, I plan to include you all in the game!" the publisher stated.

1001049.name: [Bundle Code] Like & Subscribe Gun
1001049.desc: Gives the selected Bangboo <color=#2BAD00>Number of Attacks +1</color>.

1001050.name: [Hollow] Power Hook
1001050.desc2: Super sticky, super long-lasting. Tear and stick, super easy. So long as you're strong enough, you can even pull a train!

1001051.name: [Hollow] Hollow Robot
1001051.desc: Can be used to <color=#2BAD00>place a route for transportation</color>.
1001051.desc2: A road paving robot designed for transportation in narrow areas. Once a preliminary passageway has been paved, transportation work will be easier moving forward.

1001052.name: [Hollow] Jackbox Bomb
1001052.desc2:
Detonate an explosion.
Not super powerful, but shocking. The best present for ending a friendship.

1001053.name: [Hollow] Security Scanner
1001053.desc2: Confirm it's safe, then proceed, if you discover danger... you can use it in self-defense, too.

1001054.name: [Hollow] Nameless Book
1001054.desc2: There's no way to know what this book records, but you can feel that it is very much affected by this Hollow.

1001056.name: [Hollow] Explosion-Proof Structure
1001056.desc: Now, the jackhammer will be <color=#2BAD00>immune to bomb and trap damage</color>, and the special dash range has also <color=#2BAD00>expanded to 3 columns</color>!

1001058.name: [Hollow] Koleda's Demolition Hammer
1001058.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Spikes no longer deal damage</color>, but instead grant <color=#2BAD00>+3</color> HP.

1001061.name: [Hollow] VIP Card
1001061.desc: Receive <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> of spent Coins back when purchasing items.

1001062.name: [Hollow] Health Medicine
1001062.desc: When picking up Coins, there is a 50% chance to generate a <color=#2BAD00>Health Recovery Tile</color>.

1001063.name: [Hollow] Combo Sword
1001063.desc: When picking up coins, there's a 50% chance to generate an <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color>.

1001064.name: [Hollow] Standard Power Medicine
1001064.desc: When picking up Coins, there is a 50% chance to generate an <color=#2BAD00>EXP Tile</color>.

1001065.name: [Hollow] Combat Gloves Module
1001065.desc: When picking up Coins, there is a 25% chance to spawn a <color=#CF4029>monster</color>.

1001066.name: [Hollow] Farewell Paper Cranes
1001066.desc: Place 1 additional <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color> above and below when placing bombs.

1001067.name: [Hollow] Bangboo Stand-In
1001067.desc: 50% chance to generate a <color=#2BAD00>Coin Tile</color> when defeating monsters.

1001068.name: [Hollow] Endgame Wish Star
1001068.desc: <color=#CF4029>Health Recovery Tiles no longer restore HP</color>, instead giving all squad members <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> ATK

1001069.name: [Hollow] Combo Sword
1001069.desc: Gain a temporary <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> ATK when killing monsters. Resets at the end of each floor.

1001070.name: [Hollow] Enhanced Health Medicine
1001070.desc: Generate 1 <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color> every 5 moves and lose <color=#CF4029>3</color> HP.

1001072.name: [Hollow] Hollow Robot
1001072.desc: Significantly increase the chance to generate good items when smashing <color=#2BAD00>Ether crystals</color>

1001073.name: [Hollow] Jackbox Bomb
1001073.desc: At the start of each floor, generate <color=#CF4029>15 spikes</color> and <color=#2BAD00>2 Resonium Tiles</color> throughout the floor.

1001074.name: [Hollow] Security Scanner
1001074.desc: When stepping on spikes, <color=#2BAD00>no HP is lost</color>, but 1 <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color> is generated.

1001075.name: [Hollow] Nameless Book
1001075.desc: When a bomb explodes, random items are generated. (There is a cap on the total output per floor)

1001076.name: [Hollow] Blue Shield
1001076.desc: Each time you collect Coins 10 times, gain <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> ATK

1001078.name: [General] Cat Comb
1001078.desc: The protagonist immediately gains <color=#2BAD00>+15</color> ATK, but for each attack, ATK <color=#CF4029>-1</color>.

1001079.name: [General] Bag of Salt
1001079.desc: 1 <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color> is generated instantly when a monster is killed

1001080.name: [Hollow] Casino Banknote
1001080.desc: Protagonist ATK <color=#CF4029>-5</color>, but gains <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> ATK for every 100 Coins held.
1001080.desc2: So long as you have someone to spend time with you, you will be wealthy forever.

1001081.name: [Hollow] Coin Collection
1001081.desc2: A collection with all manner of rare and strange coins. With all these coins, the collection is pretty heavy.

1001082.name: [Hollow] Paper Airplane
1001082.desc: Protagonist HP <color=#CF4029>-20</color>, but for every <color=#2BAD00>10</color> HP, ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>+1</color>.
1001082.desc2: A simple and cheap toy that carries a dream of success.

1001083.name: [Hollow] Lucky Stars
1001083.desc: Protagonist gains <color=#2BAD00>+4</color> ATK, but loses <color=#CF4029>-15</color> HP.
1001083.desc2: Awarded as "The Most Popular Resonium Among Hollow Investigators" for three years in a row.

1001084.name: [Hollow] Expired VIP Card
1001084.desc: When the Protagonist takes DMG, there is a 10% chance of generating 1 <color=#2BAD00>Coin Tile</color>.
1001084.desc2: If you don't say anything, the careless store clerk won't figure out it expired a long time ago.

1001085.name: [Hollow] Glass Marbles
1001085.desc: When the Protagonist attacks, there's a <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> chance to trigger a critical hit, dealing double DMG.
1001085.desc2: It might be busted up, but it can still use great force to shoot out marbles.

1001086.name: [Hollow] Mini Punch Bag
1001086.desc2: Using violence to release stress may not be an elegant solution, but it is effective.

1001088.name: [Hollow] Water Gun
1001088.desc2: I may not be hurt, but my feelings are.

1001089.name: [Hollow] Bubble Gun
1001089.desc: Protagonist gains <color=#2BAD00>+50%</color> CRIT Rate but <color=#CF4029>cannot recover HP</color>.
1001089.desc2: These bubbles are safe, edible, and child-friendly.

1001090.name: [Hollow] Toy Trumpet
1001090.desc2: Face the ocean and shout out whatever is troubling you.

1001091.name: [Hollow] Spray Paint
1001091.desc2: Give the jar a big shake and then leave a mark of your adventure.

1001092.name: [Hollow] Bangboo Pillow
1001092.desc2: A soft and squishy body pillow. It's larger than an actual Bangboo. With this you'll have nothing else to worry about!

1001093.name: [Hollow] Toy Castle
1001093.desc2: Yes, it's made of building blocks, but you can recognize how impressive it is. It would be so nice to live there...

1001094.name: [Hollow] Sword Catalog
1001094.desc: Protagonist gains <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> Lifesteal, <color=#CF4029>but current HP becomes 2</color>.
1001094.desc2: A photo album filled with famous swords. The name of each sword's owner is written thoughtfully on the back of each photo.

1001095.name: [Hollow] Herbarium
1001095.desc2: A collection of leaf specimens. The back of every leaf has a note about what plant it came from.

1001096.name: [Hollow] Toy Laser Blade
1001096.desc2: A toy laser blade that is all the rage with kids. If it's charged, the sword will extend and light up by pressing a button on the hilt (there are also some lackluster sound effects).

1001097.name: [Hollow] Battle Spinner
1001097.desc2: The winner earns a prize: the loser's Battle Spinner. Remove a component from the upper side of the top to add it to your own!

1001098.name: [Hollow] Insect Catalog
1001098.desc2: A photo album filled with bugs. Looking at it for too long can get you feeling a little anxious.

1001099.name: [Hollow] Funny Alarm
1001099.desc2: "It's 3 a.m. Get up and get to work!"

1001100.name: [Hollow] Ordinary Card Pack
1001100.desc: When the protagonist takes DMG, 10% chance to generate <color=#2BAD00>1 Bangboo Plug-In</color>.
1001100.desc2: A card pack from the hit board game, Starlight: Lost Tower. Every pack will have at least 2 Starlight Knight cards.

1001101.name: [Freeze] Freezing Gloves
1001101.desc: Triggering Ice Mark additionally increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
1001101.desc2: Other than keeping the wearer's hands warm, they can shoot a cold mist from the fingertips. Just make sure you aren't too close to the target when using this function. You could get frozen right along with them.

1001102.name: [Freeze] Ice Shaver
1001102.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. When <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> is triggered, hitting enemies increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 5s.
1001102.desc2: An old-school ice crusher with a hand crank. Most people see this as less of a daily necessity item and more of a toy.

1001103.name: [Freeze] Ice Maker
1001103.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> for 15s.
1001103.desc2: Work hard turning the handle until you work up a sweat and a thirst. That's when the true value of ice cubes becomes apparent.

1001104.name: [Freeze] Portable Ice Maker
1001104.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>12</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
1001104.desc2: Pour in the water and flip the switch. Then leave the rest to it.

1001105.name: [Freeze] Freezing Spray
1001105.desc: Triggering Ice Mark increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1001105.desc2: Light and handy, it can reduce fever and relieve pain quickly.

1001106.name: [Freeze] Freezing Gun
1001106.desc: Upon triggering <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, the Agent inflicts additional Daze equal to <color=#2BAD00>140%</color> of their initial Impact on the target, if the target is not Stunned.
1001106.desc2: This deadly weapon can produce shards of ice and shoot at great distances. Think twice before using it, even in the summer.

1001107.name: [Freeze] Ice Cube Tray
1001107.desc: When an Ultimate hits an enemy and deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>, the Agent gains <color=#2BAD00>36</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
1001107.desc2: A simple and easy-to-use hockey mold. The biggest challenge is how to get the puck out of the mold.

1001108.name: [Freeze] Ice Bag
1001108.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy increases the Agent's DEF by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>, stacking up to 4 times.
1001108.desc2: A bag that once held many ice cubes, they've since all melted.

1001109.name: [Freeze] Portable Cooler
1001109.desc2: A must-have item for professional anglers. Besides fish, there are some other strange things inside.

1001110.name: [Freeze] Ice Bucket
1001110.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack grants the Agent <color=#2BAD00>8</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
1001110.desc2: An ice bucket that only graces the finest of dining tables. Any drink it holds becomes instantly fancy.

1001111.name: [Freeze] Cutie Cold Pack
1001111.desc2: Everyone loves it for its ice-cold touch. It's even popular among cats and dogs.

1001112.name: [Freeze] Collective Emblem
1001112.desc: Increases the chance for [Freeze] Resonia to appear.
1001112.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Ice three feet thick doesn't form in a day... So we need more of the cold.

1001401.name: [Onslaught] Claw Hammer
1001401.desc: Upon triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, the Agent inflicts additional Daze equal to <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> of Max Daze +<color=#2BAD00>100</color> Daze. This effect can only be triggered against each enemy once every 5s.
1001401.desc2: It out may not be that they lack the strength if they can't pull it out, but rather that they fear the pain.

1001402.name: [Onslaught] Utility Knife
1001402.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
1001402.desc2: Pain can creep close in the subtlest of ways...

1001403.name: [Onslaught] Window Breaker
1001403.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack enables the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color> attacks to inflict <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more Daze for 15s.
1001403.desc2: Hopefully, this stuff will always stay behind an intricate little window and will never have to be used.

1001404.name: [Onslaught] Gardening Shears
1001404.desc2: If all you have is a pair of gardening shears, everything looks like a branch out of place.

1001405.name: [Onslaught] Lightweight Wrench
1001405.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
1001405.desc2: These little, lightweight tools are also used as a juggling prop or makeshift throwing weapons.

1001406.name: [Onslaught] Steel File
1001406.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist increases the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 15s.
1001406.desc2: The term "grind" beautifully encapsulates the idea of complete and extreme destruction.

1001407.name: [Onslaught] Roller Brush
1001407.desc: Each Standard [Onslaught] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>32%</color>.
1001407.desc2: One can never truly know what a wet, sticky roller brush has just been through.

1001408.name: [Onslaught] Pitchfork
1001408.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 12s.
1001408.desc2: Once you're holding it, the urge to stab something is always irresistible... and that's where the holes in these haystacks come from.

1001409.name: [Onslaught] Lumber Axe
1001409.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent.
1001409.desc2: Once you've found the best spot for chopping, each blow will become more effortless than the last.

1001410.name: [Onslaught] Steel Handsaw
1001410.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s.
1001410.desc2: A saw's serrated shape contributes to only 1% of its overall intimidating presence, while the remaining 99% comes from horror movies.

1001411.name: [Onslaught] Pointed Shovel
1001411.desc2: Many people associate shovels with painful memories of the wooden handle bouncing off their faces when they stepped on it.

1001412.name: [Onslaught] Collective Emblem
1001412.desc: Increases the chance for [Onslaught] Resonia to appear.
1001412.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Hooks, axes, hammers, chisels, shovels, saws, scissors... We've got all the tools.

1001601.name: [Assist] Gate Breaker
1001601.desc: Vital View triggered by Evasive Assist lasts <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s. Defensive Assist inflicts <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more Daze.
1001601.desc2: Harnessing the power of inertia, this device can help break through a target's defense. Don't forget to release your grip at the right moment, or else you'll go flying off with it.

1001602.name: [Assist] Hydraulic Buffer
1001602.desc2: During rescue operations, this device will provide a buffer for you and your teammates to make sure you don't collide with each other's bodies... or lips.

1001603.name: [Assist] HF Communicator
1001603.desc2: This device emits loud and clear sound that is perfect for communication with your teammates. Its excellent voice amplification ensures that your voice is always delivered to your teammates... and also your enemies.

1001604.name: [Assist] Ether Reaction Device
1001604.desc: Triggering a Perfect Assist increases all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
1001604.desc2: This device analyzes the Ether activity of your squad members and adjusts its algorithms accordingly to facilitate Ether integration.

1001605.name: [Assist] Impact Feedback Device
1001605.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Rush.
1001605.desc2: This device can absorb and store a certain amount of impact, that you can then release at precisely the right moment.

1001606.name: [Assist] Dynamic Calibration Device
1001606.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Insight.
1001606.desc2: This device ensures visual calibration while moving quickly. While it can be a real game-changer in combat, it causes great strain on the operator's optic nerves.

1001607.name: [Assist] Holographic Decoy
1001607.desc: Hitting enemies with an Assist Follow-Up increases all squad members' PEN Ratio by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 15s.
1001607.desc2: This device projects illusions in all directions, disrupting its target.

1001608.name: [Assist] Activity Transfer Device
1001608.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 10s.
1001608.desc2: This support device, resembling a relay baton, transfers active Ether energy from a target surface to the user.

1001609.name: [Assist] Hand Operated Generator
1001609.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
1001609.desc2: This device converts kinetic energy into electric energy. In short, it generates power as long as you are running.

1001610.name: [Assist] Emergency Enhancement Device
1001610.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
1001610.desc2: A micro enhancement device that works on the surface of the skin. While its effect is limited and temporary, it's incredibly convenient. All you need to do is attach it to your skin like a plaster, and you're good to go.

1001611.name: [Assist] Backup Shield Generator
1001611.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist grants the Agent a Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> of their Max HP for 10s.
1001611.desc2: A portable shield generator that sacrifices some of its protection for portability. Since it only provides a very limited level of protection, some would even say you get about as much protection as picking up a trash can lid.

1001612.name: [Assist] Impact Stacker
1001612.desc: Defensive Assist and Assist Follow-Up Daze increases by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> against normal enemies, <color=#2BAD00>75%</color> against Elite enemies, and <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> against Bosses. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
1001612.desc2: An enhancement device that can amplify impact effects for a short time. It's design is said to take inspiration from a woodpecker.

1001613.name: [Assist] Cycle Drive Unit
1001613.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist has a <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> chance to restore 1 Assist Point. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
1001613.desc2: A support device mounted on the legs and feet, allowing runners to store kinetic energy during initial acceleration.

1001614.name: [Assist] Collective Emblem
1001614.desc: Increases the chance for [Assist] Resonia to appear.
1001614.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Even a hero needs the help of three friends.

1001801.name: [Artifice] Sensory Poker
1001801.desc:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, <color=#CF4029>lose all Energy and Decibels</color> upon being hit by an enemy attack.
Once reconstructed, Agents will instead generate Energy and Decibels <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> faster.
1001801.desc2: Not only does he know which card you chose, he also knows that your awe and praise are insincere.

1001802.name: [Artifice] Pitch Dark Cape
1001802.desc:
Each movement on the current floor causes an additional <color=#CF4029>100%</color> Pressure.
Upon reaching the next floor, the Pressure increase from movements is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
1001802.desc2: The cloak is the most reliable partner for a magician. It can even be used to shield oneself from rotten eggs and tomatoes when exposed.

1001803.name: [Artifice] Ornate Cane
1001803.desc:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, Agent CRIT Rate decreases by <color=#CF4029>40%</color>.
Once reconstructed, Agent CRIT DMG instead increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
