1001803.desc2: With each hidden prop removed, the magician's cane juggling becomes effortlessly smooth.

1001804.name: [Artifice] Hypnotic Pocket Watch
1001804.desc:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, enemy Stun duration decreases by <color=#CF4029>40%</color>.
Once reconstructed, enemy Stun duration increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1001804.desc2: From how your eyelids start to get heavy when you stare at it, these hypnotic pocket watches are basically the same as your summer homework.

1001805.name: [Artifice] Mechanical Pigeon
1001805.desc:
The amount of Gear Coins you gain from Gear Coin events is <color=#CF4029>halved</color> on the current floor.
When you reach the next floor, the repayment will be reduced by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1001805.desc2: Since everyone knows the magic is fake, there's no need to use real pigeons either, right?

1001806.name: [Artifice] Top Hat of Wonders
1001806.desc:
For the current floor, exploring an unexplored tile causes all squad members to lose <color=#CF4029>1%</color> HP.
Upon reaching the next floor, at the end of every combat, all squad members instead recover <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> HP.
1001806.desc2: Pulling a Bangboo out of a hat everyone thinks contains a rabbit... Now that's magic!

1001807.name: [Artifice] Burning Rose
1001807.desc:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, Agent Anomaly Buildup Rate decreases by <color=#CF4029>80%</color>.
Once reconstructed, Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
1001807.desc2: A beautiful rose that can ignite and burn. Actually, it's just a fake flower with a fire starter in the stem.

1001808.name: [Artifice] Magician Gloves
1001808.desc:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, Chain Attacks replenish <color=#CF4029>1</color> less Assist Point.
Once reconstructed, Defensive Assist inflicts <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> more Daze, and Assist Follow-Up DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
1001808.desc2: If you don't want to play the role of the embarrassed fool in a show, then don't shake the hand of a gloved magician.

1001809.name: [Artifice] Extendable Short Sword
1001809.desc: Chain attacks deal <color=#2BAD00>considerably more DMG </color>, but the damage taken by your allies is also <color=#2BAD00>greatly increased</color>.
1001809.desc2: When the expansion button is functioning properly, it's a great magic prop for intimidating people. But when the button malfunctions... well, that's even more intimidating.

1001901.name: [Ether] Scrap Amplifier
1001901.desc: Each point of Anomaly Proficiency increases the Agent's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>0.2%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1001901.desc2: An operational amplifier regulates the cycling speed of the surrounding Ether. As for the malfunctioning ones... they are typically repurposed into wireless speakers.

1001902.name: [Ether] Rusty W-Engine
1001902.desc2: When your W-Engine completely fails in the Hollow, don't hesitate to use it as a disposable throwing weapon.

1001903.name: [Ether] Net Launcher
1001903.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies.
1001903.desc2: This device launches a special Etheric grid that temporarily reduces the Ether activity of Ethereals upon contact.

1001904.name: [Ether] Cracked Drive
1001904.desc2: A drive disc covered in cracks. Playing it despite the cracks will only produce stress-inducing noises.

1001905.name: [Ether] Suppressive Bracelet
1001905.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Activity to all squad members.
1001905.desc2:
"Ah! This bracelet just won't stop sending me alerts! It's so annoying!"
"Just take it off. See? Problem solved."

1001906.name: [Ether] Deteriorating Filter
1001906.desc: Dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stack of Activity. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10s</color>.
1001906.desc2: Once a trendy accessory popular in New Eridu, it was later banned due to concerns about causing anxiety among the public.

1001907.name: [Ether] Invalid Adapter
1001907.desc: Each Standard [Ether] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>32%</color>.
1001907.desc2: Much like a mobile phone data cable, it connects multiple Bangboo for data connection. However, it also shares another trait with data cables: it's prone to breaking.

1001908.name: [Ether] Frozen Timer
1001908.desc2: A device used to calculate the recommended exploration duration within the Hollows. The readings are frozen at the moment of its destruction.

1001909.name: [Ether] Depleted Battery
1001909.desc: Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1001909.desc2: A discarded battery, its power depleted, possibly discarded by a Bangboo with a backup battery module.

1001910.name: [Ether] Broken Chip
1001910.desc: Launching a Chain Attack increases all squad members' Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>25</color> for 15s.
1001910.desc2: A discarded broken Bangboo core chip, with its owner nowhere to be found.

1001911.name: [Ether] Faulty Jammer
1001911.desc: <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1001911.desc2: Originally designed as an interference device to be installed on a Bangboo's head, capable of disrupting Ethereals, a hat version was developed, allowing Hollow Raiders to wear it themselves.

1001912.name: [Ether] Collective Emblem
1001912.desc: Increases the chance for [Ether] Resonia to appear.
1001912.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Etheric matter exhibits mutual attraction... to a certain extent, this is true.

1001913.name: [Ether] Lightning Rod
1001913.desc: Ether currents deal <color=#2BAD00>significantly more DMG</color>. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
1001913.desc2: Never stand in open areas during a thunderstorm!

1001914.name: [Ether] High-Efficiency Lightning Rod
1001914.desc: Ether currents deal <color=#POSITIVE_WITH_RED>overwhelmingly more DMG</color>! Agents and enemies won't be able to take it! Please be sure to dodge and use these currents to defeat enemies!
1001914.desc2: From now on, if there are no lightning rods, everyone can be efficient lightning catchers.

1002101.name: [Synergy] Feather Cat Wand
1002101.desc: Launching a Bangboo Chain Attack enables the Bangboo to deal <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> more DMG for 30s.
1002101.desc2: A Bangboo-shaped cat teaser that can provoke fierce attacks from cats, provided the user is swift and diligent enough.

1002102.name: [Synergy] Jingling Bell
1002102.desc: Bangboo ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for each Combat Bangboo and Ally Bangboo in your squad.
1002102.desc2:
When your pet presses it, a corresponding voice will ring out, such as "hug me," "feed me," and "play with me"...
The dog at the newsstand on Sixth Street also uses such bells, but the voice is not as sappy.

1002103.name: [Synergy] Roly-Poly Bunny
1002103.desc: Bangboo Active Skill DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
1002103.desc2: Everyone's hands will eventually get sore, so the tumbler always gets back up in the end.

1002104.name: [Synergy] Laser Pointer
1002104.desc: Launching an Active Skill or Bangboo Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>10</color> Energy for the active Agent. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1002104.desc2: A cute laser pointer, extremely attractive to animals.

1002105.name: [Synergy] Teething Toy
1002105.desc: When a Bangboo hits an enemy, Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to that enemy for 10s.
1002105.desc2: A bone-shaped teething toy that will help keep your dog's teeth clean and sharp.

1002106.name: [Synergy] Dog Frisbee
1002106.desc: When an Agent launches an EX Special Attack, Bangboo CRIT Rate is increased by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for 10s.
1002106.desc2: Catching a Frisbee in mid-air is always an impressive feat, no matter who or what catches it.

1002107.name: [Synergy] Goldfish Hideout
1002107.desc: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1002107.desc2: Hide in the little house underwater, and the fish can avoid that bossy round face outside.

1002108.name: [Synergy] Wave Cat Scratcher
1002108.desc2: Thank you, for saving the couch from unbearable pain.

1002109.name: [Synergy] Dash Tunnel
1002109.desc2: It takes hours to wiggle and prepare, and the dash lasts only 1 second.

1002110.name: [Synergy] Insane Running Wheel
1002110.desc: Bangboo Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1002110.desc2: A hamster decides to give the wheel a spin, and soon finds itself on an uncontrollable crazy ride!

1002111.name: [Synergy] Happy Merry-Go-Round
1002111.desc2: This toy is designed for three cats to play together. The ideal scenario is one cat monopolizing all three balls, while the worst-case scenario is none of the cats showing any interest.

1002112.name: [Synergy] Collective Emblem
1002112.desc: Increases the chance for [Synergy] Resonia to appear.
1002112.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Help me, Bangboo!

1002201.name: [Research] Overload Distribution
1002201.desc: Each Pressure Overload restores <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> of Max HP and increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>. (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:StressOverloadCount,0.01,2}%. Maximum: 50%.)
1002201.desc2:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on overload-related matters.

1002202.name: [Research] Resource Conversion
1002202.desc: Every 100 Gear Coins spent increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>0.5%</color> (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:DamageShow,0.1,2}%. Maximum: 50%.)
1002202.desc2:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on resource conversion-related matters.

1002203.name: [Research] Trigger Instinct
1002203.desc: For every 1% of HP lost, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color>. (Current increase: Please see Resonium Details. Maximum increase: 80%)
1002203.desc2:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on survival instinct-related matters.

1002301.name: [Affinity] Attack Tactical Exchange
1002301.desc: Increases Attack specialty Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
1002301.desc2: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Attack tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

1002302.name: [Affinity] Stun Tactical Exchange
1002302.desc: Stun specialty Agents inflict <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> more Daze.
1002302.desc2: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Stun tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

1002303.name: [Affinity] Anomaly Tactical Exchange
1002303.desc: Increases Anomaly specialty Agent Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>20</color>.
1002303.desc2: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Anomaly tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

1002304.name: [Affinity] Support Tactical Exchange
1002304.desc: Increases Support specialty Agent Energy Regen by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
1002304.desc2: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Support tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

1002305.name: [Affinity] Defense Tactical Exchange
1002305.desc: Defense specialty Agents take <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> less DMG.
1002305.desc2: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Defense tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

1002306.name: [Affinity] Rupture Tactical Exchange
1002306.desc: Increases Rupture specialty Agent Sheer DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1002306.desc2: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Rupture tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

1002401.name: [Tenacity] Guiding Lantern
1002401.desc: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> more CRIT DMG.
1002401.desc2: Guides the way to hope while signaling to the hunters lurking in the shadows.

1002402.name: [Tenacity] Medical Kit
1002402.desc: When an Agent is attacked, the DMG is <color=#2BAD00>shared between all squad members</color>. When any off-field Agent has less than 10% HP, they will share DMG but not lose HP.
1002402.desc2: From large items like first-aid supplies to small items like cold medications, it all fits inside.

1002403.name: [Tenacity] Flames of Survival
1002403.desc: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> more DMG.
1002403.desc2: In the depths of despair, only the light of the flame can restore one's reason and confidence.

1002404.name: [Tenacity] Cut-Resistant Gloves
1002404.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist or gaining a Shield increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 20s.
1002404.desc2: Only the hardest gloves can handle the sharpest blades.

1002405.name: [Tenacity] Military Canteen
1002405.desc: Triggering an Ultimate grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of their lost HP.
1002405.desc2: A canteen with dual filtration. It not only filters outdoor freshwater into drinkable water but also reduces the risk of consuming Ether from water sources in the Hollow.

1002406.name: [Tenacity] Toothpick-sized Can
1002406.desc: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 30%, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> for 20s. This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.
1002406.desc2: Each bite was hard to swallow, but every one of them kept hunger at bay.

1002407.name: [Tenacity] High-Pressure Insulated Boots
1002407.desc:
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to enemies with a higher percentage HP.
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more DMG to enemies with a lower percentage HP.
1002407.desc2: Extra-thick at the bottom for enhanced protection and kicking power.

1002408.name: [Tenacity] Wilderness Map
1002408.desc: When an Agent is attacked or triggers Perfect Assist, the Agent restores <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy. This can be triggered once every 7s across all squad members.
1002408.desc2: The red crosses marked as "no entry" on the map were all earned through pain.

1002409.name: [Tenacity] Survival Kit
1002409.desc: Upon entering combat, the Agent gains Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of lost HP.
1002409.desc2: All preparations are made to survive.

1002410.name: [Tenacity] Emergency Flashlight
1002410.desc:
When the Agent's HP is below 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
When HP is above 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>.
1002410.desc2: An adjustable brightness flashlight. Save the battery by keeping it dim unless it's an emergency.

1002411.name: [Tenacity] Insulated Sleeping Bag
1002411.desc2: An exceptionally warm sleeping bag. No need to worry about oversleeping. When it gets too hot, you'll naturally crawl out.

1002412.name: [Tenacity] Collective Emblem
1002412.desc: Increases the chance for [Tenacity] Resonia to appear.
1002412.desc2:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
The price of accelerating your sprint is accelerating your use of oxygen.

1002943.name: [Affinity] Fully Charged
1002943.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002943.desc2: Anby has had enough rest, and she's now ready for a big fight. Wherever she goes, she can hear the crackling of electricity around her.

1002944.name: [Affinity] Apex Predator
1002944.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002944.desc2: Nekomata is coiled and ready to pounce, just like an apex predator ready to leap out and disappear at any second.

1002945.name: [Affinity] Full Firepower
1002945.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002945.desc2: If fear towards the enemy often stems from a lack of firepower, then Nicole flexing full firepower is what instills fear in them.

1002946.name: [Affinity] Absolutely Flawless
1002946.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002946.desc2: Soldier 11 is fully prepared, and in better shape than she's ever been.

1002947.name: [Affinity] My BGM is On
1002947.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002947.desc2: Billy hums the theme song to Starlight Knights while confidently declaring "Nobody can beat me while my BGM is on!" Clearly... he's in high spirits.

1002948.name: [Affinity] Muscle Mayhem
1002948.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002948.desc2: Anton is in excellent shape, effortlessly moving through chest exercises as if he's powered by endless energy and he's looking for a punching bag to hammer.

1002949.name: [Affinity] Un-Bear-Able Rage
1002949.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002949.desc2: Ben quotes an "angry price," an amount most ordinary people couldn't even dream of affording. Luckily, some unsavory characters down in the Hollows are going to cover the bill.

1002950.name: [Affinity] Exercise Before Dinner
1002950.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002950.desc2: Soukaku radiates with an unprecedented level of energy, clearly driven to complete all her tasks before the restaurant closes.

1002951.name: [Affinity] Frosty Eviction
1002951.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002951.desc2: Lycaon is as elegant as always, but he has a particularly relentless look in his eye. Any uninvited guest would be met with a cold kick out the front door before they got the chance to say a thing.

1002952.name: [Affinity] Bangboo Give Me Strength
1002952.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002952.desc2: Grace is in fine form. A Bangboo's hug doesn't just relieve exhaustion, it also bring a steady stream of strength.

1002953.name: [Affinity] Hostile Wake-Over
1002953.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002953.desc2: The bad news is that Ellen did not get a good night's sleep. The good news is that she's now refreshed and eager to clear any obstacles for the next night's quality sleep.

1002954.name: [Affinity] Up to the Task
1002954.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002954.desc2: Rina and her little Bangboo are in excellent condition. Navigating through the dangerous Hollows is as easy as playing a game of tag.

1002955.name: [Affinity] Passionate Cleanup
1002955.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002955.desc2: With the uplifting effects of genuine compliments and rejuvenating sleep, Corin is now brimming with enthusiasm, even in her spirited "Sorry!"

1002956.name: [Affinity] Hammer Sparks
1002956.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002956.desc2: Koleda and her formidable hammer have been finely tuned to their best shapes. Now, even her casual strikes now ignite more sparks than ever before.

1002957.name: [Affinity] Solid Companionship
1002957.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002957.desc2: When Zhu Yuan confronts dangers and perils, she is never alone — Somewhere beyond her sight, numerous fellow officers stride alongside her. This camaraderie is the source of her confidence and pride as a Public Security officer.

1002958.name: [Affinity] Lady-Like Charge
1002958.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002958.desc2: Lucy and her boars have had a good rest, and were all bursting with energy.

1002959.name: [Affinity] Fighting Style: Mixed Fruit Flavor
1002959.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002959.desc2: Lighter's fighting style is more elusive than ever: rapid hooks, fierce jabs, brutal straight punches, and... is that a subtle mixed fruit aroma?

1002960.name: [Affinity] Power of Hope
1002960.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002960.desc2: Piper is full of energy, full of hope, obsessed with the lottery, and can't wait to go back and check her ticket.

1002961.name: [Affinity] Like a Fish in Water
1002961.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002961.desc2: Qingyi has achieved her daily water intake goal, and she is in her optimal state for the day.

1002962.name: [Affinity] Partners in "Crime"
1002962.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002962.desc2: Being recruited by Jane as an "accomplice" is no small feat, and it means she will unleash her full strength.

1002963.name: [Affinity] Path of Honor
1002963.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002963.desc2: The pain didn't affect Seth's condition. Instead, it raised his spirit. These wounds are his medal of honor as a Public Security officer.

1002964.name: [Affinity] Overlord's Accompaniment
1002964.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002964.desc2: For Caesar, obstacles on the path are irrelevant. As long as she can roll over them, they're not obstacles anymore.

1002965.name: [Affinity] Nitro-Fuel Feast
1002965.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002965.desc2: In Burnice's world, solving problems is simple... Gather some good friends from the squad and have a lively Nitro-Fuel Feast together!

1002966.name: [Affinity] 17-Item Check-Up
1002966.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002966.desc2: After completing a series of thorough check-ups, Yanagi is very satisfied with the results and confident in her teammates' conditions going forward.

1002967.name: [Affinity] Haiku Swordplay
1002967.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002967.desc2: Hoshimi Miyabi has begun a new round of training. The focus of her training this time is "reciting haikus while slashing away at enemies." Gotta admit it's quite the sight and her swordsmanship is impeccable. Could the haikus really be making her stronger...?

1002968.name: [Affinity] Efficient Surge
1002968.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002968.desc2: Asaba Harumasa is rested and recharged. Time to get things done!

1002969.name: [Affinity] Encore Time
1002969.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002969.desc2: Astra Yao has had enough rest and is feeling great. It's time for her to hit the stage again!

1002970.name: [Affinity] Back to Prime
1002970.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002970.desc2: Evelyn's in perfect condition — or rather, her skills are on point. She said, "It feels like I'm back in my prime when I used to go on missions." As for the details, let's just say it's best not to ask...

1002971.name: Affinity: Silver Heart's Resonance
1002971.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002971.desc2: Silver Heart Tin Soldiers are born for combat, but here beside you is Anby. Her blade speaks of things that cannot be forgotten.

1002972.name: Affinity with Your Rhythm
1002972.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002972.desc2: Remembering lost loved ones and those beside me, "Trigger" blew an original harmonica tune. The powerful will to protect now transforms into soaring fervor.

1002973.name: [Affinity] Nail It Big Time
1002973.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002973.desc2: Pulchra, brimming with fighting spirit, pulled out various eyeshadows, lipsticks, and compacts... "Are these disguise bombs?" "They're hot-selling resale items. Hold onto them carefully - if they break, they'll lose their value."

1002974.name: [Affinity] The Girl's Parasol
1002974.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002974.desc2: The hem of her dress and the parasol are more than just a girl's way of attracting attention. When Vivian opens her parasol, her fierce protective instinct sweeps any obstacles, shielding her from all hostility.

1002975.name: [Affinity] The Phantom Thief's Magic
1002975.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002975.desc2:
In New Eridu, there's only Ether, no magic — unless you trust the mischievous glint in the eyes of the phantom thief.
Here, you see the unyielding flames and the quiet frost intertwining, revealing a harsh truth mingled with gentle lies.

1002976.name: [Affinity] Guarding Tranquility
1002976.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002976.desc2:
"True training is like drawing spring water beneath the moon — you touch the surface gently, leaving the moon's reflection undisturbed, not stirring the stars into chaos."
She's always behind you, quietly shielding you from it all, steady and serene, as if it were nothing.

1002977.name: [Affinity] "Such Might"
1002977.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002977.desc2:
According to your dear senior Fufu herself, tiger Thirens naturally possess a protective aura called Might during battle.
Although it can't be explained by either science or sorcery, Fufu's fighting spirit is definitely all fired up.

1002978.name: [Affinity] A Soup to Bring Everyone Together
1002978.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002978.desc2: Senior Yinhu is doing his best to figure out how to score the finest ingredients from the market at the lowest prices. This bowl of ten-treasure nutrition soup is proof of his trust and gratitude.

1002979.name: [Affinity] Perfect Symmetry
1002979.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002979.desc2: After all sorts of tweaking and adjusting, Eous is finally perfectly symmetrical, and Alice finally feels a deep sense of relief she's never felt before! As for the tweaking process... Well, some details are better left unsaid.

1002980.name: [Affinity] Lucky Plum Cookie
1002980.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002980.desc2: The street snacks of Failume Heights are infamous for their mouth-puckering sourness. While this makes them perfect for Yuzuha's pranks, they also work wonders for folks who wish to stay alert and awake!

1002981.name: [Affinity] Three Musketeers
1002981.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002981.desc2:
One gunner, one gun. Two gunners, one gun. Three gunners... still just one gun!
But at least with Orphie and Magus around, you won't have to worry about running out of ammo.

1002982.name: [Affinity] Flowers on the Ruins
1002982.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002982.desc2:
Once, in ruins like these, humanity had nothing left. But now, she truly saw it... flowers blooming upon the ruins.
At this moment, she offers you flowers filled with love. Please don't ask why - just accept them and don't be shy.

1002983.name: [Affinity] Changing Tides
1002983.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002983.desc2:
Around you, her emotions have always ebbed and flowed like gentle tides, whispering softly only when washing over the shore.
But in this moment, you truly sense her feelings surge into silent waves, condensing into a force of immense weight within those rolling swells.

1002984.name: [Affinity] Moonlit Adventure
1002984.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002984.desc2:
Keen Ether perception, vast Ethereal knowledge, exceptional combat skills, and an ever-growing curiosity — without a doubt, Lucia is one of the finest Hollow companions.
...And after agreeing to seek the "Doppelganger" together, that boundless energy has reached even greater heights.

1002985.name: [Affinity] Tempered Blade
1002985.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002985.desc2:
Manato's body and soul are hardened by years of labor and countless brushes with death.
So rest assured, as long as he can still swing that heavy greatsword, he won't let danger come near you.

1002986.name: [Affinity] The Dead Dials
1002986.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002986.desc2: Only spirits can dial Dialyn's phone. When it rings, it signals the start of a judgment where yesterday's truth condemns today's sins.

1002987.name: [Affinity] Greater Heights
1002987.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002987.desc2:
Beyond every peak lies an even higher summit. Whether in martial arts or character, Banyue always strives to reach greater heights.
Looking back now, his achievements stand tall and proud.

1002988.name: Sword of the Solitary Heart
1002988.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002988.desc2:
The Hollow is filled with treacherous places and requires vigilance and caution to remain safe.
But right now, you can rest easy — your senior walks by your side, her sword's light guarding the path ahead.

1002989.name: Double Lucky Bunny Ears
1002989.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002989.desc2: Xiao'Zhao says clean bunny ears bring luck to everyone, so with me and Xiao'Zhao together, we've got two pairs: that's double the luck!

1002990.name: Wings of Steel
1002990.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002990.desc2: I'll protect every single one of your delusions — whether on stage or on the battlefield, same as always.

1002991.name: Strawberry Paradise
1002991.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002991.desc2:
She picked up that sheet music, and with it, an entire summer that had withered away in the strawberry garden.
In this awakened paradise, as long as it's her wish, every delusion can come true!

1002992.name: Flawless Plumage
1002992.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002992.desc2:
There's no such thing as a flawless genius idol, or wings of pure white.
But at least for this one moment, I'll deliver the perfect delusions.

1002993.name: Guidepost Home
1002993.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002993.desc2: Her innate sharp senses always lead Cissia to her destination — be it prey, truth, or just a warm corner where she can curl up. Yet what she craves most is a beacon to take her home.

1002994.name: Beyond the Shackles
1002994.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002994.desc2: Promeia never uncuffs herself if it's not necessary, but... it seems a certain special client's presence has turned it into a necessity.

1002995.name: Starlight Beacon
1002995.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002995.desc2: The starlight that guides hope may not exist, but there will always be someone who becomes the beacon leading people toward hope.

1002996.name: Like the Spring Breeze
1002996.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002996.desc2: Even a gentle breeze sometimes hides its sting, yet Velina has already read the shifting winds. Wherever the path ahead may lead, all lies within her grasp with a single fold of her fan.

1002997.name: En-Nah Laureate
1002997.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002997.desc2: Miss Norma has earned the crown in Bangboo technology — and she wears it, quite literally. I mean, she literally has a Bangboo hat that fires large-caliber rounds and flies at high speed.

1002998.name: Dawn's Elegy
1002998.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002998.desc2: Sighs gather into a roar, sobs forge a battle hymn. The herald of death, having ushered in the long, silent night, will finally sing the first act of daybreak.

1002999.name: Hannibull
1002999.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1002999.desc2: While the winged Thiren girl favors a light and nimble combat style, treating the enemy to a little Void Hunter shock and awe now and then isn't half bad.

1003000.name: Legendary Ascent
1003000.desc: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
1003000.desc2: Sigrid has left behind many legends in Roscaelifer, though most were spun by a certain "lady." Even so, Sigrid draws closer to those legends with each passing day. This narrow path winding toward legends will one day become a truly legendary road of its own.

1005001.name: [General] Tactical War Weapon
1005001.desc: Anomaly Buildup Rate <color=#2BAD00>increases significantly</color>. (Appears only in Rally Commissions)
1005001.desc2: A supply box left behind by the Defense Force with a treasure that can help them ensure their victory through enhancing their combat efficiency.

1005002.name: [General] Full Infantry Armaments
1005002.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Significantly increases</color> Anomaly Buildup Rate, and when any squad member inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect on enemies, restores <color=#2BAD00>50</color> Energy for all squad members. (Appears only in Rally Commissions)
1005002.desc2: An advanced supply box left behind by the Defense Force. Inside, there's a variety of supplies for all sorts of combat situations. For a soldier operating in the Hollow, finding one of these is even better than winning the lottery.

1006001.name: [Rupture] Armor-Piercing Bullet
1006001.desc2: Depleted uranium alloy, straight to the core.

1006002.name: [Armorer] Unstoppable Edge
1006002.desc: Sharp DMG dealt by Agents <color=#2BAD00>increases by 15%</color>.
1006002.desc2: The sharper the edge, the harder the hit.

1010101.name: [Ignite] Vintage Matchbox
1010101.desc: Dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> triggers <color=#FF5521>Blaze</color>, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 1200% of ATK. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
1010101.desc2: Strike a match, toss it, turn around, and wait for the explosion. And there you have it, a classic movie shot.

1010102.name: [Ignite] Electric BBQ Grill
1010102.desc: Increases the effect of Motivation to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of its original value.
1010102.desc2: As it roasts, the heat intensifies, and your craving only grows stronger. Is it just you, or can you really smell the aroma of grilled meat...

1010201.name: [Energy] Bomb Cola
1010201.desc: Generates <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> Energy for all squad members upon entering the battlefield.
1010201.desc2: Prepare for a carbonated war to erupt on your tongue! It used to come with a freebie popping candy, but it was later canceled because too many people were winding up in the oral emergency room.

1010202.name: [Energy] Master Tin's Premium
1010202.desc: Decibel Rating is set to <color=#2BAD00>Maximum</color> upon entering the battlefield. Ultimates have a 35% chance of <color=#2BAD00>not costing Decibels</color>.
1010202.desc2: Tin Master's elegance and sincerity are woven into every drop of this specially selected coffee, accompanying you through the city.

1010301.name: [Critical] High-Explosive Grenade
1010301.desc: Agent CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>36%</color>. Critical Hits may <color=#2BAD00>execute</color> normal enemies with less than <color=#2BAD00>75%</color> HP. This effect can trigger once every 6s.

1010302.name: [Critical] Lightweight Buttstock
1010302.desc: Increases the stack limit of Insight from 5 to <color=#2BAD00>8</color>.
1010302.desc2: A great battlefield companion, it can help you counter annoying recoil and defend against close-range attackers.

1010401.name: [Shield] Tactical Rucksack
1010401.desc: Shielded Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>35%</color> more DMG and won't take DMG <color=#2BAD00>that exceeds their Shield</color>. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
1010401.desc2:
A large capacity and extra compartments are all you need to carry supplies for a whole squad...
As long as you're willing to shoulder the load.

1010402.name: [Shield] Anti-Riot Fork
1010402.desc: Agents deal additional DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> of their current Shield.
1010402.desc2: The best defense is... stopping your opponent's attacks entirely!

1010501.name: [Shock] Lightning Rod
1010501.desc: Dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> triggers <color=#2EB6FF>Jolt</color>, inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to 1,200% of ATK. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
1010501.desc2: This Resonium may seem inconspicuous most of the time, but when thunderstorms roll around, it becomes the master of the sky.

1010502.name: [Shock] Outdoor Battery
1010502.desc: Increases the stack limit of Zap from 20 to <color=#2BAD00>30</color>. Dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stack of Zap. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
1010502.desc2: Its capacity is large, and so is its weight. The strongest person will find themselves as the poor soul carrying this burdensome battery on a camping trip.

1010701.name: [Duel] Ceramic Vase
1010701.desc: Increases enemy Stun DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>. When your squad is full, Agents can additionally trigger <color=#2BAD00>1</color> Chain Attacks on Stunned enemies.
1010701.desc2: One of the weapons frequently wielded by the leading ladies in classic films, it's often used to deliver the decisive blow when the love interest is in a life-or-death battle with the villain.

1010702.name: [Duel] Inflatable Hammer
1010702.desc: Increases the stack limit of Rush from 4 to <color=#2BAD00>8</color>. Stunned enemies' Stun DMG Multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
1010702.desc2: Don't be fooled by the text "1000T" written on this hammer... It's only meant to scare people. It is in fact, just a flimsy hammer that will make a funny toy sound when it hits anything.

1010801.name: [Dodge] Rugby Ball
1010801.desc: On triggering a Perfect Dodge, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stacks of Agility, and DMG dealt is increased by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 15s.
1010801.desc2: Break through your opponent's heavy defenses and strike the winning blow on their turf.

1010802.name: [Dodge] Magnetic Dart
1010802.desc: When in the Counter state, Agent EX Special Attacks and Dodge Counter <color=#2BAD00>Interrupt level is increased</color>, and all Agents' DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
1010802.desc2: A dart with a powerful magnet installed on the tip that allows you to hit the bullseye every time even with your eyes closed, as long as you don't throw it off the dart board.

1011101.name: [Freeze] Icicle Shooter
1011101.desc: Triggering <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> leaves an icy mist that lasts 10s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> against enemies caught in the mist deal <color=#2BAD00>80%</color> more CRIT DMG.
1011101.desc2: This sweet Resonium can shoot small icicles, but it costs a pretty penny in water bills. Still, that doesn't stop folks from taking it out and having some fun on the streets whenever it rains.

1011102.name: [Freeze] Ice Flask
1011102.desc: Triggering Ice Mark <color=#2BAD00>no longer consumes stacks</color>.
1011102.desc2: A small bottle made of a special material, emitting a slight chill even when it's empty.

1011401.name: [Onslaught] Pneumatic Drill
1011401.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> deals additional DMG to Normal/Elite/Boss enemies equal to <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>/<color=#2BAD00>15%</color>/<color=#2BAD00>3%</color> of their Max HP. Additional DMG cannot exceed 4,000% of the Agent's initial ATK.
1011401.desc2: With this Resonium, you can unleash ruthless attacks that hit with incredible precision and penetrate deep into your target's core! Listen, the brick walls are wailing, and your neighbors are complaining!

1011402.name: [Onslaught] Circular Saw
1011402.desc: <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> can <color=#2BAD00>execute</color> Normal/Elite/Boss enemies with less than <color=#2BAD00>70%</color>/<color=#2BAD00>20%</color>/<color=#2BAD00>10%</color> HP.
1011402.desc2: When this wickedly sharp blade starts to spin, it emits an ear-splitting noise as if it's shrieking, "Stay away!"

1011601.name: [Assist] Dynamic Sensors
1011601.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>48%</color> for 30s. All squad members gain 1 stack of Acuity.
1011601.desc2: This observation device tracks and predicts a target's movements, revealing their weakspots.

1011602.name: [Assist] Tactical Analyzer
1011602.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge or Chain Attack additionally restores <color=#2BAD00>1</color> Assist Point and increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> for 12s.
1011602.desc2: This support tool was once installed on Bangboo merchants and could search and analyze the surrounding Ethereals, providing the user with tactical advice. It was abandoned, however, due to repeatedly providing the Bangboo combat advice such as "We have the advantage, go all out!" during combat.

1011901.name: [Ether] Trashed Harpoon Gun
1011901.desc: Inflicting <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> on an enemy grants 1 stack of Activity to all squad members. <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies have their <color=#FE437E>Ether RES</color> reduced by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1011901.desc2: A firearm modified by Hollow Raiders using Ether technology—primitive, but highly effective.

1011902.name: [Ether] Unstable Tranquilizer
1011902.desc: Dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> to an enemy increases Attribute Anomaly DMG <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> against the target for 10s.
1011902.desc2: Limits movement by slowly eroding the target's Ether stability. Primarily effective against targets within the Hollows.

1012101.name: [Synergy] Mini-Sled
1012101.desc: Bangboo deal <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> more DMG. Bangboo Chain Attack additionally deal <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> more DMG.
1012101.desc2: The more the dogs, the higher the speed.

1012102.name: [Synergy] Silver Vine Ball
1012102.desc: Bangboo's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>48%</color>.
1012102.desc2: Give this tiny ball a toss, and brace yourself for endless attention and unlimited cat saliva.

1012401.name: [Tenacity] Compass
1012401.desc: Upon activating EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, Perfect Assist or Ultimate, the Agent immediately loses 4% of their current HP and all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>1 stack</color> of Instinct. This effect will not cause the Agent to lose HP when their HP is below 20%.
1012401.desc2: Not only does it point the way, but it also marks the place where hope resides.

1012402.name: [Tenacity] Distress Radio
1012402.desc: Increases the stack limit of Instinct from 5 to <color=#2BAD00>10</color>, with each stack increasing the Daze caused by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>. The threshold for the [Compass] Resonium not losing HP is increased to <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1012402.desc2: Even if all that's received is static, it's still a comfort. As long as there's power, there's hope.

1014046.name: Trainee Investigator's Supply Box
1014046.desc: Supply box contains Trainee Investigator Logs, W-Engine Batteries, and Dennies.
1014046.desc2:
<color=#FFFFFF>A container holding Agent upgrade materials.</color>
The accomplishments of our predecessors will serve as a ladder, or more specifically, a portable ladder stored in a chest.

1014047.name: Senior Investigator's Supply Box
1014047.desc: Supply box contains Trainee Investigator Logs, W-Engine Batteries, and Dennies.
1014047.desc2:
<color=#FFFFFF>A container holding advanced Agent upgrade materials.</color>
A smart mind is an investigator's most powerful weapon, and the materials in this chest provide efficient ways to use this weapon.

1014048.name: Elite Investigator's Supply Box
1014048.desc: Supply box contains Official Investigator Logs, W-Engine Power Supplies, and Dennies.
1014048.desc2:
<color=#FFFFFF>A chest holding the most advanced Agent upgrade materials.</color>
A testament to the remarkable adventures of a legendary investigator.

1021801.name: [Artifice] Sensory Poker
1021801.desc: Agents generate Energy and Decibels <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> faster.
1021801.desc2: Not only does he know which card you chose, he also knows that your awe and praise are insincere.

1021802.name: [Artifice] Pitch Dark Cape
1021802.desc: Reduces the Pressure increase from movements by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
1021802.desc2: The cloak is the most reliable partner for a magician. It can even be used to shield oneself from rotten eggs and tomatoes when exposed.

1021803.name: [Artifice] Ornate Cane
1021803.desc2: With each hidden prop removed, the magician's cane juggling becomes effortlessly smooth.

1021804.name: [Artifice] Hypnotic Pocket Watch
1021804.desc2: From how your eyelids start to get heavy when you stare at it, these hypnotic pocket watches are basically the same as your summer homework.

1021805.name: [Artifice] Mechanical Pigeon
1021805.desc2: Since everyone knows the magic is fake, there's no need to use real pigeons either, right?

1021806.name: [Artifice] Top Hat of Wonders
1021806.desc: At the end of combat, all squad members recover <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> HP.
1021806.desc2: Pulling a Bangboo out of a hat everyone thinks contains a rabbit... Now that's magic!

1021807.name: [Artifice] Burning Rose
1021807.desc2: A beautiful rose that can ignite and burn. Actually, it's just a fake flower with a fire starter in the stem.

1021808.name: [Artifice] Magician Gloves
1021808.desc: Defensive Assist inflicts <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> more Daze. Assist Follow-Up DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
1021808.desc2: If you don't want to play the role of the embarrassed fool in a show, then don't shake the hand of a gloved magician.

1043001.name: [Deployed] Penguinboo
1043001.desc: Active Skill: Executes a series of graceful slashes with an ice blade, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup</color>.
1043001.desc2: <color=#FFFFFF>Bangboo Chain Attack: Attacks the target with a series of slashes, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and accumulating massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup</color>.</color>

1043002.name: [Deployed] Luckyboo
1043002.desc: Active Skill: Strikes the target with a barrage of golden coins, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and accumulating <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color>.

1043003.name: [Deployed] Exploreboo
1043003.desc: Active Skill: Scans and excavates the nearby ground, then gives the character a random buff based on the Bangboo's stats Buff 1: Recovers HP. Buff 2: Generates a Shield. Buff 3: Increases Energy Regen.

1043004.name: [Deployed] Sumoboo
1043004.desc: Active Skill: Jumps towards the target and executes a downward strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> in an area. This skill is good at interrupting.

1043005.name: [Deployed] Paperboo
1043005.desc: Active Skill: Uses a cardboard box to camouflage itself, inducing a taunt effect: While camouflaged, being attacked by enemies or reaching the camouflage time limit will trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> in an area.
1043005.desc2: <color=#FFFFFF>Bangboo Chain Attack: Enters a cardboard box and jumps at the target enemy, causing an explosion when it lands, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> over a large area.</color>

1043006.name: [Deployed] Bagboo
1043006.desc: Active Skill: Unleashes a series of slashes with dual blades, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
1043006.desc2: <color=#FFFFFF>Bangboo Chain Attack: Continually slashes the target, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.</color>

1043007.name: [Deployed] Cryboo
1043007.desc: Active Skill: Throws a bomb at the target, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and accumulating <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>.
1043007.desc2:
<color=#FFFFFF>Bangboo Chain Attack: 
Throws a bomb at the target, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and accumulating massive <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>.</color>

1043008.name: [Deployed] Avocaboo
1043008.desc: Active Skill: Shoots juice bullets at the character currently on the battlefield. If the bullet misses, the juice will remain on the ground for a while. Characters coming into contact with the juice will recover HP. The recovery effect can only trigger up to 15 times per combat.

1043009.name: [Deployed] Boollseye
1043009.desc: Active Skill: Throws a dart at the target, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
1043009.desc2:
<color=#FFFFFF>Bangboo Chain Attack: 
Launches itself with a slingshot, flying towards the target and performing consecutive slashes, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.</color>

1043010.name: [Deployed] Electroboo
1043010.desc: Active Skill: Charges the enemy and continuously electrocutes the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> and accumulating <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color>.
1043010.desc2: <color=#FFFFFF>Bangboo Chain Attack: Continually electrocutes the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> and accumulating massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color>.</color>

1043011.name: [Deployed] Magnetiboo
1043011.desc: Active Skill: Pulls in nearby enemies and deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to all enemies hit.

1090008.desc2: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

1090009.name: Onslaught Resonium Supply
1090009.desc2: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

1090010.name: Assist Resonium Supply
1090010.desc2: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

1090011.name: Ether Resonium Supply
1090011.desc2: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

1090012.name: Synergy Resonium Supply
1090012.desc2: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

1090013.name: Tenacity Resonium Supply
1090013.desc2: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

1100001.name: Resistance Decline
1100001.desc2: Your body and mind are weakened, as fragile as wreckage in the Hollow.

1100003.name: Resonium Repulsion
1100003.desc: When selecting Resonium, you have fewer choices.
1100003.desc2: This stuff makes me feel sick... It smells like Ethereal... it's not an embryo, is it?

1100004.name: Frightened
1100004.desc: When Pressure overloads, all squad members lose HP.
1100004.desc2: "Oh nooooo... We're done for!" "I just sneezed. Am I going to die?"

1100006.name: Energizing Effect
1100006.desc: Enemy Daze diminishes over time, but the Stun DMG Multiplier is increased.
1100006.desc2: Squad members are shrouded in a mist of special Ether. It seems to be provoking the Ethereals.

1100007.name: Demotivation
1100007.desc2: Your raging battlelust has dried out. You fight only to survive.

1100010.name: Sinister Resonance
1100010.desc: Boss attacks have a chance to deal critical damage.

1100011.name: Suspicion
1100011.desc: When Pressure increases, there is a chance your Pressure either does not increase or increases by a lot.
1100011.desc2: The intensifying uneasiness in your soul is taking its toll.

1100012.name: Rampage
1100012.desc: The Bangboo merchant offers discounts, but also fewer items.
1100012.desc2: For some reason, everyone has become tough and fierce, and not even the resourceful Bangboo merchant can handle these difficult customers.

1100013.name: Self Reassurance
1100013.desc: You receive Gear Coins when Pressure increases, but can only possess up to 3,333 Coins.
1100013.desc2: "Calm down... Yeah... I will survive as long as I have Gear Coins..."

1100014.name: Assimilation
1100014.desc: Agents gain less Pressure, but lose HP when obtaining Resonia.
1100014.desc2: You grow accustomed to the burning pain of the restless Ether as you gradually become one with the Hollow... This is the path to total collapse.

1100017.name: Toxic Dependency
1100017.desc: HP is restored at the conclusion of combat, but Pressure is increased.
1100017.desc2: The enemy explodes in a puff of Ether, and bathing in it you feel a sense of soothing like never before. Who cares about the price. More! More enemies!

1100018.name: Weakened
1100018.desc2: The old signature fighting moves and combos... It's a struggle now just to recall how they went.

1100019.name: Exhausted
1100019.desc: Decreases HP when exploring through the monitor. In combat, on-field characters will lose HP gradually.
1100019.desc2: Like air, the corruption of the Ether seeps into every being, humans or robots alike.

1100020.name: Shadow of Horror
1100020.desc: The Dead End Butcher deals <color=#CF4029>20%</color> more DMG. He <color=#CF4029>restores Daze and a small amount of HP</color> when he hits squad members.
1100020.desc2: Fear slumbers within the recesses of memory, stirring awake with each uncontrolled, pounding heartbeat.

1100021.name: Megalophobia
1100021.desc: Corruption Complex deals <color=#CF4029>30% more DMG</color>. Attacks from allies <color=#CF4029>no longer accumulate Daze</color>, but breaking weak spots <color=#2BAD00>inflicts a substantial amount of Daze</color>.
1100021.desc2: Upon realizing their insignificance, their attempts to evade falter, and endeavors to attack appear futile.

1100022.name: Uncanny Valley
1100022.desc: Twin Marionettes deal <color=#CF4029>50% more DMG</color> and revive <color=#CF4029>much faster</color>.
1100022.desc2: Hesitation emerges from semblance and shatters under the weight of disparities.

1100023.name: Harshness
1100023.desc: Bangboo merchants only sell S-Rank items.
1100023.desc2: The concept of "tolerance" has been stripped from the mind, leading to a critical outlook on everything.

1100024.name: Insatiable Greed
1100024.desc: Gear Coin events generate more Gear Coins but also inflict more Pressure.
1100024.desc2: Unleash yourself from all restraints and moderation, releasing the overwhelming burden by plundering everything in your path.

1100025.name: Overcaution
1100025.desc: Upon entering the next floor and starting the final battle, lose 300 Gear Coins and recover 10% of Max HP for all squad members. However, failure to pay will immediately deduct 15% Max HP from all squad members.
1100025.desc2: Caution becomes a feeble pretext for the fear of moving forward, urging one to pursue an illusory path of safety amid the Hollow's malevolence.

1100026.name: Destructive Urge
1100026.desc: Rest Areas and Swift Supplies no longer recover HP. Instead, after each battle, all squad members recover 3% of Max HP. Before the next floor and final battle, recover 10% of Max HP.
1100026.desc2: The insatiable craving for destruction overrides reason, providing momentary respite only when completely sated.

1100027.name: Grasping Fervor
1100027.desc: Purchasing items from Bangboo merchants costs HP instead of Gear Coins.
1100027.desc2:
An appetite for all that lies within sight, regardless of the cost.
Seize them, and take them away.

1100029.name: Primal Malice
1100029.desc: Typhon Slugger deals <color=#CF4029>30% more DMG</color> and has <color=#CF4029>Immunity to all Attribute Anomalies</color>.
1100029.desc2: Just like a gorilla mimicking a human with a weapon, the beast, devoid of reason, skillfully pulls the trigger. This evokes thoughts of the primal malice encountered only in barbaric lands.

1100030.name: Parasitic Mycose
1100030.desc: When an Agent's HP is above 50%, HP recovery speed is significantly reduced. When an Agent's HP is below 50%, HP recovery speed is significantly increased.
1100030.desc2: Greedy when you are strong, merciful when you are weak...

1100101.name: [Ignite] Molten Gloves
1100101.desc: When an Agent with Motivation <color=#FF5521>Burns</color> an enemy, the <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG interval is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
1100101.desc2: Each finger has a small lighter. If the other hand had a frost glove, that would be pretty cool.

1100102.name: [Ignite] Flamethrower
1100102.desc2: Once you start to spray this flame, you won't want to stop until you've passed out first.

1100103.name: [Ignite] Kerosene Lamp
1100103.desc: When an Agent has Motivation, their <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> attacks have <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> bonus PEN Ratio.
1100103.desc2: A versatile item that can serve as a cool decoration, a handy source of light, and even a makeshift throwing weapon in a pinch.

1100104.name: [Ignite] Blowtorch
1100104.desc: Dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> grants 1 stack of Motivation to all squad members. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>6</color>s.
1100104.desc2: It releases a sweet roaring flame.

1100105.name: [Ignite] Molotov Cocktail
1100105.desc: Agent <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
1100105.desc2: Someone was trying to do the right thing and threw it into the Hollow. Where exactly it fell and what it might have burned is a mystery.

1100106.name: [Ignite] Top-Notch Charcoal
1100106.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Motivation to all squad members.
1100106.desc2: High-end charcoal that emits a fruity fragrance when lit. If used to roast fruit, perhaps it could double the fruity flavor.

1100107.name: [Ignite] Camping Stove
1100107.desc: Inflicting <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> grants <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Motivation to all squad members.
1100107.desc2: With this handy tool, you can enjoy hot food wherever you go.

1100108.name: [Ignite] Deluxe Lighter
1100108.desc2: An elaborately decorated lighter. It looks like the favorite item of the head of a certain gang.

1100109.name: [Ignite] Electric Torch
1100109.desc2: It is known as the Eternally Inextinguishable, but it has gone out more than a few times.

1100110.name: [Ignite] Pulse Igniter
1100110.desc: <color=#FF5521>Burning</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
1100110.desc2: A tool that housewives use to light the stove. It can light up places that need to be lit.

1100111.name: [Ignite] Solid Alcohol
1100111.desc2: A convenient and portable item for various occasions. For example, it can be particularly useful when you want to confess your love but can't find enough candles to make a heart pattern.

1100201.name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble Special
1100201.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s, stacking up to 5 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
1100201.desc2: Scarlet Noble of a random flavor. You never know what flavor you have bought until after you drink it. There's supposedly a 0.01% chance of getting the secret flavor: blood.

1100202.name: [Energy] Neon Cola
1100202.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, generates <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> Energy for 1 random Agent and increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
1100202.desc2: The champion beverage consumer for five years in a row. Sugar-free and healthy drinks only. Even the color of the drinks is white.

1100203.name: [Energy] Raging Taurine
1100203.desc: Ultimate DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1100203.desc2: "Be brave! Be wild!" The commercial is memorable, particularly the part where the actor pours the half-finished drink over his head and then crushes the can into dust.

1100204.name: [Energy] TANKA: BBQ Flavor
1100204.desc: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for the Agent.
1100204.desc2: A brand of soda that is constantly putting out new flavors. This barbecue flavor is supposed to give you that lovely nostalgic taste of barbecue and cola.

1100205.name: [Energy] Power Up
1100205.desc: Launching an Ultimate generates <color=#2BAD00>12</color> Energy for all squad members.
1100205.desc2: Re-hydrate and restore electrolytes in a flash as fast as lightning!

1100206.name: [Energy] Orange God
1100206.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge generates 6 Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>5s</color>.
1100206.desc2: This orange juice is popular among girls. Each can packs the nutritional punch of thirty oranges. "We carefully choose only the finest oranges. One of ours is as good as ten of another kind. That means with just three oranges, you're getting the nutrients of thirty!"

1100207.name: [Energy] Captain Cow
1100207.desc: Agents Decibel Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1100207.desc2: "Help me grow taller, Captain Cow!" This pure milk drink is loved by both children and adults alike. After all, who wouldn't want to add a few inches to their height?

1100208.name: [Energy] Sharp Smile
1100208.desc: Basic Attack Energy Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
1100208.desc2: No additives and sugar free. Who wouldn't love a combo like this?

1100209.name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble: Lemon
1100209.desc: EX Special Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>.
1100209.desc2: An energy drink that is all the rage with young people. Green lemon concentrate covers the taurine flavor.

1100210.name: [Energy] Leman
1100210.desc: Defeating an enemy generates 8 Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s.
1100210.desc2: "Hey, you. Yeah, you. Drink me and we'll be besties for life. Come on. Drink me."

1100211.name: [Energy] Mr. Bright's Probiotics
1100211.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 15s.
1100211.desc2: "Healthy inside and out with a bottle of Mr. Bright."

1100301.name: [Critical] Sniper Scope
1100301.desc: Landing a critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
1100301.desc2: Take it easy. Aim and then shoot. If you miss, it's because you are in too much of a hurry.

1100302.name: [Critical] Sawn-Off Shotgun
1100302.desc: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>3</color> stacks of Insight upon entering the battlefield. Agents <color=#2BAD00>no longer lose</color> Insight stacks when attacked.
1100302.desc2: It packs a punch but is small and convenient to carry. You can even keep it in your waistband. (There are over 200 accidental discharge incidents each year for this very reason)

1100303.name: [Critical] Weapon Crate
1100303.desc: Each Standard [Critical] Resonium owned increases Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>64%</color>.
1100303.desc2: Don't be fooled by this unassuming box — it's not just a crate for weapons, but rather a portal to an entire arsenal of them. You will never know how many weapons you can pull out of it.

1100304.name: [Critical] RPG Shell
1100304.desc: Triggering a critical hit increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 3s.
1100304.desc2: Regular soldiers should get out of the way!

1100305.name: [Critical] Gatling Gun
1100305.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants all squad members 1 stack of Insight. <color=#2BAD00>This effect no longer has a cooldown</color>.
1100305.desc2: Once you pull the trigger, you'll never want to let go. Offense is the best defense, so a constant attack is the ultimate defense!

1100306.name: [Critical] Doombringer
1100306.desc2: Smart ignition and precision blasts. How far it explodes all depends on how far you throw it.

1100307.name: [Critical] Tactical Goggles
1100307.desc: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>3</color> stacks of Insight upon entering the battlefield.
1100307.desc2: Sometimes, good cover is all you need to get a clear view of your target.

1100308.name: [Critical] Duelist
1100308.desc: Defeating an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Insight.
1100308.desc2: Add a little high-tech flare to your duel. Who cares if it is fair?

1100309.name: [Critical] Spare Magazine
1100309.desc: Landing a critical hit on an enemy reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
1100309.desc2: Better prepare for the next enemy early.

1100310.name: [Critical] Muzzle Compensator
1100310.desc: When hitting an enemy from behind, Agent CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
1100310.desc2: An essential accessory for firearms, it enhances your prowess in combat.

1100311.name: [Critical] Laser Scope
1100311.desc: Each non-critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>. This effect is reset after the Agent triggers a critical hit.

1100401.name: [Shield] Fingerless Gloves
1100401.desc: Shielded Agents' <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt level</color> increases, and they receive <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> less DMG.
1100401.desc2: People into punk love wearing this style of gloves.

1100402.name: [Shield] Elastic Kneepads
1100402.desc: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of the Agent's Max HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1100402.desc2: It offers the flexibility needed for all those weird and wonderful leg positions.

1100403.name: [Shield] Battery-Charged Baton
1100403.desc: Increases CRIT DMG of Shielded Agents by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color> and Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>25</color>.
1100403.desc2: Don't touch it while it's charging — it's super hot.

1100404.name: [Shield] Riot Helmet
1100404.desc: Generates Shield for all squad members equal to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of their initial DEF upon entering the battlefield.
1100404.desc2: Rabbit ears were added to display closeness and power.

1100405.name: [Shield] Punk Belt
1100405.desc: Shielded Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to enemies within 6m.
1100405.desc2: With this spiky belt, no one is going to bother you when you're out and about.

1100406.name: [Shield] War Boots
1100406.desc: Defeating an enemy generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> of Max HP for all squad members, lasting 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
1100406.desc2: It may look handsome, but it has a strong smell.

1100407.name: [Shield] Exoskeleton Armor
1100407.desc: Each Standard [Shield] Resonium owned increases Agent DEF by <color=#2BAD00>4.5%</color>.
1100407.desc2: Provides excellent protection while allowing you to launch powerful elbow strikes.

1100408.name: [Shield] Blast Shield
1100408.desc2: Justice must win! Or at least it can't lose.

1100409.name: [Shield] Warm Bracers
1100409.desc: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 25%, immediately generate Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of Max HP for 10s. (This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.)
1100409.desc2: It's not practical to hope it will stop damage. But graffiti lovers like wearing it to protect their wrists.

1100410.name: [Shield] Flak Jacket
1100410.desc2: Heavy attacks bounce right off. The only problem is you bounce forward.

1100411.name: [Shield] Tactical Mask
1100411.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> of Max HP for 5s. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
1100411.desc2: Strong filtration and fresh circulation. You can even wear it while using the bathroom.

1100501.name: [Shock] Current Gloves
1100501.desc2: Gloves that release a shocking voltage. Remember what these gloves look like, and be careful when shaking hands.

1100502.name: [Shock] Stun Gun
1100502.desc: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy generates <color=#2BAD00>15</color> Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
1100502.desc2: It won't do direct damage, but it is still recommended that you take a shot before a fight.

1100503.name: [Shock] Amplification Bracelet
1100503.desc: Agents with Zap deal <color=#2BAD00>35%</color> more <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
1100503.desc2: According to those who have used this device, running with it feels like an invisible muscle-man is gripping your wrist and yanking you forward as hard as he can.

1100504.name: [Shock] Tesla Sphere
1100504.desc: Agents generate <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> Decibels upon hitting a <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemy. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1100504.desc2: Look cool when the power is on or use it for divination when the power is off (and still look cool).

1100505.name: [Shock] Lightning Trident
1100505.desc: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>10</color> stacks of Zap.
1100505.desc2: You can't take this with you to ponds to harpoon fish!

1100506.name: [Shock] Electric Baton
1100506.desc: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>15</color> stacks of Zap.
1100506.desc2: This weapon is a must for any lady's purse. Once you've shocked the perv, follow it up with a slap to the face.

1100507.name: [Shock] Mosquito Swatter
1100507.desc: Each stack of Zap increases the Agent's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>.
1100507.desc2: With this powerful and convenient tool, you won't need to tap with your hands anymore. The only downside is that it may emit the smell of burnt meat if you use it for too long...

1100508.name: [Shock] Conductive Coil
1100508.desc: Dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stacks of Zap. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>2</color>s.
1100508.desc2: A crude method: wrapping the weapon to increase its conductivity.

1100509.name: [Shock] Thunder Whip
1100509.desc2: Sure, it's not practical, but you can look like a villain.

1100510.name: [Shock] EMP Grenade
1100510.desc2: Stay clear of electrical devices when throwing this; otherwise, you'll get carried off too.

1100511.name: [Shock] Hand Crank Generator
1100511.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemies.
1100511.desc2: The strongest person will find themselves as the poor soul cranking the generator alone on a camping trip.

1100701.name: [Duel] Chain Mace
1100701.desc: For each stack of Rush, Agents' Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> when hitting a Stunned enemy.
1100701.desc2: If you get hit, then you only have yourself to blame for not throwing it far enough.

1100702.name: [Duel] Shock Gloves
1100702.desc: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> Decibels.
1100702.desc2: A direct hit to the jaw is all you need to bring the opponent to their knees.

1100703.name: [Duel] Homemade Spiked Mace
1100703.desc: When triggering a Chain Attack, all squad members receive 1 stack of Rush, and the Stun DMG Multiplier of enemies hit is increased by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>, up to a max of <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
1100703.desc2: Who even cares if it's sturdy or practical? As long as it looks terrifying and painful, it's good enough!

1100704.name: [Duel] Tonfa
1100704.desc2: Attack and defense are one. The more you hit, the faster you'll become.

1100705.name: [Duel] Joiner's Hammer
1100705.desc: When an enemy is inflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, all squad members gain a stack of Rush. If the target is not Stunned, its Daze increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
1100705.desc2: A decisive blow. Go forth, little nail!

1100706.name: [Duel] Bench
1100706.desc: When an enemy is Stunned, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> Decibels and <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Rush. Can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s.
1100706.desc2:
"I can't bear to watch. I want in, too!"
