And then they strike with the power of a substitution that catches enemies off guard.

1100707.name: [Duel] Ergonomic Brick
1100707.desc2: Convenient to have on your person, everyone gets one.

1100708.name: [Duel] Baseball Bat
1100708.desc2: If you accidentally let go, one extra combatant will be stunned.

1100709.name: [Duel] Nunchucks
1100709.desc: EX Special Attacks inflict <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more Daze.
1100709.desc2: Once you start playing, you can't put it down. Even if you hit yourself, it doesn't hurt.

1100710.name: [Duel] Brass Knuckles
1100710.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 5s.
1100710.desc2: Frighten the enemy with your imposing manner and then rain down the punches.

1100711.name: [Duel] Gong of Jubilation
1100711.desc: Upon Stun recovery, the enemy's ATK is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 30s.
1100711.desc2: Hit it hard by your ear... and you'll see double all day.

1100801.name: [Dodge] Sports Shades
1100801.desc: Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>75%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
1100801.desc2:
Pro goggles designed to keep the eyes safe during high-speed sports.
"See! I can see everything!"

1100802.name: [Dodge] Skateboard
1100802.desc: When in the Counter state, Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.

1100803.name: [Dodge] Shuttlecock
1100803.desc: On triggering Perfect Dodge, Agents gain <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Agility and enter Vital View for 4s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1100803.desc2: One must remain calm and ensure precision during a spike; otherwise, you'll only end up snapping fragile feathers with a roar.

1100804.name: [Dodge] Tennis Racket
1100804.desc: When entering Vital View by triggering Perfect Dodge, the post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter that can be used repeatedly up to <color=#2BAD00>6</color> times.
1100804.desc2: If you can't hit back, at least try to dodge. Getting smacked by that ball hurts.

1100805.name: [Dodge] Fencing Sword
1100805.desc: Extends the duration of the Counter state by <color=#2BAD00>8</color>s.

1100806.name: [Dodge] Yoga Ball
1100806.desc: The post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s. Triggering this effect grants the Agent 1 stack of Agility.
1100806.desc2: If you can maintain one pose without moving, then you can slow down the flow of time.

1100807.name: [Dodge] Killer Paddle
1100807.desc: Upon being attacked, quickly press Dodge to <color=#2BAD00>immediately break free</color> and recover 50% of the DMG taken as HP. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>4</color>s.
1100807.desc2: It's all about the final, show-stopping spike.

1100808.name: [Dodge] Skate Shoes
1100808.desc2: Made for those who seek the ultimate sprinting speed. If you can't stop, you'll probably crash.

1100809.name: [Dodge] Sneakers
1100809.desc: Perfect Dodge is <color=#2BAD00>easier</color> to trigger, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.

1100810.name: [Dodge] Skis
1100810.desc: Triggering Dodge Counter generates <color=#2BAD00>7</color> Energy for the Agent.
1100810.desc2: Gracefully dodge obstacles or eat snow like no one else.

1100811.name: [Dodge] Hard Hat
1100811.desc: Using Dodge increases the Agent's DEF by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 5s.
1100811.desc2: All defensive measures are a means to better offense.

1100946.name: [Affinity] Absolutely Flawless
1100946.desc: Soldier 11 has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Indulgent Blaze]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Refreshing Rations</color> effect (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100946,1,2} more battles).
1100946.desc2: Soldier 11 is fully prepared, and in better shape than she's ever been.

1100947.name: [Affinity] My BGM is On
1100947.desc: Billy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Roaming Gunslinger]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, he gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Starlight Knight's Maintenance</color> effect. (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100947,1,2} more battles).
1100947.desc2: Billy hums the theme song to Starlight Knights while confidently declaring "Nobody can beat me while my BGM is on!" Clearly... he's in high spirits.

1100948.name: [Affinity] Muscle Mayhem
1100948.desc: Anton has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Warm-Up Exercises]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, he gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Industrial Grade Motivation</color> effect. (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100948,1,2} more battles).
1100948.desc2: Anton is in excellent shape, effortlessly moving through chest exercises as if he's powered by endless energy and he's looking for a punching bag to hammer.

1100952.name: [Affinity] Bangboo Give Me Strength
1100952.desc: Grace has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lightning Piercer]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>A Massage for Eous</color> effect (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100952,1,2} more battles).
1100952.desc2: Grace is in fine form. A Bangboo's hug doesn't just relieve exhaustion, it also bring a steady stream of strength.

1100953.name: [Affinity] Hostile Wake-Over
1100953.desc: Ellen has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Arctic Ocean Predator]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Rest Longer To Work Better</color> effect (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100953,1,2} more battles).
1100953.desc2: The bad news is that Ellen did not get a good night's sleep. The good news is that she's now refreshed and eager to clear any obstacles for the next night's quality sleep.

1100959.name: [Affinity] Fighting Style: Mixed Fruit Flavor
1100959.desc: Lighter has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>The Champion</color>. Additionally, gain the <color=#FFAF2C>Declaration of Victory</color> effect.
1100959.desc2: Lighter's fighting style is more elusive than ever: rapid hooks, fierce jabs, brutal straight punches, and... is that a subtle mixed fruit aroma?

1100963.name: [Affinity] Path of Honor
1100963.desc: Seth has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Idealist</color>. Additionally, gain the <color=#FFAF2C>Silver Offensive Line</color> effect.
1100963.desc2: The pain didn't affect Seth's condition. Instead, it raised his spirit. These wounds are his medal of honor as a Public Security officer.

1100964.name: [Affinity] Overlord's Accompaniment
1100964.desc: Caesar has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Spearhead Advance]</color>. Additionally, gain the <color=#FFAF2C>Impact Formation</color> effect.
1100964.desc2: For Caesar, obstacles on the path are irrelevant. As long as she can roll over them, they're not obstacles anymore.

1100965.name: [Affinity] Nitro-Fuel Feast
1100965.desc: Burnice has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Extra at No Additional Charge]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>[Endless Refills] </color>effect.
1100965.desc2: In Burnice's world, solving problems is simple... Gather some good friends from the squad and have a lively Nitro-Fuel Feast together!

1101005.name: Sharpened Perception
1101005.desc: Both enemies and allies gain a CRIT Rate bonus.
1101005.desc2: Time seems to stretch out, everyone's actions slow down, and weak points appear more obvious.

1101006.name: Sharpened Pain
1101006.desc: Both enemies and allies gain a CRIT DMG bonus.
1101006.desc2: The senses grow sharper until they exceed the limits of human endurance. Everything in the world grows brittle, including yourself.

1101007.name: Radicalize
1101007.desc: Both enemies and allies deal more DMG.
1101007.desc2:
You're so absorbed in attacking that no thought is given to any consequence.
It's not that you don't want to — it's just that you can't.

1101008.name: Scabbed Infection
1101008.desc: Enemies gain Anomaly Buildup RES but lose Daze RES.
1101008.desc2: A highly contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but can cause Ether on the skin to multiply and scab over. This strengthens resistance while destroying overall stability.

1101009.name: Hardening Infection
1101009.desc: Enemies gain Daze RES but have their DEF reduced.
1101009.desc2: A highly contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but can cause rapid stiffening and excess rigidity in the limbs. This strengthens resistance to Impact damage but also increases the risk of fractures.

1101010.name: Stress Infection
1101010.desc: Enemy Stun duration is reduced, and Max HP is decreased.
1101010.desc2: A highly contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but greatly boosts motor coordination and reactive functions at a cost to active energy reserves.

1101011.name: Crystal Infection
1101011.desc: Enemy Stun DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced.
1101011.desc2: A highly-contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but causes Ether to crystallize into hard plating. This strengthens resistance to strikes and is also more conductive to elements.

1101101.name: [Freeze] Freezing Gloves
1101101.desc: Triggering Ice Mark additionally increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
1101101.desc2: Other than keeping the wearer's hands warm, they can shoot a cold mist from the fingertips. Just make sure you aren't too close to the target when using this function. You could get frozen right along with them.

1101102.name: [Freeze] Ice Shaver
1101102.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>75%</color>. When <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> is triggered, hitting enemies increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 5s.
1101102.desc2: An old-school ice crusher with a hand crank. Most people see this as less of a daily necessity item and more of a toy.

1101103.name: [Freeze] Ice Maker
1101103.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> for 15s.
1101103.desc2: Work hard turning the handle until you work up a sweat and a thirst. That's when the true value of ice cubes becomes apparent.

1101104.name: [Freeze] Portable Ice Maker
1101104.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>18</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
1101104.desc2: Pour in the water and flip the switch. Then leave the rest to it.

1101105.name: [Freeze] Freezing Spray
1101105.desc: Triggering Ice Mark increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
1101105.desc2: Light and handy, it can reduce fever and relieve pain quickly.

1101106.name: [Freeze] Freezing Gun
1101106.desc: Upon triggering <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, the Agent inflicts additional Daze equal to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of their initial Impact on the target, if the target is not Stunned.
1101106.desc2: This deadly weapon can produce shards of ice and shoot at great distances. Think twice before using it, even in the summer.

1101107.name: [Freeze] Ice Cube Tray
1101107.desc: When an Ultimate hits an enemy and deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>, the Agent gains <color=#2BAD00>48</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
1101107.desc2: A simple and easy-to-use hockey mold. The biggest challenge is how to get the puck out of the mold.

1101108.name: [Freeze] Ice Bag
1101108.desc: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy increases the Agent's DEF by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, stacking up to 4 times.
1101108.desc2: A bag that once held many ice cubes, they've since all melted.

1101109.name: [Freeze] Portable Cooler
1101109.desc2: A must-have item for professional anglers. Besides fish, there are some other strange things inside.

1101110.name: [Freeze] Ice Bucket
1101110.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack grants the Agent <color=#2BAD00>12</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
1101110.desc2: An ice bucket that only graces the finest of dining tables. Any drink it holds becomes instantly fancy.

1101111.name: [Freeze] Cutie Cold Pack
1101111.desc2: Everyone loves it for its ice-cold touch. It's even popular among cats and dogs.

1101401.name: [Onslaught] Claw Hammer
1101401.desc: Upon triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, the Agent inflicts additional Daze equal to <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> of Max Daze +<color=#2BAD00>150</color> Daze. This effect can only be triggered against each enemy once every 5s.
1101401.desc2: It out may not be that they lack the strength if they can't pull it out, but rather that they fear the pain.

1101402.name: [Onslaught] Utility Knife
1101402.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
1101402.desc2: Pain can creep close in the subtlest of ways...

1101403.name: [Onslaught] Window Breaker
1101403.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack enables the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color> attacks to inflict <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more Daze for 15s.
1101403.desc2: Hopefully, this stuff will always stay behind an intricate little window and will never have to be used.

1101404.name: [Onslaught] Gardening Shears
1101404.desc2: If all you have is a pair of gardening shears, everything looks like a branch out of place.

1101405.name: [Onslaught] Lightweight Wrench
1101405.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
1101405.desc2: These little, lightweight tools are also used as a juggling prop or makeshift throwing weapons.

1101406.name: [Onslaught] Steel File
1101406.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist increases the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> for 15s.
1101406.desc2: The term "grind" beautifully encapsulates the idea of complete and extreme destruction.

1101407.name: [Onslaught] Roller Brush
1101407.desc: Each Standard [Onslaught] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>48%</color>.
1101407.desc2: One can never truly know what a wet, sticky roller brush has just been through.

1101408.name: [Onslaught] Pitchfork
1101408.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 12s.
1101408.desc2: Once you're holding it, the urge to stab something is always irresistible... and that's where the holes in these haystacks come from.

1101409.name: [Onslaught] Lumber Axe
1101409.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for the Agent.
1101409.desc2: Once you've found the best spot for chopping, each blow will become more effortless than the last.

1101410.name: [Onslaught] Steel Handsaw
1101410.desc: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 30s.
1101410.desc2: A saw's serrated shape contributes to only 1% of its overall intimidating presence, while the remaining 99% comes from horror movies.

1101411.name: [Onslaught] Pointed Shovel
1101411.desc2: Many people associate shovels with painful memories of the wooden handle bouncing off their faces when they stepped on it.

1101601.name: [Assist] Gate Breaker
1101601.desc: Vital View triggered by Evasive Assist lasts <color=#2BAD00>7</color>s. Defensive Assist inflicts <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> more Daze.
1101601.desc2: Harnessing the power of inertia, this device can help break through a target's defense. Don't forget to release your grip at the right moment, or else you'll go flying off with it.

1101602.name: [Assist] Hydraulic Buffer
1101602.desc2: During rescue operations, this device will provide a buffer for you and your teammates to make sure you don't collide with each other's bodies... or lips.

1101603.name: [Assist] HF Communicator
1101603.desc2: This device emits loud and clear sound that is perfect for communication with your teammates. Its excellent voice amplification ensures that your voice is always delivered to your teammates... and also your enemies.

1101604.name: [Assist] Ether Reaction Device
1101604.desc: Triggering a Perfect Assist increases all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 10s.
1101604.desc2: This device analyzes the Ether activity of your squad members and adjusts its algorithms accordingly to facilitate Ether integration.

1101605.name: [Assist] Impact Feedback Device
1101605.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Rush.
1101605.desc2: This device can absorb and store a certain amount of impact, that you can then release at precisely the right moment.

1101606.name: [Assist] Dynamic Calibration Device
1101606.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Insight.
1101606.desc2: This device ensures visual calibration while moving quickly. While it can be a real game-changer in combat, it causes great strain on the operator's optic nerves.

1101607.name: [Assist] Holographic Decoy
1101607.desc: Hitting enemies with an Assist Follow-Up increases all squad members' PEN Ratio by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 15s.
1101607.desc2: This device projects illusions in all directions, disrupting its target.

1101608.name: [Assist] Activity Transfer Device
1101608.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
1101608.desc2: This support device, resembling a relay baton, transfers active Ether energy from a target surface to the user.

1101609.name: [Assist] Hand Operated Generator
1101609.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
1101609.desc2: This device converts kinetic energy into electric energy. In short, it generates power as long as you are running.

1101610.name: [Assist] Emergency Enhancement Device
1101610.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 10s.
1101610.desc2: A micro enhancement device that works on the surface of the skin. While its effect is limited and temporary, it's incredibly convenient. All you need to do is attach it to your skin like a plaster, and you're good to go.

1101611.name: [Assist] Backup Shield Generator
1101611.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist grants the Agent a Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> of their Max HP for 10s.
1101611.desc2: A portable shield generator that sacrifices some of its protection for portability. Since it only provides a very limited level of protection, some would even say you get about as much protection as picking up a trash can lid.

1101901.name: [Ether] Scrap Amplifier
1101901.desc: Each point of Anomaly Proficiency increases the Agent's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>0.3%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
1101901.desc2: An operational amplifier regulates the cycling speed of the surrounding Ether. As for the malfunctioning ones... they are typically repurposed into wireless speakers.

1101902.name: [Ether] Rusty W-Engine
1101902.desc2: When your W-Engine completely fails in the Hollow, don't hesitate to use it as a disposable throwing weapon.

1101903.name: [Ether] Net Launcher
1101903.desc: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> more DMG to <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies.
1101903.desc2: This device launches a special Etheric grid that temporarily reduces the Ether activity of Ethereals upon contact.

1101904.name: [Ether] Cracked Drive
1101904.desc2: A drive disc covered in cracks. Playing it despite the cracks will only produce stress-inducing noises.

1101905.name: [Ether] Suppressive Bracelet
1101905.desc: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Activity to all squad members.
1101905.desc2:
"Ah! This bracelet just won't stop sending me alerts! It's so annoying!"
"Just take it off. See? Problem solved."

1101906.name: [Ether] Deteriorating Filter
1101906.desc: Dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stack of Activity. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>8s</color>.
1101906.desc2: Once a trendy accessory popular in New Eridu, it was later banned due to concerns about causing anxiety among the public.

1101907.name: [Ether] Invalid Adapter
1101907.desc: Each Standard [Ether] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>48%</color>.
1101907.desc2: Much like a mobile phone data cable, it connects multiple Bangboo for data connection. However, it also shares another trait with data cables: it's prone to breaking.

1101908.name: [Ether] Frozen Timer
1101908.desc2: A device used to calculate the recommended exploration duration within the Hollows. The readings are frozen at the moment of its destruction.

1101909.name: [Ether] Depleted Battery
1101909.desc: Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1101909.desc2: A discarded battery, its power depleted, possibly discarded by a Bangboo with a backup battery module.

1101910.name: [Ether] Broken Chip
1101910.desc: Launching a Chain Attack increases all squad members' Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>35</color> for 15s.
1101910.desc2: A discarded broken Bangboo core chip, with its owner nowhere to be found.

1101911.name: [Ether] Faulty Jammer
1101911.desc: <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1101911.desc2: A firearm modified by Hollow Raiders using Ether technology—primitive, but highly effective.

1102001.name: Super Homerun
1102001.desc: No more path ahead. You have to leave the Hollow.
1102001.desc2: I wanna, I wanna go home... I don't wanna try anymore!

1102101.name: [Synergy] Feather Cat Wand
1102101.desc: Launching a Bangboo Chain Attack enables the Bangboo to deal <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> more DMG for 30s.
1102101.desc2: A Bangboo-shaped cat teaser that can provoke fierce attacks from cats, provided the user is swift and diligent enough.

1102102.name: [Synergy] Jingling Bell
1102102.desc: Bangboo ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for each Combat Bangboo and Ally Bangboo in your squad.
1102102.desc2:
When your pet presses it, a corresponding voice will ring out, such as "hug me," "feed me," and "play with me"...
The dog at the newsstand on Sixth Street also uses such bells, but the voice is not as sappy.

1102103.name: [Synergy] Roly-Poly Bunny
1102103.desc: Bangboo Active Skill DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
1102103.desc2: Everyone's hands will eventually get sore, so the tumbler always gets back up in the end.

1102104.name: [Synergy] Laser Pointer
1102104.desc: Launching an Active Skill or Bangboo Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>15</color> Energy for the active Agent. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
1102104.desc2: A cute laser pointer, extremely attractive to animals.

1102105.name: [Synergy] Teething Toy
1102105.desc: When a Bangboo hits an enemy, Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to that enemy for 10s.
1102105.desc2: A bone-shaped teething toy that will help keep your dog's teeth clean and sharp.

1102106.name: [Synergy] Dog Frisbee
1102106.desc: When an Agent launches an EX Special Attack, Bangboo CRIT Rate is increased by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 10s.
1102106.desc2: Catching a Frisbee in mid-air is always an impressive feat, no matter who or what catches it.

1102107.name: [Synergy] Goldfish Hideout
1102107.desc: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
1102107.desc2: Hide in the little house underwater, and the fish can avoid that bossy round face outside.

1102108.name: [Synergy] Wave Cat Scratcher
1102108.desc2: Thank you, for saving the couch from unbearable pain.

1102109.name: [Synergy] Dash Tunnel
1102109.desc2: It takes hours to wiggle and prepare, and the dash lasts only 1 second.

1102110.name: [Synergy] Insane Running Wheel
1102110.desc: Bangboo Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
1102110.desc2: A hamster decides to give the wheel a spin, and soon finds itself on an uncontrollable crazy ride!

1102111.name: [Synergy] Happy Merry-Go-Round
1102111.desc2: This toy is designed for three cats to play together. The ideal scenario is one cat monopolizing all three balls, while the worst-case scenario is none of the cats showing any interest.

1102201.name: [Research] Overload Distribution
1102201.desc: Each Pressure Overload restores <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> of Max HP and increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>. (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:StressOverloadCount,0.01,2}%. Maximum: 50%.) In addition, grants <color=#FFAF2C>Pressure Management</color>.
1102201.desc2:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on overload-related matters.

1102202.name: [Research] Resource Conversion
1102202.desc: Every 100 Gear Coins spent increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>0.5%.</color> (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:DamageShow,0.1,2}%. Maximum: 50%.) In addition, grants <color=#FFAF2C>Matthew Effect</color>.
1102202.desc2:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on resource conversion-related matters.

1102203.name: [Research] Trigger Instinct
1102203.desc: For every 1% of HP lost, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color>. (Current increase: Please see Resonium Details. Maximum increase: 80%) In addition, grants <color=#FFAF2C>Peak Physique</color>.
1102203.desc2:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on survival instinct-related matters.

1102401.name: [Tenacity] Guiding Lantern
1102401.desc: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> more CRIT DMG.
1102401.desc2: Guides the way to hope while signaling to the hunters lurking in the shadows.

1102402.name: [Tenacity] Medical Kit
1102402.desc: When an Agent is attacked, the DMG is <color=#2BAD00>shared between all squad members</color>, and the DMG is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>. When any off-field Agent has less than 10% HP, they will share DMG but not lose HP.
1102402.desc2: From large items like first-aid supplies to small items like cold medications, it all fits inside.

1102403.name: [Tenacity] Flames of Survival
1102403.desc: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> more DMG.
1102403.desc2: In the depths of despair, only the light of the flame can restore one's reason and confidence.

1102404.name: [Tenacity] Cut-Resistant Gloves
1102404.desc: Triggering Perfect Assist or gaining a Shield increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 20s.
1102404.desc2: Only the hardest gloves can handle the sharpest blades.

1102405.name: [Tenacity] Military Canteen
1102405.desc: Triggering an Ultimate grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> of their lost HP.
1102405.desc2: A canteen with dual filtration. It not only filters outdoor freshwater into drinkable water but also reduces the risk of consuming Ether from water sources in the Hollow.

1102406.name: [Tenacity] Toothpick-sized Can
1102406.desc: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 30%, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>80%</color> for 20s. This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.
1102406.desc2: Each bite was hard to swallow, but every one of them kept hunger at bay.

1102407.name: [Tenacity] High-Pressure Insulated Boots
1102407.desc:
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to enemies with a higher percentage HP.
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG to enemies with a lower percentage HP.
1102407.desc2: Extra-thick at the bottom for enhanced protection and kicking power.

1102408.name: [Tenacity] Wilderness Map
1102408.desc: When an Agent is attacked or triggers Perfect Assist, the Agent restores <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy. This can be triggered once every 7s across all squad members.
1102408.desc2: The red crosses marked as "no entry" on the map were all earned through pain.

1102409.name: [Tenacity] Survival Kit
1102409.desc: Upon entering combat, the Agent gains Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of lost HP.
1102409.desc2: All preparations are made to survive.

1102410.name: [Tenacity] Emergency Flashlight
1102410.desc:
When the Agent's HP is below 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
When HP is above 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>.
1102410.desc2: An adjustable brightness flashlight. Save the battery by keeping it dim unless it's an emergency.

1102411.name: [Tenacity] Insulated Sleeping Bag
1102411.desc2: An exceptionally warm sleeping bag. No need to worry about oversleeping. When it gets too hot, you'll naturally crawl out.

1106001.name: Metabolic Trauma
1106001.desc: You can no longer recover HP.
1106001.desc2: Upon touching the crystal, a peculiar Ether matter corrodes your body, hindering its internal mechanisms and destroying its recovery processes. No amount of potions or medicine has any effect.

1106002.name: Gear Allergy
1106002.desc: You can no longer obtain Gear Coins.
1106002.desc2: Upon touching the crystal, your body reacts strongly to certain metal components, and unfortunately, Gear Coins also trigger this allergic reaction.

1106003.name: Delirium
1106003.desc2: Due to the influence of the active crystal, you start to experience symptoms that affect your mental state, such as hallucinations and disorientation. Having to explore the Hollow under such circumstances puts you under even more pressure...

1110002.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Healing Hands</color>
1110002.desc: HP <color=#2BAD00>+2</color> when the protagonist defeats an enemy with an attack

1110004.name: <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT Enhancement</color>
1110004.desc: When the Protagonist attacks enemies, there's a <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> chance to trigger a critical hit, dealing double DMG

1110007.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Explosion Expert</color>
1110007.desc: Bombs deal <color=#2BAD00>+10</color> DMG to enemies, explosion length <color=#2BAD00>+2</color>

1110009.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Detonate and Dominate</color>
1110009.desc: Bombs will <color=#FFAF2C>explode immediately</color>. Protagonist ATK <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> when detonating a bomb

1110010.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Blast Suit</color>
1110010.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Take no DMG from detonations, instead recovering 5 HP</color>

1110011.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Legacy Inheritance</color>
1110011.desc: When taking DMG, generate 1 – 2 <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coin Tiles of 50 coins</color>.

1110012.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Shop Revamp</color>
1110012.desc: Shopkeeper ATK <color=#FFAF2C>+20</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>number of items for sale is doubled</color> in the shop

1110013.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Windfall</color>
1110013.desc: Automatically <color=#FFAF2C>spend HP to purchase</color> items upon running out of coins, for <color=#CF4029>1</color> HP per 50 coins

1110014.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Path to Wealth</color>
1110014.desc: Immediately generates a large number of <color=#2BAD00>items for sale</color> and <color=#2BAD00>coins</color>

1110015.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Cash Conversion</color>
1110015.desc: 20% chance when picking up Gear Coins: Protagonist ATK <color=#2BAD00>+1</color>

1110016.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Blessing or Curse I</color>
1110016.desc: Upon stepping on a blank tile for the first time, 40% chance to <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> HP

1110017.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Blessing or Curse II</color>
1110017.desc: EXP <color=#2BAD00>+5</color> when the protagonist attacks, but starting from the next level, enemy HP <color=#CF4029>+10</color>

1110018.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Blessing or Curse III</color>
1110018.desc: EXP <color=#2BAD00>+20</color> when exchanging supplies with autonomous robot, but starting from the next level, enemy ATK <color=#CF4029>+8</color>

1110019.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Blessing or Curse IV</color>
1110019.desc: EXP <color=#2BAD00>+40</color> upon killing a monster, but starting from the next level, enemy HP <color=#CF4029>+20</color>

1110022.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Legend Reborn I</color>
1110022.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Mysterious equipment</color> marked in yellow and surrounded by enemies appears on the floor

1110023.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Legend Reborn II</color>
1110023.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Mysterious equipment</color> marked in yellow and surrounded by thorns appears on the floor

1110024.name: <color=#FFAF2C>Legend Reborn III</color>
1110024.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Mysterious equipment</color> marked in yellow and waiting to be pulled out appears on the floor

1200001.name: Key
1200001.desc: Allows you to open certain closed gates.
1200001.desc2: Did someone lose this? Let's look for the keyhole that fits it!

1200002.name: Resonium Converter
1200002.desc: Adjust your approach to collecting Resonia by choosing from a new set of Resonia.
1200002.desc2: This device, resembling a Resonium collection box, analyzes Ether matter attached to Resonia and destabilizes it, converting Resonia into random new ones.

1200003.name: Notes
1200003.desc: A notebook with info recorded inside. You can check the exact content.
1200003.desc2: What messy handwriting. Probably not my work.

1200010.name: Ether Fuel Cells
1200010.desc: Canned fuel that can power generators.

1200011.name: Gentleman With a Bangboo
1200011.desc: A lifelike portrait. The fine brushstrokes reveal the artist's masterful painting skills.
1200011.desc2:
This is one of the portrait series painted by the renowned artist Kinston Bird for the two founders of the Ballet Twins. There's a line of small text on the back:
"No Bangboo were harmed during the painting process."

1200015.name: Navigation Data
1200015.desc: Consuming Navigation Data times allows you to reset the map navigation.

1200016.name: HP
1200016.desc: HP can be spent to acquire items through illicit transactions.
1200016.desc2: This device, resembling a Resonium collection box, analyzes Ether matter attached to Resonia and destabilizes it, converting Resonia into random new ones.

1310001.name: TarotCard_name_S2test_1310001
1310001.desc: Triggering a critical hit increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 3s.
1310001.desc2: Regular soldiers should get out of the way!

1310101.name: [Ultimate] Echoing Zither
1310101.desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the Agent has a 50% chance to <color=#2BAD00>recover 15% of Decibels consumed</color>.

1310102.name: [Ultimate] Charging Drum
1310102.desc: When a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains 300 additional Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

1310103.name: [Ultimate] Repeating Synth
1310103.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, <color=#2BAD00>it deals DMG equal to 2,500% of the Agent's ATK</color> to the target. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

1310104.name: [Ultimate] Heavy Drum Sticks
1310104.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG is <color=#2BAD00>increased by 20%</color>. When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 10%</color> for 15s.

1310105.name: [Ultimate] Endless Flute
1310105.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, <color=#2BAD00>it deals DMG over time equal to 20% of the Agent's ATK</color> per second to the target for 10s.

1310106.name: [Ultimate] Remedial Harp
1310106.desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, if the Agent has a shield, <color=#2BAD00>they recover 5% HP</color>. If not, <color=#2BAD00>they gain a shield equal to 15% of their Max HP</color> for 7s.

1310201.name: [Dexterity] Advanced Chassis
1310201.desc: The Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains an extra dodge</color>. Their <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 300</color> for 5s when a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> is triggered.

1310202.name: [Dexterity] Safety Airbag
1310202.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> <color=#2BAD00>deals 20% more DMG and inflicts 20% more Daze</color>. When an Agent triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, they <color=#2BAD00>gain a shield equal to 10% Max HP</color>.

1310203.name: [Dexterity] Sensitive Gear
1310203.desc: When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Impact is increased by 5%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1310204.name: [Dexterity] Smart Buffer
1310204.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains a shield equal to 5% of their Max HP</color> for 10s. While the shield is active, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>deals 10% more DMG</color>.

1310205.name: [Dexterity] Protective Safety Belt
1310205.desc: The Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>10% less DMG</color>. When shielded, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Energy Regen is increased by 10%</color>.

1310206.name: [Dexterity] Efficient Bumper
1310206.desc: When launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color>, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG is increased by 15%</color> for 15s.

1310301.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Universal Catalyst
1310301.desc: When Stunning or inflicting Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 8%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 15</color> for 20s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1310302.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Shattered Test Tube
1310302.desc: When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier is increased by 25%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt to the target due to Attribute Anomaly is increased by 25%</color> for 10s.

1310303.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Growth Culture Medium
1310303.desc: When an enemy is hit, <color=#2BAD00>Daze is increased by 15%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup is increased by 15%</color>.

1310304.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Research Microscope
1310304.desc: All squad members' <color=#2BAD00>Impact is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 10</color>.

1310305.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Chaos Measuring Beaker
1310305.desc: When Stunning or inflicting Disorder on an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>recovers 2.5% HP</color>, <color=#2BAD00>10 Energy</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>an additional 100 Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

1310306.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Compound Stimulant
1310306.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>deals 15% increased DMG</color> and Attribute Anomaly <color=#2BAD00>deals 15% increased DMG</color>.

1310401.name: [Adversity] Powerful Dialysis Machine
1310401.desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 Energy</color> while <color=#CF4029>consuming 20% of current HP</color>. For every 100 HP consumed, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt is increased by 1%</color> for 10s.

1310403.name: [Adversity] Emergency Partition
1310403.desc: When losing HP, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt by the Agent is increased by 20%</color>, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 10%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level is increased</color>, lasting for 10s and triggering once every 20s.

1310404.name: [Adversity] Dual Injection Needle
1310404.desc: DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> is <color=#2BAD00>increased by 15%</color>. When the skill hits an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>recovers 5% HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

1310405.name: [Adversity] Targeted Antibodies
1310405.desc: When attacking enemies with a higher HP percentage than the Agent, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup is increased by 10%</color>.

1310406.name: [Adversity] Pain-Killer Hormones
1310406.desc: When losing HP, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>ATK is increased by 10%</color> for 10s. When recovering HP, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 10%</color> for 10s.

1310501.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Endless Blizzard
1310501.desc: After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi's next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will not consume energy and <color=#2BAD00>deals 50% increased DMG</color> to enemies with an Attribute Anomaly. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

1310502.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Unbreakable Ice
1310502.desc: Enemies afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> <color=#2BAD00>take <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to 50% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK each second</color>. Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi can bypass the restrictions of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to enemies</color>.

1310503.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Snow Debris
1310503.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Lingering Snow</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi gains 6 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. While performing <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi <color=#2BAD00>gains 70/140/210 Decibels</color> based on the charge level of the attack.

1310601.name: [Billy] Overwhelming Firepower
1310601.desc: When Billy <color=#FFFFFF>lands 20 hits on enemies with Basic Attack: Full Firepower</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>5 hits with Basic Attack: Full Firepower - Modified</color>, the next use of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>will not consume energy</color>, and the skill's <color=#2BAD00>DMG will be increased by 100%</color>.

1310602.name: [Billy] Gunslinger Time
1310602.desc: When Billy hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a debuff is applied to the target, <color=#2BAD00>increasing Billy's DMG dealt to the target by 60%</color> for 10 seconds.

1310603.name: [Billy] Judgment by Eradication
1310603.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, hold Special Attack <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to charge, <color=#2BAD00>increasing the skill's power</color>. The <color=#2BAD00>DMG Multiplier for <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> increases by 200%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>guaranteeing a critical hit</color>.

1310701.name: [Ellen] Blizzard Trim
1310701.desc: With<color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>, the third move of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming</color> replaces <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Cold Snap</color>. During this skill , gain a <color=#2BAD00>shield equal to 20% of Max HP</color>. While Ellen has this shield, her <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level increases</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>DMG taken is reduced by 60%</color>. Activating <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Reef Rock</color> grants Ellen 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>.

1310702.name: [Ellen] Everwinter Windtrace
1310702.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Ellen <color=#2BAD00>leaves behind a patch of Icy Mist</color> on the ground, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG over time</color> to enemies and reducing their <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> by 30% for 10 seconds. When Ellen attacks an enemy within the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> will trigger an extra instance of DMG.

1310703.name: [Ellen] Blood-Seeking Fangs
1310703.desc: With <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Fin</color>, applying a <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> mark to an enemy <color=#2BAD00>increases Ellen's DMG by 15%</color>, lasting for 15s. When a marked target is defeated, the current <color=#2BAD00>DMG buff gets an additional increase of5%</color>, with a maximum additional increase of 150%.

1310801.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Moon Across the Sky
1310801.desc: After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> three times, Tsukishiro Yanagi's <color=#2BAD00>next Chain Attack will be replaced with an Ultimate</color>.

1310802.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Flowing Change
1310802.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tsukuyomi Kagura</color>, Tsukishiro Yanagi can <color=#2BAD00>interrupt the current action at any time</color> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Ruten</color>.

1310803.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Moonlight Illusion
1310803.desc: When Tsukishiro Yanagi's attack hits an enemy and triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, the target's <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES is reduced by 16%</color>, lasting for 8 seconds.

1310901.name: [General] Lucky Stars
1310901.desc: Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases the Agent's DMG by 5%</color> for 30s, stacking up to 5 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1310903.name: [General] Energy Restorer MKII
1310903.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 15%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze inflicted increases by 10%</color>.

1310904.name: [General] Water Gun
1310904.desc: Landing a critical hit <color=#2BAD00>increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by 3%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1310905.name: [General] Bubble Gun
1310905.desc: Landing a critical hit <color=#2BAD00>increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by 15%</color> for 3s.

1310906.name: [General] Like & Subscribe Gun
1310906.desc: Each non-critical hit <color=#2BAD00>increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by 6%</color>. This effect is reset after the Agent triggers a critical hit.

1310907.name: [General] Falling Starsea Armor
1310907.desc: Hitting an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>generates a Shield equal to 10% of the Agent's Max HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

1310908.name: [General] Ultra Sacred Sword of Radiance
1310908.desc: Shielded Agents <color=#2BAD00>deal 30% more DMG</color> to enemies within 6m.

1310909.name: [General] BUG Shield
1310909.desc: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 25%, <color=#2BAD00>a shield that is equal to 15% of Max HP</color> is generated for 10s. (This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent per combat encounter.)

1310911.name: [General] Three Glass Marbles
1310911.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases the duration that enemies are stunned for by 15%</color>.

1310912.name: [General] Tri-End Toy Stethoscope
1310912.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases Daze inflicted by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> by 15%</color>.

1310913.name: [General] Bomb Difuser
1310913.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> triggered by <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 5s longer</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>inflicts 30% more Daze</color>.

1310914.name: [General] Demolition Hammer
1310914.desc: Triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 25%</color> for 10s.

1310915.name: [General] Hammer Drill
1310915.desc: Triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 20%</color> for 10s.

1310916.name: [General] Untitled Book
1310916.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 30%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze inflicted increases by 15%</color>.

1310917.name: [General] Secret File
1310917.desc: When attacked, quickly press Dodge to <color=#2BAD00>immediately break free</color> and <color=#2BAD00>recover 50% of the DMG taken as HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>4</color>s.

1310918.name: [General] General File
1310918.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is <color=#2BAD00>easier</color> to trigger, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG is increased by 15%</color>.

1310919.name: [General] Sword Catalog
1310919.desc: Agents <color=#2BAD00>deal 25% more DMG</color> but also <color=#CF4029>take 15% more DMG</color>.

1310920.name: [General] Insect Catalog
1310920.desc: Attacks against enemies with less than 50% HP <color=#2BAD00>deal 15% more DMG</color>.

1310921.name: [General] Plant Catalog
1310921.desc: Off-field Agents with 25% or lower HP <color=#2BAD00>slowly recover HP</color>.

1310922.name: Suction Welding Torch - Healing Sachet
1310922.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#FFAF2C>[Ultimate] Healing Sachet</color> in your collectibles.

1310923.name: Suction Welding Torch - Rhythm Energy Saver
1310923.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#FFAF2C>[Ultimate] Rhythm Energy Saver</color> in your collectibles.

1310924.name: Suction Welding Torch - Talisman of Five Realms
1310924.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#2EB6FF>[Dexterity] Talisman of Five Realms</color> in your collectibles.

1310925.name: Suction Welding Torch - Zone Energy Shield
1310925.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#2EB6FF>[Dexterity] Zone Energy Shield</color> in your collectibles.

1310926.name: Suction Welding Torch - Solvent Launcher
1310926.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#2BAD00>[Anomaly - Stun] Solvent Launcher</color> in your collectibles.

1310927.name: Suction Welding Torch - Essence Pill
1310927.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#2BAD00>[Anomaly - Stun] Essence Pill</color> in your collectibles.

1310928.name: Suction Welding Torch - Combat Nutrient Pack
1310928.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#FF3333>[Adversity] Combat Nutrient Pack</color> in your collectibles.

1310929.name: Suction Welding Torch - Emblem of Calamity
1310929.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#FF3333>[Adversity] Emblem of Calamity</color> in your collectibles.

1310930.name: Suction Welding Torch - Imperial Decree: Dark Banner
1310930.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#FE437E>[Mobile] Imperial Decree: Dark Banner</color> in your collectibles.

1310931.name: Suction Welding Torch - Shatter Blade's Cry
1310931.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of <color=#FE437E>[Mobile] Shatter Blade's Cry</color> in your collectibles.

1310932.name: Suction Welding Torch
1310932.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of corresponding General Gear in your collectibles.

1311001.name: [Mobile] Energy-Saving Vehicle
1311001.desc: When other characters use <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, the active character <color=#2BAD00>recovers 5 Energy and 200 Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s per character.

1311002.name: [Mobile] Mighty Fists
1311002.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> will execute normal enemies and Elite enemies with HP below 15%. When triggered, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 10%</color> for 30s.

1311003.name: [Mobile] Carousel
1311003.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershocks</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 20%, Daze by 15%, and Anomaly Buildup by 30%</color>.

1311004.name: [Mobile] Inflatable Swimming Ring
1311004.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>restores 5% HP</color> for the active character. Each character can trigger this effect once every 15s.

1311005.name: [Mobile] Kids' Lunchbox
1311005.desc: The active character's <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate increases by 10% and Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%</color>.

1311006.name: [Mobile] Hurricane Swing
1311006.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>reduces DEF by 10%</color> for 10s upon hitting an enemy.

1312201.name: Astra Yao - Perfect Save
1312201.desc: DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color> will be <color=#2BAD00>considered as <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG</color>. During this skill, <color=#2BAD00>all squad members' Crit Rate is increased by 18%</color>.

1312202.name: Astra Yao - Scattered Melody
1312202.desc: With enough energy, releasing or following up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state will <color=#2BAD00>additionally deal two instances</color> of identical <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> DMG. When Astra Yao hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, there's a 20% chance to gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Inspiration</color> effect, allowing her next <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> to <color=#2BAD00>directly trigger</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, which can be followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, lasting 10s.

1312203.name: Astra Yao - Aria of the Gentle Wind
1312203.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao's <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level increases</color> and she <color=#2BAD00>takes 20% less DMG</color>. <color=#2BAD00>All squad members' PEN Ratio increases by 15%</color>, and they <color=#2BAD00>gradually recover HP</color>.

1312301.name: Evelyn - Sheathed Blade
1312301.desc: When activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, Evelyn gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Blade</color> effect, increasing <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG by 20%</color>. This effect can stack up to 3 times and lasts for the entire combat.

1312302.name: Evelyn - Binding Arts
1312302.desc: When Evelyn enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 20%</color>, while the target enemy's <color=#2BAD00>ATK decreases by 20%</color>. After exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, Evelyn retains her buff for 10s. Upon exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she detonates the target enemy, <color=#2BAD00>dealing additional</color> <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

1312303.name: Evelyn - Special Energy Drink
1312303.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Evelyn gains 100% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color>.

1312401.name: Jane - Gaming Time
1312401.desc: When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Insight</color>'s <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> CRIT effect, there is a 50% chance to <color=#2BAD00>increase CRIT DMG by an additional 40%</color>.

1312402.name: Jane - Combat Technique
1312402.desc: When hitting an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color> is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.

1312403.name: Jane - Relentless Pursuit
1312403.desc: When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Jane <color=#2BAD00>gains 40 additional Decibels</color>, and her next <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>'s <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 5% </color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG is increased by 20%</color>, stacking up to 5 times.

1312501.name: Corin - Maid's Dainty Steps
1312501.desc: When a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, <color=#2BAD00>recover 25 Energy</color>. Can be triggered once every 6s.

1312502.name: Corin - Unfortunate Laceration
1312502.desc: When Corin hits enemies with Chainsaw extended slashes, she gains 1 stack of Charge. At 10 stacks, the next slash applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Laceration</color> effect on enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equivalent to <color=#2BAD00>20% of Corin's ATK</color> every 3s, stacking up to 10 times and lasts 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1312503.name: Corin - Cursed Tetanus
1312503.desc: When hitting enemies with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color> is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 15s.

1319901.name: Geppetto - Stable Restraint
1319901.desc: For every 100 Gear Coins owned, gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color> and Energy Generation Rate by <color=#2BAD00>0.5%</color> when dealing DMG to Geppetto.

1319902.name: Geppetto - Blood for Blood
1319902.desc: When Geppetto becomes Impaired, all squad members recover <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> HP.

1319903.name: Geppetto - Melee Thrust
1319903.desc: Increase DMG dealt to Geppetto by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> and reduce DMG received from Geppetto by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.

1319904.name: Geppetto - Moment of Judgment
1319904.desc: When Geppetto becomes Impaired, its DEF drops by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>, stacking up to 2 times.

1319905.name: Geppetto - Execution Order
1319905.desc: When Suspended is removed, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>300</color> Decibels, and the next <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG of each Agent is increased by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.

1320001.name: Relic_name_S2test_1320001
1320001.desc: Triggering Perfect Dodge generates 6 Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10s</color>.
1320001.desc2: This orange juice is popular among girls. Each can packs the nutritional punch of thirty oranges. "We carefully choose only the finest oranges. One of ours is as good as ten of another kind. That means with just three oranges, you're getting the nutrients of thirty!"

1320101.name: [Ultimate] Healing Sachet
1320101.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Decibels limit is increased to 6,000</color> for all squad members.

1320102.name: [Ultimate] Rhythmic Energy Saver
1320102.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Reduces the Decibels required to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to 2,000</color>.

1320103.name: Relic_1320103_name
1320103.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Decibels limit is increased to 6,000</color> for all squad members.

1320201.name: [Dexterity] Talisman of Five Realms
1320201.desc: When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>gain 1 Dexterity Count</color>, stacking up to 3 times. With 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Count</color>, consume all stacks to <color=#2BAD00>enter Dexterity State</color>, lasting 9s. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>ATK is increased by 60%</color>. When an attack hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> on the target. <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> is calculated when exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, dealing <color=#2BAD00>additional DMG equal to 10% of DMG accumulated</color> during <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> to enemies.

1320202.name: [Dexterity] Zone Energy Shield
1320202.desc: When in combat, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>gain 1 Dexterity Charge</color> (up to 32) every 0.5s. When taking DMG and losing HP, all <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Charge</color> will be consumed. When Dexterity Charge consumed is greater or equal to 8/16/24, <color=#2BAD00>Dexterity State</color> will last for 2/4/8s. With 32 <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Charge</color>, all Charge is consumed when an enemy is hit, <color=#2BAD00>entering Dexterity State</color> for 16s. In <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>ATK is increased by 60%</color>. When an attack hits an enemy, <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> is inflicted on the target. <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> is calculated when exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, dealing <color=#2BAD00>additional DMG to enemies equal to 10% of DMG accumulated</color> during <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color>.

1320301.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Solvent Launcher
1320301.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Daze caused by all squad members is increased by 10%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 30</color>. When Stunning or inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies, triggers an additional strike, <color=#2BAD00>dealing DMG equal to 1,100% of the Agent's ATK</color> to the target and the surrounding enemies.

1320302.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Essence Pill
1320302.desc: When Stunning or inflicting <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> on an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>randomly draws 3 to 6 times from the following 6 buffs</color>, with each buff stacking up to 6 times: Energy Regen increased by 0.02 pts/s, DEF increased by 4%, DMG taken reduced by 2%, Impact increased by 2%, Anomaly Proficiency increased by 3, and Decibel Generation Rate increased by 3%.

1320401.name: [Adversity] Combat Nutrient Pack
1320401.desc: When an attack hits an enemy, the Agent enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Bloodfury</color> state for 2s. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Bloodfury</color> state, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>deals 75% increased DMG</color> and <color=#2BAD00>takes 10% reduced DMG</color>. <color=#CF4029>1% of the Agent's HP is consumed per sec</color> when their current HP is higher than 20%.

1320403.name: [Adversity] Emblem of Calamity
1320403.desc: When the Agent's HP drops from above 20% to below 20%, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains a shield equal to 20% of their Max HP</color>.

1320501.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Awakening of the Bees
1320501.desc: Replaces <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Fuyubachi</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Fuyubachi — Maximum</color>. Upon activating this skill, Hoshimi Miyabi will <color=#2BAD00>dash forward</color> and deal <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> to enemies. After the skill is replaced, when Hoshimi Miyabi is knocked back or launched, using Basic Attack or Special Attack while a target is staggered will <color=#2BAD00>immediately trigger</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Fuyubachi — Maximum</color>, <color=#2BAD00>restoring 70% of the DMG she just received in HP and granting invulnerability for 0.5s</color>.

1320502.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Dance of the Sparrows
1320502.desc: When Hoshimi Miyabi is attacked by an enemy, she will <color=#2BAD00>automatically dodge the attack</color>, triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> lasts for 3s. The automatic dodge effect can trigger once every 12s. When the effect is triggered, Hoshimi Miyabi's <color=#2BAD00>DMG is increased by 80%</color>, lasting for 20s.

1320503.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Sparrows in the Flowers
1320503.desc: After Hoshimi Miyabi activates <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Kan Suzume</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Dancing Petals</color>, she will <color=#2BAD00>automatically chain into the ALT</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Storm</color>, <color=#2BAD00>unleashing a blast of air to attack nearby enemies and inflicting a substantial amount of Daze</color>. When the enemy is Stunned, Hoshimi Miyabi gains 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, and the target's <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier is increased by 75%</color>.

1320601.name: [Billy] Explosive Bullets
1320601.desc: Replaces <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full Firepower</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full Firepower - Modified</color>. This <color=#2BAD00>decreases the rate of fire to increase bullet power</color>. Upon activating this skill, Billy will <color=#2BAD00>directly enter Crouching Shot</color>, triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Steady Shot</color> and <color=#2BAD00>increasing his DMG dealt by an additional 50%</color>. The buff will end when he moves, returns to idle, or is knocked back or launched.

1320602.name: [Billy] Rotating Drivetrain
1320602.desc: When Billy uses his <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, he <color=#2BAD00>gains 2/2/4/4 stacks of Charge</color> (up to 4 stacks). When Billy performs a piercing attack in a large area around him during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Sanction</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>consume 1 stack of Charge</color> and trigger the skill repeatedly, <color=#2BAD00>increasing its DMG by 150%</color>. When the effect is triggered, Billy's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate increases by 20%</color> for 10s. The effect stacks up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1320603.name: [Billy] Mysterious Transmorpher
1320603.desc: When Billy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Crouching Shot</color> during his Basic Attack, he triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Steady Shot</color>. After maintaining the buff for 1.5 seconds, he enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Descent</color> state, during which his attacks <color=#2BAD00>ignore 50%</color> of the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. Additionally, he <color=#2BAD00>continuously generates Decibels</color>, <color=#2BAD00>starting at 20 points/second and gradually increasing to 50 points/second</color>, reaching the maximum after 3 seconds. This effect lasts until he is knocked back or launched.

1320701.name: {AWAKEN_1191#[Ellen] Blade of Frost: Advanced}{NOAWAKEN_1191#[Ellen] Blade of Frost}
1320701.desc: {AWAKEN_1191#<color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> will also automatically activate after the third hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Saw Teeth Trimming</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, dealing multiple hits of <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to enemies in a large area ahead. <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> <color=#2BAD00>reduces DEF by 30%</color> for 15s upon hit. When the additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> is triggered, the skill's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 25%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.}{NOAWAKEN_1191#The 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Reef Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> <color=#2BAD00>trigger an additional Icy Blade</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in a large area in front</color> and <color=#2BAD00>reducing their DEF by 30%</color>. When the additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> is triggered, the skill's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 25%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blades</color> don't affect the original skill's alts.}

1320702.name: [Ellen] Dangerous Bearings
1320702.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color>, Ellen gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Charge</color> every 0.5 sec. When Ellen hits an enemy with Swift Scissors or Charged Scissor Strike during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>leaves an Icy Mist on the ground</color>, which deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG over time</color> to enemies and <color=#98EFF0>reduces their Ice RES</color> by 30% for 10s. Ellen's <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt level increases</color> and she <color=#2BAD00>gains 50% DMG reduction</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. This effect continues for 5s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>.

1320703.name: [Ellen] Hunter's Fin
1320703.desc: Every 15s, Ellen applies a <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> mark that lasts for 15s to a random enemy. When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or Swift Scissors/Charged Scissor Strike during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, using Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or Special Attack <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again allows Ellen to <color=#2BAD00>consume nothing</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately trigger the skill again</color> with <color=#2BAD00>its CRIT DMG increased by 25%</color>. If the target is defeated, Ellen will instantly apply a <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> mark to the next enemy. When she has <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>, each extra point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases Ellen's ATK by 5%</color>. This effect lasts for 10s and stacks up to 9 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1320801.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Soaring Moonlight
1320801.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color>, after performing a quick thrust, Tsukishiro Yanagi hovers in midair, <color=#2BAD00>continuously channeling thunderbolt strikes into the ground</color>, and dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Tsukishiro Yanagi triggers the downward smash from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color> by releasing or pressing Special Attack <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again, or when the duration limit is reached. When her thunderbolt strikes hit enemies, it <color=#2BAD00>increases the Disorder DMG they take by 3%</color>, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color>'s heavy attack hits enemies, Tsukishiro Yanagi gains shield equal to 20% of her Max HP, lasting 20s, triggering up to once per 20s.

1320802.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Kagura's Dance
1320802.desc: While triggering the fifth move of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> stance or triggering the fourth move of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color> stance, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>extend the skill duration</color>, slash continuously, and increase <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> dealt by Tsukishiro Yanagi by 4%, stacking up to 15 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. During consecutive slashes, DMG taken by Tsukishiro Yanagi is <color=#2BAD00>reduced by 40%</color>, and after triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, pressing Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <color=#2BAD00>transitions to continuous slashes of the alternate stance</color>.

1320803.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Flowing Reflection
1320803.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Ruten</color>, Tsukishiro Yanagi <color=#2BAD00>gains 1 Charge</color> (max. 3 stacks). Upon reaching 3 Charges and triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>consume all Charges</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with Chain Attack: Celestial Harmony</color>. If an enemy attack is successfully parried during <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, following up with <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Celestial Harmony</color> <color=#2BAD00>will not consume any Charge</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Celestial Harmony</color>'s DMG will increase by 50%.

1321001.name: [Mobile] Imperial Decree: Dark Banner
1321001.desc: When the active character lands a heavy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> for the next character. Press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> at this moment, and the next character will perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> centered on the enemy. <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> won't switch the current active character, and the damage dealt is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG. When a character performs a <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, it provides 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Comrade</color> to the whole squad, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Comrade</color> increases <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency by 20</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate by 10%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>Impact by 4%</color> for Stun specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate by 5%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG by 10%</color> for Attack specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate by 7.5%</color> for Support specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>shield efficiency by 10%</color> for Defense specialty Agents; and increases <color=#2BAD00>Sheer DMG by 7%</color> for Rupture specialty Agents.

1321002.name: [Mobile] Shatter Blade's Cry
1321002.desc: When the active character lands a heavy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> for the next character. Press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> at this moment, and the next character will perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> centered on the enemy. <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> won't switch the current active character and the damage dealt is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG. <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>200% increased DMG, 50% increased Daze, and 100% increased Anomaly Buildup</color>. After the squad performs 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assists</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.

1322201.name: Astra Yao - Radiant Moment
1322201.desc: For every 25 Energy consumed, Astra Yao gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, up to 3 stacks. During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>, continuously channeling an energy beam to attack enemies. Upon activating this skill, <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> will be consumed, with each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> <color=#2BAD00>extending the skill duration by 1s</color>. During this skill, <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level is increased</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>DMG taken is further reduced by 20%</color>. When the skill hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>target's DEF is reduced by 40%</color>. After gaining 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, switching back to Astra Yao will automatically trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>.

1322202.name: Astra Yao - Hollow Symphony
1322202.desc: For every 25 Energy consumed, Astra Yao gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> by 15% when released and additionally released while she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state</color>. Holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Finale</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color> consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases the attack's DMG</color> by 15% and <color=#2BAD00>restores 4 Energy</color> to Astra Yao. When Astra Yao hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color>, an additional 25 Energy will be consumed. When hitting enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, <color=#2BAD00>an additional 4 Energy will be restored</color>.

1322203.name: Astra Yao - Harmonic Echo
1322203.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color>, <color=#2BAD00>increases CRIT Rate of all squad members by 20%</color>. When CRIT Rate reaches 100%, each 1% over 100% will <color=#2BAD00>increase CRIT DMG by 2%</color>, up to 100%. When the active character hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Astra Yao will <color=#2BAD00>recover 1 Energy</color> and <color=#2BAD00>launch an additional <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1s.

1322301.name: Evelyn - Low-Combustion Coating
1322301.desc: When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the attack's DMG increases by 80%</color>.

1322302.name: Evelyn - Portable Detonator
1322302.desc: When Evelyn exits <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ignite Preparation</color> for 20s, during which the next <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush</color> will be replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color> <color=#2BAD00>is considered a Chain Attack</color>. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote</color>, <color=#2BAD00>she will exit Binding Seal</color>.

1322303.name: Evelyn - Ultimate Contingency Protocol
1322303.desc: When Evelyn is about to be staggered by a frontal attack, she will consume <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> to <color=#2BAD00>automatically trigger Defensive Assist</color>, blocking enemy attacks and enabling an ALT <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Course Disruption</color>. When Evelyn activates <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 50%</color>, stacking up to 2 times for 20 seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1322401.name: Jane - Phantom Armor
1322401.desc: Significantly increases the <color=#2BAD00>sustained attack duration</color> of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>. Triggering a Finishing Move when about to be attacked activates <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>. When the sustained attack duration reaches maximum or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered by a Finishing Move, the Finishing Move will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>Salchow Jump: Airborne</color>. When this skill is activated, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> is <color=#2BAD00>increased by 50%</color> for 10s.

1322402.name: Jane - Boiling Predatory Instinct
1322402.desc: When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> is <color=#2BAD00>greatly increased</color>, replacing the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state with the <color=#FFFFFF>Overload Passion</color> state.
