In this state, Jane's <color=#2BAD00>ATK is additionally increased by 35%</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> will automatically decrease over time, and hitting enemies with attacks <color=#2BAD00>no longer consumes</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.

1322403.name: Jane - Venomous Edge
1322403.desc: During the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Overload Passion</color> state, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep-Onslaught</color>. When using this skill, Jane will re-enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Overload Passion</color> state. When this skill hits enemies, the target's <color=#2BAD00>All Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 40%</color> for 15s.

1322501.name: Corin - Chainsaw Operation Manual
1322501.desc: Replace <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy!</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified</color>. Hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to maintain sprint mode, ending when the chainsaw has continuously slashed enemies 30 times or when the button is released.

1322502.name: Corin - Overload Driver
1322502.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, holding <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to continuously slash enemies for over 0.5 seconds will trigger the <color=#FFFFFF>Overclock State</color>, <color=#2BAD00>continuously gathering enemies</color>. When the attack hits enemies 10 times, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Overclock Overload</color>, <color=#2BAD00>additionally dealing one instance of</color> <color=#ELEMENT_PHYSiCS>Physical DMG</color> <color=#2BAD00>equivalent to 400% of Corin's ATK</color>.

1322503.name: Corin - Blasting Blowers
1322503.desc: During the 1st, 2nd and 3rd hits of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>directly trigger the 4th hit of the Basic Attack</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>unleash a high-speed swirling slash towards enemies in front</color>.

1330001.name: Artifact_name_S2test_1330001
1330001.desc2: Smart ignition and precision blasts. How far it explodes all depends on how far you throw it.

1330101.name: Uproar of Decibels
1330101.desc: All squad members' <color=#CF4029>Energy Generation Rate is reduced by 15%</color>, while <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate is increased by 25%</color>.

1330201.name: Overlocked Dexterity Mode

1342501.name: "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun
1342501.desc:
A machine gun can be implanted on Tully's chest, firing out <color=#E48600>powerful projectiles</color>, but with a <color=#E48600>limited magazine capacity</color>. After firing all bullets in the magazine, it will <color=#E48600>reload</color>, and once reloaded can <color=#E48600>continue attacking</color>.

With each <color=#E48600>reload</color>, Tully will load projectiles corresponding to an attribute type of a randomly selected Agent in the squad.

Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Projectile Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

1342502.name: "Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box
1342502.desc:
Missile pods that can be installed on Tully's shoulders that will launch <color=#E48600>auto-tracking missiles</color> that automatically fire a small number of missiles at intervals during combat.

When an Agent activates their <color=#E48600>EX Special Attack</color>, it will use <color=#E48600>Maximum Firepower</color> to launch a massive missile barrage.

Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Shadow Pursuit Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

1342503.name: "Dreamland Equipment" Glimmering Whiskers
1342503.desc:
Can modify Tully's ears into laser emitters that shoot out <color=#E48600>destructive energy beams</color> from their tips. When enemies suffer an <color=#E48600>Attribute Anomaly</color> or become <color=#E48600>Stunned</color>, it uses <color=#E48600>Enhanced Energy Beam</color> to fire a sustained laser attack. When the energy beam hits an enemy, it applies the Weaken effect, increasing the damage they receive.
Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Sharp Edge Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

1343001.name: Extended Magazine
1343001.desc:
"Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's magazine capacity <color=#FFAF2C>increases by 1 per Rank</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>DMG increases by 20% per Rank</color>.
"Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun will continuously fire bullets until the magazine is empty, then stop firing to reload, and resume firing after reloading.

1343002.name: Alloy Bullet
1343002.desc:
"Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's magazine capacity <color=#FFAF2C>increases by 1 per Rank</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>PEN Ratio increases by 20% per Rank</color>.
"Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun will continuously fire bullets until the magazine is empty, then stop firing to reload, and resume firing after reloading.

1343003.name: Timed Explosives
1343003.desc:
"Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's magazine capacity <color=#FFAF2C>increases by 1 per Rank</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 45% per Rank</color>.
"Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun will continuously fire bullets until the magazine is empty, then stop firing to reload, and resume firing after reloading.

1343004.name: Blast-Proof Goggles
1343004.desc: When hitting an enemy, "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's <color=#FFAF2C>DMG to the target is increased by 0.5% per Rank per 10 stacks</color>, stacking up to 50 times.

1343005.name: Sniper Elite
1343005.desc:
When hitting an enemy, "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT DMG increases by 0.6% per Rank per 10 stacks</color>, stacking up to 50 times.
This effect lasts for 20s, and the duration is refreshed each time the effect stacks.

1343006.name: Silenced Pistol
1343006.desc:
When inflicting an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's <color=#FFAF2C>DMG is increased by 13% per Rank</color> for 10s.
repeated triggers reset the duration.

1343007.name: Flash Suppressor
1343007.desc: "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun and "Dreamland Equipment" Glimmering Whiskers deal <color=#FFAF2C>40% more DMG</color> to enemies suffering an Attribute Anomaly.

1343008.name: Focus Lens
1343008.desc: When "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun hits an enemy, it inflicts Weaken, increasing the enemy's <color=#FFAF2C>Anomaly and Disorder DMG taken by 4% per Rank</color> for 10s.

1343009.name: Tear Gas Grenade
1343009.desc: "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun unlocks an additional barrel, firing <color=#FFAF2C>1 extra bullet</color> with each shot, increasing by 1 per rank, up to 3 bullets.

1343010.name: Scorched Barrel
1343010.desc: After "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun fires 40 shots, "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun unleashes a wave of <color=#FFAF2C>consecutive attacks</color>

1343011.name: Memory Recorder
1343011.desc:
"Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box's <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT DMG increases by 44% per rank</color>, Maximum Firepower <color=#FFAF2C>launches 2 additional missiles</color>, increasing by 2 missiles per Rank.
When an Agent activates an EX Special Attack, Tully will use Maximum Firepower.

1343012.name: Electrifying Ring
1343012.desc:
"Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box's <color=#FFAF2C>PEN Ratio increases by 20% per Rank</color>, and when an Agent activates an EX Special Attack, <color=#FFAF2C>2 additional missiles are fired</color>, increasing by 2 missiles per Rank.
When an Agent activates an EX Special Attack, Tully will use Maximum Firepower.

1343013.name: Wave Conductor

When an Agent activates an EX Special Attack, Tully will use Maximum Firepower.

1343014.name: Starlight Radar
1343014.desc: During <color=#E48600>Maximum Firepower</color>, "Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box has a chance to fire <color=#FFAF2C>enhanced</color> giant missiles with increased explosive range, dealing <color=#FFAF2C>144% more DMG</color>.

1343015.desc: "Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box deals <color=#FFAF2C>26% more DMG per Rank</color> to Stunned enemies.

1343016.name: Particle Mask
1343016.desc:

Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.

1343017.name: Electric Coil Watch
1343017.desc:

The buff lasts 10 seconds, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

1343018.desc: "Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box has a 13% chance to <color=#FFAF2C>fire 1 additional missile</color> with each attack, adding 1 more missile per Rank.

1343019.desc: When "Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box critical hits, "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT Rate increases by 60%</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 50%</color>, lasting 15s.

1343020.name: Galaxy Communicator
1343020.desc:

Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1343021.desc:

1343024.name: Hypnosis Roly-Poly Toy

1350001.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Reflections and Shadows
1350001.desc: When Hoshimi Miyabi is attacked by an enemy, she will <color=#2BAD00>automatically dodge the attack</color>, triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> lasts for 4s. The automatic dodge effect can trigger once every 12s. When the effect is triggered, Hoshimi Miyabi's <color=#2BAD00>DMG is increased by 40%</color>, lasting for 12s.

1350002.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Frost Inferno
1350002.desc: Enemies afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> <color=#2BAD00>take <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to 180% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK each second</color>. Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi can bypass the restrictions of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to enemies</color>.

1350003.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Autumn Rain's Echo
1350003.desc: When a squadmate triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Resolution</color>, stacking up to 3 times. After using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Resolution</color> and trigger 1 instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Blade Pursuit</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Blade Pursuit</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> and can be retriggered by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Resolution</color>.

1350011.name: [Billy] Execution Order
1350011.desc: Replaces <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full Firepower</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full Firepower - Modified</color>. This <color=#2BAD00>decreases the rate of fire to increase bullet power</color>. Upon activating this skill, Billy will <color=#2BAD00>directly enter Crouching Shot</color>, triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Steady Shot</color> and <color=#2BAD00>increasing his DMG dealt by an additional 100%</color>. The buff will end when he moves, returns to idle, or is knocked back or launched.

1350012.name: [Billy] Paintball Round
1350012.desc: When Billy activates <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, he <color=#2BAD00>gains 1/2/2/4 stacks of Charge</color>, stacking up to 4 times. When Billy performs a piercing attack in a large area around him during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Sanction</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>consume 1 stack of Charge</color> and trigger the skill repeatedly. Upon hit <color=#2BAD00>the enemy's DEF is reduced by 4%</color> for 12s, stacking up to 12 times, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350021.name: [Ellen] Arctic Hunt
1350021.desc: Every 15s, Ellen applies a <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> mark that lasts for 15 to a random enemy. When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or Swift Scissors/Charged Scissor Strike from <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, pressing Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or Special Attack <IconMap:Icon_Special> allows Ellen to <color=#2BAD00>immediately trigger the skill again</color> with <color=#2BAD00>no cost or other requirements</color>. When she obtains <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>, each excess point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases Ellen's ATK by 12%</color>. This effect lasts for 10s and stacks up to 9 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1350022.name: [Ellen] Icy Blade Execution
1350022.desc: {AWAKEN_1191#<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color> DMG Multiplier significantly increases: After launching <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe</color>, <color=#2BAD00>Basic Attack: Icy Blade will be automatically launched</color> to deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in front in a large area</color> and reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 40%</color>, lasting 8s. While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color>, Ellen will obtain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>.}{NOAWAKEN_1191#After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>, an <color=#2BAD00>Icy Blade will be automatically unleashed</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in a large area ahead</color> and <color=#2BAD00>reducing the target's DEF by 40</color>, lasting 8s. When the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> activates, Ellen gains 3<color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>; The additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.}

1350023.name: [Ellen] Mist Tide Resurgence
1350023.desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Ellen <color=#2BAD00>leaves behind a patch of Icy Mist</color> on the ground, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG over time</color> for 15s. Friendly Agents have <color=#2BAD00>increased Anti-Interrupt Level</color> and <color=#2BAD00>their DMG received reduced by 30%</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, the effect continues for 5s. When Ellen attacks an enemy within the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, an extra instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> DMG will be triggered.

1350031.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Moonlit Clarity
1350031.desc: When using the fifth attack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo in the <color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> Stance or the fourth attack of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color> Stance, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>reactivate the slash</color> up to 4 times. Each reactivation <color=#2BAD00>increases</color> the <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> dealt by Tsukishiro Yanagi <color=#2BAD00>by 12.5%</color>, stacking up to 4 times and lasting 8s and repeated triggers reset the duration. During the reactivated slashes, Tsukishiro Yanagi <color=#2BAD00>takes 40% less DMG</color>. After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>quickly follow up with the reactived slashes of the other Stance</color>.

1350032.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Awakening Moonlight
1350032.desc: When squadmates inflict Attribute Anomaly on enemies, it can trigger Tsukishiro Yanagi's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> once every 6s. After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> in this way, Tsukishiro Yanagi will hover in the air and <color=#2BAD00>continuously guide down lightning strike attacks</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> with relatively high <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color>.

1350033.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Moonblade Shadow Pursuit
1350033.desc: When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, Tsukishiro Yanagi gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadow Pursuit</color>, stacking up to 3 times. When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, if Tsukishiro Yanagi has <color=#FFFFFF>Shadow Pursuit</color>, it will automatically consume 1 stack to execute 1 instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Graceful Dance</color> against the enemy. <color=#FFFFFF>Graceful Dance</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> and can be triggered once every 1s.

1350041.name: [Jane] Phantasm Strike
1350041.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Significantly increases the continuous attack duration</color> of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>. Triggering the Finishing Move when there is an incoming attack activates <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>. When the continuous attack duration reaches maximum or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered by the Finishing Move, the Finishing Move will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>Salchow Jump - Airborne</color>. When this skill is activated, own <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases by 70%</color> for 15s.

1350042.name: [Jane] Encircle and Hunt
1350042.desc: {AWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>, with its DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup greatly increased}{NOAWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>}. Hitting an enemy with this attack inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Wound</color> on the target. While in this state, the target takes <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 60% of Jian's ATK and accumulates <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color> once per second for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

1350043.name: [Jane] Playful Pursuit
1350043.desc: When other squad members trigger <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, Jane will launch an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> centered around the target enemy. This DMG will be treated as <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

1350051.name: [Corin] Speed-Cleaning Technique
1350051.desc: During the 1st, 2nd and 3rd hits of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>directly follow up with the 4th hit of the Basic Attack</color> and launch a <color=#2BAD00>high-speed spin slash at enemies</color> ahead, and when Corin triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 20 Energy</color> once per 10s.

1350052.name: [Corin] Tea Break Time
1350052.desc: Corin's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> are replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified</color>. Hold the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> button to maintain sprint state, which ends after hitting enemies 30 times with consecutive chainsaw slashes or upon releasing the button. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified</color> will <color=#2BAD00>reduce enemy DEF by 3%</color> when it hits, stacking up to 10 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350061.name: [Astra Yao] Rainbow Concerto
1350061.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>30% increased CRIT DMG</color>, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>60 increased Anomaly Proficiency</color>, and characters with Rupture specialty deal <color=#2BAD00>15% increased Sheer DMG</color>. When the active character hits enemies with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#2BAD00>Astra Yao will recover 4 Energy</color> and <color=#2BAD00>perform an additional attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color></color>. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per second.

1350062.name: [Astra Yao] Crimson Beats
1350062.desc: With enough energy, releasing or following up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state will <color=#2BAD00>additionally deal two instances</color> of identical <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> DMG. When Astra Yao hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, there's a 20% chance to gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Inspiration</color> effect, allowing her next <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> to <color=#2BAD00>directly trigger</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, which can be followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, lasting 30s.

1350063.name: [Astra Yao] Starfall Waltz
1350063.desc: For every 25 Energy consumed, Astra Yao gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, up to 3 stacks. During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>, continuously channeling an energy beam to attack enemies. Upon activating this skill, <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> will be consumed, and with each stack consumed <color=#2BAD00>the skill duration will extend by 1s</color>. During this skill, <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level is increased</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>DMG taken is further reduced by 20%</color>. When the skill hits enemies, the <color=#2BAD00>target's DEF is reduced by 20%</color> for 30s. With 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, switching back to Astra Yao will automatically trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>. When Astra Yao's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color> hits enemies, it will consume 25 additional Energy, and when <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color> hits enemies, it will <color=#2BAD00>restore 5 additional Energy</color>.

1350071.name: [Evelyn] Gilded Spiral Edge
1350071.desc: When Evelyn exits <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ignite Preparation</color> for 30s, during which the next <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush</color> will be replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color> <color=#2BAD00>is considered a Chain Attack</color>. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote</color>, <color=#2BAD00>she will exit Binding Seal</color>.

1350072.name: [Evelyn] Lethal Etiquette
1350072.desc: When any squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> hits enemies, Evelyn recovers <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the attack's DMG increases by 80%</color>.

1350073.name: [Evelyn] Rogue Flames
1350073.desc: When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>'s heavy attacks hit enemies, they apply a <color=#FFFFFF>Burst</color> mark that lasts 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When other squad members' attacks hit an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Burst</color> mark, they deal an additional instance of <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 370% of Evelyn's ATK and recover 20% of Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>, once per 2s. After 3 instances of additional DMG are triggered, the enemy's <color=#FFFFFF>Burst</color> mark is removed.

1350081.name: [Yixuan] Phoenix Shadow
1350081.desc: When Yixuan is attacked by enemies, she will automatically dodge the attack, trigger Vital View and leave the Grand Tai Chi Formation in place. Press Basic Attack to chain into Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption. The automatic dodge effect can trigger once every 12s.

1350082.name: [Yixuan] Resonance of the Spirit
1350082.desc: Replace Quick Assist with EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break. When Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption hits an enemy or after launching EX Special Attack and Ultimate, Yixuan's <color=#2BAD00>Sheer DMG additionally increases by 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350083.name: [Yixuan] Gold Talisman of Mystic Feathers
1350083.desc: While charging EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation, Perfect Block can be triggered, after which additionally restores 15 Technique Points and gains <color=#2BAD00>18% DMG boost</color> that lasts for 15s. Each Perfect Block against an enemy increases the next Ultimate <color=#2BAD00>DMG by 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.

1350091.name: [Ju Fufu] Mountain King Banishes Evil
1350091.desc: After Ju Fufu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>, if she is not the currently active character, it will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, performing the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> around enemies. The skill's DMG is considered <color=#2BAD00>Aftershock DMG</color>. <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 75%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt increased by 45%</color>.

1350092.name: [Ju Fufu] Call of Wind and Thunder
1350092.desc: After Ju Fufu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Offensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she can quickly chain into the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and enhance this skill, increasing the <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt by 60%</color> and triggering an additional strike equivalent to the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> after the skill ends.

1350093.name: [Ju Fufu] Tiger Spirit Talisman
1350093.desc:
When Ju Fufu's 3rd <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> sequence hits an enemy, she <color=#2BAD00>gains 3 Might</color>.
After executing the 4th <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> sequence, pressing Basic Attack again will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw - Blazing Will</color>. If Hu Wei is present at this time and <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is above 100, it will consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> to trigger Hu Wei's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>.

1350121.name: [Alice] Duelist's Etiquette
1350121.desc: When Alice lands a hit on the enemy with the 5th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Marks</color> on hit targets. When she attacks an enemy with full <color=#FFFFFF>Marks</color>, all <color=#FFFFFF>Marks</color> are consumed to trigger the special <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> effect, <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>. This ignores Anomaly Buildup to deal one instance of DMG equal to 100% of the original <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG. This can also interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical Attribute Anomaly, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.

1350122.name: [Alice] Swiftblade Spin
1350122.desc: Alice's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> are replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Featherblade</color>. When Alice uses <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Featherblade</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency increases by 150</color> for 15s.

1350123.name: [Alice] Aurora Ensemble
1350123.desc: When Alice uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross</color>, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00> CRIT Rate increases by 10%</color>, and their <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 20%</color> for 20s. When she uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross</color>, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 35%</color>, and their <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency increases by 50</color> for 20s.

1350131.name: [Yuzuha] Shaman's Charm
1350131.desc: When Yuzuha uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Mastery increases by 40</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. She also reduces the enemy's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 18%</color> and their <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES by 15%</color> for 30s on hit. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350132.name: [Yuzuha] Secret Technique: Umbrella Smash!
1350132.desc: After <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, or the fifth hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to make Yuzuha perform <color=#FFFFFF>Umbrella Smash</color>. When this attack lands a heavy attack on enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color>, it unleashes one <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> attack, <color=#2BAD00>increases her ATK by 20%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00> increases her Anomaly Buildup Rate by 30%</color> for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Yuzuha will also gain a <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Point</color> when she lands a hit on the enemy with the fifth hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

1350133.name: [Yuzuha] Tanukis Abound
1350133.desc: When Yuzuha uses <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> or launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the whole squad gains 5 Energy and 160 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 12s. When she lands a heavy attack on the enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 15%</color> for 20s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. It also triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character. This <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is upgraded to a Chain Attack. This effect can trigger once every 12s.

1350141.name: [Lucia] Dream Surge
1350141.desc:
When Lucia upgrades a skill or uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color>, stacking up to 4 times.
Upon exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color> will be consumed with each stack consumed <color=#2BAD00>restoring 10 Energy for herself</color>.

1350142.name: [Lucia] Full Nocturne
1350142.desc: The <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> created by Lucia during her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> covers a larger area and <color=#2BAD00>its duration increases to 20s</color>. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, <color=#2BAD00>gain 200 additional Decibels</color>.

1350143.name: [Lucia] Spectral Focus
1350143.desc: When entering the battlefield, Lucia <color=#2BAD00>gains ATK equal to 3% of her base Max HP</color>, and her <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> <color=#2BAD00>deals 40% increased Ether DMG</color> to enemies.

1350151.name: [Yidhari] Piercing Light
1350151.desc: When Yidhari performs a 3-stage charged attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color>, she gains <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> each time she hits an enemy during the spinning horizontal attack. When Yidhari performs the final downward smash of this <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> sequence, or when she performs an ALT <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color> during the charged attack ALT, all <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> will be consumed to <color=#2BAD00>increase the attack's DMG by up to 240%</color> based on the amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> consumed. The Temporary Shield <color=#2BAD00>caps at 80% of Yidhari's Max HP.</color> All <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> will be reset if the spinning horizontal attack is interrupted.

1350152.name: [Yidhari] Biting Frost
1350152.desc: When Yidhari consumes Adrenaline to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Coil</color>: When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> hit an enemy, consume <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Coil</color> to attack the target enemy. This effect can only be triggered once per 1s.

1350153.name: [Yidhari] Dreamweaver's Heart
1350153.desc: When Yidhari becomes the active character in combat, she immediately activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> (can only be triggered once per 180s). <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 15s longer</color>, and during <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Sheer Force is increased by 800</color>.

1350161.name: [Dialyn] Deathrattle Toll
1350161.desc: When Dialyn has 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> points, using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color> will consume 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> and directly replace it with <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed</color> hits a Stunned enemy, it will <color=#2BAD00>trigger the Totalize effect, dealing additional DMG equal to 2,700% of Dialyn's ATK</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed</color>'s <color=#2BAD00>DMG will increase by 30%</color>.

1350162.name: [Dialyn] Ringing Aftertone
1350162.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, there's a 50% chance to gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color>, up to a maximum of 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color>. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color>, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color> can be consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> again.

1350163.name: [Dialyn] Dying Descent
1350163.desc: When dropping below 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> from above 90, immediately <color=#2BAD00>restore 60 Positive Reviews</color> and <color=#2BAD00>restore teammate's Decibels by 750</color>. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

1350171.name: [Banyue] Sever Attachment
1350171.desc: When not in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, after Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. Banyue's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>60% increased</color> Sheer DMG.

1350172.name: [Banyue] The Way of Asura
1350172.desc: When Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, he gains a shield <color=#2BAD00>equal to 35% of his Max HP</color>, lasting 30s. This effect can trigger once every 30s. While shielded, Banyue's <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level increases</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases by 15%</color>.

1350173.name: [Banyue] Scorching Karma
1350173.desc: For each 1 Energy or Adrenaline other squad members consume, if Banyue is not in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, he will recover 0.3 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. With at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue's next switch-in will directly trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. When coming on-field through this method with at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue immediately enters <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and increases his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> for 20s.

1350181.name: [Ye Shunguang] Frosted Blade
1350181.desc: After entering Enlightened Mind, upon first using Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum, <color=#2BAD00>automatically triggers Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>gains 45% Physical RES ignore</color> for 15s.

1350182.name: [Ye Shunguang] Clang of Jade
1350182.desc: After Ye Shunguang activates Ether Veil: Verdict, <color=#2BAD00>all squad members will use Veil Vulnerability bonus when attacking</color>, instead of Stun DMG Multiplier, and the Veil Vulnerability bonus cap is reduced by 85%. Enlightened Mind state duration doesn't pause while off-field anymore.

1350183.name: [Ye Shunguang] Case Full of Light
1350183.desc: Ye Shunguang's <color=#2BAD00>Qingming Sword Force generation rate increases by 100%</color>, Enlightened Mind duration is reduced to 10s.

1350191.name: [Zhao] Cold Moonlight
1350191.desc: Zhao's <color=#2BAD00>Impact increases by 2</color> for every 1,000 initial max HP she has. All squad members' Ultimates and EX Special Attacks deal <color=#2BAD00>12% increased Daze</color>.

1350192.name: [Zhao] Frostmist Enigma
1350192.desc: After charging Basic Attack: Final Verdict for 1s, Basic Attack: Final Verdict - Frostgleam can be unleashed, which <color=#2BAD00>increases CRIT Rate by 15% and CRIT DMG by 40%</color> for 15s.

1350193.name: [Zhao] Moonlit Dew
1350193.desc: When Zhao activates Ether Veil, she recovers 30 Frostbite Points and <color=#2BAD00>increases ATK by 25%</color> for all squad members, lasting 50s.

1350201.name: [Aria] Delusion's Glow
1350201.desc: After Aria completes her EX Special Attack, the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> on the field <color=#2BAD00>increases by 1</color>, and EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked does not consume Energy.

1350202.name: [Aria] Sweetheart Strike
1350202.desc: Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 20%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG additionally increases by 20%</color>; for every 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery Aria has, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate increases by 4%</color>; the third hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> on a target <color=#2BAD00>deals additional 50% of Aria's ATK</color> as <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

1350203.name: [Aria] Hear the Present
1350203.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Harmony of Delusion</color> is triggered</color> when an enemy enters an Attribute Anomaly while Aria is off field. When a heavy attack is landed with <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Harmony of Delusion</color>, it can trigger the Abloom effect of Core Passive: Innate Stage Presence. Further, should the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby be equal or greater than 2, she may proceed to launching the third hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> after the attack. <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Harmony of Delusion</color> can trigger once every 8s.

1350211.name: [Sunna] Bubble Planet
1350211.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Deal 50% more DMG</color> with EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, and Ultimate: Smash It All!. Bubblegum's Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted is changed to Basic Attack: Bubblegum Barrage. DMG dealt is <color=#2BAD00>regarded as <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG</color>.

1350212.name: [Sunna] Tour de Rhythm
1350212.desc: Reduces the number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, and when an enemy is afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, their <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 20%</color> for 10s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> hits a target afflicted with <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color> or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>, it also triggers one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>: applies one additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>370%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>192%</color>/<color=#FF5521>480%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>30%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>48%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>19%</color> of original Attribute Anomaly DMG.

1350221.name: [Nangong Yu] Focus Shift
1350221.desc: When other squad members trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, Nangong Yu will launch a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> around the target enemy. This attack is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>. This effect can trigger at most once every 6s. When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> heavy attack hits a target afflicted with <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color> it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, which deals additional Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>230%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>120%</color>/<color=#FF5521>300%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>20%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>30%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>12%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. This effect can trigger once every 6s.

1350222.name: [Nangong Yu] Beat Sync
1350222.desc: When Nangong Yu triggers a Precise Charging, <color=#2BAD00>restore 4 Energy</color> for all squad members. When any squad member uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, restore120 Decibels for all squad members.

1350223.name: [Nangong Yu] Spotlight Solo
1350223.desc: Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 60. For every 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeat</color> consumed, <color=#2BAD00>she restores 0.15 Energy</color>. After triggering Precise Charging with the first hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. When Precise Charging is triggered, <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 20%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350231.name: [Cissia] Coiled Strike
1350231.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color>, based on the time the character is airborne, <color=#2BAD00>the skill's CRIT DMG increases by 15%, and it deals 1 additional instance of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to 450% of ATK</color>. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts until the skill ends.

1350232.name: [Cissia] Venomous Concoction
1350232.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>300%</color> of own ATK</color>.

1350233.name: [Cissia] Ouroboros Loop
1350233.desc: After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color>: when any non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can trigger once every 1s, and lasts for 6s.

1350241.name: [Starlight - Billy] Crimson Gun Demon
1350241.desc: When successfully performing a Block during <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, gain 1 Charge stack, up to 1 stack max, which <color=#2BAD00>increases the DMG</color> of the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color> <color=#2BAD00>by 100%</color>.

1350242.name: [Starlight - Billy] Knight's Belt
1350242.desc: After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Stunt Show</color>, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to surrounding enemies. This skill is a guaranteed CRIT. During this skill, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 80%</color>, <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>/s</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level increases</color>.

1350243.name: [Starlight - Billy] Heated Cacophony
1350243.desc: After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 8s and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color>'s DMG Multiplier is 1,200%. When successfully performing a Block during <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color> can trigger an additional <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color> hits an enemy, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt against the target increases by 12%</color>, stacking up to 2 times, only one stack can be applied per enemy per use of a skill, lasting 20s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350251.name: [Promeia] Whirlwind Judgment
1350251.desc: When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, and when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.

1350252.name: [Promeia] Frostbound Shadow
1350252.desc: Attacks no longer recover <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. Instead <color=#2BAD00>recover an additional</color> <color=#2BAD00>5/s</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> . With <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, <color=#2BAD00>switching on-field replaces the normal switch-in</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>, this effect can trigger once every 10s. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's <color=#2BAD00>Ice RES is reduced by 24</color> for 20s, repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350253.name: [Promeia] Execution Finale
1350253.desc: When a character in the squad Stuns an enemy, Promeia <color=#2BAD00>recovers 5 Corrosive Chill/s</color> for 10s. Promeia's <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG against Stunned enemies increases by 60%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Disorder DMG increases by 60%</color>.

1350261.name: [Velina] Lace-Veiled Blades
1350261.desc: When Velina inflicts <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> on an enemy, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 30%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 3s longer</color> and <color=#2BAD00>deals 20% more Daze</color>.

1350262.name: [Velina] Graceful Serenade
1350262.desc: When Velina triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, she recovers <color=#2BAD00>10 Energy and 200 Decibels</color> and consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enhance the DMG</color> of this <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> consumed. Upon using her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Velina gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. If this <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>， recovers 1 additional point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>

1350263.name: [Velina] Candescent Wind Crown
1350263.desc: While <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is present on the field, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate by 40% , Decibel Generation Rate increase</color> by 30%, and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color>'s <color=#2BAD00>duration is extended by 3s.</color>

1350271.name: [Norma] En-Nah Frontline
1350271.desc: When Norma unleashes a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Combo</color>, causing her DMG to ignore 6% of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, stacking up to 5 times. When Norma is hit, she loses 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Combo</color>, with a maximum loss of 1 stack every 5s. Norma's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>.

1350272.name: [Norma] Grand Finale
1350272.desc:
When squadmates activate an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Norma <color=#2BAD00>immediately gains 100% Preheated Chamber</color>. Can be triggered at most once every 40s;
When any Agent in the squad activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the corresponding Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate increases 25%</color> for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1350273.name: [Norma] Menacing Bangboo
1350273.desc: When any Agent in the squad defeats an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color> state, all Agents in the squad gain <color=#2BAD00>2.5% ATK</color> in the Hollow during this run, stacking up to 10 times.

1350281.name: [Pyrois] Sword of Dawn
1350281.desc: Pyrois gains <color=#2BAD00>20 points of Solar Prominence</color> upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, up to once every 10s. Hitting enemies with different attacks <color=#2BAD00>improves Pyrois's Solar Prominence recovery efficiency by 30%</color>.

1350282.name: [Pyrois] Ironclad Honor
1350282.desc: Pyrois's <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG is increased by 20%</color>. Unleashing <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Total Annihilation</color> immediately <color=#2BAD00>grants Pyrois 1,500 Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

1350283.name: [Pyrois] Flame of Illumination
1350283.desc: Upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Pyrois <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 Energy and 20 Solar Prominence</color>.

1350291.name: [Remielle] Voidwing Pilgrimage
1350291.desc: When Remielle is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, if her Auto-Attack's Finishing Move hits a target afflicted with <color=#FE437E>Ether Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>triggers an additional instance of Abloom</color>, dealing a fixed 220% multiplier of the corresponding Attribute Anomaly DMG.

1350292.name: [Remielle] Blade Radiance
1350292.desc: When Remielle is the active character, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 1.6 Energy per second</color>. When using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>gains 3</color> special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color>.

1350293.name: [Remielle] Petals and Silver
1350293.desc: When Remielle uses Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace, she does not consume her stored <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color>.

1350301.name: [Sigrid] Invincible Cavalry
1350301.desc:
Unlocks <color=#FFFFFF>Converging Spear: Vanquisher</color>: While not in <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear Form</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Converging Spear: Vanquisher</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>;
If hit at the moment <color=#FFFFFF>Converging Spear: Vanquisher</color> is activated, block can be triggered. Each successful block trigger resets <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear Form</color> and grants one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>; after a successful block, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the corresponding stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>

1350302.name: [Sigrid] Frosty Flourish
1350302.desc: When launching <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will skip the Chain Attack window; <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color> deals 60% bonus CRIT DMG.

1350303.name: [Sigrid] Dancing Spearhead
1350303.desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced to <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>; when hit by an enemy attack while using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Sigrid will block with her shield. If the block is successful, the incoming attack DMG is negated, her own attacks ignore <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> of the target's DEF for <color=#FFFFFF>30</color>s, the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state is refreshed, and she gains one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>; after a successful block, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the corresponding stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>;

1350311.name: [Claret] Riftforge Onslaught
1350311.desc: When Claret's initial ATK exceeds 1,500, every 1 point of ATK over that threshold increases DEF by 1.3. This effect does not stack across different Gears. Claret's <color=#2BAD00>[Maim] DMG is increased by 20%</color>, and even when the target has not entered a Stunned state, Daze Vulnerability can still be triggered.

1350312.name: [Claret] Crimson-Eyed Bat Shadow
1350312.desc: When Claret's initial ATK exceeds 1,500, every 1 point of ATK above that increases DEF by 1.3. This effect does not stack across different Gears. Claret's Gash Buildup Rate is reduced by 30%. <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Blood Bloom Oath - Star Forge]</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Blood Bloom Oath - Crouching Axe]</color> deal <color=#2BAD00>40% increased Sharp DMG</color>. When Perfect Dodge is triggered while in the [Crimson Engrave] state, [Crimson Engrave] duration is extended by 3s. This can be triggered at most once every 5s.

1350313.name: [Claret] Scarlet Fever Night
1350313.desc: When Claret's initial ATK exceeds 1,500, every 1 point of ATK over that threshold increases DEF by 1.3. This effect cannot stack across different Gear; <color=#FFFFFF>[Scarlet Inscription]</color> While in this state, when attacks hit an enemy, the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF is reduced by 16%</color> for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Reapplying refreshes the duration. Can be triggered at most once every 2s.

1350321.name: [Roxy] Lead-Forged Mastery
1350321.desc: The buff granted to the whole squad after <color=#FFFFFF>[Cleanse]</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>[Core Passive: First Embrace Under the Moon]</color> <color=#2BAD00>additionally increases ATK by 600 points</color>. The ATK increase effect can stack up to 1 time. Additionally, <color=#2BAD00>Roxy can also receive the buff after <color=#FFFFFF>[Cleanse]</color></color>.

1350322.name: [Roxy] Eternal Night's Slumber
1350322.desc: Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack: Watch Out for Wind Chill]</color> and <color=#2BAD00>generate an additional large tornado</color>; enemies hit by the large tornado have their <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES reduced by 24%</color> for 30s.

1350323.name: [Roxy] Lantern Night Wanderer
1350323.desc: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist: Overtime Again?]</color>, it is replaced with <color=#2BAD00>activating <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack: Funeral Wind Giant Hammer]</color></color>, triggerable at most once every 12 sec; <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt by all squad members' <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attacks]</color> is increased by 50%</color>.

1352114.name: Blazing Storm

1352115.name: Incendiary Ammo

1352116.name: Voidwing Module

1352119.name: Dual Domain Heat
1352119.desc: 解锁后，切换近远程形态时，立即回复80%热力值

1352120.name: Pulse Shield
1352120.desc: 解锁后，部分血量转化为一段时间内不受伤则回复的护盾

1352121.name: Alloy Frame
1352121.desc: 解锁后，强化自己有盾时的抗打断能力

1352122.name: Fatal Reconstruction
1352122.desc: 解锁后，转化更多血量至护盾，击杀敌人时，魔神邦布可以补充自己的护盾。

1352123.name: Backup Energy Module
1352123.desc: 解锁后，有盾时无视远程攻击

1352124.name: Shield Burst

1353001.name: Shield Break Marker Plug-In
1353001.desc: Attacks against marked enemies can pierce shields

1353003.name: Speed King Plug-In
1353003.desc: Successfully performing quick-time interactions grants 20 bonus Energy.

1353004.name: Invincible Speed Plug-In
1353004.desc: The fastest ally gains full starting Energy.

1353005.name: Let's Try It Again Plug-In
1353005.desc: After a Mark is removed, your fastest unit takes another action immediately. Limited to once per round.

1353006.name: Your Turn Belongs to My Plug-In
1353006.desc: Upon an enemy's defeat, the one who dealt the final blow may act instantly. Limited to once per round

1353007.name: Weaken Plug-In
1353007.desc: When using a skill, if the target is an enemy, randomly dispel one stat buff from the main target

1353008.name: Purification Plug-In
1353008.desc: Dispels the mark on allies when they receive a stat buff

1353009.name: Lifesteal Plug-In
1353009.desc: After defeating an enemy unit, the one that dealt the final blow gains a healing buff at the start of each turn for 2 turns

1353010.name: For All Plug-In
1353010.desc: When a support ally uses a skill that grants a buff, it grants an extra turn. Limited to once per round.

1354001.name: Penny's Lost Notes: The Price
1354001.desc:
The Creator's strength has been stolen time and time again over the years, and the Exaltists no longer follow the guidance of their sacred texts. They feast upon Gibor's remains, leaving a trail of atrocities in their wake.
Why does no one wish to forgo their own gain and offer their strength to the Creator instead...

1354002.name: Hot Pot Soup Base
1354002.desc:
Simmer's mildly spicy hotpot base, with its steaming broth and fresh ingredients, is enough to warm even the coldest heart.

<color=#B5B5B5>Having both</color> <color=#D9A600>Breaking Thunder - Standard</color> <color=#B5B5B5>and</color> <color=#D9A600>Joyful Blaze - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s Broken Clues will unlock the secret location of</color> <color=#D9A600>Pale Breath - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>.</color>

1354003.name: Hollow Wayfinder
1354003.desc: An old-school hollow wayfinding instrument. Its design suggests it was an early model deployed by the Defense Force, equipped with basic boundary measurement and route-planning functions.

1354004.name: Broken Oni Mask
1354004.desc: A broken Oni mask, its ornate patterns suggest its owner once held a prestigious position.

1354005.name: Abandoned Bangboo
1354005.desc: According to HAND's records, someone once used this Bangboo device to send an apocalyptic alert to HAND. After discussion between the Intelligence Division and Deputy Chief Yanagi, it was temporarily archived due to insufficient evidence.

1354006.name: Leave Request Form
1354006.desc: The leave request form was filled with various excuses (all of which were rejected), including but not limited to: psychological therapy at Waifei Peninsula, sprained index finger from writing, burned tongue from team-building hotpot dinner...

1354007.name: Complete Literacy Guide
1354007.desc: On the practice pages of the book, it reads: "Never visit a burger joint without a reason." Below it, in elegant handwriting: "How can I get Soukaku to study without thinking about food?"

1354008.name: Section 6 Chief's Schedule
1354008.desc: The record shows various meetings and appointments for Hoshimi Miyabi, though it seems she skipped most of them. There's a small note written by her on the side: "Meetings seem to be a rather ineffective form of training."

1354009.name: Newspaper from the Future
1354009.desc: A newspaper from the future, reporting the joyous news that humanity has finally triumphed over the Hollow.

1354010.name: Penny's Lost Notes: The Feast Begins
1354010.desc:
According to both the institute's documents and the hidden messages discovered after deciphering the exalted scriptures, the apocalypse is inevitable.
If that's the case, then perhaps the only path left is to cast our mortal bodies into the fire and offer up humanity's strength to Them — to join Their grand feast, become beings under Their protection, and claim immortality in the world that follows the end.

1354011.name: Nitro-Fuel Ultra Fire Special
1354011.desc:
The Outer Ring's special ultra-concentrated Nitro-Fuel, packed with all kinds of wild ingredients. Just a single drop feels like it could instantly cheer you up.

<color=#B5B5B5>Having both</color> <color=#D9A600>Breaking Thunder - Standard</color> <color=#B5B5B5>and</color> <color=#D9A600>Joyful Blaze - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s Broken Clues will unlock the secret location of</color> <color=#D9A600>Pale Breath - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>.</color>

1354012.name: Nitro-Fuel Theme Park Blueprints
1354012.desc: Looks like someone's dream project — a Nitro-Fuel themed amusement park they planned to build in the Outer Ring. Inside are all kinds of bizarre attractions: giant Nitro-Fuel cans, periodic showers of flaming meteors, and elevator-mounted speaker arrays. It all looks dangerous, but strangely fun.

1354013.name: Warm Fuzzball
1354013.desc: A soft, warm-looking fuzzball. Judging by its texture and color, it seems to have been collected from a feline Thiren...

1354014.name: Flickering Light Ball
1354014.desc: A strange disco ball. It gives the impression that once it lights up, a one-hour loop of high-energy beats will start playing in everyone's head.

1354015.name: Holy Fuel Barrel
1354015.desc: A limited-edition golden Nitro-Fuel barrel from Burnice's collection. The drink inside is long gone, but even as an empty barrel, it still radiates the Outer Ring's raw power.

1354016.name: Carlishe Nourishing Shampoo
1354016.desc: Carlishe 30-Second Ultimate Hair Repair: premium care that restores heat- or dye-damaged hair. Available at Lumina Square.

1354017.name: Temporary Shipping Order
1354017.desc: A temporary expedited delivery slip from Leaps and Bounds logistics. Client: Penny; Courier: Burnice; Destination: Northeast side of the Papago Hollow... (the more specific address seems to have been scratched out).

1354018.name: Scratch Card from the Newsstand
1354018.desc: A scratch card sold at the newsstand. From the parts where the coating's been scraped away, it looks like it won the grand prize, "Golden Ice Cream."

1354019.name: Penny's Lost Notes: Sacrifice
1354019.desc:
"According to Mentor Yeshde'ah's notes, death is not the endpoint."... "I am willing to be the bait that lures sustenance into the depths of the Divine Maze."... "I am willing to cast off my flesh and guide my spirit toward the realm of immortality."
May all return to the Creator. May the Creator shelter me and all humankind.

1354020.name: 1,000 Heartbreak Ballads
1354020.desc:
A full CD collection of heartbreaking ballads released by High Ambitions Entertainment. Just skimming the tracklist gives you chills — it feels like the kind of music that could drown you in sorrow...

<color=#B5B5B5>When held, unlocks</color> <color=#D9A600>Joyful Blaze - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s secret locations.</color>

1354021.name: Krampus Decryption Plug-In
1354021.desc:
A cracking plug-in marked with the Krampus emblem, with a small line inscribed below: A trusty tool for bypassing access-control mechanisms.

<color=#B5B5B5>When held, unlocks</color> <color=#D9A600>Breaking Thunder - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s secret locations.</color>

1354022.name: Bunnygrass
1354022.desc: A vegetable that herbivorous Thiren love to eat. It's delicious in salads, and when boiled in hotpot with dipping sauce, it becomes incredibly flavorful.

1354023.name: Krampus Mission File
1354023.desc: An internal TOPS mission file. From the intact sections, the operation was led by Zhao, a member of Krampus. The mission briefing highlights that a researcher named Penny had provided certain trade information, which led to the approval of this operation.

1354024.name: One Denny
1354024.desc: Some kind of personal collectible. The worn edges suggest it's been around for quite a few years.

1354025.name: Vintage Timer
1354025.desc: An old-style timer once used to predict Hollow disasters. Judging from the symbols on it, it seems tied to the training schedule of a prominent family.

1354026.name: Deep Pit
1354026.desc: A deep, pitch-black pit. Just looking at it fills you with a crushing sense of dread, as if you might fall in at any moment.

1354027.name: Phantoms of the Past
1354027.desc: It appears to be a lingering phantom from the past, muttering words like "family," "worth," and "little bunny" under its breath...

1357017.desc: After entering Enlightened Mind, upon first using Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum, <color=#31CC00>automatically triggers Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder</color>, and <color=#31CC00>gains 45% Physical RES ignore</color> for 15s.

1357018.name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Sparrows in the Flowers

1357019.name: [Yixuan] Resonance of the Spirit
1357019.desc: When <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption</color> hits an enemy or after launching EX Special Attack and Ultimate, Yixuan's <color=#31CC00>Sheer DMG additionally increases by 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1357020.name: [Ellen] Arctic Hunt
1357020.desc: Every 15s, Ellen applies a <color=#FFAF2C>Hunting</color> mark that lasts for 15s to a random enemy. When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFAF2C>Hunting</color> with <color=#FFAF2C>EX Special Attack</color> or Swift Scissors/Charged Scissor Strike from <color=#FFAF2C>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, pressing Basic Attack or Special Attack allows Ellen to <color=#FFAF2C>immediately trigger the skill again</color> with <color=#FFAF2C>no cost or other requirements</color>. When she obtains <color=#FFAF2C>Flash Freeze Charge</color>, each excess point of <color=#FFAF2C>Flash Freeze Charge</color> <color=#FFAF2C>increases Ellen's ATK by 12%</color>. This effect lasts for 10s and stacks up to 9 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1357021.name: [Soldier 11] Fire Suppression
1357021.desc: When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, press <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack</color> right before the attack ends grants one auto Block. If you get hit during the attack, you'll negate the DMG and automatically trigger <color=#31CC00>Basic Attack: Fire Assault</color>. This effect will not stack if already active.

1357022.name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Soaring Moonlight
1357022.desc: During <color=#FFAF2C>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color>, after performing a quick thrust, Tsukishiro Yanagi hovers in midair, <color=#31CC00>continuously channeling thunderbolt strikes down</color>, and dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. When her thunderbolt strikes hit enemies, <color=#31CC00>the Disorder DMG they take increases by 60%</color> for 6s. When <color=#FFAF2C>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color>'s heavy attack hits enemies, it grants Yanagi a <color=#FFAF2C>Shield</color> equal to 20% of her Max HP for 20s.

1357023.name: [Qingyi] Surprise Blow

During this time, Qingyi's <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack: Penultimate, Basic Attack: Enchanted Blossoms, and Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color> deal <color=#31CC00>15% increased CRIT DMG</color>.

1357024.name: [Lighter] Knockout Punch
1357024.desc: When Lighter's <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist</color> hits an enemy, he gains one stack of <color=#FFAF2C>Inspire</color> (max one stack every 0.5s, up to 20 stacks). If he is launched, he loses 50% of his Inspire stacks. Each remaining stack increases Lighter's <color=#31CC00>Daze dealt by 5%</color>. <color=#FFAF2C>Hold the dodge button to activate Provoke</color>. While active, taking damage triggers Perfect Assist, increasing Lighter's <color=#31CC00>CRIT DMG by 15%</color> for 20s.

1357026.name: [Lucia] Full Nocturne
1357026.desc: The <color=#FFAF2C>Starlight Convergence</color> created by Lucia during her <color=#FFAF2C>Ultimate</color> <color=#31CC00>covers a larger area and lasts longer</color>. When using <color=#FFAF2C>Harmony</color>, <color=#31CC00>grants other teammates an additional 10 Energy and 20 Adrenaline</color>.
