1360002.name: Popularity Carrot
1360002.desc2: Someone once asked Joyous why he called the Hollow route data "Carrot." He replied, "Why not ask that woman why she made those machines look like rabbits?"

1360101.name: [Attack: Eradication] Netherflame Reignited
1360101.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Orphie & Magus accumulate Energy over time. With enough Energy, press <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> to summon Orphie & Magus to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies and grant all Agents the <color=#FFFFFF>Zeroed In</color> effect for 15s. Agents with <color=#FFFFFF>Zeroed In</color> gain <color=#2BAD00>500 ATK and their attacks ignore 20% of the enemy's DEF</color>.

1360102.name: [Attack: Eradication] Masquerade
1360102.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Hugo accumulates Energy over time. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Hugo to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. This skill always CRITs, and when a heavy attack from this skill hits an enemy, it <color=#FFFFFF>triggers the Totalize effect</color>, dealing <color=#2BAD00>DMG equal to 100%/20%/10% of the target's Max HP</color> to normal enemies/Elite enemies/Boss enemies respectively. When Hugo's <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> hits a Stunned enemy, it ends the enemy's Stunned state and deals <color=#2BAD00>additional DMG equal to a percentage of Max HP</color> to Elite enemies/Boss enemies based on remaining Daze duration, up to an additional 20%/10%.

1360103.name: [Anomaly: Infliction] Flame in a Cup
1360103.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Burnice accumulates Energy over time, starting with 75 Charge. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Burnice to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Hitting enemies inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect. <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> enemies have <color=#2BAD00>all attribute Anomaly Buildup RES reduced by 42%</color> for 40 seconds.

1360104.name: [Anomaly: Infliction] Featherlight Snowfall
1360104.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Vivian accumulates Energy over time.With enough energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Vivian to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Upon hitting enemies affected by Attribute Anomaly, inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> effect on them and <color=#2BAD00>an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG</color> at a ratio based on the original Attribute Anomaly DMG of <color=#FE437E>6,129%</color> / <color=#2EB6FF>3,040%</color> / <color=#FF5521>7,600%</color> / <color=#F0D12B>533%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>760%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>304%</color>.

1360105.name: [Stun: Knock] One and Done
1360105.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Lighter accumulates Energy over time, starting with 75 Charge. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Lighter to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Hitting enemies inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect. Enemies inflicted with the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect have their <color=#2BAD00>Stunned duration extended by 3s after being Dazed</color>. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect ends when the enemies recover from the Stunned state. When Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> hits normal/Elite/Boss enemies, it <color=#2BAD00>directly accumulates 100%/30%/15% Daze</color> respectively.

1360106.name: [Stun: Knock] Spectral Pierce
1360106.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Trigger accumulates Energy over time, starting with 75 Charge. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Trigger and launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Hitting an enemy inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Pierce</color> effect. Enemies with the <color=#FFFFFF>Pierce</color> effect have their <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier increased by 20%</color>. The <color=#FFFFFF>Pierce</color> effect ends when the enemies recover from the Stunned state. When Trigger's <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> hits a normal enemy, elite enemy, or boss enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>accumulates 100%/30%/15% Stun</color>.

1360107.name: [Support: Saturation] Elegant Creed
1360107.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Rina does not accumulate Energy over time, instead she accumulates Energy when any Agent in the squad consumes Energy/Adrenaline. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Rina to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>. During <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt by all Agents in the squad increases by 70%</color> for 10s.

1360108.name: [Support: Saturation] Denny Magnet
1360108.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Nicole accumulates Energy over time. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Nicole to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> for 10s. During <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>, all Agents in the squad <color=#2BAD00>ignore 50% of the enemy's DEF</color>.

1360109.name: [Rupture: Activation] Soulfire Showdown
1360109.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Manato accumulates Energy over time. The lower the HP of the active character, the faster Manato's Energy Generation. With enough energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Manato to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies, equalize all Agents in the squad ' HP and <color=#2BAD00>restore 20% HP</color>. all Agents in the squad gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> status. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> status, Agents' <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG is increased by 50%</color>, lasting 40s.

1360110.name: [Defense: Battle Shield] Backup Barge-In
1360110.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Caesar accumulates Energy over time, starting with 75 Charge. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Caesar to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies and grant all Agents 6,000 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> Shield. While an Agent has <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color>, they have unlimited <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> <color=#2BAD00>, their DMG dealt increases by 35%, and DMG taken in a single instance cannot exceed the Shield amount</color>.

1370101.name: [Attack: Eradication] Greataxe of Conquest
1370101.desc: Upon entering combat, gain 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Enhancement</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Enhancement</color> grants the Agent bonus <color=#2BAD00>16% CRIT DMG</color>. Getting hit removes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Enhancement</color>.

1370102.name: [Attack: Eradication] Fluttering Butterfly
1370102.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> turns the following <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> into a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

1370201.name: [Stun: Knock] Mini Handsaw
1370201.desc: Upon stunning an enemy, that enemy's <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 37.5%</color>.

1370202.name: [Stun: Knock] Portable Angle Grinder
1370202.desc: Upon stunning an enemy, the whole squad <color=#2BAD00>gains 5 Energy</color> or <color=#2BAD00>6 Adrenaline</color>.

1370203.name: [Stun: Knock] Multi-Function Circular Saw
1370203.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases Agent DMG dealt to Stunned enemies by 45%</color>.

1370204.name: [Stun: Knock] High-Speed Chainsaw
1370204.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases the duration enemies are stunned by 10%</color>.

1370206.name: [Stun: Knock] Power Impact Drill
1370206.desc: Upon Stun recovery, the enemy <color=#2BAD00>accumulates 10% Daze</color>.

1370301.name: [Anomaly: Infliction] Tactical Flashbang
1370301.desc: Inflicting the Disorder effect <color=#2BAD00>increases the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency by 25</color> for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1370302.name: [Anomaly: Infliction] Heavy Flamethrower
1370302.desc: Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly PEN Ratio increases by 20%</color> when attacking an enemy suffering an Attribute Anomaly.

1370303.name: [Anomaly: Infliction] High-Strength Pepper Spray
1370303.desc: When an Attribute Anomaly is triggered, the whole squad either <color=#2BAD00>recovers 7 Energy</color> or <color=#2BAD00>recovers 9 Adrenaline</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

1370306.name: [Anomaly: Infliction] EMI Jammer
1370306.desc: Agent <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG increase by 18%</color>.

1370401.name: [Support: Saturation] Lucky Cookie
1370401.desc: When an Agent activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#2BAD00>the whole squad gains 17 Energy</color> or 21 <color=#2BAD00>Adrenaline</color>. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

1370402.name: [Support: Saturation] Nutritional Can Food
1370402.desc: Upon launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>5% more DMG</color> for 10s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1370403.name: [Support: Saturation] Energy Drink
1370403.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 44%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 44%</color>.

1370405.name: [Support: Saturation] Quick-Heat Hot Pot
1370405.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases</color> Energy and Adrenaline Generation Rate by 18%.

1370501.name: [Rupture: Activation] Unwavering Resolve
1370501.desc: <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 60%</color> when Agent HP drops below 70%.

1370502.name: [Rupture: Activation] Heavy Hitter
1370502.desc: <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 37.5%</color> when Agent HP drops below 70%.

1370503.name: [Rupture: Activation] Offense-Defense Balance
1370503.desc: When launching <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the whole squad <color=#2BAD00>restores 4% HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

1370505.name: [Rupture: Activation] Locked and Loaded
1370505.desc: When HP is lost, Rupture Agents' <color=#2BAD00>Sheer Force increases by 270</color> while non-Rupture Agents' <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 324</color> for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1370506.name: [Rupture: Activation] Light of Foot
1370506.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases Agent CRIT DMG by 30%</color> for 20s when losing HP. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1370603.name: [Defense: Battle Shield] Type-III Combat Helmet
1370603.desc: Triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> grants <color=#2BAD00>150 Decibels</color> to the whole squad. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

1370605.name: [Defense: Battle Shield] 4th-Gen Blast Shield
1370605.desc: Upon entering combat, the whole squad <color=#2BAD00>gains a shield</color> equal to 10% of HP.

1370606.name: [Defense: Battle Shield] Lightweight Bulletproof Armor
1370606.desc: When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains a shield equal to 3% of HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s. Repeated triggers refresh shield HP.

2090000.name: Special Custom Ordered Cake
2090000.desc:
Cute little cakes handcrafted by the finest dessert-class intelligent constructs.
They vanish after consumption, granting Ether Battery ×1 and Cake Souvenir ×1.
2090000.desc2:
Enclosed is an unsigned card:
To the most important person.
With you here, the world will never see its final act.

2090001.name: Special Custom Ordered Cake
2090001.desc: These cute little cakes are handmade by the most professional Dessert-class intelligent constructs. They say you can appreciate the ultimate taste in all of New Eridu in just a single bite!
2090001.desc2:
Enclosed is an unsigned card:
To the most important person.
With you here, the world will never see its final act.

2090002.name: Fresh and Icy Energy Drink Special
2090002.desc2:
Just one sip to let this drink fill you with energy in this summer heat!
The secret ingredients are lemon, perfectly blended mineral salts, and never selling at room temperature.

2090003.name: Fresh and Icy Special Commemorative Can
2090003.desc: Fresh and Icy Energy Drink Special's limited-edition can. A breath of cold in the heat, with you through every summer day.
2090003.desc2:
The reason why it's considered to have commemorative value is mostly due to a promise made by the manufacturer: "Collect 6 consecutively numbered cans for a gold bar."
Everyone went all in for the six-can family pack, but no one has ever seen a can with a number ending in 0 or 5.

2090004.name: Investigator Special Gift
2090004.desc: A gift prepared for the Proxy to complete the special investigation mission. Use to restore 60 Battery Charge.
2090004.desc2: A message from HAND is attached to the gift: As Section 6's most favored independent investigator, may you always emerge victorious and unstoppable in your battles against the Hollows!

2090005.name: Investigator Gift: Commemorative Edition
2090005.desc: A gift prepared for the Proxy upon completing special investigation missions, holding significant commemorative value.
2090005.desc2: A message from HAND is attached to the gift: As Section 6's most favored independent investigator, may you always emerge victorious and unstoppable in your battles against the Hollows!

2090006.name: "Peerless Player" Exclusive Controller
2090006.desc: The "GameSir × Zenless Zone Zero" collaboration event exclusive reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090006.desc2: This custom-made controller for the Hollow Deep Dive System comes with a fully charged battery and works perfectly in environments like the Godfinger Arcade and the Marcel Maze. According to Fairy's calculations, a fully charged controller can support Eous through an entire day of dungeon runs in the Marcel Maze.

2090007.name: "Peerless Player" Customized Controller
2090007.desc: The commemorative reward for the collab event "GameSir × Zenless Zone Zero."
2090007.desc2: A controller customized for the Hollow Deep Dive System, loved by everyone in the family. Naturally, this leads to frequent arguments in the first-floor workshop over "who used the controller last night and didn't charge it?" — somehow, these debates always end up featuring the AI making excuses and the occasional "Ehn-ne-ehn-nah" noises.

2090008.name: Caramel Drizzle Cake Slice
2090008.desc: This slice of cake, produced by the Phaethon Birthday Preparatory Alliance, awards you Ether Battery ×1 and Commemorative Cake Slice ×1.
2090008.desc2:
By the time you see this cake, you've already missed the epic scene of Eous, Lil Six, and 18 standing on each other's shoulders to reach the kitchen utensils, and somehow managing to bake this cake under Fairy's guidance without blowing up the kitchen in the process.
However, {M#Belle}{F#Wise} might have recorded it on video, so why don't you go ask {M#her}{F#him}... maybe you can still find it?

2090009.name: Commemorative Cake Slice
2090009.desc: A cake slice made by the Phaethon Birthday Preparatory Alliance; its precise cooking method was formulated after being searched and compared by Ridu's most advanced AI assistant.
2090009.desc2:
By the time you see this cake, you've already missed the epic scene of Eous, Lil Six, and 18 standing on each other's shoulders to reach the kitchen utensils, and somehow managing to bake this cake under Fairy's guidance without blowing up the kitchen in the process.
However, {M#Belle}{F#Wise} might have recorded it on video, so why don't you go ask {M#her}{F#him}... maybe you can still find it?

2090010.name: Orange Fanta Can
2090010.desc: The "Fanta × Zenless Zone Zero" collaboration event exclusive reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090010.desc2:
A critically acclaimed classic carbonated drink — your perfect choice for that dopamine and energy boost!
The head of St. Leen's Beverage R&D Division claimed it was "nothing special" after tasting it, but was later spotted secretly stockpiling several cases of the same drink at home.

2090011.name: Orange Fanta Commemorative Can
2090011.desc: The commemorative reward for the collab event "Fanta × Zenless Zone Zero."
2090011.desc2:
A beloved classic soda. The perfect choice to lift your spirits in seconds!
Word on the street is that Deputy Chief Tsukishiro from Section 6 has already added it to the supplies list, labeling it as a desk-side staple, team-building essential... and overtime fuel.

2090012.name: Golden Proxy Awards Trophy
2090012.desc: "Golden Proxy Awards Annual Ceremony" event exclusive reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090012.desc2: The glittering trophy represents recognition and approval from friends. Naturally, Fairy and Eous insisted on being in the spotlight — not just during the thrilling live ceremony, but in every moment of reflection that followed.

2090013.name: Golden Proxy Awards Commemorative Trophy
2090013.desc: "Golden Proxy Awards Annual Ceremony" event commemorative reward.
2090013.desc2: "All these stories only happened because of you."

2090014.name: "Yummy Rush" Power Jelly
2090014.desc: The "Operation Yum" global collaboration event commemorative reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090014.desc2: A special power jelly launched by Crispy Delights Food Stall to celebrate the food festival. Built on the original energy supplement formula with flavors beloved to New Eridu citizens, it's become a massive hit. Whether you're hitting the gym for daily workouts or need to dash past Ethereals in the Hollows, this jelly's got you covered.

2090015.name: "Yummy Rush" Power Jelly
2090015.desc: Operation Yum global collab event commemorative reward.
2090015.desc2: A special power jelly launched by Crispy Delights Food Stall to celebrate the food festival. According to Fairy's analysis, just one pack is enough to make an average citizen zip around Lumina Square five times at lightning speed. That's why accidentally consuming this jelly at night usually results in staying wide awake until dawn, having an intense staring contest with your Bangboo at home.

2090016.name: "ChaPanda" Boba Teamilk
2090016.desc: The "ChaPanda × Zenless Zone Zero" collaboration event exclusive reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090016.desc2:
Savor the aroma and rich flavor of tea — no reason needed!
Try this drink, a delicious recipe that even Tin Master and Richard Teamilk tried to study. With its blue and white adorable little critter, it has already won over countless citizens of New Eridu!

2090017.name: "ChaPanda" Teamilk Commemorative Badge
2090017.desc: The commemorative reward for the collab event "ChaPanda × Zenless Zone Zero."
2090017.desc2:
Savor the aroma and rich flavor of tea — no reason needed!
This commemorative badge is exquisite and beautiful, perfect for home decoration, itabag accessories, showing off your taste and understanding of beverages, or marking your Bangboo to avoid mix-ups with others. Word on the street says some batches even have Resonium effects — but try at your own risk!

2090018.name: Sparkling Wonderland Admission Ticket
2090018.desc: Obtained after purchasing a 2025 Zenless Zone Zero FES ticket. Use to gain 60 Battery Charge.
2090018.desc2:
"Welcome to New Eridu — Where Humanity Rises Anew!"
Forget the Hollows, forget the commissions — here in this music-forged paradise at the world's end, listen to the beats of joy, despair, tension, melancholy... and pure passion!

2090019.name: Sparkling Wonderland Commemorative Ticket
2090019.desc: The commemorative reward for 2025 Zenless Zone Zero FES.
2090019.desc2:
While hard at work on Inter-Knot commissions and tirelessly saving New Eridu, pulling out this old ticket stub brings back the wild rhythm that once set your heart pounding.
"Welcome to New Eridu — Where Humanity Rises Anew!"

2090020.name: Hormel Beef Jerky
2090020.desc: A Hormel collaboration event exclusive reward. Grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090020.desc2:
Savor the flavor anytime, anywhere!
On a day trip? Eat this! Work got you dizzy? Eat this!
Binge-watching and craving? Eat this! Hungry late at night? Eat this!
A must-have wellness essential, highly recommended by Senior Sister Fufu!

2090021.name: Hormel Commemorative Charm
2090021.desc2:
Savor the lingering aroma anytime, anywhere!
A commemorative charm included inside the packaging. It's utterly scentless, yet somehow it looks delicious.
A small memory surfaces — the fresh fragrance, satisfied taste buds, and the Senior Sister who almost stuffed the charm into her mouth thinking it was beef jerky.

2090022.name: Delulu Fan Gift
2090022.desc: A fan gift personally designed by the Angels of Delusion. Use it to gain 60 Battery Charge.
2090022.desc2: At the bottom of the gift box, there's a handwritten message from all three members of the Angels of Delusion: "To our dearest Delulu, may you always have the courage to dream big, no matter where life takes you!"

2090023.name: Delulu Gift: Commemoration Edition
2090023.desc: A fan gift personally designed by the Angels of Delusion, and a precious keepsake with serious collector's value.
2090023.desc2: At the bottom of the gift box, there's a handwritten message from all three members of the Angels of Delusion: "To our dearest Delulu, may you always have the courage to dream big, no matter where life takes you!"

2090024.name: Auspicious Golden Carrot
2090024.desc: A Gilded Carrot Day gift from the Angels of Delusion. Use it to obtain 1 Ether Battery.
2090024.desc2: The "Carrot" is one of the Proxy's most iconic symbols, and clearly, and the Angels clearly approve of the Manager's "side hustle." Just as the Angels of Delusion never forget their promise to their Delulus, the world's greatest Proxy naturally keeps watch over unfinished delusions.

2090025.name: Auspicious Golden Carrot: Commemorative Accessory
2090025.desc: A Gilded Carrot Day gift from the Angels of Delusion that holds precious commemorative value
2090025.desc2: The "Carrot" is one of the Proxy's most iconic symbols, and clearly, and the Angels clearly approve of the Manager's "side hustle." Just as the Angels of Delusion never forget their promise to their Delulus, the world's greatest Proxy naturally keeps watch over unfinished delusions.

2090026.name: "Sushiro" Special Bangboo Roll
2090026.desc: The "Sushiro × Zenless Zone Zero" collaboration event exclusive reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090026.desc2:
One bite of surging energy, and you're instantly fully charged!
The warmth of the vinegared rice, the freshness of the seaweed, and the pressure of the grip — only a perfect balance of these three can create such a delicacy.

2090027.name: "Sushiro" Commemorative Plate
2090027.desc: The commemorative reward for the collab event "Sushiro × Zenless Zone Zero."
2090027.desc2:
One bite of surging energy, and you're instantly fully charged!
Just seeing the commemorative plate brings that rich umami flavor right back to my taste buds... Great, now I'm hungry again.

2090028.name: Custom-Made Flower Gift
2090028.desc: A birthday gift box presented by Aurelia Academy. Use it to obtain Ether Battery ×1 and a Custom-Made Commemorative Card ×1.
2090028.desc2:
A birthday gift box specially prepared by Aurelia Academy for its students, customized according to each person's preferences.
In Roscaelifer, where gentle breezes embrace the clouds, flowers are a rare and precious gift. Yet on special days worth remembering, their beauty always arrives right on time.

2090029.name: Custom-Made Commemorative Card
2090029.desc: A commemorative card from Aurelia Academy's birthday gift box. It has some value as a collectible.
2090029.desc2:
A commemorative birthday card included with the gift boxes prepared by Aurelia Academy for its students, illustrated according to each person's preferences.
Even after a long time, the floral fragrance lingering on the card remains rich and vivid. Hopefully you'll leave behind memories in Roscaelifer that are just as enduring.

2090030.name: Streamer K Cheering Fan
2090030.desc: The "KFC × Zenless Zone Zero" collaboration event exclusive reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090030.desc2:
Exclusive commemorative item from a major "Angels of Delusion" brand event!
A cheering fan personally designed by Sunna

2090031.name: Streamer K Keychain
2090031.desc: The commemorative reward for the collab event "KFC × Zenless Zone Zero."
2090031.desc2: Exclusive commemorative item from a major "Angels of Delusion" brand event!

2090032.name: "With Food Comes Fortune" Energy Pack
2090032.desc: The "Operation Yum" global collaboration event commemorative reward; grants 60 Battery Charge upon use.
2090032.desc2:
An energy drink co-developed by Marcel Group through a cross-brand collaboration, available in a standard version and a Bangboo edition.
While little is known about Roscaelifer to the outside world, Marcel Group's Chief Technician's name has been removed from the packaging to avoid causing panic among "Interior" personnel and Bangboo alike.

2090033.name: "With Food Comes Fortune" Commemoration Bag
2090033.desc: Operation Yum global collab event commemorative reward.
2090033.desc2:
An energy drink co-developed by Marcel Group through a cross-brand collaboration, available in a standard version and a Bangboo edition.
Word on the street is that the Bangboo edition has some mysterious synergy with the Group's Bangboo Taste Chips in its design — and just like that, sales of the latest Taste Chips went through the roof... The Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department just smiled and said nothing.

2090034.name: "PSBoo" Themed Console
2090034.desc: Obtained with the purchase of the PS5 physical game disc
2090034.desc2:
A limited-edition console featuring an exclusive startup screen and theme.
"From the very first press of the power button to adventures across countless game worlds, PSBoo has never been absent from your journey."

2090035.name: "PSBoo" Commemorative Console
2090035.desc: Obtained with the purchase of the PS5 physical game disc
2090035.desc2:
A limited-edition console featuring an exclusive startup screen and theme.
"From the very first press of the power button to adventures across countless game worlds, PSBoo has never been absent from your journey."

"From the very first press of the power button to adventures across countless game worlds, XBoo has never been absent from your journey."

2090037.desc2:
A limited-edition console featuring an exclusive startup screen and theme.
"From the very first press of the power button to adventures across countless game worlds, XBoo has never been absent from your journey."

2100001.name: Reserved Relics
2100001.desc: After use, you can choose and obtain one of the following: Ferocious Grip, Living Drive, Finale Dance Shoes, Scarlet Engine, and Sycophant's Refinement.
2100001.desc2: The preservation environment for the rare-form Etheric coagulum is extremely demanding, and the current device is the most perfect "storage solution" available. The holder can extract power from it for their own use—provided they can control it, rather than be controlled by it.

2100002.name: Hidden Treasure
2100002.desc: Select one item to obtain from the Precious Relics after use.
2100002.desc2:
These restless, high-density Ethereal condensates are always waiting for the moment to "break free" — as long as the price is right, they're ready to become part of the user's power.
However, whether they'll be obedient or compliant is another matter entirely.

2100020.name: 1-in-4 Selectable W-Engine
2100020.desc: Upon use, you can select a W-Engine from the following: The Vault, Demara Battery Mark II, Starlight Engine Replica or Housekeeper.
2100020.desc2: The best-selling W-Engine gift box in the city. Among the many reviews, there are even some familiar IDs. If you discuss their taste in choosing W-Engine with these friends... you might discover some shared interests!

2100021.name: Basic Upgrade Bundle
2100021.desc: Redeem for 3 Senior Investigator Logs, 2 Ether Plating Agents, 2 Bangboo Algorithm Modules, and 3,000 Dennies.

2100022.name: Advanced Upgrade Bundle
2100022.desc: Redeem for 5 Senior Investigator Logs, 3 Ether Plating Agents, 2 Bangboo System Widget, and 5,000 Dennies.

2100023.name: Restart Selectable A-Rank Weapon Chest
2100023.desc: Use this item in your Storage to select and obtain one of the following A-Rank W-Engines: Precious Fossilized Core, Rainforest Gourmet, Starlight Engine, Slice of Time, Original Transmorpher.
2100023.desc2: A custom W-Engine giftbox for those looking to restart their business. If you want to give your new career a boost, this is more than worth the cost.

2100024.name: A-Rank Agent Contact Letter
2100024.desc:
Use this item in your Storage to select and obtain one of the following A-Rank Agents:
Anby, Nicole, Corin, Billy, Anton, Ben, Soukaku, Lucy, Seth, Piper

2100025.desc2: A custom W-Engine giftbox for those looking to restart their business. If you want to give your new career a boost, this is more than worth the cost.

2100026.name: Limited Upgrade Bundle
2100026.desc: Redeem for 5 Senior Investigator Logs, 5 Ether Plating Agents, 5 Bangboo System Widgets, and 10,000 Dennies.

2100031.name: Immediate Invitation Gift
2100031.desc:
You can select and obtain one of the following A-Rank Agents:
Anby, Nicole, Corin, Billy, Anton, Ben, Soukaku, Lucy, Piper, Seth, Pulchra

2100032.name: Collaboorator Invitation Gift
2100032.desc:
You can select and obtain one of the following A-Rank Bangboo:
Penguinboo, Exploreboo, Paperboo, Sumoboo, Bagboo, Cryboo, Avocaboo, Boollseye, Electroboo, Magnetiboo, Devilboo, Baddieboo

2100033.name: Customizable Tactical Prism Program
2100033.desc:
Tactical Prism Custom Selection Program
<color=#B5B5B5>A customizable equipment box developed by HAND based on the Tactical Prism Program. It generates Tactical Prism solutions based on user selections.</color>

2100034.name: Selectable Resonium Chest
2100034.desc:
A Custom Resonium Selection Box. Proxies can choose one Resonium based on their needs.
<color=#B5B5B5>A customizable Resonium box developed based on the Resonium system. It generates the desired Resonium according to the user's selection.</color>

2100035.desc:
A Custom Resonium Selection Box. Proxies can choose one Resonium based on their needs.
<color=#B5B5B5>A customizable Resonium box developed based on the Resonium system. It generates the desired Resonium according to the user's selection.</color>

2100036.desc:
A Custom Resonium Selection Box. Proxies can choose one Resonium based on their needs.
<color=#B5B5B5>A customizable Resonium box developed based on the Resonium system. It generates the desired Resonium according to the user's selection.</color>

2100037.name: Suit-Up Gift
2100037.desc:
Obtain one of the following A-Rank W-Engines:
Demara Battery Mark II, The Vault, Housekeeper, Starlight Engine Replica, Drill Rig - Red Axis, Big Cylinder, Bashful Demon, Kaboom the Cannon, Peacekeeper - Specialized, Roaring Ride, Box Cutter, Tremor Trigram Vessel, Grill O'Wisp

3000000.name: Weaver Calendar Gift Box
3000000.desc: Use to extend your Inter-Knot Membership by 30 days.
3000000.desc2: The 'Weaver' membership welcome gift and benefits voucher, also a popular gift among Proxies; It is advisable to verify the trustworthiness of the giver or recipient for privacy purposes.

3000001.name: Weaver Calendar Gift Box
3000001.desc: Use to extend your Inter-Knot Membership by 30 days.
3000001.desc2: The 'Weaver' membership welcome gift and benefits voucher, also a popular gift among Proxies; It is advisable to verify the trustworthiness of the giver or recipient for privacy purposes.

3000002.name: Weaver's Gilded Gift
3000002.desc: Limited Calendar Gift Box: Activate a 30-day "Inter-Knot Membership: Festival Edition" upon claiming.
3000002.desc2:
To celebrate Gilded Carrot Day and thank our members for their continued support, Inter-Knot presents an exclusive member-only custom calendar gift box — rumored to bring good fortune.
As this is a festival special edition, the membership duration included with this gift box does not stack with the regular Inter-Knot Membership duration and will be calculated separately.

3000003.name: Weaver's Gilded Gift
3000003.desc: Limited Calendar Gift Box: Activate a 30-day "Inter-Knot Membership: Festival Edition" upon claiming.
3000003.desc2:
To celebrate Gilded Carrot Day and thank our members for their continued support, Inter-Knot presents an exclusive member-only custom calendar gift box — rumored to bring good fortune.
As this is a festival special edition, the membership duration included with this gift box does not stack with the regular Inter-Knot Membership duration and will be calculated separately.

3000051.name: Anniversary Surprise Ticket
3000051.desc: Purchase this product and log in for a total of 10 days within the 21 days after purchase to obtain Monochrome ×240, Polychrome ×760, Original Chip ×60, and Denny ×360,000.

3000053.name: Dawn Seeker's Ticket
3000053.desc: Purchase this product and log in for a total of 10 days within the 21 days after purchase to obtain Monochrome ×240, Polychrome ×760, Original Chip ×60, and Denny ×360,000.

3000054.name: Skyward Exploration Supply
3000054.desc: Purchase this product and log in for a total of 7 days within the 15 days after purchase to obtain Polychrome ×840.

3000100.name: "Growth Plan" Silver Piggy Bank
3000100.desc: Use to unlock this period's New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan
3000100.desc2: A special piggy bank for the New Eridu City Fund, holding valuable rewards. Obtaining all the "coins" within requires more effort than merely opening an ordinary piggy bank, however.

3000101.name: "Premium Plan" Gold Piggy Bank
3000101.desc: Use to unlock this period's New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan
3000101.desc2: A special golden piggy bank for the New Eridu City Fund, holding valuable rewards. It's been designed to make it much easier for premium users to access all the rewards inside.

3000103.name: City Fund Experience
3000103.desc: Your City Fund will level up once you have accumulated enough EXP.
3000103.desc2: The New Eridu City Fund organizers believe every citizen's actions play a role in making New Eridu better. Among them, many emphasize the importance of precise quantitative standards.

3000104.name: Great Builder's Certificate
3000104.desc: Activate City Fund Benefits after obtaining. After activating City Fund Benefits, you can choose one of the following W-Engines: Radiowave Journey, Cannon Rotor, Six Shooter, Electro-Lip Gloss, Unfettered Game Ball, Spring Embrace.
3000104.desc2: A voucher prepared by the organizers of the New Eridu City Fund, serving both as a ticket to the prize pool and proof of dedicated participation in the New Eridu City Fund program. It's a recognition of the hard work contributed by the dedicated core builders of New Eridu!

3000105.name: Great Builder's Certificate
3000105.desc: Activate City Fund Benefits after obtaining. After activating City Fund Benefits, you can choose one of the following W-Engines: Radiowave Journey, Cannon Rotor, Six Shooter, Electro-Lip Gloss, Unfettered Game Ball, Spring Embrace.
3000105.desc2: A voucher prepared by the organizers of the New Eridu City Fund, serving both as a ticket to the prize pool and proof of dedicated participation in the New Eridu City Fund program. It's a recognition of the hard work contributed by the dedicated core builders of New Eridu!

3031551.name: Belle and Pyrois' Namecard
3031551.desc: Obtained after unlocking Pyrois' Mindscape: Chains of Fate.
3031551.desc2:
The namecard of Pyrois, Phaethon's new companion.
Fairy made this namecard specially to welcome the newest member of Random Play. That said, actually handing it out in a social setting would still take a fair amount of courage.

3061551.name: Rekindled Without a Name
3061551.desc: Obtained after unlocking Pyrois' Mindscape: Morning Star at Dawn.
3061551.desc2:
A card bearing hidden images of Pyrois and Phaethon.
"I am the undying flames of disaster."
"Then, let me light the way forward for us before I burn out."

3110310.name: Lil Sassy
3110310.desc2: The classic outfit of the leader of the Cunning Hares, hiding a hint of playful cunning, both mischievous and cute.

3110311.name: Cunning Cutie
3110311.desc2: Pink! Pink! Pink! Pink is Nicole's signature color. So are you feeling it?

3110911.name: Dignified Blossom
3110911.desc2:
As blooms first grace the banquet hall and frost dusts the silver courtyard, the young lady would retreat to a quiet corner whenever guests gathered — eyes downcast, book in hand, softly reciting verses from days long past.
Guests would shower them with praise: the Hoshimi Family still upheld tradition, dignified and cultured as ever.
Only Souichirou stood nearby, his eye twitching slightly — he knew better than anyone that his daughter probably didn't grasp half the poem's true meaning.

3111511.name: Princess on Holiday
3111511.desc2: A baseball bat obviously has no place in beach volleyball, but it can ensure no one disturbs the princess of the wildlands' holiday fun. Grassy, Woody, Bricky — time to enter vacation combat mode!

3111910.name: Ellen Scissorhands
3111910.desc2: The sharp scissors of Victoria Housekeeping, if only she weren't sleeping...

3111911.name: On Campus
3111911.desc2: The tail doesn't quite match the school uniform, but with just a little bit of needlework, it can become even cuter!

3112610.name: Hidden Nightfade
3112610.desc2: Her everyday look when she isn't putting on a disguise. Maybe it's just one of the countless faces she wears. The night becomes her covering, and the mask is the one truth she never sets aside.

3112611.name: Nocturne of Light
3112611.desc2: Who says sunlight must accompany a seaside stroll? For lurkers with names unknown, the night is their most faithful companion. The anonymous lady says the evening sea holds unspeakable secrets — is this the truth, or another deception?

3113110.name: Scarlet Rock
3113110.desc2: The bold red is only to ignite the freedom deep within. On stage, nothing can overshadow her brilliance.

3113111.name: Chandelier
3113111.desc2: The black-and-white dress glimmers in both light and shadows. Every smile of hers seems to sink into the flowing light of the night, becoming a timeless classic.

3113310.name: Fluttering Violet
3113310.desc2: Maintain your elegance, Miss Vivian, from the point of your parasol, right down to your flowing skirt. Maintain your courage, Miss Vivian, be it last night's lonely walk, or here today at my side.

3113311.name: Iris of the Shore
3113311.desc2: Birds soar into the starlit skies, while irises bloom by the pond. Though this enchanting moonlit night may be brief, please let me see the lingering anticipation in your eyes in the moment I bloom.

3113710.name: Summit of Clouds
3113710.desc2: As the Master of Yunkui Summit, one's fashion and accessories need only be what feels natural. Stay true to one's self.

3113711.name: Trails of Ink
3113711.desc2: A custom attire in shades of ink. Like an elusive shadow, gone in a flash.

3114010.name: Celestian Etiquette
3114010.desc2: The young woman's perfect symmetry is only ever slightly compromised when she wears the school crest — such is the elegant and noble Thymefield spirit.

3114011.name: Sea of Thyme
3114011.desc2:
Though it wasn't completely symmetrical, she did not mind this gift from a dear friend.
The girl pushed open the locked door and walked along the pink beach after the sudden downpour, the cool waves brushing over her ankles. There were no unknowns left to frighten her.

3114110.name: Tanuki Under the Shade
3114110.desc2: Can you tell what the umbrella conceals? A tanuki, a trap, a ghost, or a girl's sly, spirited smile?

3114111.name: Tanuki in Broad Daylight
3114111.desc2: Ghost stories aren't born only in shadows. Unconvinced? Just lock eyes with that playful young lady splashing in the water. She'll possess your thoughts, while Kama sneaks away with your drink.

3114210.name: Hundred Flavors
3114210.desc2: Yunkui Summit's largest disciple uniform, spacious enough for this senior brother's belly and all his seasonings. And that iron wok on top is a first of its kind. But... putting a pan you just used for stir-frying on your head? Doesn't it burn?

3114211.name: Culinary Jewel
3114211.desc2:
Senior Yinhu once dreamed of becoming a renowned chef, but in this day and age, there's always some thug looking to smash your bowl.
—"Go on, try smashing one."

3114310.name: Clouddrift Illumination
3114310.desc2:
Cloud-woven silk, a blade's gleam reflected in its folds. The attire mirrors the person.
But who truly chose this dress? Was it her... or the deeper self within?

3114311.name: Touch of Dawnlight
3114311.desc2: The gentle glow of sunlight and warm breeze seem to welcome your next encounter as you walk down the streets.

3114410.name: Loyal Wild Soul
3114410.desc2:
The standard attire of the unofficial mediator in Sailume Bay, enough to intimidate petty thugs.
Still, it sometimes draws wandering eyes.

3114411.name: White Heart Silhouette
3114411.desc2:
A young Manato made a solitary vow to himself — and from his deep reverie, a lone pale shadow was born.
Mimicking his attire enhances Manato's already exceedingly intimidating presence.

3114910.name: Dreams on Loop
3114910.desc2: Put on the outfit she finds cutest, and she can break free from the crowd, slipping into the lingering echoes of delusion.

3114911.name: Afternoon Tea Break
3114911.desc2:
Freshly baked cake, rich and fragrant coffee, and the gentle warmth of the afternoon sun...
Wrapped in moments of softness, it's time to begin today's tea break.

3115091.name: Discordant Note
3115091.desc2:
Aria's performance outfit for special shows, worn only a handful of times.
A pure-white "angel" clad in "demonic" wings. Take a deep breath, get ready... once the spotlight comes on, it's the Angels of Delusion's time to rebel.

3115111.name: Rhapsody's Muse
3115111.desc2:
Dancing within disordered rhythms, spinning across a stage of wild fantasia.
The boundary between angel and demon tilts with the lights, dissolving within her reflection.

3115611.name: Shade of Leisure
3115611.desc2: Outside of work, Velina occasionally invites close friends to afternoon tea parties. During such moments, she changes into relatively casual attire to enjoy her free time... though to the Bangboo, it's merely the Grim Reaper in a different terrifying disguise.

3115811.name: Moonlight Whispers
3115811.desc2:
Since the sun has never shown mercy, let us embrace the fall alongside the moonlit night.
You say it's difficult to differentiate between jokes and deception?
Then let's have another round of our Q&A game, my dear partner in crime.

3115812.name: Seashade Pas Seul
3115812.desc2: This was originally a solo dance, yet a ray of light has illuminated the secrecy and solitude shrouded in darkness. Now, would you care to join me for a pas de deux, my partner in crime?

3115813.name: Moonlight Whispers (Veil)
3115813.desc2:
Since the sun has never shown mercy, let us embrace the fall alongside the moonlit night.
You say it's difficult to differentiate between jokes and deception?
Then let's have another round of our Q&A game, my dear partner in crime.

3115891.name: "Moonlit Shore" Outfit Set
3115891.desc: Purchase to unlock two outfits for Remielle: Moonlight Whispers and Seashade Pas Seul.
3115891.desc2:
This bundle includes Remielle's outfits Moonlight Whispers and Seashade Pas Seul. Proxies who do not own either outfit can purchase this bundle at a discounted price. Bundle discounts cannot be combined with discounts on individual outfits.
※ Obtaining Moonlight Whispers will also unlock Moonlight Whispers (Veil).

3115911.name: Majestic Wavechaser
3115911.desc2: A knight accustomed to galloping through the skies must now face a new challenge from the waves and the sun!

3131551.name: Wise and Pyrois' Namecard
3131551.desc: Obtained after unlocking Pyrois' Mindscape: Chains of Fate.
3131551.desc2:
The namecard of Pyrois, Phaethon's new companion.
Fairy made this namecard specially to welcome the newest member of Random Play. That said, actually handing it out in a social setting would still take a fair amount of courage.

3161551.name: Unfading Embers
3161551.desc: Obtained after unlocking Pyrois' Mindscape: Morning Star at Dawn.
3161551.desc2:
A card bearing hidden images of Pyrois and Phaethon.
"I am the undying flames of disaster."
"Then, let me light the way forward for us before I burn out."

3201001.name: Eridu Tycoon
3201001.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201001.desc2:
The only publicly released image of the founder of the New Eridu City Fund.
Although such an image with the founder buried in gold coins may evoke jealousy, who can refuse the lucrative earnings and the prestigious avatar from the City Fund?

3201002.name: Efficient Summer Getaway Plan
3201002.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201002.desc2:
A hard to resist and highly efficient summer getaway plan: Enjoy the ocean's embrace and let it wash away the heat!
Also: Bangboo diving equipment is on sale right now! Check out the super hot brand "City Prisoner."

3201003.name: Hidden Ending
3201003.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201003.desc2:
Almost no one noticed that a regular social service Bangboo left its post, except for its cat.
Was the ability to trace the data logs due to a glitch in the system, or was it love?

3201004.name: Chief Classical Music DJ
3201004.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201004.desc2: A DJ who is on good terms with Elfy. Despite wearing the latest headphones, this DJ's real love is classical music, drifting through the melodies with the listeners... until both fall into a peaceful slumber.

3201005.name: Heartwarming Game
3201005.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201005.desc2:
On a snowy winter's day, warmth still verberates from the bubbling hot soup, the fireplace lit at night, and Belle's hands as she rubs them together.
However, when these warm hands grasp soft snow, then tighten around it and pack it in...

3201006.name: Reflections of Fireworks
3201006.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201006.desc2:
Through the distance, with eyes that see through the Hollow, at this moment, only the brilliant fireworks are reflected.
Leaving behind Commissions, forgetting the Ethereals, shaking off the apocalypse — at the moment the year changes, only you and I remain.

3201007.name: "My Love For You"
3201007.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201007.desc2:
"I don't care what anyone thinks, just as I don't care if the sky will collapse or if tomorrow will come..."
"All I care about right now is whether the owner of that name cares as much about me right now."

3201008.name: Strolling Hand in Hand
3201008.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201008.desc2:
No matter which world we're in, the one who roams with me, crossing endless space, is always you.
No matter how many journeys we take, the one who forgets to plan and ends up scrambling... is still you.

3201009.name: Stunt Coordinator Needed ASAP!
3201009.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201009.desc2:
When recommending the antagonist actor, the senior sister from Yunkui Summit emphasized that her fellow townsman excels in both martial arts and acting skills, appearing fierce yet remarkably patient.
...Senior, could you please recommend an equally outstanding stunt coordinator to save our two panicking leads?!!

3201010.name: Underwater Sightseeing Tour
3201010.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201010.desc2:
Upon checking the photos when they were back at home:
In Wise's camera reel, there were vibrant corals, lively schools of fish, and Belle in her graceful poses.
In Belle's camera reel, there were shimmering white lights, unidentifiable creatures, and a blurry Wise.

3201011.name: Lotus Lucid Dream
3201011.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201011.desc2:
In the seemingly endless summer days, these moments of glory, life-threatening peril, turning tides, and graceful exits... belong to Phaethon.
While others of rippling streams, lotus-lit ponds, lazy daydreams, and drowsy eyes... belong only to Belle and Wise.

3201012.name: Sweet Dreams in the Breeze
3201012.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201012.desc2:
"That Bangboo... will it be able to find its way home?"
"...I'm so sleepy. How about we finish the story after we wake up?"
"Don't forget..."

3201013.name: Maple Rest
3201013.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3201013.desc2:
One-Dennyboo sent a postcard: it's doing great with the kitten you helped rescue.
Even better, they've found a home now! Time to embrace the warm autumn sun and maple leaves — with fully charged batteries and delicious canned food waiting for them at home.

3201014.name: Exclusive Fan Support
3201014.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3201014.desc2:
"Wise, you've gotta wave the glow stick to the beat! Just holding it up doesn't count!"
"Left–right–left, up–left–down–down... Belle? What was it again? Give me a minute, I'll get the sequence down."

3201015.name: All Magic Is a Miracle
3201015.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3201015.desc2:
The world likes to hide the things that matter most, only to quietly bring them forward when least expected.
With a turn of the fingers, before the applause fades, our eyes meet for an instant, and the miracle arrives right on time.

3201016.name: Perfect Expression Control
3201016.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3201016.desc2:
The marble game taking the city by storm welcomes every Bangboo friend — hop in your bubble and smash into your pals!
High-speed cameras are rolling: even if everything's spinning, remember to blink gracefully as you brush past each other!

3201017.name: Camera Sense
3201017.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3201017.desc2: In the play of light and shadow, every treasured moment is meticulously captured into the frames through the lens.

3201018.name: Focus on This!
3201018.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3201018.desc2:
Mysteries pile up, and fate weaves us together in ways we can't unravel.
But at least, on this journey to seek the truth, we'll walk side by side, always and forever.

3201019.name: Berry Party
3201019.desc: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3201019.desc2:
In Booastrum, the clear skies might let you down. A Bangboo might even get the wrong idea.
But berries never will.
Strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries, whether sweet, tangy, or delightfully sour, will always sweeten your Cream Party.

3202001.name: Fragrant Infusion
3202001.desc: Avatar reward obtained when your Hollow Zero Investigation License reaches a specific level.
3202001.desc2: You might already have received the flower seeds gifted from Hollow Zero? Invest a little life force as nourishment, and it'll cling to you as it emits a fragrance — what a fair exchange.

3202003.name: Shiyu Defense: Adaption
3202003.desc: "Shiyu Defense: Critical Node" full S-Rank clear commemorative avatar.
3202003.desc2: Amidst the upheaval, you remain the eternal anchor.

3202004.name: Endless Ascension: Smooth Path
3202004.desc: Commemorative avatar for specific floors in the "Simulated Battle Trial".
3202004.desc2: Breaking through the siege and battling to the summit, the path ahead lies wide open.

3202005.name: Deadly Assault: Line Breaker
3202005.desc2: The Hollow is a labyrinth — those unskilled in strategy face no return, no survival.

3202006.name: Final Dose
3202006.desc: Commemorative avatar for reaching the designated investigation level in "Hollow Zero: Lost Void."
3202006.desc2:
Accept this gift from the shadows, and perhaps you'll find the strength to escape being "lost."
But more likely: you'll remain lucid, battling like a cornered beast... only to join the ranks of your foes, becoming the next howl in the shadows.

3202007.name: Endless Last Stand - Impasse
3202007.desc: Commemorative avatar for specific floors in the "Battle Trial: The Last Stand."
3202007.desc2: At the journey's end, a spark remains; A blade cuts through, and a new world gains.

3202008.name: Plundering the Core
3202008.desc: Commemorative avatar for reaching the designated Investigation Progress level in Hollow Zero: Lost Void.
3202008.desc2:
Its thin, sharp fingers tightly grip the key that controls the entire "Lost Void."
If you stare for too long... you might unknowingly become one of the manipulated.

3202009.name: Gazed Upon in This Moment
3202009.desc:
An avatar reward for the limited-time event "Festival Channel."
Limited-time reward.
3202009.desc2:
Before you realize it, a gaze has been watching you for quite a while now — wait, just one gaze... that's actually pretty rare?
"Objection. This eye is merely a visual representation of program execution. During this time, I haven't just been watching — every line of code of New Eridu's most powerful AI assistant has been running for Master."

3202010.name: Blessed by Glory: The Crown
3202010.desc: Commemorative avatar for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Glory".
3202010.desc2: The strong crown themselves with the glory of fierce battles.

3202011.name: A Thousand Paths, A Thousand Changes
3202011.desc: Commemorative avatar for "Threshold Simulation: Branching Echoes."
3202011.desc2: Take different paths and embark on countless adventures.

3202012.name: Sān-Z: The Never-Ending Show
3202012.desc: Commemorative avatar for the Filmgoer Thank-You Gift limited event.
3202012.desc2:
Every roll of film from the past holds your silhouette.
Every story yet to unfold awaits your companionship.
New Eridu, the show never ends!

3202013.name: Discovering Truths
3202013.desc: Threshold Simulation: Myriad Endgame Commemorative Avatar.
3202013.desc2: On the gridlines of data, the one and only true path is calculated.

3202014.name: Everburning Heart
3202014.desc: Threshold Simulation: Myriad Endgame Commemorative Avatar.
3202014.desc2: So long as the road of pursuit remains, the heart has yet to fall silent.

3202015.name: Crowned by Waves: Apex
3202015.desc: Commemorative avatar for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Tidal Wave."
3202015.desc2: Crown-bearer who has reached the apex, claim your ultimate glory.

3202016.name: Simulated Annihilation: Terminus
3202016.desc2:
"Venture into certain death and seize the one who stands against ten thousand!"
"...Uhh, Belle, this is only a data exercise. Maybe tone down the dramatic energy a little..."

3202017.name: The Best Gift
3202017.desc:
An avatar reward for the limited-time event "Marcel Anniversary Gift."
Limited-time reward.
3202017.desc2:
"Ehn... Ehn-ne? (So... what should we get Master for a celebration gift?)"
"Ehn, ne, ehn... (Something cute, something sparkly, and most importantly... something Master would love...)"
"Ehn-ne ehn-ne ehn-ne-ne—! (Ah!... I've got it! Let's wrap ourselves up as a gift and give ourselves to Master!)"

3202018.name: Tempered Crown
3202018.desc: Earn a 2-Star rating in "Deadly Assault: Adversity Mode" to automatically unlock the limited-time avatar reward.
3202018.desc2: Sharp blades cut through thorns, while glory tempers the crown.

3203001.name: M-Boo En-Nah En-Nah
3203001.desc: Commemorative avatar for the collaboration with McDonald's Mainland China.
3203001.desc2:
A relaxing and joyful party time! All the BFFs have gathered... now,
who else is everyone waiting for?
Ta-da! M-Boo is right outside, delivering a feast of deliciousness!

3204001.name: Subtle Wink
3204001.desc2:
An invitation from Lumina Square has been received.
The breeze is gentle, the clouds are light, and the sun is just right... Why not set aside the Hollows, the Ethereals, and work for now, and sway leisurely amidst the crowd on this pleasant afternoon?

3205001.name: Gimme a Fanta!
3205001.desc: Commemorative avatar for the collaboration with Fanta.
3205001.desc2:
Grab a Fanta, let the joy burst~
When those feel-good bubbles dance and rise, injecting Fanta's colorful dopamine into this moment — right now, let's make it pop with color!

3206001.name: A Flavorful Journey Home
3206001.desc:
An avatar reward for the limited-time collab event "Operation Yum."
Limited-time reward.
3206001.desc2: A platter of delicious food arrives at your doorstep. No matter the flavor, it always awakens that original feeling of warmth hidden deep in your heart, just like a gentle call from childhood at the dinner table, bringing back all the tenderness in the world.

3207001.name: Time for a Shining Eridu!
3207001.desc: 2025 Zenless Zone Zero FES Commemorative Avatar.
3207001.desc2:
Thanks to Fairy's thoughtful planning, you finally get a break from your busy schedule.
Today's most important commission is to move with the beat and shine across New Eridu!

3208001.name: Crazy Support Day
3208001.desc: Commemorative avatar for the collaboration event with KFC.
3208001.desc2:
Help the monochromatic K Boss take some color photos! The secret...? Inject some pink angel Fandom Power!
Crazy Fandom Day — don't you dare miss it!

3209001.name: Best Before
3209001.desc: Commemorative avatar for the Operation Yum collab event.
3209001.desc2:
Perfectly controlled heat, perfectly balanced flavor. The perfect meal, served up by Bangboo culinary experts!
Best enjoyed right now!

3300001.name: Honorary Citizen
3300001.desc: The standard namecard for Inter-Knot users.
3300001.desc2: Beyond the shadows of the Hollows, what we fight for and are proud of — is New Eridu.

3300002.name: Lucky Start
3300002.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300002.desc2: Howl is waiting for you — go across the street to pick up a little luck and start your day in New Eridu!

3300003.name: Heatwave-Bound
3300003.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300003.desc2: A 10-year consecutive winner of "The Ridu Tour" Best Summer Vacation Spots ranking. Reason: "Sunshine never gets old."

3300004.name: Mini Adventure Story
3300004.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300004.desc2:
A commemorative namecard of the movie "7710 and Its Cat."
Watchers who wish to break the fourth wall obtained a story of regrets. Life and movies were always as separate as night and day... right?

3300005.name: Bardic Afternoon
3300005.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300005.desc2:
A membership card for Bardic Needle.
Sharing music with an elegant lady under the gentle afternoon sun is quite the delightful experience. However, one will have to wait until the music plays to see if the needle has landed on what you want.

3300006.name: Sibling Friendship
3300006.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300006.desc2:
"I love having snowball fights with Wise! Whoever wins gets to put a snow Bangboo on the other. He always lets me win~"
"The snowballs Belle makes hurt... a lot. I don't know how she manages to make them... Every time I have to quickly surrender to avoid further pain..."

3300007.name: Essential Agenda
3300007.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300007.desc2:
This Family Day event's shift photographer and Head of Family Security, Lil Six, is here to capture beautiful moments for you:
The most important activity, the essential moment in the agenda— no matter if my bangs flap in the wind or if the wound from that snowball hasn't healed, we'll go out together to watch the fireworks!

3300008.name: Dream After the Rain
3300008.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300008.desc2:
If the remainder of my life were to be nothing but repeating lines I've already recorded, at least I could still say "I love you" over and over.
The day we reunited after the disaster was too sudden... But when the rain clears and spring arrives, flowers will bloom, ready to be handed to my "beloved."

3300009.name: Pixel World Adventures
3300009.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300009.desc2:
Taming soul-hounds, taking on greedy serpents, leaping over Turbo taxis... Nothing slows Phaethon down in the pixel world!
Victory after victory, it's time to resupply! Wait a sec — before we left, didn't someone say they'd bring the batteries?

3300010.name: "Tigerbane Legend"
3300010.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300010.desc2:
"I hear Yunkui Summit is surrounded by dark miasma, and a glorious, ferocious tiger dwells within, sowing strife among the people. A heroic pair of siblings decide to act, disguising themselves as tigers and sneaking in..."
"Wait! Director! Didn't you say you'd use a green screen to edit all our actions in?! AAAHH!"

3300011.name: Special Snorkeling Photo Session
3300011.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300011.desc2:
I arrived at the best snorkeling spot in New Eridu, recommended by the heir of a certain prominent family! But I politely turned down the photographer she suggested.
Maybe... when faced with a vibrant, unfamiliar world, there's no better photographer than curiosity; and when it comes to those we spend every day with, no technique beats patience and love.
—That doesn't guarantee a beautiful result, though.

3300012.name: Where Sky Rests in Water
3300012.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300012.desc2:
"A lazy summer afternoon, lying on the water's surface, beneath the lotus flowers and leaves to cool off... This is exactly how animals in fairy tales must live!"
"Uh... if by 'animals' you mean like those half-asleep capybaras, and the lotus flowers and leaves are those freebie hair clips you just brought back from the accessory shop, Belle..."
"But... why am I the one wearing the flower?"

3300013.name: Upon a Pillow of Clouds
3300013.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300013.desc2:
No Knock Knock alerts from my phone, no Agents politely or urgently knocking on my door, no emergency evacuation notices from PubSec echoing through the streets, even Fairy's processing sounds are as soft and airy as the wind passing through the clouds...
Finally, time to rest.

3300014.name: One Denny's Autumn Outing
3300014.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
3300014.desc2:
In every story about autumn, I've gathered golden leaves, plush grass, and burning crimson slips of paper — but what I love most of all... is when you lean against my shell.
A Bangboo's Logic Core may just be a piece of machinery, yet in this warm, fuzzy moment, I could swear I hear it beating inside my chest.

3300015.name: New Idol Program
3300015.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3300015.desc2:
"I already told you, a lively, adorable video store manager like me, plus being a smart, fearless Proxy, I'm totally idol material..."
"Huh? Wise, are you okay?!"
"Belle, ch—change the song... this one's way too fast..."
Once the last encore chant was done, Wise sat down on the ground and, with the last bit of energy he had, managed two weak swings of his glowsticks.

3300016.name: Between White Doves and Fireworks
3300016.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3300016.desc2:
An amateur magician claims their top hat is bottomless, big enough to hold every miracle in the world. Maybe white doves bursting into flight, maybe fireworks waiting to be lit...
Or maybe you, smiling and waving at me.

"This... doesn't even count as magic, does it?"
"Really? The person who once tucked me under her hat as a kid didn't see it that way."

3300017.name: Isle of Gentle Dreams
3300017.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3300017.desc2:
A remarkable anti-gravity device that lets Eous drift off in any direction.
"ehn... nhe-ehn? (So this is what it feels like... after "managing your weight"?)"

"What?! Bangboo don't need to manage their weight! Who's been putting ideas in your head?!"
"Perhaps... it was that fitness meal takeout bag from our last order?"
"Ugh... I'm never ordering from that place again!"
"I agree. But... is that really because of Eous?"

3300018.name: Shadowlight Intermission
3300018.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3300018.desc2:
"Born anew from the theater, we step onto the stage before the curtain calls. Though the stars may dim for now, we... will make everyone shine bright." — Entrance line of an actor from a mysterious theater somewhere.
"Belle... do we seriously have to say that out loud when we make our entrance?"

3300019.name: The Truth of the World!
3300019.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3300019.desc2:
Amid the overwhelming chaos of scattered clues, we are both the truth behind it all and each other's solution.

"Belle... those really just look like normal dog paw prints..."
"—Wise! A true master detective pays attention to every detail!"
"Pays attention to detail? So you can chase after them and make me ask the owner, 'Can I pet your dog?'"
"...That's just an older brother's job!"

3300020.name: Time for Afternoon Tea
3300020.desc: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
3300020.desc2:
"Ta-da! This is the guestbook everyone signed after the tea party we hosted last time! Let's read it together, Wise~"
"Sure. Though... 'Baby, you're a little blueberry!'... What's that supposed to mean?"
"Hmm... I think they're saying the afternoon tea outfit I picked for you was adorable!"
"What? Are you really calling your big brother adorable? Surely you're way cuter, Belle? You don't even need an outfit to be a little blueberry."

3301001.name: "The Other Side"
3301001.desc: A birthday gift for a Proxy.
3301001.desc2: Wishing the most amazing Proxy and the greatest video store manager in New Eridu — and my {M#brother}{F#sister} a happy birthday!

3301003.name: "You Sure Are Awesome, Purr~"
3301003.desc2: Proof of being a good citizen with the image of the only mascot of Public Security imprinted — from the number of people who have these, it seems like Officer Mewmew thinks there are no bad citizens.

3301004.name: Popular Freebie
3301004.desc2: A freebie from "The Ridu Tour" magazine... Considering how a reader has to buy the full volume to get this freebie, each one signifies an impressive profit for the magazine raked in by this event.

3301005.name: BFF Best Friends Forever!
3301005.desc: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with McDonald's Mainland China.
3301005.desc2:
No matter where you are, you can recall the BFFs you used to share fried chicken with when you order a BFF Platter.
Perhaps we may part ways in life, but our friendship and memories will forever be hot, juicy, and crispy, just like fried chicken!

3301006.name: Gulliver, Reporting In
3301006.desc: A namecard reward for Version 1.4 "A Storm of Falling Stars" pre-registration event.
3301006.desc2:
Allow me to introduce the liaison officer dispatched by Section 6 for this special commission.
Its gaze is bright, it's got a steady and precise shot, it's steady and meticulous, and friendly and reliable. It is... Agent Gulliver!

3301007.name: "Fight On!"
3301007.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Bangboo vs Ethereal."
Limited-time reward.
3301007.desc2:
"En-nah, neh! (Bad Ethereal, eat my kick!)"
—Visual recording from the Marcel Group's Combat Bangboo Examination, featured examinee: Nutty.

3301008.name: Assistant Director Pass
3301008.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Springtime Snapshots."
Limited-time reward.
3301008.desc2:
Your Assistant Director Trial Card has arrived! Clapperboard? Check. Megaphone? Charged. Monitor? In position!
With the spring breeze in the air and the sunlight just right, friends are stepping into the spotlight — "Action!"

3301009.name: "Instant Trigger"
3301009.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Soul of Steel: Golden Bond."
Limited-time reward.
3301009.desc2: We each have our own duty to protect, and our own reasons to fight. Even as the heavy iron fist falls, it can't erase the heart that shines with golden resolve.

3301010.name: A Special Day
3301010.desc: A birthday gift for a Proxy.
3301010.desc2:
This might not be much of a surprise, since we all know it always comes, year after year.
Even so, it's best not to disturb Eous' rehearsal! If the launch angle isn't just right, it could end up knocking over those expensive, fragile, discontinued VHS tapes...

3301011.name: Delicious Light
3301011.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time collab event "Operation Yum."
Limited-time reward.
3301011.desc2:
Is there perhaps a world made from the ground up with simple, classic, and delicious food?
And at the center of this world, the us of the past, without worries or troubles.

3301012.name: Dopamine Vacation Plan
3301012.desc: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with Fanta.
3301012.desc2:
The ideal vacation plan includes many activities: meals with friends, pleasant walks, and peaceful moments of rest...
The one thing you need for all of it is a can of Fanta — pop the tab and let orange joy burst and flow through your holiday!

3301013.name: Rhythm Raver
3301013.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Rhythm Rave."
Limited-time reward.
3301013.desc2:
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the rave~
We irresponsibly promise to help you leave all your daily woes behind and let your true self run wild! Feel free to share your deepest thoughts with our staff — even if you're a Bangboo complaining about your owner. We promise to forget it immediately.

3301014.name: Project Shining Hollow
3301014.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "SNAP! Shining Strike."
Limited-time reward.
3301014.desc2:
Click-click-click! The Ethereals quake in fear!
Click-click-click! His name resounds through every Hollow!
Everyone, join me in giving a cheer and thunderous applause to the one and only Ethereal Terminator, the Hollow savior, Mr. Click!

3301015.name: "To Be Continued"
3301015.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Neo Golden Mecha."
Limited-time reward.
3301015.desc2:
To give wings to an unfinished dream, waiting for it to become a shooting star beneath the night sky. To boast before my younger, naive self, swearing I'd witness the brightest dawn.
And when I look back, that golden dream still stands, watching beyond the horizon — we never truly left our childhood behind.
"Golden Mecha, stand tall upon the earth!"

3301016.name: Sparkling Wonderland
3301016.desc: 2025 Zenless Zone Zero FES commemorative namecard.
3301016.desc2:
After receiving more than a few enthusiastic invitations, the Proxy siblings showed up right on time at "The Best Sounding Spot in New Eridu."
What they didn't expect was to become the stars of the audience — after all, not many fans have lightsticks that glow in every performer's color at a joint concert.

3301017.name: Sān-Z: Undying Spark
3301017.desc: Commemorative namecard for the limited-time event "Filmgoer Thank-You Gift."
3301017.desc2:
"From that very first spark, we've blazed a path across the world — but this is nowhere near the end. As long as the fire in our chests keeps dancing, the story doesn't end."
"We hope you'll stay with us on the journey to come. Let's set off together and light up the next chapter of New Eridu!"
— Sān-Z STUDIO

3301018.name: Maze Exit
3301018.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Joint Investigation: The Divine Maze."
Limited-time reward.
3301018.desc2: The joint investigation into the Divine Maze has finally wrapped up. Thanks to the efforts of our Agents, the squad broke through Papago's maze and fulfilled HAND's request. Yet from the eerie sounds at the Hollow's entrance to the sudden return of old shadows, every unanswered mystery hints at one thing — the end of this case might just be the beginning.

3301019.name: The Shape of Delusion
3301019.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Angels of Delusion Training in Progress."
Limited-time reward.
3301019.desc2:
The girls seize their imaginings the way you'd lift a naughty kitten, tracing the outlines to give them shape... clumsy, soft curves that stack together like building blocks you can form into anything.
During their time with the "assistant," those blocks piled higher and higher, becoming charming stages and castles... and with a bright melody underfoot, they stepped upward, turning everyday life into a tiny musical.

3301020.name: Deliciousness Ready to Roll
3301020.desc: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with Hormel.
3301020.desc2:
Clear skies and bright sunshine put everyone in a good mood. It's the perfect time for a little outdoor escapade.
Grab a couple of friends and share some tasty, easygoing moments together.
Take off on a spontaneous outing — deliciousness is ready to roll!

3301021.name: A Perfect Story on Screen
3301021.desc2:
A ticket stub from "Gravitational Storytime" that bears witness to time spent with someone important — time called "togetherness."
The Gilded Carrot Day screening story reaches a perfect ending, and the memories spun by "Gravity" will shine for all time.

3301022.name: Returning Photos to Dreams
3301022.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Adventure Footage Freeze Frame."
Limited-time reward.
3301022.desc2:
It carried his dreams and charged into the depths of the Hollow.
He gathered its memories in his hands, piecing together the scattered images of their adventures.

3301023.name: Pursuit of the Paranormal
3301023.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "A Look Into Ridu's Legends."
Limited-time reward.
3301023.desc2:
All the coordinates on the Ridu urban legend tour map have been woven together into one web address used only for urban legends.
"To those who came chasing urban legends, welcome to Spook Shack!" This is the first greeting every visitor sees after opening the link.

3301024.name: Stargazy (Improved)
3301024.desc: A birthday gift for a Proxy.
3301024.desc2:
Prepared by a local Bangboo chef based on a legendary recipe from the early days of Roscaelifer, this pastry tastes quite different from the original due to the recipe being lost to time, leaving everyone sighing in regret.
Legend says it once had a romantic name: "Stargazy."

Note: No Eous units were harmed during the making of this cake!

3301025.name: Delusion Support Project
3301025.desc: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with KFC.
3301025.desc2:
"I heard they're an incredibly famous brand — we absolutely can't mess this up! B—But why did they pick us in the first place...?"
"You must know, right, Xiao'Yu? Ms. Cecilia mentioned that a few days ago, you..."
"...Oh, I don't really know either! But I heard that once this project's finished, Sunna won't have to worry about lunch money ever again~"
"R—Really? Then that's another fixed group expense we can cut down on!!"
"—Wait, Sunna! Weren't we just saying we should figure out why they picked us first...?"

3301026.name: With Food Comes Fortune
3301026.desc: Commemorative namecard for the Operation Yum collab event.
3301026.desc2:
Marcel Group has rolled out an updated version of the taste Chip, and Bangboo can now distinguish the flavors of over a thousand different foods.
—Unfortunately, that still doesn't include the experimental dishes cooked up in your kitchen through pure "I reckon this'll work" logic.

3301027.name: Countless Nychthemerons
3301027.desc: Commemorative namecard for the limited-time event "Filmgoer Thank-You Gift."
3301027.desc2:
The wind weaves through winding streets as we wander beneath the endless sky.
We'll share midnight conversations with the stars, travel alongside the wandering sunlight, awaken the tranquil dawn, and herald the resounding fall of the moon.
The ever-turning cycle of day and night will remember our journey, and the stories we leave for tomorrow will ride the wind, becoming something eternal beyond the reach of time.

3301028.name: Summer Blaze Eternal
3301028.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Summer Waves Roll In."
Limited-time reward.
3301028.desc2: Summer, with its rising and falling tides, slips away in an instant. Yet its flames leave warmth upon the passing of time, ensuring the memories of these summer days never fade away.

3301029.name: Authentic Void Hunter Sketchbook
3301029.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "First-Generation Void Hunter Returns."
Limited-time reward.
3301029.desc2:
"But! That's what Belle and Wise look like~"
"I only added the tiniest bit of creative flair to make the picture more lively and expressive!"

3301030.name: Ding! Achievement Unlocked
3301030.desc: "Zenless Zone Zero Collector's Edition Physical Gift Box" commemorative namecard.
3301030.desc2:
Pop in the disc, grab a controller, and step back into a world of vibrant adventures!
Congratulations! You've unlocked the rarest achievement of all: "Champion Player."

3301031.name: Road to Platinum
3301031.desc: "Zenless Zone Zero Collector's Edition Physical Gift Box" commemorative namecard.
3301031.desc2: Every story along the way is worth remembering. That's why we keep chasing that final Platinum Trophy.

3301032.name: Miracle Winner
3301032.desc:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Phaethon's Grand Reveal of the Year."
Limited-time reward.
3301032.desc2:
"And now, it's time to reveal this year's winner of Best..."
"Nhe-hu... Ehn nha na! (Fairy, wait... This isn't an awards show this time!)"
"Understood. Now then, please welcome our lucky grand prize winner, New Eridu's one and only legendary Proxy of the Year, Phaethon."

3302001.name: Winding Roses
3302001.desc: Namecard reward from Hollow Zero Investigation License Level.
3302001.desc2: A gift from Hollow Zero that's impossible to refuse — if fortunate, the recipient will be surrounded by the scent of 'flowers' for the rest of their days.

3302002.name: Something Certain
3302002.desc: Namecard reward from Hollow Zero: Lost Void Investigation License Level.
3302002.desc2: "Here lies Alowyn. We may not know her past, but we know she is a friend." An inscription in memory of Alowyn. Beside it blooms a tiny flower.

3302003.name: Puppeteer's Letter
3302003.desc: Namecard reward from Hollow Zero: Lost Void Investigation License Level.
3302003.desc2:
The puppeteer pulling the strings in the Lost Void still lurks in the shadows... Only this strange letter tells of its presence, an invitation.
Give up control of your body and it shall give you the right to wander here... until your consciousness dissipates, until forever...

3302004.name: Thousand Wishes of Dawn
3302004.desc: A commemorative namecard from increasing the Suibian Temple Restoration Level in "As Time Passes: A Decade of Suibian Temple"
3302004.desc2:
