Every fold of the skyletter hides murmurs of the mortal world, bobbing and undulating on the horizon, until they vanish.
Once the night wind carries away the last glow of sunlight, the tides formed from heartbeats calm, people realize... Those unspoken blessings of peace and safe return have been read by the clouds countless times.

3302005.name: Savor the Thrill of Battle
3302005.desc: Commemorative namecard for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Glory."
3302005.desc2:
Whether you came out of the "Endless Tower" beaten down, cornered by endless enemies, or barely clinging to life...
Now's the time to celebrate your win. Stand tall and declare, "None of them were a match for me!"

3302006.name: Final Gambit
3302006.desc: Commemorative namecard for "Threshold Simulation: Branching Echoes."
3302006.desc2:
Explore every possible path in "Threshold Simulation," and watch long-buried secrets emerge from the mist.
Choose carefully, but never lose the courage to move forward.

3302007.name: Smash Through Everything!
3302007.desc: Commemorative namecard for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Tidal Wave."
3302007.desc2:
Whether treasure or enemies lie behind the wall doesn't matter. Just grab the weapon in your hand and smash everything to pieces!
Break through every obstacle, climb to the top of the tower, and soak in the cheers of victory!

3302008.name: Because Tomorrow Still Comes
3302008.desc: A commemorative namecard obtained by increasing the Central Computing Hub repair progress in "The Genius and the Miracle Chip!"
3302008.desc2:
"Then... I suppose it's time for us to say goodbye."
—"What is goodbye?"
"It's writing a long letter, filling it with all your memories and well wishes, and sending it toward tomorrow as you set off."
—"Then... we can also say — let's go!"

May we always have an endless past to draw from, and a tomorrow vast enough to dream freely toward.

3302009.name: Starforged Sword Song
3302009.desc: Earn a 2-Star rating in "Deadly Assault: Adversity Mode" to automatically unlock the limited-time namecard reward.
3302009.desc2:
The universe is boundless, and the stars shine beyond compare.
Here is where our journey begins, where we forge an immortal hymn with nothing but iron swords.

3311011.name: Anby's Namecard
3311011.desc: Get by unlocking Anby's Mindscape: Well-Disciplined
3311011.desc2:
A card with a core member of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
A movie OST plays upon calling this number. Anby sometimes likes to deliberately answer calls late so that everyone has a chance to listen to her favorite song.

3311021.name: Nekomata's Namecard
3311021.desc: Get by unlocking Nekomata's Mindscape: Curious Left Tail
3311021.desc2:
A card with the newest member of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
Every namecard handed out means another chance at landing an outstanding commission! Looking forward to this, the new member has diligently designed this namecard and even drawn a small bell in the corner.

3311031.name: Nicole's Namecard
3311031.desc: Get by unlocking Nicole's Mindscape: A Hare's Cunning
3311031.desc2:
A card with the manager of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
Contact this number right now? It is highly recommended that you disable all automatic debit services on your device prior to contacting this number.

3311041.name: Soldier 11's Namecard
3311041.desc: Get by unlocking Soldier 11's Mindscape: Elite Soldier
3311041.desc2:
A card with the lead striker from Obol Squad printed on it.
Using the contact info on this card to contact Soldier 11 naturally trips Defense Force systems, but it's also the most stable and efficient channel of communication — she has promised to always arrive on time.

3311051.name: Yidhari's Namecard
3311051.desc: Get by unlocking Yidhari's Mindscape: A Story Without an Audience
3311051.desc2:
A namecard printed with the image of Spook Shack contributor, Yidhari.
The card is one of a kind, made especially for a person she cares about. The back is particularly creative—
Alongside Yidhari's carefully handwritten name and contact details are what look like suction-like marks, the combined autograph of her "little ones"!

3311061.name: Corin's Namecard
3311061.desc: Get by unlocking Corin's Mindscape: Amateur Maid
3311061.desc2:
A card with a shy maid from Victoria Housekeeping printed on it.
At first, Corin diligently listed all the housekeeping services she provided. After being contacted a little too frequently, she was forced to also list the explicit prices of each service.

3311071.name: Caesar's Namecard
3311071.desc: Get by unlocking Caesar's Mindscape: Absolute Trust
3311071.desc2:
A namecard with the image of the safety consultant from Leaps and Bounds.
It looks very professional, meticulous, and thorough — if you can overlook that the last digit of the contact number was filled in with a pen. Seems like this safety consultant often needs help from a more meticulous friend.

3311081.name: Billy's Namecard
3311081.desc: Get by unlocking Billy's Mindscape: Teachings of the Starlight Knights
3311081.desc2:
A card with the combat intelligent construct of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
Clearly mimicking the style of the Starlight Knight's official card, even the anti-counterfeit protection is copied near exactly... It may be copied poorly, but it's still near exact.

3311091.name: Hoshimi Miyabi's Namecard
3311091.desc: Get by unlocking Hoshimi Miyabi's Mindscape: Martial Discipline
3311091.desc2:
A card with the image of HSO Section 6's Chief printed on it.
Completely useless when actually trying to get in contact — after all, communication from within Hollows is difficult — this card is, nonetheless, an immense honor to possess. Both sides are imprinted with elegant and ancient-looking patterns, but the image doesn't seem to have anything to do with the Hoshimi family.

3311101.name: Koleda's Namecard
3311101.desc: Get by unlocking Koleda's Mindscape: "Mind Your Own!"
3311101.desc2:
A card with the president of Belobog Heavy Industries printed on it.
A professional namecard is a must for any president — but not this one, which is for friends only. However, due to the president's busy schedule, the chance of getting through to her "friend hotline" is vanishingly slim.

3311111.name: Anton's Namecard
3311111.desc: Get by unlocking Anton's Mindscape: Rotational Training
3311111.desc2:
A card with the worksite overseer of Belobog Heavy Industries printed on it.
A friendly reminder to hold your phone slightly away from your ear when contacting the number on this card, unless you are well-prepared for the noise of the construction site and the thundering "bro."

3311121.name: Ben's Namecard
3311121.desc: Get by unlocking Ben's Mindscape: Careful Accounting
3311121.desc2:
A card with the head of finance of Belobog Heavy Industries printed on it.
The most commonly used namecard in all Belobog. Ben printed 4 separate backup phone numbers on it to ensure important affairs and remittance time can be promptly communicated.

3311131.name: Soukaku's Namecard
3311131.desc: Get by unlocking Soukaku's Mindscape: Attendance Meal Allowance
3311131.desc2:
A card with a member of Section 6 printed on it.
While having a lot of commemorative value, this card has almost no practical use. Even if Soukaku could actually be contacted with it, her "guardian" in the squad would once again filter out the commissions she can take on.

3311141.name: Lycaon's Namecard
3311141.desc: Get by unlocking Lycaon's Mindscape: Attendant Training
3311141.desc2:
A card with a Victoria Housekeeping attendant printed on it.
Very few clients ever receive a copy of this elegant, refined card. It symbolizes approval from a wolf Thiren, and can be thought of as a light pawprint upon the back of your hand.

3311151.name: Lucy's Namecard
3311151.desc: Get by unlocking Lucy's Mindscape: Ironfist Overseer
3311151.desc2:
A card with a Boar Thiren Overseer from Leaps and Bounds Express Services Co. printed on it.
This namecard has an exquisite texture and design from a Throne Quarter print shop. But currently its only use is in contacting the little boars roaming the Outer Ring for delivery.

3311161.name: Lighter's Namecard
3311161.desc: Get by unlocking Lighter's Mindscape: Mercenary Leader
3311161.desc2:
A card with the image of Leaps and Bounds Logistics Company's Hollow affairs consultant printed on it.
The edges of the card are charred and burned but luckily don't cover the prices. "Any fighting is guaranteed to be a good show," is also written on it... Is this really proper Hollow consulting?

3311171.name: Burnice's Namecard
3311171.desc: Get by unlocking Burnice's Mindscape: Optimistic by Nature
3311171.desc2:
A namecard with the image of the marketing consultant from Leaps and Bounds.
It looks like someone doodled over it. The handwriting on the contact details is very... wild. The names of many drinks are scribbled on the back, but there's a big circle drawn around the Nitro-Fuel, and a note that says "min 1 pack for delivery."

3311181.name: Grace's Namecard
3311181.desc: Get by unlocking Grace's Mindscape: Chief Mechanic
3311181.desc2:
A card with a Belobog Heavy Industries engineer printed on it.
To avoid being disturbed, Grace usually hands out random namecards with a special direct hotline to her "kid" that's most gifted at chatting... But don't worry. This card is not one of those.

3311191.name: Ellen's Namecard
3311191.desc: Get by unlocking Ellen's Mindscape: Overtime-Intolerant
3311191.desc2:
A card with an apathetic Victoria Housekeeping maid printed on it.
These namecards had to be "carefully" prepared under the watchful gaze of the head maid and a professional attendant. Besides handing these out to clients, some have also been given to classmates stuck in the same group project.

3311201.name: Asaba Harumasa's Namecard
3311201.desc: Get by unlocking Asaba Harumasa's Mindscape: White Lies
3311201.desc2:
A card with the image of a HSO Section 6 member printed on it.
This card has two printed editions with the only difference being the contact number. For one of these versions, the only thing that one will hear when calling is a notice that the number they have dialed does not exist... Apparently, most of the victims of this are the bigwigs at HSO.

3311211.name: Rina's Namecard
3311211.desc: Get by unlocking Rina's Mindscape: Head Maid's Specialty
3311211.desc2:
A card with a Victoria Housekeeping maid printed on it.
You can summon a gentle and beautiful maid with this namecard. But if you weren't the direct recipient... please come clean about it BEFORE drinking any coffee she serves~

3311221.name: Tsukishiro Yanagi's Namecard
3311221.desc: Get by unlocking Tsukishiro Yanagi's Mindscape: Tsukishiro Style Management
3311221.desc2:
A card with the image of HSO Section 6's Deputy Chief printed on it.
A valuable card that's considered a token of Section 6's friendship and commitment to the members of the HSO. Apart from contact information, it also carefully lists various means of seeking assistance in emergencies.

3311241.name: Zhu Yuan's Namecard
3311241.desc: Get by unlocking Zhu Yuan's Mindscape: Public Security Special Training
3311241.desc2:
A card with the image of the of the team leader of a Criminal Investigation Special Response Team of some department.
In theory, all Public Security Officers share a contact number that represents safety and responsibility, but the number on this card of Zhu Yuan's is her personal number.

3311251.name: Qingyi's Namecard
3311251.desc: Get by unlocking Qingyi's Mindscape: Drink Hot Water
3311251.desc2:
A card with an outstanding officer from the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team printed on it.
Hard currency within the NEPS. Possession of this namecard is equivalent to owning your own support force you can drop in at any minute, equally competent at evidence inspection or case analysis.

3311261.name: Jane's Namecard
3311261.desc: Get by unlocking Jane's Mindscape: Anonymity
3311261.desc2:
A card with a criminology specialist printed on it.
It's supposed to be a namecard, but there are no contact numbers on it... It isn't easy for anyone, no matter who, to get hold of that lady.

3311271.name: Seth's Namecard
3311271.desc: Get by unlocking Seth's Mindscape: Slow Reflexes
3311271.desc2:
A card with a rookie officer from the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team printed on it.
The NEPS standard namecard format is simple and clear. While taking the profile photo, Officer Seth was asked not to let his unkempt bangs cover up his ears.

3311281.name: Piper's Namecard
3311281.desc: Get by unlocking Piper's Mindscape: Truck Expert
3311281.desc2:
A card with a truck driver from Leaps and Bounds Express Services Co. printed on it.
The steadiest of hands whose delivery routes traverse the Hollows and the Outer Ring. Contact them for any long-distance deliveries — but please note, safety of fragile items cannot be guaranteed.

3311291.name: Hugo's Namecard
3311291.desc: Get by unlocking Hugo's Mindscape: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
3311291.desc2:
A card featuring the image of a famous phantom thief.
On the back, bold letters read: "The one and only in all of New Eridu", accompanied by a flamboyant handwritten signature.
After all, if everyone recognized this gentleman thief... he might be doomed to endlessly change identities on the ever-shifting stage of light and shadow.

3311301.name: Orphie & Magus' Namecard
3311301.desc: Get by unlocking Orphie & Magus' Mindscape: "Tactics Manual"
3311301.desc2:
A name card printed with the image of the gun-type Intelligent Construct Magus and her wielder, Orphie.
Name, rank, squad affiliation, contact details, all neatly laid out on this card. The precise formatting and carefully chosen content reflect the owner's serious personality.
But flip it over, and on the back... there's a red T. rex breathing fire, drawn in permanent marker?

3311311.name: Astra Yao's Namecard
3311311.desc: Get by unlocking Astra Yao's Mindscape: Interwoven Staff Notation
3311311.desc2:
A business card featuring the image of a glamorous superstar.
It's widely known that any number on a celebrity's card leads to an agent who answers like a programmed, automatic response. But if it's a card she hands to you personally... perhaps it's different?

3311321.name: Evelyn's Namecard
3311321.desc: Get by unlocking Evelyn's Mindscape: Metamorphosis
3311321.desc2:
A business card featuring the image of a not-too-famous security consultant.
For those ready to spend a small fortune on security, this clean and straightforward card symbolizes a second chance at life. Unfortunately, the well-reputed "Life Protection Service" is currently unavailable for purchase.

3311331.name: Vivian's Namecard
3311331.desc: Get by unlocking Vivian's Mindscape: "Another and the Same"
3311331.desc2:
A namecard printed with a photo of Mockingbird's versatile assistant, Vivian.
Mockingbird's business cards have never circulated publicly — if one were placed in a private auction, collectors would surely bid fiercely for it.
There's no contact information on this card, yet it's said that anyone who holds it won't have to wait long before the graceful and mysterious assistant finds them — through a method they'd never anticipate.

3311341.name: Zhao's Namecard
3311341.desc: Get by unlocking Zhao's Mindscape: Frostveil Blade
3311341.desc2:
A namecard printed with an adorable bunny Thiren's image.
It's got that classic Krampus Compliance Authority style — neat, professional, and packed with phone numbers... everything from Krampus' legal hotline to their complaint desk. But on the back, there's a handwritten note and a single number:
"Forget those numbers. Call this one if you want to reach me."

3311351.name: Pulchra's Namecard
3311351.desc: Get by unlocking Pulchra's Mindscape: Territorial
3311351.desc2:
A card featuring an image of the former Outer Ring mercenary now working for Leaps and Bounds logistics company.
It's the standard business card used by employees of Leaps and Bounds, but on the back, there's a line of text: "Private services available." Apparently, while others' got their cards slow, this one was printed twice in the first month.

3311361.name: Trigger's Namecard
3311361.desc2:
A card featuring an image of the Obol Squad sniper.
In addition to the contact information printed on the card, there is a neatly handwritten list of backup contacts, emergency contacts, final emergency contacts, code words to use in case of danger, and several commonly used Morse codes for requesting help. She seems truly afraid of losing contact with you.

3311371.name: Yixuan's Namecard
3311371.desc: Get by unlocking Yixuan's Mindscape: Cycle of Yin and Yang
3311371.desc2:
A card imprinted with the image of Yunkui Summit's Yixuan, also identifying her as a Special Investigator with the Hollow Investigative Association.
Yixuan Shifu is apparently quite elusive, and only a fated few ever receive her guidance. Who knows — this card might be your invitation into the sect.

3311381.name: Soldier 0 - Anby's Namecard
3311381.desc: Get by unlocking Soldier 0 - Anby's Mindscape: Past Glory
3311381.desc2:
A card featuring the unfamiliar image of a friend.
In this city, who doesn't have secrets or a past they prefer to keep hidden? Perhaps we don't need to cross that line; in the long, cold nights, we can still find warmth in each other.

3311391.name: Ju Fufu's Namecard
3311391.desc: Get by unlocking Ju Fufu's Mindscape: Righteous Young Hero
3311391.desc2:
A card imprinted with the image of Yunkui Summit's most senior disciple.
Instead of dialing her number, the sect's exclusive voice-transmission technique calls a disciple in an instant. So beyond the contact details, it even includes the incantation to call the "super scary big tiger":
Senior, Shifu has been kidnapped by Ethereals!

3311401.name: Alice's Namecard
3311401.desc: Get by unlocking Alice's Mindscape: Symmetrism
3311401.desc2:
A name card bearing the image of the heiress of the Thymefield family.
Many high-society figures have tried to get their hands on this noble family's contact info, only to end up with a "business card" that's all symmetry and no number. But this one's special... it has the young lady's name written in graceful script, plus a cute, perfectly symmetrical doodle of a bunny — showing just how much she values the person receiving it.

3311411.name: Ukinami Yuzuha's Namecard
3311411.desc: Get by unlocking Ukinami Yuzuha's Mindscape: Fairytale of the Haunted City.
3311411.desc2:
A business card from Mystic Wares, with Ukinami Yuzuha's name and phone number handwritten on the back.
Call the number, and you'll be greeted by Baorong's deep, booming voice as the custom ringtone. It's a bit startling, but according to Yuzuha, it's not a prank — it's just an effective way to fend off telemarketers.

3311421.name: Pan Yinhu's Namecard
3311421.desc: Get by unlocking Pan Yinhu's Mindscape: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
3311421.desc2:
A namecard featuring Yunkui Summit's official chef.
To street vendors, it's the bargaining chip the clever Panda Thiren uses, to seasoned foodies, it's a limited-edition ticket to a meet-and-greet with the mysterious master chef, and to the struggling masses, it's a lifeline left by the Yunkui disciple determined to put others first.

3311431.name: Ye Shunguang's Namecard
3311431.desc: Get by unlocking Ye Shunguang's Mindscape: Swordswoman
3311431.desc2:
A namecard bearing the image of Ye Shunguang.
This card never circulates publicly; it's said that only a select few "fated recipients" ever obtain one. Possessing it grants a one-time "Void Hunter assistance."
On the back is a hand-drawn doodle of a face and a line of neat handwriting:
"No matter when... if you ever need me, just come find me. If I can help, I'd be happy to!"

3311441.name: Komano Manato's Namecard
3311441.desc: Get by unlocking Komano Manato's Mindscape: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
3311441.desc2:
A card printed with an image of Sailume Bay's unofficial mediator.
This business card can smooth over a number of minor issues, but its use is limited to certain areas of Waifei Peninsula. During Manato's make-up exams, the card functions merely as a simple referral.
A sketch of a "grand and imposing" canine Thiren was drawn on the back, though in crayon, making it feel a little less threatening.

3311451.name: Lucia's Namecard
3311451.desc: Get by unlocking Lucia's Mindscape: The Best Partner
3311451.desc2:
A name card featuring the Night Emissary's image.
While exploring a Hollow on the edge of the city, the Investigative Association stumbled upon this card. It had been placed deep within an Ethereal nest, with a doodle of a witch brandishing her staff sketched on the back.
"At first we thought it was some kind of distress signal, but later realized it really was just a business card... Seriously, who in the world would hand something like that to an Ethereal?!"

3311461.name: Seed's namecard
3311461.desc: Get by unlocking Seed's Mindscape: "A Story of Sprouting"
3311461.desc2:
A card printed with the image of Obol Squad's heavy weapons specialist.
It carries a faint floral scent, but no name, no contact info, nothing remotely helpful — only a few indecipherable doodles and notes that look like the owner scrawled them at random. Whether it's a major company eager to learn the secrets behind her inventions or a military official furious about being blindsided by a giant mech, no one's reaching her through this card.
If the scent of flowers suddenly grows stronger while you're reading the card, take a look around — you might just find a girl nearby who looks like a water sprite. When someone truly piques her interest, she just shows up on her own.

3311471.name: Banyue's Namecard
3311471.desc: Get by unlocking Banyue's Mindscape: Ignorance Binds Like Chains
3311471.desc2:
A name card with the image of Banyue, a newly appointed Krampus Judge and head of a martial arts school.
The design is plain, but it bears a distinctive and solid weight.
On the back, Banyue's name is engraved with the bold strength of a blade and chisel.

3311481.name: Dialyn's Namecard
3311481.desc: Get by unlocking Dialyn's Mindscape: Call from the Hollow
3311481.desc2:
A name card bearing the image of Dialyn, the Krampus Judge and TOPS customer service representative.
Dialyn receives countless calls every workday, but the special number printed on this card can be reached by only one person.

3311491.name: Sunna's Namecard
3311491.desc: Get by unlocking Sunna's Mindscape: "Transformation Apple"
3311491.desc2:
A namecard featuring Sunna from the Angels of Delusion.
The background weaves together mint green and pebble white, accented with peach-pink lace patterns. With such an adorable card, its owner must be just like this soft pastel stock — evoking thoughts of a fresh summer day.

3311501.name: Aria's Namecard
3311501.desc: Get by unlocking Aria's Mindscape: Delulu
3311501.desc2:
A namecard featuring Aria, the Angels of Delusion's lead vocalist.
A beloved collectible among Delulus, calling the number printed on the card plays the Angels of Delusion's newest track, and after connecting, you can also look up details on their recent and upcoming shows.

3311511.name: Nangong Yu's Namecard
3311511.desc: Get by unlocking Nangong Yu's Mindscape: Chips on the Scales
3311511.desc2:
A card with the Angels of Delusion's captain, Nangong Yu printed on it.
It features a classic black background with gold foil stamping and faint wing patterns embossed along the edges. When you call, you'll hear the sweet voice of a staff member handling the Angels of Delusion's business inquiries. But rumor has it there's a tiny chance the Angels' captain herself might pick up...

3311521.name: Cissia's Namecard
3311521.desc: Get by unlocking Cissia's Mindscape: Chains and a Warm Nest
3311521.desc2:
A card with the Public Security case specialist Cissia printed on it.
Other than the official formatting and Public Security emblem, it also bears two faint tooth marks.

3311531.name: Starlight - Billy's Namecard
3311531.desc: Get by unlocking Starlight - Billy's Mindscape: Knight's Chivalry
3311531.desc2:
A card printed with an image of Knight Billy and his upgraded armaments.
A special, customised Starlight Knight official fan's namecard. Though real heroes need no anti-counterfeit proof, there is indeed a gilded one on the card... This hero, however, is a familiar yet unfamiliar one.

3311541.name: Promeia's Namecard
3311541.desc: Get by unlocking Promeia's Mindscape: Cruel Moonlight
3311541.desc2:
A namecard featuring Krampus Judge Promeia.
Aside from her name and position within Krampus, the namecard appears completely blank. Holding it brings a calm, cool sensation.

3311561.name: Velina's Namecard
3311561.desc: Get by unlocking Velina's Mindscape: Conquest by Etiquette
3311561.desc2:
A business card bearing the image of the Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department.
Its design is elegant and restrained, with clean lines and not a trace of unnecessary flourish — neither overly familiar to the point of impropriety, nor so cold as to create a sense of distance. Every detail strikes a perfect balance. Among the elite of Roscaelifer, owning one is considered a mark of pride.
But when an ordinary video store owner accepts it as part of a routine exchange, they discover something unexpected — beneath the card lies another one. Written in neat, graceful handwriting is a private number, separate from the public line.
So... is this, too, some unspoken form of "special treatment"?

3311571.name: Norma's Namecard
3311571.desc: Get by unlocking Norma's Mindscape: Natural-Born Villain Paradox
3311571.desc2:
A business card bearing the image of Norma, Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department.
Specially designed for high-ranking department officials, the card's elaborate decorative patterns also function as physical watermarks. Yet the space intended for a serious professional photo is instead covered with playful Bangboo scribbles.

3311581.name: Remielle's Namecard
3311581.desc: Get by unlocking Remielle's Mindscape: The Garden of Diverging Time
3311581.desc2:
A card with one of the first-generation Void Hunters, who is also a former Lieutenant Colonel of the Guard of Staves, printed on it.
Its vintage typography and layout make it look like a prop misplaced from the set of an old film.
The number printed on the card is no longer in service, and the listed address also disappeared long ago. Just as its owner says, it serves no practical purpose. Yet this slender slip of paper carries the weight of an entire era.

3311591.name: Sigrid's Namecard
3311591.desc: Get by unlocking Sigrid's Mindscape: Protector of Miracles
3311591.desc2:
A card with Sigrid, Deputy Director of the Airspace Patrol Department, printed on it.
The Airspace Patrol Department's namecards are simple yet dignified, much like the way its officers conduct themselves. Sigrid's portrait is rendered in meticulous detail, down to every strand of hair.

3321011.name: "Ending Theme"
3321011.desc: Get by unlocking Anby's Mindscape: Charging Field
3321011.desc2:
A card with Anby's personal photo printed on it.
"What am I listening to? Hmm, it's a fantastic ending theme..."
"It's from the movie we watched together last time... When I thought you were secretly crying."

3321021.name: "Patience of a Cat"
3321021.desc: Get by unlocking Nekomata's Mindscape: Predator Lineage
3321021.desc2:
A card with Nekomata's personal photo printed on it.
"Meow~! Are you sure~ you don't want to play with me? I've been waiting all this time, meow—"
"You know what it means when a cat slaps its tail against the ground, right—meow?"

3321031.name: "Precise Focus"
3321031.desc: Get by unlocking Nicole's Mindscape: Corrupting Energy Field
3321031.desc2:
A card with Nicole's personal photo printed on it.
"Quick, check out this one! Pretty sweet, huh... Don't I look totally delicate and cute?"
"Did I not get the Bangboo charm you picked out in frame? Oh, it's a little out of focus... Better take another shot!"

3321041.name: "Trust Your Life"
3321041.desc: Get by unlocking Soldier 11's Mindscape: Scorching Flow
3321041.desc2:
A card with Soldier 11's personal photo printed on it.
"My loyalty belongs solely to the Defense Force..."
"But as a mutually-recognized comrade-in-arms, I can entrust my life to you."

3321051.name: One of a Kind
3321051.desc: Get by unlocking Yidhari's Mindscape: At Last, a Peaceful Dream
3321051.desc2:
A card with Yidhari's personal photo printed on it.
"From the moment I saw your eyes in that illusion, I understood..."
"After that, I no longer feared my mind would be consumed by the void, nor that I would be lost to the abyss."
"Because within the illusion, I found the one and only reality I could look to."

3321061.name: "Good Friends"
3321061.desc: Get by unlocking Corin's Mindscape: Accumulated Release
3321061.desc2:
A card with Corin's personal photo printed on it.
"{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} P—Proxy, you w—wanna know about my teddy bear?"
"This is my good friend... N—No, it's not like you. Y—You are..."

3321071.name: "After the Battle"
3321071.desc: Get by unlocking Caesar's Mindscape: Overlord's Will
3321071.desc2:
A card with Caesar's personal photo printed on it.
"Let's go, Proxy. The trouble here's been dealt with... but could you help me put on some medicine?"
"I'm the boss! I don't wanna make everyone worry..."

3321081.name: "Perfect Pose"
3321081.desc: Get by unlocking Billy's Mindscape: Starlight Hero
3321081.desc2:
A card with Billy's personal photo printed on it.
"Proxy! How'd ya like my perfect pose... Hey hey hey, c'mon now! I say, c'mon now — I can't hold this all day! Ah!"
"Didja geddit, didja geddit? Did you manage to get my high-density alloy abs in the shot?"

3321091.name: "Today's Training"
3321091.desc: Get by unlocking Hoshimi Miyabi's Mindscape: Prodigious Talent
3321091.desc2:
A card with a personal photo of Hoshimi Miyabi printed on it.
"Would you mind lending me a hand? I may have... overdone it on today's training."
"It's not an issue with sword swinging training... Alright, well, the thirty-fifth corrupted... it was tougher than expected."

3321101.name: "Pink Bear"
3321101.desc: Get by unlocking Koleda's Mindscape: Saturated Blast
3321101.desc2:
A card with Koleda's personal photo printed on it.
"Hey, don't look at me like that — I'm not a kid looking to be pitied!"
"What? What's wrong with the pink bear bandaid..."

3321111.name: "Everyone Get Fired Up!"
3321111.desc: Get by unlocking Anton's Mindscape: Break the Limit
3321111.desc2:
A card with Anton's personal photo printed on it.
"Hey, bro! Everyone get fired up!"
"Don't exercise without warming up first, or you might get injured!"

3321121.name: "Careful Contemplation"
3321121.desc: Get by unlocking Ben's Mindscape: Wild Spirit
3321121.desc2:
A card with Ben's personal photo printed on it.
"Hmm? Do I look very serious right now?"
"I'm in a slight pickle... 26 Dennies are missing from last month's accounts, and I can't seem to figure out how..."

3321131.name: "Take a Break"
3321131.desc: Get by unlocking Soukaku's Mindscape: Northern Wind
3321131.desc2:
A card with Soukaku's personal photo printed on it.
"I'm just going to lie down for a bit. Just a little while longer..."
"I get tired so easily if I don't eat much for breakfast! I'll just rest a little while longer..."

3321141.name: "Thank You For Requesting Me"
3321141.desc: Get by unlocking Lycaon's Mindscape: Ruthless Hunter
3321141.desc2:
A card with Lycaon's personal photo printed on it.
"Proxy? Could you assist me in tying this bandage..."
"Very well... A little tighter... It shan't hurt. It must be tight to prevent injuries."

3321151.name: "Little Boars, Coming Right Up"
3321151.desc: Get by unlocking Lucy's Mindscape: Fierce Fangs of Fire
3321151.desc2:
A card with Lucy's personal photo printed on it.
"Want this little boar doll? Then come and get it yourself..."
"I finally found a comfortable position, and I'm not moving from it."

3321161.name: "Black Boxing Gloves"
3321161.desc: Get by unlocking Lighter's Mindscape: Survivor
3321161.desc2:
A card with Lighter's photo printed on it.
"If you need any help that you'd rather your more... 'honest' friends not find out about, just hit me up."
"I'll deal with it and make sure no one gets away to continue harassing you."

3321171.name: "An Invitation or Provocation?"
3321171.desc: Get by unlocking Burnice's Mindscape: Burning Invitation
3321171.desc2:
A card with Burnice's personal photo printed on it.
"I decided before leaving that today, we drink until dawn!"
"Lemme think... considering your performance before... let's start with five cups of Nitro-Fuel as a warmup!"

3321181.name: "A Promise Unbroken"
3321181.desc: Get by unlocking Grace's Mindscape: Detonation Trigger
3321181.desc2:
A card with Grace's personal photo printed on it.
"Sometimes I want to just pull apart someone as interesting as you to see what makes you tick..."
"Don't worry. I wouldn't do that though... I'd be beside myself if any parts got lost!"

3321191.name: "I'll Take Care of It"
3321191.desc: Get by unlocking Ellen's Mindscape: The Feast Begins
3321191.desc2:
A card with Ellen's personal photo printed on it.
"Tsk, that sounds like a real pain..."
"What am I to do with you... As a friend, I'll take care of that thing you mentioned. But in exchange, you'll help me out at the next parent-teacher meeting... Okay?"

3321201.name: "Feathered Blade Approaching"
3321201.desc: Get by unlocking Asaba Harumasa's Mindscape: Tacit Understanding
3321201.desc2:
A card with Asaba Harumasa's personal picture printed on it.
"Ahem... I'm not one of those powerful recon soldiers, agile and able to travel thousands of miles for a surprise strike..."
"But my arrows are pretty fast, hm... Probably faster than anything that would attempt to take your life."

3321211.name: "The Truth"
3321211.desc: Get by unlocking Rina's Mindscape: Stormy Night's Fright
3321211.desc2:
A card with Rina's personal photo printed on it.
"You can trust me completely... Your wish is my command~"
"Wish! Wish!" "Command! Command!"

3321221.name: "Final Emergency Plan"
3321221.desc: Get by unlocking Tsukishiro Yanagi's Mindscape: Inhuman Blood
3321221.desc2:
A card with Tsukishiro Yanagi's personal photo printed on it.
"Though I'd like to make a cool promise, something like: No matter what danger you're in, please place your trust in Section 6!"
"But I think for most people, it's more fortunate if they never need to contact us."

3321241.name: "Justice and Order"
3321241.desc: Get by unlocking Zhu Yuan's Mindscape: Expanded Energy Pack III
3321241.desc2:
A card with Zhu Yuan's personal photo printed on it.
"Be it the NEPS or the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, they both exist to preserve justice and order."
"As do I."

3321251.name: "Drink Hot Water"
3321251.desc: Get by unlocking Qingyi's Mindscape: Eight Meridians
3321251.desc2:
A card with Qingyi's personal photo printed on it.
"Good morning! Are you looking for a water bottle?"
"If you can't find one, why don't you take this flask with you?"

3321261.name: "Anonymity"
3321261.desc: Get by unlocking Jane's Mindscape: "Shady" Technique
3321261.desc2:
A card with Jane's personal photo printed on it.
"Don't you think that's interesting — getting a namecard from a nameless person?"
"But there's a way to get hold of me on it, anyway — whether you believe it or not~"

3321271.name: "Leave It To Me"
3321271.desc: Get by unlocking Seth's Mindscape: Idealist
3321271.desc2:
A card with Seth's personal photo printed on it.
"I'm going to be the best officer of them all!"
"Ow! Even if it's something as basic as soothing a cat... Just leave it to me! Yeowch!"

3321281.name: "Taste in Shows"
3321281.desc: Get by unlocking Piper's Mindscape: Mild Excitement
3321281.desc2:
A card with Piper's personal photo printed on it.
"Ha... I'm not young like you, and I'm getting tired already."
"Let's listen to something interesting so we don't get exhausted from driving... How about the Ridu Lucky Star?"

3321291.name: Conspirator
3321291.desc: Get by unlocking Hugo's Mindscape: Crown of Thorns
3321291.desc2:
A card featuring a private photo of Hugo.
"All cursed crowns will eventually shatter into stars."
"Now, allow me to invite you to leap with me — into this mist filled with thorns and flowers."

3321301.name: Peach-Flavored Flash Suppressor
3321301.desc: Get by unlocking Orphie & Magus' Mindscape: Magic Seed
3321301.desc2:
A business card printed with a private photo of Orphie & Magus.
"I've got another secret to share... Actually, Magus really likes being around you too, Proxy!"
"Orphys, I'll be more mindful of how I talk from now on, okay? So stop talking, and take this pink ribbon off me too!"

3321311.name: Firelight Palm
3321311.desc: Get by unlocking Astra Yao's Mindscape: We Are the World
3321311.desc2:
A card with a personal photo of Astra Yao.
"The criteria for choosing gems? It's certainly not boring numbers like clarity, craftsmanship, or weight~"
"But if you're too shy to even look me in the eye, how would you ever know the real reason they're being given to you?"

3321321.name: Impromptu Combat Practice
3321321.desc: Get by unlocking Evelyn's Mindscape: Bond of Light and Shadow
3321321.desc2:
A card featuring a personal photo of Evelyn.
"Of course, I'll stay on guard... Wait, do you mean to say because I'm unarmed, I'm completely defenseless right now?"
"Hmm, want to spar? Right now — I'll give you three seconds to get ready before I have you pinned on that couch."

3321331.name: Love Like a Bouquet
3321331.desc2:
A namecard featuring a private photo of Vivian.
"How should I describe you...? You are like the mist at midnight, the wind on a clear day, the shimmering light on water, like... everything I adore."
"I cherish this moment... because, right now, in your eyes, there is only me."

3321341.name: "Non-Business Card"
3321341.desc: Get by unlocking Zhao's Mindscape: No Value Has Its Own Value
3321341.desc2:
A card featuring a personal photo of Zhao.
"Why... would you even want something like this? In terms of actual value, it's less useful than my employee ID..."
"A keepsake? Well... okay. As long as you like it. But you're not allowed to take it outside, alright?"
"Not even my coworkers have seen this photo."

3321351.name: Moment of Vulnerability
3321351.desc: Get by unlocking Pulchra's Mindscape: Behind the Mask
3321351.desc2:
A card featuring a private photo of Pulchra.
"What, it's the first time you're seeing my nose? Ah, right. When we go to restaurants, I always lift my mask a little from the bottom to eat."
"Is a Thiren's nose moist like a real cat's? Why do you ask? Uhh... I suppose so. That's why wearing the mask helps keep my nose healthy."

3321361.name: The Bloom of Asphodels
3321361.desc: Get by unlocking Trigger's Mindscape: Beyond the River of the Dead
3321361.desc2:
A card featuring a private photo of Trigger.
"Proxy, please come a little closer... close enough that you won't slip through my fingers."
"I want to remember the outline of the person who trusted me with their back... Is this selfish? If it is, then let me be a little selfish."

3321371.name: "Clarity of Mind"
3321371.desc: Get by unlocking Yixuan's Mindscape: Swift Yet Still
3321371.desc2:
A namecard featuring a private photo of Yixuan.
"A mystic must safeguard a pure mind, free from distractions at all times."
"That should be simple enough for you... but if you don't yet know how, I'm happy to teach you."
"As your Shifu, tell me what you wish to learn, and I'll teach you without reservation."

3321381.name: Gelatin Silver Dance
3321381.desc: Get by unlocking Soldier 0 - Anby's Mindscape: Prequel Protagonist
3321381.desc2:
A card with Soldier 0 - Anby's personal photo printed on it.
"Proxy, between a sequel and a prequel, which do you think has a higher chance of becoming a flop?"
"...I see. I'm curious as well... about the days before you became who you are today."

3321391.name: "Super Scary Big Tiger"
3321391.desc: Get by unlocking Ju Fufu's Mindscape: Roar of My Inner Tiger
3321391.desc2:
"Speckled tails of clouds unfurl like ancient manuscripts, while blossoms of flame issue commands like a tiger-tally."
"Such majestic might it seems to shake down the moon atop the mountain, and an aura that would level caves beneath the earth."
—Composed by the awe-inspiring and caring Senior of Yunkui Summit.

3321401.name: Within Her Heterochromatic Gaze
3321401.desc: Get by unlocking Alice's Mindscape: A Heart of Thyme
3321401.desc2:
A card printed with a personal photo of Alice.
"Hey... can you take a look at me? My asymmetrical eyes... do they look weird?"
"No? Then why did you instinctively look away...? Keep your eyes on me."
"I can see myself reflected in your pupils. So maybe if we keep making eye contact like this... I'll learn to feel okay about it."

3321411.name: Proof of Companionship
3321411.desc: Get by unlocking Ukinami Yuzuha's Mindscape: Put Down Roots.
3321411.desc2:
A student ID card with Ukinami Yuzuha's name and photo. It was retired when the school upgraded to chip-based cards.
"Even though we've got new IDs, the school's pretty lax — most of us still use both. With this, you could walk right in like you're one of us. I've actually always wanted to see what it'd be like to be classmates for a day."

3321421.name: "Greater Hermit of the City"
3321421.desc: Get by unlocking Pan Yinhu's Mindscape: Meridian Theory
3321421.desc2:
A card with Pan Yinhu's personal photo printed on it.
"Uh... did I just nod off? So all of that was just a dream..."
"...It's fine. I just dreamed I got legendary-grade cookware and used it to save the world."
"Besides, using the mystic arts to keep the peace here isn't really any different."

3321431.name: Another Self
3321431.desc: Get by unlocking Ye Shunguang's Mindscape: Lantern Wish
3321431.desc2:
A namecard printed with one of Ye Shunguang's personal photos.
"On that bleak, lightless path, there was another version of 'me' at my side..."
"...But now, we're unified."
"'We' will treasure the memories of our past... and the memories of you."

3321441.name: The First Safehouse
3321441.desc: Get by unlocking Komano Manato's Mindscape: Beyond Dreams of the Past
3321441.desc2:
A card with Komano Manato's personal photo printed on it.
"This safehouse was the first shelter I set up for myself when I was eight."
"Even though I used to say silly stuff like 'I don't need any friends,' somehow... I think I still believed I'd be sharing this place with someone one day."
"Looks like I've got some bandages left from before. Proxy, hold on, I'll patch this up real quick... ngh!"

3321451.name: The Story Continues
3321451.desc: Get by unlocking Lucia's Mindscape: The Never-Ending Journey
3321451.desc2:
A card with Lucia's personal photo printed on it.
"Alright, sun's almost up, so that's it for tonight's Night Emissary lesson..."
"You want to know more, and what happens next?"
"Sure! Every night at midnight, second-floor windowsill of the Sixth Street video shop — be there or be square!"

3321461.name: Pale Blue Flower of Sorrow
3321461.desc: Get by unlocking Seed's Mindscape: "Theory of the Heart"
3321461.desc2:
A card printed with a private photo of Seed.
"Guess the cockpit is still a bit too small for both of us... Stop squirming around, Proxy.
"Now I'm going to dim the lights... Keep your eyes closed until I say so!
"Okay... Proxy, promise me you won't freak out no matter what you see..."
"...Check out this bioluminescent flower — I found it in the Hollow, it's a brand-new species~ Let's come up with a name for it together~"

3321471.name: No Way Back
3321471.desc: Get by unlocking Banyue's Mindscape: Descended Vidyaraja
3321471.desc2:
A card with Banyue's personal photo printed on it.
"Desire burns like fire, hatred cuts like a blade, and ignorance binds like chains..."
"I was once trapped by fate and doubt..."
"But now, nothing clouds my mind."

3321481.name: Meet With Me
3321481.desc: Get by unlocking Dialyn's Mindscape: Truth
3321481.desc2:
A card with Dialyn's personal photo printed on it.
"Hearing your voice always lifts my mood more than anyone else's~"
"But instead of guessing your mood through the phone..."
"I'd rather see you in person, standing right here before me."

3321491.name: Teardrop Necklace
3321491.desc: Get by unlocking Sunna's Mindscape: "Hollow Big Bang"
3321491.desc2:
A card with Sunna's personal photo printed on it.
"In the story, the girl's lone tear gave shape to the necklace and returned rain to the entire kingdom."
"So does that mean a crybaby like me... might be able to do something that amazing someday?"

3321501.name: Kingdom of Delusion
3321501.desc: Get by unlocking Aria's Mindscape: Construct's Dream
3321501.desc2:
A card with Aria's personal photo printed on it.
"This song is dedicated to all of you! Every single Delulu!"
"If something's bothering you, maybe you could ask the great Wishing Sprite?"

3321511.name: Tear Gland Insurance
3321511.desc: Get by unlocking Nangong Yu's Mindscape: An Angel's Delusion
3321511.desc2:
A card with Nangong Yu's personal photo printed on it.
It has a distinct texture and gives off the faintest spicy scent that leaves the tip of your nose feeling warm.
"When tears need permission, this is the only switch."
"The real me, saved just for you."

3321521.name: Couch Royalty
3321521.desc: Get by unlocking Cissia's Mindscape: Home and Sixth Street
3321521.desc2:
A card with Cissia's personal photo printed on it.
Found wedged inside the couch cushions at the video store, with faint bite marks along the edge.
"This seat's taken. By one person only.
—Or I'll bite."

3321531.name: Hero Pose
3321531.desc: Get by unlocking Starlight - Billy's Mindscape: Starlight Knight
3321531.desc2:
A card with Starlight - Billy's personal photo printed on it.
"Fight like a hero! Charge ahead like a hero!"
"And of course, strike an epic hero-worthy pose too~"

3321541.name: The Only Option
3321541.desc: Get by unlocking Promeia's Mindscape: To Be Continued
3321541.desc2:
A card with Promeia's personal photo printed on it.
The face in the photo seems somewhat unnatural, with a faint hint of red hidden beneath the gray-blue tones.
"It was just a photo for leave approval."
"I didn't end up using it, so you can have it."

3321561.name: Beyond Etiquette
3321561.desc: Get by unlocking Velina's Mindscape: Chief Angel
3321561.desc2:
A card with Velina's personal photo printed on it.
"Your once-in-a-lifetime request was simply for this photograph? You needn't have gone to so much trouble. It's my pleasure."
"Then, it seems I'll have to reluctantly postpone my chance to earn a favor from the legendary Proxy Phaethon."
"Another picture? Certainly... no professional smile, you say? Hmm, noted."

3321571.name: En-Nah Time
3321571.desc: Get by unlocking Norma's Mindscape: The Primary Cause of Genius
3321571.desc2:
A card with Norma's personal photo printed on it.
"People are way harder to deal with than Bangboo, aren't they?"
"That's why, every now and then, I'd like us to enjoy some simple and genuine moments together, just like Bangboo do."

3321581.name: "Stray Birds"
3321581.desc: Get by unlocking Remielle's Mindscape: Lone Feather's Endless Flight
3321581.desc2:
A namecard featuring a private photo of Remielle.
"O bird that carries spring upon its wings, take my flowers, my wind, and my love. Carry them to the child of the sun, to my beloved partner-in-crime."
"May your footsteps never falter, may your dreams never lose their color, and may your path forever branch into countless bright and boundless tomorrows."

3321591.name: Armor Maintenance
3321591.desc: Get by unlocking Sigrid's Mindscape: Knight of the Skies
3321591.desc2:
A namecard featuring a private photo of Sigrid.
"No matter how finely crafted your armor is, it still needs regular, careful maintenance."
"And a mortal body is far less durable than armor... I suppose what I am trying to say is, please look after yourself."

3550000.desc: Dynamic wallpaper that can be displayed or changed in the main menu.
3550000.desc2: This dynamic wallpaper captures Bangboo enjoying their leisure time at Port Elpis. A soothing visual that brings you a peaceful moment during a busy day.

3550001.desc: Dynamic wallpaper that can be displayed or changed in the main menu.
3550001.desc2:
"En-nah enne! (Aim, strike — gotcha!)"
"En-ne, enen-nah! (...Dummy... Can't catch me!)"
This dynamic wallpaper captures the image of Bangboo playfully undergoing training on a sunny day.

3590001.name: Dynamic Wallpaper: Delusions in Progress
3590001.desc: Dynamic wallpaper that can be displayed or changed in the main menu.
3590001.desc2:
"Just add one more syllable at the end, finish it off with a harmony, and that should do it..."
"Whoa... Then I gotta try singing it first! Starting from this note right here—"
"Nangong, c-cut it out with Sunna already... Her heart rate just shot way up!"

3600001.name: Bangboo Diet Plan
3600001.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600001.desc2: "Wait, wait! That's the wrong way! Come back!" Captured during a delivery with a Hollow Raider. Seeing Bangboo trying so hard to run backwards on the conveyor belt was too cute, so I forgot to help.

3600002.name: BOOM!
3600002.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600002.desc2: A commemorative photo taken while experimenting with explosives in a Hollow. A real, seasoned Hollow Raider doesn't look back at the explosion.

3600003.name: Please don't answer...
3600003.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600003.desc2: There's two things in life one should miss: love ending in regrets and a phone ringing unexpectedly on a street at midnight.

3600004.name: Pet "Tumtum"
3600004.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600004.desc2: A close-up photo of the cat "Tumtum." You can't help but utter "Let me pet you! C'mon, let me pet you!" upon seeing it.

3600005.name: PhotoName_3600005
3600005.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3600006.name: Inky is With You
3600006.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600006.desc2:
A picture taken with {NPC_103174203}. {M#Belle}{F#Wise} helped to take the photo.
It's a precious image taken shortly after adopting {NPC_103174203}. Her eyes look so clear and full of wisdom. Looking at the picture makes you want to rub it.
Gazing at this picture satisfies you when you can't pet {NPC_103174203}.

3600007.name: Photo: Sibling Portrait
3600007.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3600008.name: Photo: Siblings
3600008.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3600009.name: Photo: A simple pencil-drawn sketch of two children
3600009.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3600010.name: Photo: A photo of a cat on Sixth Street
3600010.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3600011.name: Photo: A picture taken by Wise of the scenery
3600011.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3600015.name: "The perfect chance! Bam!"
3600015.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600015.desc2: Captured by the Bangboo Alliance. This is the decisive moment as they launched the final strike against the reigning champion.

3600017.name: Which one of us is more handsome?
3600017.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600017.desc2: Before being ordered to move the signboard, Gerant asked General Chop to take a commemorative photo. Honestly... it looks better than the real one.

3600018.name: "First Time on Stage"
3600018.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600018.desc2: A photo of the famous Twin Dancers taken during their ballet training. Though the picture is a little blurry with how much time has passed, that elegance and beauty still remain.

3600019.name: "Terrifying!"
3600019.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600019.desc2: A fan-exclusive photo of streamer Archie. It features her iconic live reaction: "Terrifying!"

3600023.name: A Corner of the Banquet
3600023.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600023.desc2: A photograph taken by Big Daddy captures the lively feast inside the Cheesetopia diner. Within just a few days, this once-abandoned establishment has been revitalized, and it looks like Blazewood will become even more bustling in the future.

3600024.name: Special Feast
3600024.desc: A precious commemorative photo that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
3600024.desc2:
Is Victoria Housekeeping also interested in sandwiches?
Though... "using simple ingredients and simple methods to create something delicious" is probably something that people would expect of maids.

3600027.name: Unforgettable Tonight
3600027.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600027.desc2:
On Gilded Carrot Day, you had hoped to take a photo with everyone, but you never managed to catch everyone together at the same time.
Later that night, when you got home, Fairy quietly lit up the screen and pulled up a whole folder of photos "borrowed" from Lumina Square surveillance system. You selected the one with the most people and printed it...
Thanks, Fairy! Genuinely appreciate it this time.

3600028.name: Phantom of the Lost Lands
3600028.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600028.desc2:
The Puppeteer of the Lost Void has finally revealed its true form — but whether it truly possesses the intelligence to control Ethereals, or is a product of an experiment or someone's hidden schemes... everything remains inconclusive.
The Hollows never have an obligation to be honest.

3600029.name: Cherished Flowers
3600029.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600029.desc2:
The reason for cherishing a flower might lie in its delicate shape and fragrant scent, the intention of the giver, or one's mood during its appreciation...
But it could also simply be because it's extremely expensive.

3600030.name: A Summer Night's Moment
3600030.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600030.desc2: A moment captured by Therese's camera after the Fantasy Music Festival. Old friends, new companions, and most importantly, family... Though the summer night may pass, our smiles will forever be frozen in this most beautiful summer memory.

3600033.name: Cheers!
3600033.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600033.desc2: A snapshot Blaze caught on her phone of everyone clinking glasses on the day the Simmer hot pot restaurant reopened. There are a million flavors in Ridu, yet nothing beats hot pot with your ride-or-dies.

3600034.name: Yesterday Once More
3600034.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600034.desc2: You happened to catch a glimpse of this photo and said "cute" — next thing you knew, Norma was so pleased with herself that she printed a copy for you too. This is the first photo of Norma and Victor together, snapped by Velina on a whim. When this photo was taken, Norma asked Velina: why do we always meet new friends, only to say goodbye to them? You asked Velina how she answered back then, but she turned the question right back around on you. So, if it were you answering — you might tell young Norma: that's not goodbye. It's a new beginning. Because everyone here is something special, deserving of an even brighter future. That's exactly why you can send each other off to new tomorrows with full hearts and nothing but hope.

3600035.name: A Commemoration for Tomorrow
3600035.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3600035.desc2:
A group photo from Victor's retirement party — Norma got a print made for you to keep as a memento.
If tomorrow is destined to bring farewells, at least we have memories to give us courage.
If memories are destined to fade, at least we have photographs to keep them alive.

3650008.name: Wildness' Blessing
3650008.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3650008.desc2: The Sunflint was woven and painted by several members of the Sons of Calydon. Although the craftsmanship is not complicated, it must have taken a lot of time to make it. The legend speaks of a hero who was saved from a sea of flames by divine protection... If such a space that defies natural laws truly harbors a deity, would it be an enemy to mankind, a friend, or merely a cold, detached observer of the world?

3650009.name: Thorns and Stamen
3650009.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
3650009.desc2: After resolving the crisis in the Converging Lands, Orchidea sent a thank-you gift. Delicate flower stamens and stubborn thorns convey a friendship from the wild; beneath the seamless "Silent Riddle" lies a thrilling adventure.

3650011.name: En-Nah Rising Star Medal
3650011.desc: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
3650011.desc2:
Coach Aster was so impressed and delighted by its assistant coach's work that it applied for a medal from the training department of the company... Unfortunately, the application was rejected, so it made this medal by itself.
It's pretty sweet token of friendship, don't you think?

3650013.name: The Dream Endures
3650013.desc: A precious commemorative photo that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
3650013.desc2:
A group photo shared by Belle in the group chat, taken when everyone gathered at the video store before the get-together. Aside from nearly flaking out herself, it's definitely just as beautiful as in the dream.

*Note: You can always trust the best AI assistant in New Eridu.

3650014.name: Cash In
3650014.desc: A precious commemorative photo that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
3650014.desc2: On a quiet night, a secret showdown was unfolding on Reef Island near the Torchlit Lighthouse. The long-dormant submarine had finally resurfaced, and it might just be the most valuable catch of a lifetime for everyone involved.

3651011.name: Damaged Data Card
3651011.desc: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
3651011.desc2:
Ray's experimental Data Card. The data inside has been damaged, and seems to have only symbolic meaning now.
"Don't worry, it only contains some corrupted files."
"Take it away from the outpost and toss it somewhere far... the farther, the better."

3651012.name: Star Bracelet
3651012.desc: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
3651012.desc2: A bracelet handmade by Venus — that alone makes it worth treasuring.

3651013.name: Special Beach Souvenir
3651013.desc: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
3651013.desc2:
The special keepsake has already been given to Remielle. The one left at home is a wind chime we recreated together afterward, using the original as a reference.
"In the end, we wound up making two keepsakes that look exactly the same... But since they're both meant to remember the same summer, I guess that feels just right~"
"Next time... how about I be the one to keep our promise?"

3690001.name: PhotoName_3690001
3690001.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3690002.name: PhotoName_3690002
3690002.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3690003.name: PhotoName_3690003
3690003.desc: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.

3700001.name: Graffiti Mark: Final Act
3700001.desc: Used for taking photos. Can be exchanged in the "Association Supplies - Exclusive Showcase" shop.

3700106.name: Fries Lamp
3700106.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700106.desc2: "Would you like small, medium, or large fries? Our special event offers extra-large glowing fries — perfect for sharing with your BFFs!"

3700107.name: "Waiting to Melt"
3700107.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700107.desc2:
Some people interpret this black Bangboo as "We will eventually melt amidst endless Ether Corruption."
But others think the designer was just trying to remind people not to put these figures near too much heat.

3700108.name: "Waiting to Weather"
3700108.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700108.desc2:
Some people interpret this gray Bangboo as "The changes we make to the world will eventually weather away."
But others think the designer was just trying to remind people not to put these figures out in the open.

3700109.name: Greta's Lover
3700109.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700109.desc2:
It is created based on the video footage preserved by Greta of "Mr. White."
It's not just an unfinished building with questionable construction quality, but also the lover of the tunnel boring machine — although it... or rather, the building, remains silent on the matter.

3700111.name: Sān-Z Beats: Drumbeat
3700111.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700111.desc2:
This figure is based on the drummer of the band that designer Yi works with, who is also one of the spokesboo of the Bangboo clothing brand under Sān-Z STUDIO.
Due to limitations in the instrument size, it always needs an extra amplifier during performances, compared to human drummers.

3700112.name: Sān-Z Beats: Stretto
3700112.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700112.desc2:
Based on the record knight of the band that designer Yi works with and one of the spokesboos of the Bangboo clothing brand under Sān-Z STUDIO.
It can only manage to get into the dinosaur performance costume that Yi designed with the help of the drummer and bass player.

3700113.name: Sān-Z Beats: Hum
3700113.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700113.desc2:
This figure is based on the bassist of the band that designer Yi works with, who is also one of the spokesboo of the Bangboo clothing brand under Sān-Z STUDIO.
The mustache was stuck on afterward as it's rather shy and doesn't want to be recognized.

3700172.name: A Corner of the Sand Table
3700172.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700172.desc2:
To command your small Bangboo against the vicious Ethereals, you must first master tactical preparation! The sand table left by Coach Aster's friend will be crucial to your strategy.
And if the esteemed battle instructor needs a keepsake... taking a piece of the "fierce battle" from the table would surely be forgivable.

3700177.name: "4WD - Crimson Comet"
3700177.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700177.desc2:
Nitrogen Brothers/Bangboo 4WD/Racing Series

"The crimson meteor you saw on the track that day? Just the trail of my taillights left across your windshield."

3700178.name: "4WD - Street Legend"
3700178.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700178.desc2:
Nitrogen Brothers/Bangboo 4WD/Racing Series

"I'm not a racer, just a delivery guy forced into this by a greedy tofu shop owner."

3700179.name: "4WD - Wasteland Knight"
3700179.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700179.desc2:
Nitrogen Brothers/Bangboo 4WD/Off-Road Series

"Whether crushing opponents or gravel, it's the same steady rhythm — this is the spirit of a knight of the wild."

3700180.name: "Waiting to Dial"
3700180.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700180.desc2:
Some interpret this payphone-shaped Bangboo as a statement: "Our true selves are destined to dissolve into the signals of communications and media."
Others think the designer just really loves long phone calls.

3700181.name: Heartfelt Wish
3700181.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700181.desc2:
"May your dreams come true, may everything go your way" — even the most impossible wishes are whispered countless times during the New Year.
...Perhaps, they aren't truly "impossible"? After all, wishes are just prophecies of the future, aren't they, Eous?

3700183.name: Radiant Gold
3700183.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700183.desc2:
In my dream, I became a king with a golden touch, gaining infinite wealth and exchanging it for boundless happiness... until the day my hand touched Eous!
...Wait, stop. Let's be honest — this is clearly just a recolored version of the custom Eous souvenir from before. How much extra did you spend...? This can't possibly be real gold, right?!

3700192.name: Knight Errant's Helm
3700192.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700192.desc2: A personally given certification from the "Knight Errant Quixie"! Wearing this means you're a qualified knight! But... who could possibly wear such a tiny helmet?

3700193.name: 0WD - Frostedge
3700193.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700193.desc2:
Nitrogen Brothers / Bangboo Specialty Vehicle / Snowfield Series
"They say the human eye can only capture up to 60 frames per second, but for me, a single blink is all it takes to vanish into the endless snowfields."

3700194.name: 1WD - City Hunter
3700194.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700194.desc2:
Nitrogen Brothers / Bangboo Motorbike / City Series
"Drifting, weaving, overtaking. What you see as the ultimate challenge is just another day in my life."

3700195.name: Flash Yum Plate
3700195.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700195.desc2: The limited edition dining plate from Crispy Delights is inspired by Crispyboo's warm and welcoming hospitality. They say any dish served on this plate will sparkle and shine, but upon closer inspection... isn't that glow just coming from the built-in lights under the plate holder?

3700205.name: Sweet Summer Days
3700205.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700205.desc2:
Bangboo Garden Kingdom: Sweet Summer Days
A new design series launched by Sān-Z STUDIO, with design inspiration drawn from everyday fruits and vegetables.
The combination of Boonapple, Watermel-en, and Booboonut sparks imagination - memories of summer days are always filled with the sweetness of seasonal fruits.

3700206.name: Health Plan
3700206.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700206.desc2:
Bangboo Garden Kingdom: Health Plan
A new design series launched by Sān-Z STUDIO, with design inspiration drawn from everyday fruits and vegetables.
The combination of Boorocoli, Boomato, and Corn Cobboo makes you think - besides healthy eating, have you worked out today?

3700207.name: The Veggie Squad
3700207.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700207.desc2:
Bangboo Garden Kingdom: The Veggie Squad
A new design series launched by Sān-Z STUDIO, with design inspiration drawn from everyday fruits and vegetables.
The combination of Cabbooge, Auboogine, and Boonip reminds us to reflect on ourselves - a balanced diet needs vegetables every day.

3700208.name: The Way of Fine Porcelain: Prosper Together
3700208.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700208.desc2:
According to the designer, he didn't create this Bangboo, but rather discovered its form within the mineral materials.
It sits there with eyes closed, serving both as an incense burner and a lucky charm, born from a persistent chant—
"Little Bangboo, little Bangboo, help me prosper quick!"

3700222.name: On the Ridu Table: En O'Clock (Midnight Black)
3700222.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700222.desc2: Is there anything more blissful than being woken up by little Bangboo's "ehn-na-ehn-na", reaching out to turn it off by its tiny ears, and then drifting back to a sweet dream surrounded by Bangboo?

3700223.name: On the Ridu Table: Boo-rick Phone (Ebony Black)
3700223.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700223.desc2: When the call connects, don't be surprised if you hear "ehn-na-ehn-na" from the other end — that's just the dial tone for the Bangboo Kingdom.

3700226.name: On the Ridu Table: En O'Clock (Daylight Orange)
3700226.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700226.desc2: Is there anything more blissful than being woken up by little Bangboo's "ehn-na-ehn-na", reaching out to turn it off by its tiny ears, and then drifting back to a sweet dream surrounded by Bangboo?

3700227.name: On the Ridu Table: Boo-rick Phone (Ivory White)
3700227.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700227.desc2: When the call connects, don't be surprised if you hear "ehn-na-ehn-na" from the other end — that's just the dial tone for the Bangboo Kingdom.

3700236.name: Hot Pot Party: Nitro-Fuel Soda
3700236.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700236.desc2: A collab ornament from the Simmer hot pot shop! Carbonated Nitro-Fuel gives you extra punch!

3700237.name: Hot Pot Party: Crispy Pan-Fried Dumplings
3700237.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700237.desc2: A collab ornament from the Simmer hot pot shop. Got dumplings on my head and scallions on my face~

3700238.name: Hot Pot Party: Cream Pudding
3700238.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700238.desc2: A collab ornament from the Simmer hotpot shop. The spicy hotpot gets you sizzlin' and hissin', while the creamy pudding cools you down!

3700239.name: Model: Frostfall Sickle
3700239.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700239.desc2:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

Clutching a wavering ideal.
Running and shouting across the barren red earth, then falling into sleep, only to wake up grown.
Choosing chains of one's own making.
Living on as a blade, scraping by. Investigating, interrogating, hunting... endless, numb, cold.
Waiting for the promised judgment.
Plucking a rotting new bud and stepping into winter, until at last welcoming life's final hope... death, warm and peaceful.

3700240.name: Street Tales: Fish Through the Market
3700240.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700240.desc2:
A Bangboo came up to ask for directions, its silence deafening.
"En-nah? (Excuse me, how do I get to Lumina Square?)"
"En-nah-nah!? (How did you know I caught a big fish today!?)"

3700241.name: Model: Starlight Rider Faceplate
3700241.desc: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
3700241.desc2:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

What is a knight?
The crimson knight says, "Carrying out the justice in my heart!" The amber knight says, "Dealing with each sin in this world!" The verdant knight says, "Protecting everyone's hope!"
So what is a knight, in the end? The advanced tactical construct suddenly falls into serious thought over this profound question, no different from the philosophers who have long pondered the ultimate meaning of existence.
Regrettably, this great and noble meditation on chivalric aesthetics is cut short in under ten seconds by an unceremonious interruption from a companion.
"Billy, you've watched 'Starlight Knight: A Knight's Proof' a hundred times already. So what even is the proof?"
"I'll know when I've watched it another hundred times!"
—At the Cunning Hares' place, two people arguing over the remote.

3710001.name: Focus View: One-Shot Kill
3710001.desc: Used for taking photos. Can be exchanged in the "Association Supplies - Exclusive Showcase" shop.
3710001.desc2: Colors and images, light and shadow, framing and composition all weave together to create this moment.

3720001.name: Emoticon: K.O.
3720001.desc: Used in dialogue. Can be exchanged in the "Association Supplies - Exclusive Showcase" shop.
3720001.desc2: A blunt icon can cut deeper than words.

3720002.name: Emoticon: ACE!
3720002.desc: Used in dialogue. Can be exchanged in the "Association Supplies - Exclusive Showcase" shop.
3720002.desc2: A blunt icon can cut deeper than words.

3730001.name: Exclusive Action: Fleeting Dream Forever Etched
3730001.desc: An exclusive action for Remielle. Once obtained from the "Association Supplies - Exclusive Showcase" shop, it can be selected for Remielle in camera - portrait mode.
3730001.desc2: "It's such a beautiful day. Want to take a stroll with me? ...My accomplice?"

4000007.desc: A small card usually used to write congratulatory messages, appeared with a bouquet of fresh flowers in a record box at the entrance of the video store.

4000010.name: HollowItemName_4000010
4000010.desc: Places a time bomb that explodes in a cross after 3 turns, <color=#2BAD00>clearing away most event tiles in its blast area.</color>
4000010.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

4000011.name: Tactical Bomb
4000011.desc: Upon explosion, this experimental bomb <color=#2BAD00>deals AoE damage to enemies in a cross-shaped area</color> while not affecting the user.
4000011.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

4000012.name: Smash
4000012.desc: Once activated, it will explode after a period of time and release energy waves in all directions without damaging the user. This item comes at a steep price.
4000012.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

4000013.name: Tactical Bomb
4000013.desc: Upon explosion, this experimental bomb <color=#2BAD00>deals AoE damage to enemies in a cross-shaped area</color> while not affecting the user.
4000013.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

4000014.name: Targeted Projectile
4000014.desc: Once activated, it will explode after a period of time and release energy waves in the target direction without damaging the user. This item comes at a steep price.
4000014.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

4000015.name: Cross Blast
4000015.desc: Deploy and detonate a bomb that creates a cross-shaped blast, <color=#CF4029>dealing 15% Max HP in DMG to all squad members</color> while clearing <color=#2BAD00>most event tiles</color> in the blast radius. <color=#2BAD00>Normal and Elite enemies will drop Resonia</color>.
4000015.desc2: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.

4000016.name: Powerful Explosives
4000016.desc: Deploy and detonate a bomb that creates a round-shaped blast, clearing <color=#2BAD00>most event tiles</color> in the blast radius. Large or complex Elite enemies, as well as Boss enemies will not be affected by this blast, while <color=#2BAD00>Normal and Elite enemies will drop Resonia</color>.
4000016.desc2: Send a mini Bangboo to ignite a powerful Ether explosive, instantly obliterating anything in the way. The range can be controlled and won't hurt Eous.

4000017.name: Card from Dew Gardening
4000017.desc: A small card usually used to write congratulatory messages, appeared with a bouquet of fresh flowers in a record box at the entrance of the video store.
4000017.desc2: It seems to be a greeting card written in the tone of a florist, but the suggestive wording and the encrypted Inter-Knot address on the card prove that it's actually a commission from an intermediary.

4000018.name: Card from Dew Gardening
4000018.desc: A small card usually used to write congratulatory messages, appeared with a bouquet of fresh flowers in a record box at the entrance of the video store.
4000018.desc2: It seems to be a greeting card written in the tone of a florist, but the suggestive wording and the encrypted Inter-Knot address on the card prove that it's actually a commission from an intermediary.

4000020.name: "Bank Zero" Rules
4000020.desc: A simple brochure outlining the benefits and relevant rules of loyalty points with "Bank Zero."
4000020.desc2:
"For your own rights and benefits, please read carefully. The Bank reserves the right of final interpretation."

While these two prominent sentences stand out in the brochure, the rest of the text is crammed into a tiny font, making it dizzying to read. But aren't those parts the most important?

4000021.name: Mewmew's Blazewood Notes
4000021.desc: A copy of Officer Mewmew's notes that contains information about Bangboo in Blazewood requiring help.
4000021.desc2: Contains Bangboo requests for help collected from all over the place.

4000026.name: Mewmew's Port Elpis Notes
4000026.desc: A copy of Officer Mewmew's notes that contains information about Bangboo in Port Elpis requiring help.
4000026.desc2: Contains Bangboo requests for help collected from all over. Mewmew will not rest so long as there are Bangboo who need help.

4000027.name: Mewmew's Blazewood Notes
4000027.desc: A copy of Officer Mewmew's notes that contains information about Bangboo in Blazewood requiring help.
4000027.desc2: Contains Bangboo requests for help collected from all over the place.

4000028.name: Miyabi's "Operation Report"
4000028.desc: An official letter from Miyabi. You can read it at any time.
4000028.desc2: A handwritten letter from Miyabi enclosed in an official Section 6 file, acting as a "formal letter." The silk string securing the beautifully patterned envelope is made of the same material as the tassel Miyabi usually wears at her waist.

4000030.name: Drift Bottle No.1
4000030.desc: The note inside the drifting bottle seems to be from a young man battling a serious illness. Seems like he's trying to share a secret with us. Below the note are some strange patterns — perhaps they point to a clue...
4000030.desc2: A bottle carrying hopes and dreams drifts across the vast waves, only to be caught and become part of your story.

4000031.name: Drift Bottle No.2
4000031.desc: The note inside the drifting bottle seems to be from a young man battling a serious illness. Seems like he's trying to share a secret with us. Below the note are some strange patterns — perhaps they point to a clue...
