4000032.desc2: A bottle carrying hopes and dreams drifts across the vast waves, only to be caught and become part of your story.

4000034.name: Letter to Pulchra
4000034.desc: A handwritten letter from Burnice to Pulchra.
4000034.desc2: After Pulchra helped the members of the Sons of Calydon buy things from various places, Burnice wrote a handwritten letter to explain the reasons behind it all to Pulchra.

4000039.name: Wish Bottle From the Sea Wizard
4000039.desc: A wish bottle returned by the Sea Wizard, with marks on its surface from hitting sea reefs.
4000039.desc2: A letter from the "Sea Wizard" to the "Scion of the Great Sea God." If they ever make it back to their places, this bottle's gotta be worth a lot more... right?

4000040.name: Anonymous Wish Bottle
4000040.desc: A wish bottle returned by the Sea Wizard, with marks on its surface from hitting sea reefs.
4000040.desc2: The letter has elegant handwriting and a fragrant scent that calms you.

4000041.name: Wish Bottle From the Night Emissary
4000041.desc: A wish bottle returned by the Sea Wizard, with marks on its surface from hitting sea reefs.
4000041.desc2: Besides the note, there was a tiny pendant in the bottle. Judging by the shape, it seems to be a Dead End Butcher. Why would any business make toys that look like Ethereals?!

4000048.name: A Lone Path in the Snow

4000070.name: Short Distance Collection
4000070.desc: Spin the wheel once. You may get: Gear Coins, a deadly trap, restorative medicine, or a Resonium.
4000070.desc2: Release an auto-collection device to explore in a random direction, with a chance to bring back anything found on the way, which may include trouble.

4000090.name: Powerful Excavation
4000090.desc: Enter an unknown area that cannot be scanned.
4000090.desc2: Excavate in directions with no path and discover new areas.

4000100.name: Missing Developer's Secret Letter
4000100.desc: A strange letter obtained from Kylie
4000100.desc2:
Received from Kylie, this is the reward for the first challenger to complete the Simulated Battle Trial.

The envelope is simple and neatly sealed, still in perfect condition. Besides you and the writer, no one else will know what is written inside — yet that writer, whom you've never met, has now vanished into the Hollow.

4000201.name: Letter From Xiao'Guang
4000201.desc: Ye Shunguang had left some old belongings in Failume Heights, but thankfully with your help, they were all recovered. To show gratitude, Xiao'Guang left you a letter explaining the origins of these items — it seems he has something special he wants to tell you...
4000201.desc2: Attached to the letter was a delicate feather, a group photo of the Yunkui Summit folks, a broken peace knot, a heavily revised recipe, a handwritten guide for Yunkui Summit newcomers, and a burnt-out floating lantern... These old items carry Xiao'Guang's cherished memories of Yunkui Summit, and she hopes you can keep them safe for her.

4120313.name: Oath of Skies
4120313.desc: Proxy's beach-themed outfit can be worn in the Proxy Outfit interface.

4120411.name: Delicate Sunlight

4120412.name: Summer Skies
4120412.desc: Proxy's beach-themed outfit can be worn in the Proxy Outfit interface.

4161001.name: Golden Belt of Boo-gress
4161001.desc: Can be used to raise the Group Training level of Collaboorators.
4161001.desc2:
A progress certificate awarded by Norma to hardworking Collaboorators training in the data space. Is effective at raising Group Training level.
"How's training feeling?"
"En-nah-en-nah! (Feeling like the next training session is gonna be a total walk in the park!)"

4161002.name: Genius's Experimental Special
4161002.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality module for a Collaboorator.
4161002.desc2:
A cyber drink made exclusively for Collaboorators, made from Norma's attempt at "brewing" through code.
"That whole thing about glitches in the code is just a joke. Who in the dataspace wouldn't want to get their hands on Norma's special mix?"

4161003.name: Genius's Inspirational Special
4161003.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality module for a Collaboorator.
4161003.desc2:
A cyber drink made exclusively for Collaboorators, carefully "brewed" by Norma through code.
"Enneh enna! (You're right, but this is Norma's signature special blend. It updates premium mods, boosts traits, and helps Collaboorators rise to the top!)"

4161004.name: Genius's Perfect Special
4161004.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality module for a Collaboorator.
4161004.desc2:
A cyber drink made exclusively for Collaboorators, "mixed" by Norma with every last line of code she had.
"Ehn-na! Ehn-na! (Legend has it that only those who savor the most perfect cyber drink in data space won't get blasted by the Central Computing Hub's lasers!)"

4161005.name: Boo to the Rescue - Style A
4161005.desc: Can be used to load a random Collaboorator in the load terminal's Rally Protocol
4161005.desc2:
Norma specially designed the "Collaboorator" data loading code, which can download partial Bangboo data from the Marcel Group as a "Collaboorator" to enter a volunteer Bangboo's data space and boost its computing power.
"Ehn-na? Ehn-na? Ehn-na! (Overtime? But I'm just a piece of data... Wait, I'll do overtime — just don't delete me!)"

4161006.name: Boo to the Rescue - Style B
4161006.desc: Can be used to load a random Collaboorator in the load terminal's Expansion Protocol
4161006.desc2:
Norma specially designed the "Collaboorator" data loading code, which can download partial Bangboo data from the Marcel Group as a "Collaboorator" to enter a volunteer Bangboo's data space and boost its computing power.
"Ehn-na? Ehn-na... En-nah-nah! (Even as a data model, I still get to work? Th—This is absolutely amazing!)"

4161007.name: Boo to the Rescue - Style C
4161007.desc: Can be used to load a random Collaboorator in the load terminal's Final Protocol
4161007.desc2:
Norma specially designed the "Collaboorator" data loading code, which can download partial Bangboo data from the Marcel Group as a "Collaboorator" to enter a volunteer Bangboo's data space and boost its computing power.
"Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne... ehn-ne-nhe! (A request... A request just came in! Oh, good thing I'm a data model, wait... Doesn't that actually make me better suited for the job?)"

4161008.name: "Best Booddy" Medal
4161008.desc: Reward certificate obtained by completing Data Domain Training stages.
4161008.desc2:
Norma presented a shiny virtual medal to the "Collaboorator" who pushed through rigorous training in the data space, praising them for defeating countless code errors, boosting computing capacity, and making remarkable contributions to repairing the Central Computing Hub!
"En-nha na!（Thanks, everyone! I'm gonna become the greatest Collaboorator!）"

4161009.name: Genius's Experimental Special - Attack
4161009.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Attack Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality attack module for a Collaboorator.
4161009.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, casually "blended" by Norma using code.
"Training failed? No sweat! Down Norma's special brew and when the system updates, you'll still be the world's #1 Collaboorator!"

4161010.name: Genius's Inspirational Special - Attack
4161010.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Attack Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality attack module for a Collaboorator.
4161010.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "blended" by Norma using code.
When a Collaboorator downs an attack-type inspiration special, this is what happens:
"Ehn-ne! (Never had such a rockin' start to training!)"

4161011.name: Genius's Perfect Special - Attack
4161011.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Attack Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality attack module for a Collaboorator.
4161011.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, painstakingly "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-ne? (If I drink this, will I get a mod that boosts ATK?)"
(After a few sips...)
"Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne? Ehn-ne-ne! (That's disgusting! Who made this? Norma? Still disgusting!)"

4161012.name: Genius's Experimental Special - Defense
4161012.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Defense Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality defense module for a Collaboorator.
4161012.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, casually "blended" by Norma using code.
"En-nah en-nah! (Nothing can make me cry anymore, I'm a tough Bangboo!)" "But can Bangboo even cry?" "En-nah-en-nah... (Waaah, I can't even cry?)"

4161013.name: Genius's Inspirational Special - Defense
4161013.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Defense Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality defense module for a Collaboorator.
4161013.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-na! Ehn-na? (After drinking this, I feel like my shoulders really got broader! Wait, do I even have shoulders?)"

4161014.name: Genius's Perfect Special - Defense
4161014.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Defense Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality defense module for a Collaboorator.
4161014.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, painstakingly "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-na? (If I drink this, will I get totally ripped?)"
(After a taste test session...)
"Ehn-na! (Norma, I can take on ten of 'em!)"

4161015.name: Genius's Experimental Special - Support
4161015.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Support Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality support module for a Collaboorator.
4161015.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne-ne! (I'm here to help! After all, this is our blood-pumping combo move!)" —Bold words from a Collaboorator after downing the drink in one gulp.

4161016.name: Genius's Inspirational Special - Support
4161016.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Support Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality support module for a Collaboorator.
4161016.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "mixed" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-ne-ehn-ne? (Is this what a true support master looks like?!)" — A certain Collaboorator who sampled the drink immediately leaned back in awe.

4161017.name: Genius's Perfect Special - Support
4161017.desc: A special item used to reconstruct Support Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality support module for a Collaboorator.
4161017.desc2:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, painstakingly "mixed" by Norma using code.

4200000.desc: The story written by you and Zi Xu — it truly exists.

While <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is on the field, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate increases by 40% and Decibel Generation Rate by 30%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 3s longer</color>.

4321010.name: [Fragile][Remielle] Voidwing Pilgrimage - Lv.50
4321010.desc: Remielle's exclusive Tactical Prism. When an Agent in the team takes fatal damage, if there are other Agents available to switch to, they can be revived once per run. When Remielle is the active character, she <color=#2BAD00>restores1.6 Energy per second</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#2BAD00>gains 3</color> special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color>. After Remiel uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>, damage taken is reduced by 80% for 3 seconds.

4321011.name: [Fragile][Sigrid] Dancing Spearhead - Lv.50
4321011.desc:

Ulidim, the latter is dazed for 12s, and the DMG dealt increases by 30%. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> form, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> decreases.

4321012.name: [Fragile][Norma] Grand Finale - Lv.50
4321012.desc:
Norma's exclusive Tactical Prism. Etheric Phantom: Scorpse deals 50% more DMG. When another squad member uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Norma <color=#2BAD00>immediately gains 100% Preheated Chamber</color>. This effect can trigger once every 40s.
When any Agent uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, that Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate increases by 25%</color> for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4321013.name: [Fragile][Pyrois] Flame of Illumination - Lv.50
4321013.desc: Pyrois's exclusive Tactical Prism. The map will mark the locations of some unopened Electronic Strongboxes. 4321014.name: [Fragile][Promeia] Whirlwind Judgment - Lv.50
4321014.desc: Promeia's exclusive Tactical Prism. While Cacophony Soundscape is active, Promeia's DMG increases by 15%. When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>restores 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, and when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.

4321015.name: [Fragile][Cissia] Ouroboros Loop - Lv.50
4321015.desc: Cissia's exclusive Tactical Prism. When using Etheric Phantom to enter Stealth, Stealth duration is extended by 10s. After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color> effect: When any Non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can be triggered once every 1s and lasts for 6s.

4321016.name: [Fragile][Aria] Delusion's Glow - Lv.50
4321016.desc: Aria's exclusive Tactical Prism. When Etheric Phantom is used, Aria immediately recovers 800 Decibels. After Aria completes her EX Special Attack, the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> generated on the field <color=#2BAD00>increases by 1</color>, and EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked does not consume Energy.

4321017.name: [Fragile][Yuzuha] Shaman's Charm - Lv.50
4321017.desc: Yuzuha's exclusive Tactical Prism. When the Etheric Phantom: Sobek effect ends, each squad member recovers HP equal to 10% of their remaining Shield from that effect. When Yuzuha uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Mastery increases by 40</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When either attack hits an enemy, it reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 18%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES by 15%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4321018.name: [Fragile][Ju Fufu] Mountain King Banishes Evil - Lv.50
4321018.desc: Ju Fufu's exclusive Tactical Prism. After opening an Electronic Strongbox, all squad members gain a Shield equal to 15% of their Max HP for 60s. This effect does not stack, and the same Strongbox cannot trigger it more than once. After Ju Fufu uses <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>, if she is not the active character, she launches one <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, circling the enemy and performing the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. The skill's DMG is considered <color=#2BAD00>Aftershock DMG</color>, and the <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 75%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt increases by 45%</color>.

4321019.name: [Fragile][Evelyn] Lethal Etiquette - Lv.50
4321019.desc: Evelyn's exclusive Tactical Prism. After using Phase Dash, Evelyn recovers 1 Burning Tether Point. When any squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> hits enemies, Evelyn restores <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the skill's DMG increases by 80%</color>.

4321020.name: [Fragile][Jane] Encircle and Hunt - Lv.50
4321020.desc: Jane's exclusive Tactical Prism. When Etheric Phantom is used, Jane immediately recovers 100 points of Passion Stream. {AWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>, greatly increasing its DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup.} {NOAWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>}. When this skill hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Wound</color>. This state causes the affected target to take <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 60% of Jane's ATK every second and accumulate <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color>, lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4321021.name: [Fragile][Ellen] Mist Tide Resurgence - Lv.50

Agents inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> gain <color=#2BAD00>increased Anti-Interrupt Level</color> and take <color=#2BAD00>30% less DMG</color>. These effects persist for 5s after leaving <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. When Ellen hits an enemy inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> deals one additional instance of DMG.

4321023.desc: Claret's exclusive Tactical Prism. Each Perfect Block against an enemy increases the next Ultimate <color=#2BAD00>DMG by an additional 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.

4322004.name: [Nangong Yu] Spotlight Solo - Lv.60

When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>restores 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, and when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.

4350515.name: [Blueprint][Cissia] Ouroboros Loop - Lv. 60
4350515.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Cissia's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: When using Etheric Phantom to enter Stealth, Stealth duration is extended by 10s. After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color> effect: When any Non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can be triggered once every 1s and lasts for 6s.

4350516.name: [Blueprint][Aria] Delusion's Glow - Lv. 60
4350516.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Aria's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: When Etheric Phantom is used, Aria immediately recovers 800 Decibels. After Aria completes her EX Special Attack, the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> generated on the field <color=#2BAD00>increases by 1</color>, and EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked does not consume Energy.

4350517.name: [Blueprint][Yuzuha] Shaman's Charm - Lv. 60
4350517.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Yuzuha's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: When the Etheric Phantom: Sobek effect ends, each squad member recovers HP equal to 10% of their remaining Shield from that effect. When Yuzuha uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Mastery increases by 40</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When either attack hits an enemy, it reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 18%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES by 15%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4350518.name: [Blueprint][Ju Fufu] Mountain King Banishes Evil - Lv. 60
4350518.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Ju Fufu's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: After opening an Electronic Strongbox, all squad members gain a Shield equal to 15% of their Max HP for 60s. This effect does not stack, and the same Strongbox cannot trigger it more than once. After Ju Fufu uses <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>, if she is not the active character, she launches one <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, circling the enemy and performing the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. The skill's DMG is considered <color=#2BAD00>Aftershock DMG</color>, and the <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 75%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt increases by 45%</color>.

4350519.name: [Blueprint][Evelyn] Lethal Etiquette - Lv. 60
4350519.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Evelyn's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: After using Phase Dash, Evelyn recovers 1 Burning Tether Point. When any squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> hits enemies, Evelyn restores <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the skill's DMG increases by 80%</color>.

4350520.name: [Blueprint][Jane] Encircle and Hunt - Lv. 60
4350520.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Jane's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: When Etheric Phantom is used, Jane immediately recovers 100 points of Passion Stream. {AWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>, greatly increasing its DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup.} {NOAWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>}. When this skill hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Wound</color>. This state causes the affected target to take <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 60% of Jane's ATK every second and accumulate <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color>, lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4350521.name: [Blueprint][Ellen] Mist Tide Resurgence - Lv. 60
4350521.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Ellen's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: While Roaming is active, the Cacophony Soundscape's Corruption is reduced to 70% of its original value. When Ellen uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>leaves Icy Mist on the ground</color>, dealing continuous <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> for 15s. Agents inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> gain <color=#2BAD00>increased Anti-Interrupt Level</color> and take <color=#2BAD00>30% less DMG</color>. These effects persist for 5s after leaving <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. When Ellen hits an enemy inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> deals one additional instance of DMG.

4350522.name: [Blueprint][Yanagi] Ruten Reflection - Lv.60
4350522.desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Yanagi's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Available for purchase at Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Item Effect: When using "Etheric Phantom: Unfathomable," deals additional Abloom DMG to enemies. When Tsukishiro Yanagi enters combat or any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>[Disorder]</color>, Tsukishiro Yanagi also enters the <color=#FFFFFF>[Shinrabanshou]</color> state; repeated triggers reset the duration.
Additionally, while in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Shinrabanshou]</color> state, <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG and [Disorder] DMG dealt by Tsukishiro Yanagi is increased by 35%</color>.

4360001.name: Hematite Crystal
4360001.desc: A special crystal infused with Ether energy. Its black-and-russet surface resembles hematite. It feels warm to the touch, as though it could explode at any moment...

4360002.name: Stable Voltage Divider
4360002.desc: A stable voltage divider manufactured by Useful Works. Widely used in civilian and industrial systems, it automatically regulates current to keep output voltage within a safe range.

4360003.name: Porcelume Rings
4360003.desc: A ring made from Porcelume and certified by Buyan as a cultural specialty of the Waifei Peninsula. Rumor has it that wearing ten at once will earn you a special nickname among the locals: "Moneybags!"

4360004.name: Circuit Core
4360004.desc: A circuit core produced by the Marcel Group and widely used in Bangboo manufacturing and other devices. Tiny, yet surprisingly durable!

4360005.name: Storage Unit
4360005.desc: A storage unit produced by the Marcel Group and widely used in Bangboo manufacturing and other devices. Available in multiple capacities, including 128 GB and 256 GB.

4360006.name: Signal Detector
4360006.desc: A specialized HIA detector capable of tuning itself to track different signal types. Its only flaw is that users can never seem to decide whether to look through the eyepiece or at the screen.

4360007.name: Limit Gauge
4360007.desc: HIA's Zenless Limit Meter is an essential device for monitoring Hollow activity. Hollows may have limits, but an investigator's journey never ends!

4360008.name: Classified Intel
4360008.desc: A classified data terminal recovered from the Hollow. It appears to have belonged to a Defense Force unit. Unauthorized access is prohibited. But if you absolutely must peek, make it quick!

4360009.name: Tactical Computer
4360009.desc: A tactical computer issued by the Defense Force. Shockproof, waterproof, and dustproof, it is capable of handling all kinds of operations. But whatever you do, do NOT press the red button!

4360010.name: Observation Data Orb
4360010.desc: HIA's Hollow Observation Data Orb functions much like an Observation Data Pile. It's easier to carry, but its battery drains much faster, so recovering it often requires additional personnel.

4360011.name: Starlight Knight Collector's Edition
4360011.desc: A videotape of Starlight Knight: Collector's Edition. This special commemorative edition from the Starlight Knights' planet of origin features exclusive combat highlights of the three knights battling "Black Hole," along with a professional breakdown of the Starlight Knight flying kick. The ultimate dream collectible for every Starlight Knight fan!

4360012.name: Mona Dullahana
4360012.desc: A one-of-a-kind piece by a mysterious artist. Delicate brushwork recasts Dullahan as an elegant noblewoman, while rich layers of color convey both grace and strength. Anyone who sees it can only wonder: "What the hell is this?"

4360013.name: Heartbreak Ballad
4360013.desc: A collection of classic tearjerkers from Fugue Music. Maybe Ether Corruption got to the record, because these songs go beyond sadness. They're chilling enough to leave you craving hotpot just to warm up.

4360014.name: Chan Accessory
4360014.desc: A custom Chan Accessory, certified by Buyan as authentic Waifei Peninsula jewelry. What does the Chan symbolize? Ask around. Traditionalists claim it wards off disaster and evil, while younger buyers prefer the idea of wealth sticking to its wearer.

4360015.name: Signal Search TV
4360015.desc: An old Signal Search TV from an unknown brand. Its signal is highly unstable, but the aging picture tube gives the image a unique texture beloved by many art-loving Bangboos.

4360016.name: Golden Cartridge Game Console
4360016.desc: A home console jointly produced by Godfinger. It supports classics like Bizarre Brigade, Soul Hounds III, and Snake Duel, making it a favorite among the Bangboos at the research station.

4360017.name: Golden Trinket: Boobrain
4360017.desc: A solid-gold figurine by a mysterious artist. The little Bangboo sits with its eyes covered, having abandoned its search for the meaning of boo-life and chosen instead to hide from reality...

4360018.name: Golden Trinket: Boorainy
4360018.desc: A solid-gold figurine by a mysterious artist. The seated Bangboo begins to ponder the meaning of boo-life, only to find its strength slowly drained by pressure from Dennies, its master, friends, and family...

4360019.name: Golden Ice Cream
4360019.desc: A solid-gold figurine by a mysterious artist. Beneath its smooth curves lies the boundless lust for gold shared by humans, Bangboos, and all living things. Slurp...

4360020.name: Hound Hunting Trophy
4360020.desc: Proof of being the strongest hunter in the Divine Maze!

4360021.name: Gold Trinket: Lordly Trashcan
4360021.desc: A visitor from another world! The Lordly Trashcan!

4360022.name: Cabbooge Ornament
4360022.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. A tiny little cabbage, the palest in the patch and the greenest of the bunch.

4360023.name: Auboogine Ornament
4360023.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Potatoboo and Pepperboo are his eldest and second-eldest brothers.

4360024.name: Boonip Ornament
4360024.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. What can this little Boonip do for you?

4360025.name: Boonapple Ornament
4360025.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. You're the one who looks like a durian! Your whole family looks like durians!

4360026.name: Booboonut Ornament
4360026.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Going coco-loco!

4360027.name: Watermel-en Ornament
4360027.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. This melon comes with a ripeness guarantee.

4360028.name: Boorocoli Ornament
4360028.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Art is broccoli!

4360029.name: Boomato Ornament
4360029.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Have you seen my good friend, Eggboo?

4360030.name: Corn Cobboo Ornament
4360030.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Rumor has it that holding it over an open flame might turn it into Popcornboo.

4360031.name: Nitro-Fuel Soda Ornament
4360031.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Fill Nitro-Fuel with fizz, take a sip and feel the zip!

4360032.name: Crispy Pan-Fried Dumpling Ornament
4360032.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. I've got fried dumplings on my head and scallions on my face!

4360033.name: Cream Pudding Ornament
4360033.desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Hot pot makes you hiss and huff; custard pudding cools you off!

4360034.name: En O'Clock (Midnight Black)
4360034.desc: A desk alarm clock from Sān-Z STUDIO. Its midnight-black finish and the soothing "Ehn-ne-ne" white noise make for the perfect end to the day.

4360035.name: En O'Clock (Daylight Orange)
4360035.desc: A desk alarm clock from Sān-Z STUDIO. Its sunrise-orange finish and the cheerful "Ehn-ne, ehn-ne" alarm mark the perfect start to the day.

4360036.name: Boo-rick Phone (Ebony Black)
4360036.desc: A long-range radio phone from Sān-Z STUDIO. Making a call? Make it on a Boo-rick Phone! Whether it's gossip, complaints, or whispered secrets, it'll blow you away!

4360037.name: Boo-rick Phone (Ivory White)
4360037.desc: A long-range radio phone from Sān-Z STUDIO. Making a call? Make it on a Boo-rick Phone! Whether it's gossip, complaints, or whispered secrets, it'll blow you away!

4360038.name: Hound Fang
4360038.desc: A strange and terrifying fang made into a pendant by an Ethereal-art enthusiast. (Not a $$$bottle opener$$$.)

4360039.name: Etheric Phantom Card: Tyrfing
4360039.desc: The Tyrfing Card ranks at the bottom in power, but using enough copies at once may produce unexpected results.

4360040.name: Mystic Conch
4360040.desc: Questions about the maze? Ask the Mystic Conch!

4360041.name: Ruby Ring
4360041.desc: A large ring fashioned from ruby. A Buyan-certified Eridu antique. Slip it on, and labels like "old money" and "noble" practically appear over your head.

4360042.name: Blood Cicada Pendant
4360042.desc: A custom Blood Cicada pendant certified by Buyan as Waifei-style jewelry. Where cicadas usually represent good fortune, the Blood Cicada warns its wearer to protect their legacy and home.

4360043.name: En O'Clock (Icedawn White)
4360043.desc: A desk clock from Sān-Z STUDIO, finished in a white reminiscent of dawn in early winter. It chimes "Ehn-ne-ne" on the hour, making it the perfect way to mark a full year of hard work.

4360044.name: Boo-rick Phone (Amber Orange)
4360044.desc: A long-range radio phone from Sān-Z STUDIO. Making a call? Make it a Boo-rick Phone! Whether you're ranting, chatting, or whispering secrets, it'll blow you away!

4360045.name: CCTV
4360045.desc: An old closed-circuit television from an unknown brand. The label says it requires a signal cable to output video, yet there is no signal input port anywhere on the set...

4360084.name: [Commission] Labyrinth Carrot Shard
4360084.desc: A shard of Labyrinth Carrot, a special device once carried by Joyous. Rumor has it that this remarkable invention can chart routes through the Papago Hollow without relying on Rosetta Data.

4360085.name: [Fragile] Base Blade of the Other: Block
4360085.desc:
When equipped, this item grants three Alter Skills: Perfect Block, Phase Dash, and Powerful Slash.

[Perfect Block Enhancement]
Perfect Block triggers a Dodge even if the block fails.

Against enemies at <color=#CF4029>Lv. 20 or higher</color>, <color=#CF4029>Powerslash</color> deals <color=#CF4029>50%</color> less DMG.

4360086.name: [Fragile] Base Blade of the Other: Block

4360087.name: [Commission] Complete Hematite Signal Detector
4360087.desc: A specially made detector from the HIA, now locked onto the Ether signal connected to hematite...

4360088.name: [Commission] Treasure Radar
4360088.desc: A radar tuned to a special search frequency that seems to lead people toward high-value areas in the Divine Maze.

4360089.name: [Commission] Heartbreak Ballads Anniversary Edition
4360089.desc: A Fugue production — the anniversary edition of a classic tearjerker ballad. Due to Ether interference, it's bizarrely developed a refrigerating effect. Just one bar of the melody is enough to chill you to the bone and send you sneezing non-stop...

4360090.name: [Commission] Phantasm TV
4360090.desc: A TV stuck on loop, blasting some seriously creepy audio.

4360091.name: [Commission] HAND Tactical Computer
4360091.desc: Besides the classified HAND documents, there seem to be some... literary works in there that'll make you blush, your heart race, and maybe even leave you with a look of utter confusion.

4360092.name: [Commission] Broken Hematite Signal Detector
4360092.desc: A specially made detector from the HIA, now locked onto the Ether signal connected to hematite...

4360093.name: [Commission] Mysterious Access Card
4360093.desc: An access card scratched from a scratch card at a newsstand in the illusion. Perhaps the prize is hidden somewhere within the area it grants access to?

4360094.name: [Commission] Labyrinth Carrot Shard
4360094.desc: A shard of Labyrinth Carrot, a special device once carried by Joyous. Rumor has it that this remarkable invention can chart routes through the Papago Hollow without relying on Rosetta Data.

4360095.name: [Commission] Signal Transmitters
4360095.desc: A signal transmitter used to pinpoint an Unknown Bangboo's signal. Once activated, it periodically emits scanning signals. Activate multiple transmitters to obtain a precise location signal of the target.

4360096.name: [Commission] Hematite Crystal Shards
4360096.desc: （This line seems to have been cut）

4360097.name: [Commission] Special Storage Unit
4360097.desc: A Blasting storage unit specially made for repairing Boorilliant. Looks identical to any standard storage unit, except the connector is some outdated spec that was retired decades ago… (For the love of all things holy, just standardize every single connector already!)

4360098.name: [Commission] Hematite Core
4360098.desc: A special crystal used to unlock spatial fissures in the lava zone. Scorching hot and dangerous — keep away from children and pets...

4360099.name: [Commission] Elevator Access Card
4360099.desc: Opens the large elevator to the Lower Level of Suburbs Illusion. The back of the card appears to list the booking hotline for Bunless Bae Town's logistics company, Hops and Skips...

4363501.name: Fragile Carrot
4363501.desc: A Carrot chip created from Hollow observation data. Without protective encapsulation, exposure to Ether fluctuations — such as those encountered while passing through long-distance spatial fissures — may cause packet loss or complete failure.

4363502.name: Stable Carrot
4363502.desc: A fully encapsulated and locked Carrot chip capable of safely leaving the Hollow through a spatial fissure.

4363503.name: Unknown Valuable
4363503.desc: Research station logistics records indicate that a valuable item was stored here, but its details can no longer be verified...

4364001.name: Windworn Highway - Oasis Industrial Park Key
4364001.desc: Use to unlock the gate to Windworn Highway's Oasis Industrial Park.

4364002.name: Bunless Bae Town - Unloading Zone Key
4364002.desc: Use to unlock the gate to the Unloading Zone in Bunless Bae Town.

4364003.name: Phantom Aquarium East Gate, Fantasy Beach
4364003.desc: Use to unlock the east entrance of Fantasy Beach's Phantom Aquarium.

4364004.name: Fantasy Beach - Fantasy Dock Evac Point Key
4364004.desc: Can be used to access the evac point near the speedboat at Fantasy Beach's Fantasy Dock.

4364005.name: Six Dusk Street Warehouse
4364005.desc: Use to open the gate to Six Dusk Street's Warehouse.

4364006.name: Dove Phase I Project Construction Access Route
4364006.desc: Use to open the gate to Dove Street Construction Site's Phase I Access Route.

4364008.name: Phantom Aquarium East Gate, Fantasy Beach
4364008.desc: Use to unlock the east entrance of Fantasy Beach's Phantom Aquarium.

11000281.name: Hay Fever I
11000281.desc:
Nineveh's DMG <color=#CF4029>increases by 40%</color> and she <color=#CF4029>summons Hornets more frequently</color>.
A certain amount of HP is lost when exploring new areas. In combat, on-field characters will lose HP gradually.
11000281.desc2: This is a "blooming" that can't be seen with the naked eye, a strange structure vibrating its dazzling "petals." Caught in a blur, you find yourself dancing in the air with that mesmerizing, deadly flower — who's that person on the ground, frozen in astonishment?

11000282.name: Hay Fever II
11000282.desc:
Nineveh's DMG <color=#CF4029>increases by 50%</color>, she <color=#CF4029>summons Hornets more frequently</color> and activates "Blooming."
A certain amount of HP is lost when exploring new areas. In combat, on-field characters will lose HP gradually.
11000282.desc2: This is a "blooming" that can't be seen with the naked eye, a strange structure vibrating its dazzling "petals." Caught in a blur, you find yourself dancing in the air with that mesmerizing, deadly flower — who's that person on the ground, frozen in astonishment?

11000291.name: Primal Malice I
11000291.desc2: Just like a gorilla mimicking a human with a weapon, the beast, devoid of reason, skillfully pulls the trigger. This evokes thoughts of the primal malice encountered only in barbaric lands.

11007030.desc2: Who even cares if it's sturdy or practical? As long as it looks terrifying and painful, it's good enough!

After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, he gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Industrial Grade Motivation</color> effect. (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100948,1,2} more battles).
11009480.desc2: Anton is in excellent shape, effortlessly moving through chest exercises as if he's powered by endless energy and he's looking for a punching bag to hammer.

412011101.desc2: It's cute, but why do I hear birds calling overhead?

412011102.name: Azure Crane
412011102.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011102.desc2:
The streets filled with warmth, through spring and autumn together under the roof.
Failume Heights community welcomes you.

412011103.name: Jade & Scarlet Knots
412011103.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011103.desc2:
Twin emerald hoops, a scarlet thread entwines our bond.
Twin practitioners of the craft, united in spirit.

412011104.name: Scarlet Blossom Ears
412011104.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011104.desc2: Soft fox ears, adorned with blooming flowers. I'll be able to pass as a Thiren from now on!

412011105.name: Lemme See
412011105.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011105.desc2: Look in my eyes! Put it on, and you'll instantly become a fortune-telling master.

412011106.name: Leisurely Summer
412011106.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011106.desc2: The sea unfurls as it pleases, the foamy waves rippling in the wind. This must be what a relaxed life without worrying about electricity bills feels like.

412011107.name: Azure Spiral
412011107.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011107.desc2: As for the ocean, why not ask the magical seashell on my collar?

412011108.name: Tangerine & Emerald
412011108.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011108.desc2: The dynamic back straps, once fastened, give the illusion of +1 agility.

412011109.name: Zest Against the Tide
412011109.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011109.desc2: What should I do? I feel like I actually want to exercise after putting it on. Does this design have some kind of hypnotic effect?

412011110.name: Emerald Flame Lock
412011110.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011110.desc2: The zipper can't hold back... a Proxy's inner desire to lead the trend.

412011111.name: Waifei Wonder Shades
412011111.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011111.desc2: As a Proxy, wearing photochromic glasses is perfectly reasonable and logical...

412011112.name: Black Cat's Night Hunt
412011112.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011112.desc2: One stroke of green steadies a thousand sails, while the black cat dispels a hundred evils.

412011113.name: Sunken Waves
412011113.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011113.desc2: The Porcelume surface is dusted with blue floral patterns, and golden waves exude a graceful charm.

412011114.name: Mountain Crane Seal
412011114.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011114.desc2: A crane dwells in the mountains, a serpent in the seas. Shielded by mountain and sea, my mystic arts reigns supreme.

412011115.name: Golden Wings Breeze
412011115.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011115.desc2: Wearing the golden feathers, I feel like I can confidently charge higher prices for future orders.

412011116.name: Homebound Frosthelm
412011116.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011116.desc2: I'm daydreaming again. Once I put on this hat, I feel like part of the upper echelons of New Eridu, and I don't have to pay for electricity...

412011117.name: Blazing Charm of Evil Suppression
412011117.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011117.desc2: Gather the radiant energy of the sun to ward off spirits and vanquish fiends.

412011118.name: Resplendent Sunglasses
412011118.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011118.desc2: With eyes that pierce like flame, one beholds the extraordinary; a heart blazing on the right path can scorch the remnants of chaos.

412011119.name: Angels of Doglusion
412011119.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011119.desc2: Braving wind and rain, thinking of Nangong Yu day and night!

412011120.name: Scarlet Snowglow
412011120.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011120.desc2: A white hat pure as snow, red threads like flames, a gleaming silver buckle, and effortlessly flowing mystic power.

412011121.name: Inkdance Blossom
412011121.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011121.desc2: Never touch Senior Sister's tail; one touch and an angel becomes a devil.

412011122.name: Emberfire Serenity
412011122.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011122.desc2: Crimson flames condense into sigils at your side, whirling swordlight keeps calamity at bay.

412011123.name: Split-Broth Mini Hot Pot
412011123.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011123.desc2: Don't listen to my sister — spicy hot pot makes you run hot. A split pot is way healthier.

412011124.name: Shroomy Wealth
412011124.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011124.desc2: I heard the Waifei locals think mushrooms bring in wealth because their round shape looks like coins... so what if I wore one on my head?

412011125.name: Scrutinizing Expenses
412011125.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011125.desc2: If I didn't have a household and a business to run, I wouldn't bother being this frugal.

412011126.name: Prosperity Comes
412011126.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011126.desc2: Pin a cabbage to the chest, and wealth will follow.

412011127.name: Happy Neigh Year
412011127.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011127.desc2: Wishing you peace and prosperity in the Neigh Year! (Speaking of, how am I meant to see in this...)

412011128.name: Delulu Emblem
412011128.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011128.desc2: Beneath the emblem lies my heart, that pounds fiercely for the angels.

412011129.name: Angelic Voice
412011129.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011129.desc2: The angels' voices are going to blow the whole stage wide open. And all you doubters can just... kneel before them!

412011130.name: Heed the Starwish
412011130.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011130.desc2: Listen! This is the sound that will pull you into endless delusion!

412011131.name: Heartbeat Rhythm
412011131.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011131.desc2: Learning to pick up the signals from your heart... sometimes thrilling, sometimes a tiny bit annoying~

412011132.name: Angel Hotline
412011132.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011132.desc2: A cheering heart in flight, tuning the soul to the signal that links it to angels.

412011181.name: The Crane Calls Home
412011181.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011181.desc2: The Cloud Crane soaring through the Nine Heavens keeps its resolve, and Suibian Temple... um... what was it... Suibian Temple is where the mind evolves!

412011182.name: Windguide Talismans
412011182.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011182.desc2: Demons and monsters, Ethereals of the Hollows. With spiritual talismans, victory surely follows.

412011201.name: Accessoriy_412011201
412011201.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.

412011202.name: Accessoriy_412011202
412011202.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.

412011301.name: Whisper Clasp
412011301.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011301.desc2: Time sways softly with every step. Don't forget the quiet murmurs of those long afternoons.

412011302.name: Accessoriy_412011302
412011302.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.

412011303.name: Badge of Aurelia
412011303.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011303.desc2: Put on your academy badge and begin your school days!

412011304.name: Theorem of Laziness
412011304.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011304.desc2: Wearing a bow tie doesn't mean the day has to be hectic.

412011305.name: Fairwind Knot
412011305.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011305.desc2: Legend says in ages past and ages yet to come, little knots could safeguard travelers as they passed through the storm-wracked seas.

412011306.name: Bangboo-tiful Collaboorator
412011306.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011306.desc2:
An amazing headpiece hand-sewn by the little Bangboo to show their gratitude. It's the ultimate symbol of earning Bangboo approval and becoming a true friend of Bangboo. <color=#FFAF2C>Wearing it</color> will let you head into <color=#FFAF2C>Spotlight Theater</color>~

"...Do I really look like a Bangboo right now?"
"En-nha, nhe! (From afar you do. Up close though, just Bangboo-like!)"

412011307.name: Farsight Philosophy
412011307.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011307.desc2: As the saying goes, the higher you stand, the farther you see. But looking down from Roscaelifer... that's REALLY, REALLY high! Aren't people scared of heights up here?!

412011308.name: Mr. Beard
412011308.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011308.desc2: You're allowed to wear earrings at school? Aurelia Academy's dress code is surprisingly relaxed... Oh, and could I have a back-row window seat?

412011309.name: Grace in Motion
412011309.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011309.desc2: The academy's taste in clothing is as dependable as always... Hold on, this bow tie looks like it belongs to Belle?

412011310.name: Sir Panda
412011310.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011310.desc2: Anyone who loves Bangboo can't say no to Sir Panda.

412011311.name: Golden Echoes Player
412011311.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011311.desc2: A portable player made by Golden Echoes Records, whose name and song choices are so good they make you wish you'd found it sooner.

412011312.name: Afternoon at Three
412011312.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011312.desc2: Who exactly decided that Roscaelifer citizens have to start preparing for afternoon tea the moment it hits 3 PM?

412011313.name: Dubi-Meow
412011313.desc: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
412011313.desc2:
An Ether soundwave-resistant headgear developed by the Omond Research Station. Rumor has it that the design was inspired by a Public Security Officer that one of the designers looked up to.
Meow! Now you can explore the Divine Maze too, meow!

<color=#FFAF2C>Billy</color>
<color=#2BAD00>ATK: 30, HP: 10</color>

<color=#FFAF2C>Anton</color>
<color=#2BAD00>ATK: 10, HP: 28</color>

<color=#FFAF2C>Ben</color>
<color=#2BAD00>ATK: 2, HP: 80</color>

<color=#FFAF2C>Tsukishiro Yanagi</color>
